store_data.about_the_game:
Altitude Zero is a short atmospheric and claustrophobic horror experience. Pilot an old hot air balloon through desolate canyons with a single objective: reach and turn off the mysterious drainage stations scattered across the territory.

To survive this journey, which lasts about an hour, you will have to fight against the environment and what hides within it.

Main Features

  • Flight Management: constantly monitor fuel levels and altitude, and keep your thermal balloon in airworthy condition.

  • Hostile Weather: the canyons are battered by powerful and unpredictable winds capable of severely damaging your vehicle.

  • Unknown Threats: you are not alone. Strange and aggressive life forms will threaten your safety along the way.

  • A Retro Horror Atmosphere: a low-poly aesthetic that amplifies the anguish of a desolate and alien world.

Story

A few decades ago, a human spaceship intercepted a mysterious signal in deep space. The recovery of an old black box revealed coordinates leading to a small, remote moon, known for a disturbing detail: an immense sea of blood.

A scientific expedition set out with the goal of draining it to bring to light the secrets hidden beneath its surface, but something did not take kindly to human intervention. Now the mission has failed, the crew has vanished and there is nothing left to do but venture into the canyons to turn off all the drainage stations.

store_data.about_the_game:
Copter Dude

A tiny helicopter. One hook. One life per mistake.

A challenging 2D side-scrolling arcade action game where every hit is fatal.

You control a dude with a tiny helicopter, a fearless pilot armed with nothing but a grappling hook, sharp reflexes, and questionable judgment. Dodge deadly traps and hostile enemies, and master challenging obstacle-filled stages where every crash is fatal.

Which route will get you to the finale first?

Expect a serious challenge. Some stages demand lightning-fast reactions, while others require careful, precise maneuvering through narrow passages and deadly mechanisms. Learn from every crash, perfect your route, and push deeper into the game with every attempt.

Features

  • Multiple routes through the game encourage experimentation, replayability, and discovery.

  • Handcrafted levels filled with traps, enemies, and surprises

  • Copter controls focused on skill and mastery

  • Grappling hook mechanics used for traversal, puzzles, and collecting items

  • Earn extra lives by catching hidden hearts

  • Instant-death gameplay where every mistake matters

  • Fast-paced arcade action mixed with precision flying challenges

  • Original soundtrack packed with energy and personality

  • Humorous presentation and quirky charm

  • Short runs, high replayability, and satisfying mastery

Can you reach the end before your lives run out?

Crash. Learn. Crash. Retry. Conquer.

A game about greed.

Shadow Wizard Money Gang is a fast, absurd, money-obsessed roguelike shooter about magical criminals that go from little rascals with fireballs to time-manipulating reality breaking unstoppable sorcerers. 

Shadow Wizard Money Gang exist for one purpose, live fast, and destroy the SHADOW GOVERNMENT  for what they did to you and the gang. Slowly uncover the urban fantasy world of Shadow Wizard Money Gang and take down the evil powers that be the only way you know how: LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS.

Run missions from your hideout, fight through room-to-room chaos, grab strange loot, open risky chests, play gambling games and build a loadout of spells that turn every run into a bad financial decision. Money is not just score. It is health, spell fuel, reward, risk, progression, and your freedom. 

Go solo or bring a crew. Blow through enemies, gamble with your run money, upgrade your wizard, fight your friends, unlock new spell options, and return to the hideout with enough cash to become a bigger problem next time.

Key Features

Movement shooter-like traversal and possibilities,

Co-op roguelike shooter chaos with fast room-based runs,

Money acts as health, spell fuel, reward, and progression,

First-person spellcasting with spell hands, loadouts, and a spell wheel,

Loot, upgrade chests, enemy rewards, and banked progression,

A customizable hideout hub for hanging out, launching runs, banking rewards, and upgrading your gang,

Designed for replayable runs, strange builds, and multiplayer mess,

And a little bit of story.

store_data.about_the_game:
You already know how to breach; now you will learn how to survive.

Set in the universe of Breachers, Breachers: Outbreak is a 4-player co-op zombie extraction shooter where you and your friends are dropped into infected quarantine zones to recover the key to preventing an undead apocalypse.

This game is fully cross-play with friends across flatscreen and VR, so how you play is up to you!

EXTRACT OR BE OVERRUN

Enter infected hostile zones, upgrade your arsenal, locate Patient X, and prepare for extraction. Equipped with a bone marrow extractor, you and your friends are tasked with collecting the key component to a cure that could stop The Outbreak dead in its tracks.

GEAR UP

Build loadouts around your playstyle with weapons, gadgets, and specialized equipment pulled from the Breachers universe, adapted for surviving the end of the world. Furthermore, choose your perk and add mod chips to your weaponry to achieve terrifying force with which to mow down entire zombie hordes.

ERADICATE THE INFECTED

Is your squad ready to face unpredictable infected encounters, escalating threat levels, and moments where the entire mission turns against you?

WELCOME TO THE OUTBREAK

An ESTF subsidiary biotech company called Photonix experimented with something they shouldn’t have. Whatever they were working on? It got out and turned the living into undead monstrosities. In response, the ESTF is deploying a special division among their ranks, trained to deal with these kinds of threats and contain them. You and your friends are a part of this division.

Band together to fight The Outbreak!

CiVilBrawling is a turn-based strategy card battle game that blends historical civilizations with tactical deck-building. Players choose from the Chinese , Roman , or Egyptian civilizations, assemble a unique 25-card deck, and challenge 20 levels spanning from the Ancient Era to the Information Age.

### Three Civilizations, Each Unique

- Chinese Civilization — Centered around repeating crossbows, armored cavalry, and the Giant Panda, excelling in sustained damage and board control with unique techs like Bamboo Farming and Drone Factory.

- Roman Civilization — Featuring Eagle Guard, Gladiator Legions, and Siege Ballistae, emphasizing frontal assault and legion synergy.

- Egyptian Civilization — Highlighted by Mummy Warriors, the Great Pyramid, and Undead Summoning, specializing in resurrection, summoning, and resource plundering.

- Board Combat — Deploy units on a 7-column dual-row board with land, water, and air unit types countering each other.

- Era Progression — Advance from the Ancient Era through Feudal, Industrial, to the Information Age, unlocking more powerful cards.

- Resource Management — Strategically allocate gold and tech points, balancing card deployment against era advancement.

- Tactical Synergy — Each card features unique effects: direct damage, persistent buffs, resource theft, unit destruction, era restrictions, and more.

- BOSS Challenges — 20 levels, each BOSS with a dedicated deck and AI strategy (defensive/aggressive/balanced), with escalating difficulty.

Assemble your civilization's army, defeat all opponents across the ages, and become the ultimate ruler of civilizations!

4839430.name: The King Got Too Much Gold

store_data.about_the_game:
There is just TOO MUCH GOLD

Your fountain erupts coins all day. They pile up on the grass, they rot, they jam the fountain, and when there are enough of them they weigh you down so much that even the music starts to drag. You cannot die. You cannot fail. But the gold keeps coming, and somebody has to deal with it.

That somebody is you. The King. With a magnet.

 What you actually do

- Walk around the meadow, pull coins in with your magnet, and sell them at the castle

- Every level up deals you 3 upgrade cards. Bigger bag, faster boots, a new hire, or a face-down mystery card if you feel lucky

- Build up your court: robot helpers carry gold, goblins smash crates, trolls grab coins and throw them across the whole map, a plumber keeps the fountain running, a goose lays coins, and the royal cat throws thieves out of the kingdom

- Spend points in the skill web. Cheap upgrades near the center, strange ones at the edges: sell coins by stepping on them, grab coins out of the air, get 4 cards in a draft instead of 3

- Random events mess with the field every few minutes: gold rushes, earthquakes, jackpots, a coin plague, a gold meteor, raider attacks

- Watch out for the thief. Get a cat. Or a troll. Or both.

- At level 100 the Glutton King rises. Pour your entire fortune into him until he bursts. After that, endless mode.

You really can't lose

No death, no fail state, no timer. If the floor fills up, the screen shakes, the King gets slow, the fountain clogs, and the music goes wobbly. Then you clean up and everything is fine again. The game saves your run all the time, so you can quit whenever you want and carry on later.

Features

- A complete run from empty meadow to the level 100 finale, then endless mode

- 28 skill nodes, including keystones that change how the game works instead of just adding percent

- 9 kinds of hired help, each with its own little routine

- 10 random events

- Draft cards on every level up, with paid rerolls when the hand is bad

- Pixel art drawn entirely in code, chiptune soundtrack, controller support

- Constant autosave

- Small download, runs on anything

store_data.about_the_game:
In Scelerophobia, you play as a young kid left alone by his parents while they attend a party.

In regards to this, you are left with a list of chores they asked you to complete before their return.

And those chores will need to be finished before you can enjoy your time alone at home.

From finishing your homework,

to collecting all the trash in the house,

you must work through your tasks step by step.

But as the night goes on, while you try to finish your chores, the wind blows stronger, the shadows hide a pair of eyes in the dark, and the house feels a little less silent.

You will have to try to ignore the thought that you are no longer the only one breathing in this house.

Controls:
walk around: W A S D
Crouch: Crtl
Open Doors: E
Unequip Items: Q
Interact/Talk/Equip: Left Click
Pause: Esc

*Warning: This game forces interaction with external system pop-ups and operating system elements as part of its core psychological experience. And don't stay waiting too long in the menu*

About This Game

Plan your route. Refit your warship. Dodge through the void.

Stardust Protocol is a sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell shooter—the star map is as deadly as the bullets. Choose your path on a branching Star Route: battles, Black Markets, repair bays, and unknown systems. One wrong turn can end the run.

Star-Map Roguelite • Multi-layer star-map nodes: standard fights, elites, boss gates, Black Market systems, satellite supply stations, and unknown events. • Push forward along your route; crash your fighter and the run is over.

Bullet-Hell Combat • Top-down 2D space combat against handcrafted, high-density enemy bullet patterns. • Dodge, manage energy, break shields, and take down flagship bosses.

Meta Progression • Earn Diamonds between runs to permanently upgrade your fighter: damage, fire rate, HP, charge, missiles, weapon slots, wingmen, and more.

In Development • Actively in development. Wishlist now and follow Starzen Interactive for updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

You are no ordinary rat. As the smartest experiment in the laboratory—with a scar to prove it—you are about to execute the ultimate escape plan.

In Cheesty, the human world becomes a gigantic playground filled with equal parts wonder and peril. From high-security labs to your final destination (the legendary rodent paradise you’ve heard so much about), you must use your agility, instincts, and the very tools of your captors to outsmart security and break your way into the outside world.

KEY FEATURES

  • Rodent Wits: Is a scientist blocking your path? Look closely at your surroundings—the environment is your greatest ally.

  • Infiltration & Stealth: Hide in the shadows, crawl through pipes, and learn enemy patrol patterns. A single misstep will alert the staff.

  • Superior Sniffing: Use your sense of smell to guide your path and discover unique collectibles. Though... it won't always be that easy.

  • Dynamic & Varied Levels: Master classic platforming jumps and movements tailored specifically for a rat, and survive frantic alternate sections where you must outrun other dangers.

  • Art with Personality: Immerse yourself in a unique visual narrative through pre-level comic strips inspired by high-contrast comic book art, creating an unforgettable atmosphere of danger and adventure. This, paired with a distinct hand-painted visual style and an original soundtrack composed entirely in-house, ensures an unrepeatable experience in every single level.

ALL THIS AND MUCH MORE AWAITS YOU IN CHEESTY!!!

store_data.about_the_game:
Every step is a trap. Every death is a lesson.

This is not a fair platformer.
The floor collapses. Spikes strike from nowhere. Safe paths become death traps the second you trust them. The only way forward is through failure, memory, and stubborn determination.

🔥 Learn Through Failure
Every level is designed to surprise you. Hidden traps, fake-safe jumps, collapsing platforms, and perfectly timed hazards wait for the exact moment you let your guard down. You will fail. A lot. But every death teaches you something new.

⚠️ Expect the Unexpected
The game constantly plays with your expectations. A harmless wall might crush you. A checkpoint could be bait. A jump you've already survived once may suddenly become deadly. Nothing stays predictable for long.

🎮 Precision Platforming
Tight controls and fast respawns keep the action flowing. Every jump matters, every movement counts, and every mistake is punished instantly. Mastering a level feels less like luck and more like surviving a war against the game itself.

😈 Troll Traps Everywhere
This world hates confidence. The moment you think you've figured the game out, it finds a new way to destroy you. Traps trigger from impossible angles, hazards appear at the perfect worst moment, and every level is built to break your instincts.

🧠 Memorize. Adapt. Survive.
Progress comes from observation and persistence. Watch carefully, remember everything, and slowly turn impossible levels into mastered runs. The path to victory is paved with your previous deaths.

🏆 Satisfaction Earned the Hard Way
Reaching the end of a level is more than completion — it's revenge. Every impossible jump, every unfair trap, every last-second death only makes victory feel better.

💀 Brutal trap-based platforming designed to surprise and punish

⚡ Instant respawns for fast retry-focused gameplay

🧠 Levels built around memory, adaptation, and trial-and-error

🎯 Precision movement and tight platforming controls

store_data.about_the_game:
LeadFall is a fast-paced top-down survival roguelite focused on quick action, enemy waves, weapon upgrades, and chaotic builds. Choose your starting weapon, enter the battlefield, defeat enemies, collect upgrades, and try to survive increasingly dangerous waves.

Every run is about becoming stronger while the pressure keeps rising. Enemies attack from different directions, stronger enemy types appear over time, and each upgrade choice can change how your character fights.

Core Gameplay :

In LeadFall, your goal is simple: survive the enemy waves and grow stronger before the battlefield overwhelms you. Move around the map, avoid enemy attacks, defeat monsters, collect rewards, and upgrade your character during the run.

Combat is built around automatic and active weapon behavior, upgrade choices, and different projectile styles. Weapons can shoot in different patterns such as straight shots, cone spreads, bouncing shots, arc projectiles, returning projectiles, echo shots, and projectiles that break into smaller shots.

Features :

Fast top-down survival gameplay
Wave-based enemy spawning with increasing difficulty
Multiple enemy types, including weaker enemies, stronger enemies, elite enemies, special enemies, and bosses
Different starting weapons to choose from

Weapon upgrades that change damage, speed, projectile behavior, and combat style
Special cards and effects that can change each run
Different projectile styles such as bouncing, spreading, returning, arcing, splitting, and echo shots
Local progression through unlocks, upgrades, and high score improvement
Multiple maps with different enemy setups
Score-based runs focused on replayability.

Build Your Run :

Each run gives you choices that can make your character stronger in different ways. You can focus on damage, movement, projectile count, special effects, survivability, or weapon behavior. Some upgrades are simple stat boosts, while others create unique effects that change how you fight.

Special upgrade effects can create unusual run combinations, such as decoys, charged shots, temporary buffs and curses, defensive effects, or faster-paced combat moments.

Enemies and Challenges

The longer you survive, the harder the game becomes. Enemy waves grow more dangerous, stronger enemies begin to appear. You must keep moving, choose upgrades carefully, and use the space around you to avoid getting surrounded.

Who Is This Game For?

LeadFall is made for players who enjoy short, replayable survival runs, roguelite upgrades, simple controls, and fast combat. Each run is designed to be easy to start but harder to master as the waves become more intense.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Pitch Girls》 is a full-motion video strategy football game. You take on the role of Coach Ren Xing and manage the entire women’s national football team. Fight your way through qualifying rounds and compete against distinctive top women’s teams across the globe. It restores classic command-based football gameplay, including dribbling, bursting past defenders, short passes, long balls, fancy feints, charged shots and aerial duels. Every offensive decision and defensive arrangement determines the match outcome. There is no mindless stat advantage. Victory relies on tactical combinations, countering opponents’ player traits and well-timed special moves, bringing back the unique strategic fun of retro football games.

Backstory

Coach Ren Xing takes over an underperforming national women’s football team at a critical moment, aiming to compete in the Women’s World Cup. The qualifying and group stages are filled with hardships: frequent player injuries, internal team friction, tactical suppression by strong rivals and constant public doubt. Instead of imposing harsh pressure, Ren Xing patiently identifies every player’s weaknesses and strengths, creates customized training plans, relieves the athletes’ mental stress, joins extra training and match reviews with them, and leads the team to overcome countless obstacles side by side.

Through countless days and matches spent fighting together, the players have developed deep trust and affection for the gentle and reliable Ren Xing. United as one, the team stages repeated comebacks against powerful opponents and finally claims the World Cup championship trophy. After the celebration fades, the players set aside their hesitation and confess their long-hidden feelings one after another to Ren Xing, the coach who guided their growth and saved the team.

Game Features

Full-Motion Video Game with Real-Time Character Control

Players may control athletes in real time during football matches.

Command-Based Strategy Gameplay

Players freely assign all kinds of football commands to characters.

Dynamic Adaptive Challenges

Match difficulty varies based on tournament progress and player development stats.

Stat-Driven Strategy System

Diverse character growth stats interact with different match commands to generate varied success probabilities.

store_data.about_the_game:
The seas rose and the surface is gone. What's left of us holds on in hab-shells: salvaged homes anchored in the dark, overgrown by a sea that moves into anything warm that stays still. Every fathom takes something back.

One dive, one shell

You raid a shell in a short deckbuilding run. Fight through its chambers, and at each extraction point choose whether to surface with what you've got or push deeper for a richer haul. At the core waits the Pressure-Heart; crack it for the full harvest. The shells you dive are generated enemy bases, each one read by the faction that built it.

Three ways to dive

The solo dives are the heart of the game. Open Descent is the main run, generated shells set to the Pressure you choose. Daily Signal is one shared shell, the same for every diver that day. Endless Descent drops the floor and lets the Pressure climb until you break, once you've earned the way down.

Build a shell others raid

Between dives you build your own shell and lay out its defenses. While you're offline, real divers raid it, and you read the report when you surface. Climb a ranked seasonal ladder against players in your range. The rivals you face are real divers, never bots; when no one is near your rank, the board says so instead of inventing an opponent.

Pick your answer to the drowning

Four factions, four answers to the rising water, and you belong to one. The Hold seals its shell and outlasts everything, betting the water climbs forever. The Stilled live inside a dead leviathan's carcass and call it holy. The Bellows holds the last working air plant and rules by the leash, all railguns and harpoons. The Severed lost their crew and trust the swarm and the open water. Every faction draws on the Flotsam pool, the cast-off divers' common gear.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tactical, turn-based combat

Fight on a grid where positioning decides everything. Manage action and movement points, exploit line of sight, and place your units before each fight. Every spell carries an element Fire, Water, Earth, Air and striking a status of another element detonates it into a reaction: steam bursts, landslides, spreading burns, drained action points. Six reactions, and they cut both ways: enemies can detonate your statuses too.

Build your squad — from one to four

Choose your starting character. That choice is permanent for your save. Earn tickets across runs to unlock team slots and recruit new members, up to a squad of four:

  • Smokejail — Fire. Stacks burns on everything he touches, then detonates them all at once.

  • DonCorleone — Air. Hunts weakened targets. Every kill refunds him — and he keeps going.

  • Marron — Earth. Summons muscle, holds the line, shields the squad.

  • Amwet — Water. Control, sustain, and the only one who can bring the fallen back.

Each character has a passive and 8 spells — you equip 4. New spells unlock as they level, capped by a class ultimate. Characters gain experience that persists forever: allocate stat points, level your spells, shape each one into your build.

Loot. Craft. Break. Forge.

Monsters drop resources, gold and gear. Random chests hold more. Craft items with randomly rolled stats — then decide: equip it, or break it into runes. Runes feed the forge. Ten identical items fuse into one of higher rarity. Everything you find is either power now or fuel for something better.

Between fights, pick one of three run upgrades, from common to build-defining — some appear only when a specific character is in your squad, and the rarest can bring a fallen one back.

The Forge: gamble your stats

Spend runes to push an item's stats beyond their limits. Every attempt has four outcomes — clean success, success with collateral damage, nothing, or pure loss — and all four probabilities are displayed before you commit. No hidden math. Sacrifice heavy stats to bank a reserve, push lines past their crafted maximum, and know exactly what you're risking on every roll.

The descent doesn't end. You do.

Runs are procedurally generated and endless: waves of fights, then a boss, then harder waves, then a harder boss. A fallen character is gone for the rest of the run — unless you're holding a rare resurrection. When the whole squad falls, your equipment is lost. Your characters' levels, your roster and your unlocks endure. Go back down stronger.

Key features

  • Turn-based tactical combat on a grid, with a placement phase before every fight

  • 4 elements, 6 elemental reactions — symmetric, exploitable by both sides

  • 4 playable characters with distinct kits: passive + 8 spells, 4 equipped

  • Persistent character progression: levels, free stat allocation, spell leveling

  • Squad building through a meta skill tree — start alone, end as a team of four

  • Full loot economy: craft, equip, break into runes, fuse rarities

  • Between every fight: pick 1 of 3 upgrades across 5 rarities, plus random chests with rarities to crack open

  • The Forge: high-risk stat gambling with every probability displayed

  • Endless procedural runs with cycling, escalating bosses

  • Permadeath per character, rare resurrections, gear lost on a wipe

  • Run upgrades can be character-exclusive — your squad shapes what you're offered

Choose your starting character. That choice is permanent for your save. Earn tickets across runs to unlock team slots and recruit new members, up to a squad of four:

  • Smokejail — Fire. Stacks burns on everything he touches, then detonates them all at once.

  • DonCorleone — Air. Hunts weakened targets. Every kill refunds him — and he keeps going.

  • Marron — Earth. Summons muscle, holds the line, shields the squad.

  • Amwet — Water. Control, sustain, and the only one who can bring the fallen back.

Each character has a passive and 8 spells — you equip 4. New spells unlock as they level, capped by a class ultimate. Characters gain experience that persists forever: allocate stat points, level your spells, shape each one into your build.

Loot. Craft. Break. Forge.

Monsters drop resources, gold and gear. Random chests hold more. Craft items with randomly rolled stats — then decide: equip it, or break it into runes. Runes feed the forge. Ten identical items fuse into one of higher rarity. Everything you find is either power now or fuel for something better.

Between fights, pick one of three run upgrades, from common to build-defining — some appear only when a specific character is in your squad, and the rarest can bring a fallen one back.

The Forge: gamble your stats

Spend runes to push an item's stats beyond their limits. Every attempt has four outcomes — clean success, success with collateral damage, nothing, or pure loss — and all four probabilities are displayed before you commit. No hidden math. Sacrifice heavy stats to bank a reserve, push lines past their crafted maximum, and know exactly what you're risking on every roll.

The descent doesn't end. You do.

Runs are procedurally generated and endless: waves of fights, then a boss, then harder waves, then a harder boss. A fallen character is gone for the rest of the run — unless you're holding a rare resurrection. When the whole squad falls, your equipment is lost. Your characters' levels, your roster and your unlocks endure. Go back down stronger.

Key features

  • Turn-based tactical combat on a grid, with a placement phase before every fight

  • 4 elements, 6 elemental reactions — symmetric, exploitable by both sides

  • 4 playable characters with distinct kits: passive + 8 spells, 4 equipped

  • Persistent character progression: levels, free stat allocation, spell leveling

  • Squad building through a meta skill tree — start alone, end as a team of four

  • Full loot economy: craft, equip, break into runes, fuse rarities

  • Between every fight: pick 1 of 3 upgrades across 5 rarities, plus random chests with rarities to crack open

  • The Forge: high-risk stat gambling with every probability displayed

  • Endless procedural runs with cycling, escalating bosses

  • Permadeath per character, rare resurrections, gear lost on a wipe

  • Run upgrades can be character-exclusive — your squad shapes what you're offered
store_data.short_description: Die and you lose ALL your gear and half your loot. Vicelock is a tactical turn-based roguelite: build a squad, win the grid, then forge & trade your loot on a player-run market. 3 acts, then endless escalating bosses.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD YOUR OWN HOSTING COMPANY

Start with an empty business and take your first step into the world of hosting.

You begin with a limited budget, a small workspace, and only a few pieces of equipment. Your first goal is to build your own hosting startup by creating the basic infrastructure needed to serve customers. Buy server cases, place rack systems, and prepare your first working systems.

Over time, you can reinvest the money you earn into your company, build more powerful systems, increase your service capacity, and turn your small startup into a growing hosting company.

BUILD AND GROW YOUR STARTUP

Every big company starts with a small idea. In Hosting Simulator, you start your own startup from scratch and grow it step by step.

In the early stages, you need to make the right decisions with a low budget. Which equipment you buy, which services you offer, how you set your prices, and where you invest your earnings are all under your control.

As you succeed, you can improve your startup, reach more customers, expand your infrastructure, and grow from a small business into a professional data center operation.

ASSEMBLE AND UPGRADE YOUR SERVERS

Servers are more than just cases. The performance of each system depends on the hardware installed inside it.

Choose processors, RAM, storage drives, power supplies, fans, and other components to build your own server systems. More powerful hardware provides better performance, but it also means higher costs and increased energy consumption.

With every upgrade decision, you need to balance performance, price, and operating expenses carefully.

CREATE HOSTING PACKAGES

Create your own packages to offer different hosting services to your customers.

Meet different customer needs with Web Hosting, VPS, VDS, Game Server, and Dedicated Server services. Set package prices, calculate resource requirements, and plan the most profitable services for your company.

Cheap packages may attract more customers, but poor pricing can reduce your profit. That is why each package should be carefully designed according to both customer demand and operating costs.

LICENSES AND INFRASTRUCTURE UPGRADES

Strengthen your infrastructure with licenses to offer more advanced services.

Purchase licenses such as Virtualization, DDoS Protection, Web Panel, and Game Panel to provide more professional solutions to your customers. You can also buy public IP addresses to increase your service capacity and serve more customers at the same time.

The right licenses and infrastructure upgrades play an important role in the growth of your company.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Manage your hosting company alone or grow it together with your friends.

With co-op support, you can share tasks, set up servers together, manage orders faster, and develop your company through joint decisions.

While one player prepares server cases, another can organize rack systems, manage hosting packages, or handle customer orders. With the right division of work, you can grow your company faster and more efficiently.

store_data.about_the_game:
In search of adventure, you and your friends set out to explore an abandoned mine. After a sudden collapse, you become separated from the group and, while searching for a way back to the surface, discover something that should never have existed.

Deep beneath the earth lies a secret Soviet research complex whose existence was never officially acknowledged. Decades ago, the facility was completely isolated from the outside world, and all information about the experiments conducted there vanished without a trace.Explore abandoned laboratories and tunnels as you uncover the history of the complex. Project Collie was created to grant a living creature intelligence and freedom from death.

The deeper you descend underground, the more questions arise. Why was the complex sealed off? What happened to its personnel? And is everything buried beneath the mountain truly dead?

Buried Life is an atmospheric first-person adventure featuring exploration, puzzles, and psychological horror elements.

Features

• An abandoned Soviet research complex hidden from the outside world for decades.

• The secrets of Project Collie and Project Newtonia, buried deep underground.

• Exploration of laboratories, mines, and technical tunnels.

• Documents, tapes, and recordings that reveal the fate of the complex.

• Interactive environments and hidden secrets.

• Choices that influence the outcome of the story.

• An atmospheric adventure with psychological horror elements.

store_data.about_the_game:
A relentless, momentum-driven, narrative-first shooter, where you pilot J-L, half-human, half-robot protagonist, in a futuristic earth where humanity has lost its place as rulers of the world, and something far less forgiving has taken the throne.

STORY

To J-L, a Droid, it doesn't matter. All he has to do is complete the missions given to him by his Boss, then head back to the recharge station. Labor work, assassination, one-man-army he's done it all. But now, with a new danger around the corner, the Boss interrupts his charging hours, sending J-L into the most dangerous and brutal mission he has ever received,

Dive deep into this world, running across factories, cyberpunk cities, dream worlds, and many other futuristic and intriguing locations. Slashing, shooting and exploding hundreds of robots that stand in your way, speeding through levels designed to keep your momentum going, with many different and unique weapons, dashing and slowing time, sliding and climbing walls, running across buildings, kill those that stand in your way and complete your mission. And maybe... just maybe, one day you will be set free.

store_data.about_the_game:
History is not lost—it waits to be restored.

Step into the role of a relic restorer and breathe new life into treasures from ancient civilizations. Carefully assemble scattered fragments, reveal the complete form of forgotten artifacts, and uncover the stories they carry through time.

Each restored piece enriches your museum collection, allowing visitors to rediscover the beauty, craftsmanship, and legacy of the past. From delicate jade ornaments and elegant ceramics to mysterious bronzes and ancient paintings, every artifact offers a new puzzle to solve and a new chapter of history to revisit.

Take your time, enjoy the soothing atmosphere, and experience the quiet satisfaction of preserving what history left behind.

Features:

• Relaxing yet engaging fragment-based puzzle gameplay
• Restore a wide variety of artifacts inspired by ancient civilizations
• Explore themed museums and expand your collection
• Hand-painted storybook visuals with a cozy atmosphere
• Learn the stories behind each relic as history gradually unfolds
• Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful, stress-free experiences

store_data.about_the_game:
VOIDRAVE is an arcade bullet hell shoot 'em up wrapped in a Lovecraftian nightmare. What begins as a routine purge mission becomes a descent into the body of a sleeping god - and the deeper you go, the more the void notices you.

▶ FIGHT THE ORGANS OF A GOD

100 waves. 20 unique hand-crafted pixel bosses, each with its own attack patterns: lasers, gravity wells, homing swarms, time distortion, and a mirror that throws your own bullets back at you. They are not an invading species. They are something's anatomy.

▶ MUTATE OR DIE

  • Choose 1 of 3 Mutations every 10 waves - ricochet bullets, vampiric kills, glass cannon builds and more. Every run plays differently.

  • 4 playable ships with unique special abilities: EMP Burst, Phase Shift, Shield Wall, Overcharge.

  • Upgrade shop with drones, crits and the limitless VOID OVERCHARGE for late-game power.

  • Unstable wave mutators keep every sector unpredictable.

▶ PURE ARCADE DNA

  • Combo and graze scoring with a global online leaderboard.

  • Overdrive meter, screen-clearing bombs, dash with invincibility frames.

  • Beat wave 100 and unlock ENDLESS MODE - the void never ends.

  • BOSS RUSH: defeat bosses in campaign to unlock a gauntlet mode - fight them all back-to-back with mutations and shops between rounds.

  • Authentic CRT visuals: scanlines, bloom and chromatic aberration (all toggleable).

  • Synthwave-flavored FM soundtrack. Full keyboard rebinding. Xbox controller support.

▶ THE VOID IS LISTENING

The transmissions degrade. Your commander's voice begins answering questions you haven't asked. And something at the bottom of sector 50 has been waiting - not for humanity. For you.

Stop the heart. Outfly the god. End the dream.

store_data.about_the_game:
After a long absence, Silas Reed returns to Dry Creek… but something feels wrong.

The silence is too heavy, the streets too empty. And no explanation awaits him upon his return.

In this isolated town of the Old West, everything feels frozen in time. Landmarks seem to vanish, places are deserted, and a growing sense of unease slowly sets in.

Very quickly, what was meant to be a simple return home turns into a disturbing mystery, where every moment deepens doubt and uncertainty.

Les Ombres de Dry Creek offers an immersive narrative experience focused on atmosphere, mystery, and the inexplicable. The first entry in a two-part story, this adventure takes you deep into the secrets of Dry Creek and its most unsettling enigmas. While this story provides a complete experience on its own, some answers will be revealed in the second episode, Les Lumières de Dry Creek, currently planned for late 2026 / early 2027.

The game lasts approximately 45 minutes, featuring nearly 70 illustrated scenes accompanied by immersive sound design that enhances the tension and atmosphere of the narrative.

This project was developed solo by an independent developer passionate about video games, following an artisanal approach focused on storytelling and atmosphere.

A short experience, playable in a single sitting, where the past and the inexplicable intertwine without immediately revealing all their answers, set within a larger and mysterious universe.

store_data.about_the_game:
A mission gone awry. A world pushed to the brink.

Crash-landing on a strange planet was just the beginning of Lyra’s nightmare. Stranded deep within uncharted territory, she discovers the Taurids—a brutal, hostile alien race aggressively harvesting the planet's core resources.

Outnumbered and outgunned, Lyra's survival depends on her agility and wits. Navigate a beautiful but deadly alien ecosystem by scaling cliffs, leaping across chasms, and using fluid parkour movement to stay out of sight. Outmaneuver the high-tech Taurid patrols, study their patterns, and use the verticality of the terrain to engineer your escape.

Key Features:

  • Fluid Parkour & Verticality: Run, jump, climb, and vault your way through treacherous environments. Use momentum and agility to cross dangerous terrain and escape tight situations.

  • Tense Evasion Gameplay: Stay one step ahead of the ruthless Taurids. Utilize the vertical landscape to break line-of-sight and slip past deadly patrol units lurking below.

  • True Alien Perspective: Experience a sci-fi survival story from the eyes of Lyra, an alien explorer navigating a universe where she is the outsider.

  • A Beautifully Hostile World: Explore an uncharted planet filled with unique ecosystems, dangerous heights, and the atmospheric tension of a hostile occupation.

From The Developers: Our Debut & Passion for Godot

A Note From Our Small Team: Dayless Games is a small, independent team, and this is our very first commercial game! Driven by a passion for open-source tech, we chose to build this entire 3D world—including its fluid parkour and movement mechanics—inside the Godot Engine.

While Godot is traditionally famous for 2D, we wanted to push the boundaries of its 3D capabilities to prove what a dedicated indie team can achieve with the engine. By wishlisting and playing our debut title, you are directly supporting independent, open-source game development. Thank you for taking this journey with Lyra!

store_data.about_the_game:
東方天流宮 ～ Heavenly Gathering of Clouds is a fan-made Touhou Project game made using the Touhou Danmakufu ph3sx shooting game engine and is the third game made by Team Dream Compass with the direction of Studio Nenem. This project is a video game adaptation of the fan-made album of the same name, and features plenty of exciting never-seen-before content. Join Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, and Youmu Konpaku, as they explore the diverse biomes of Gensokyo while looking for the cause of this intense rainfall.

Story

Swords had gone missing from places all across the land.The sword of Kusanagi, tucked away at Kourindou, was among them. And at the same time, a vast pool of water spread across the sky. The water that spilled from it rained down on Gensokyo without end. A gigantic sea spread out up in the sky. Together with that sea, she was there. She still has no idea just what kind of disaster her presence is bringing to the world below...

Game Introduction

Heavenly Gathering of Clouds is a vertical-scrolling shoot'em-up game built upon the classic Touhou formula of six main stages and an unlockable extra stage. Each character has a set of two shot types, plus a unique ability linked to gameplay. With four different difficulty levels, this game can be enjoyed from casual players to skilled STG maniacs alike. You'll be able to dodge actual rain on the highest difficulty, really! If you can't beat all those hoarders, why not join in on the fun? The game features Gathering Mode - an engaging mechanic that encourages you to collect as many items as possible. With the simplicity of a system from a classic Touhou game and the sprinkle of creativity, you'll be able to seamlessly play through the game with a mechanic that encourages both scoring and survival. Greed is usually not encouraged, but who cares? Go wild and aim for a sky-high high score!

store_data.about_the_game:
Prepare to cross the threshold into a ruined world, where ancient magic and ancestral chaos clash in battles to the death. Gatebound: Chronicles of Valor is a Fantasy Arena Action RPG, step into battle, annihilate legions of darkness, collect invaluable loot, and rise as the ultimate hero.

Classes: Find Your Combat Style

Begin your journey exploring 3 powerful base classes, then evolve by mastering one of their 9 lethal Specializations:

Warrior: Relentless and lethal in close quarters, crushing enemies and defending the group with sheer brute force.

  • Paladin: A divine protector. Sacrifices mobility for sacred defenses to punish heretics with holy light.

  • Berserker: The embodiment of unbridled fury. Foregoes caution to inflict colossal damage, turning the pain of battle into unstoppable rage.

  • Death Knight: A dark sovereign who dominates shadow arts to weaken, terrify, and drain the life essence from enemies, thriving amidst the chaos.

Mage: A master of arcane arts who rends enemy defenses by conjuring devastating spells.

  • Pyromancer: A fire mage who summons infernos of blazing ashes, causing immense area-of-effect damage over time.

  • Cryomaner: A frost mage and brilliant tactician who slows, blocks, and paralyzes enemy hordes to control the battlefield.

  • Electromancer: Bends the energy of storms to unleash lightning-fast electrical magic and devastating chain-lightning for high bursts of damage per second.

Rogue: An indomitable specialist relying on agility to survive, with high mobility to execute targets and quickly fade away.

  • Hunter: Master of archery and primal abilities. Prefers keeping distance, controlling the flow of battle.

  • Shadow Trickster: Embraces paranormal shades. Manifests the power of darkness, while brutally draining the soul of those who dare approach.

  • Storm Ranger: A hybrid wanderer who weaves stormy ice, and lightning, combining extreme mobility with the lethal.

Deep Loot & Equipment

Your progression is defined by what you can tear from the corpses of your adversaries. A deep progression system will keep you constantly hunting for perfection:

  • Endless Loot: Collect weapons, helmets, and armor of every rarity (from Common to Legendary).

  • Mythic Weapons: Seek out Mythic weapons, extremely rare cosmic relics of catastrophic power. Tools like the Shadow Fang or the Greatsword of the Eclipse grant potent Innate Abilities capable of healing critical damage, devouring souls, or unleashing lightning storms on your enemies!

Boss Fights, Immersive Arenas & Dungeons

  • Survive haunted dungeons or delve into the corrupted depths of the universe to fight unwavering undeads, colossal monsters, and ravenous entities.

  • Face fearsome bosses, fight on the mountaintops to challenge majestic and deadly ancient dragons, or face its general in the bowels of hell.

A Devastating Endgame: No Rest for the Strong

Have you reached the maximum level? The real challenge has just begun. Push past mortal limits with Endgame challenges designed for the most devoted warriors:

Trial of the Gods: A lethal wave-based arena, with no pauses and no checkpoints. Face the arena itself turning hostile against you through powerful Divine Modifiers. Fight suspended in the Celestial Pinnacle, survive the deadly Emerald Sanctuary, or dominate the Resonating Crystal Forest. Prove your valor and take on increasingly higher level challenges.

Are you ready? Sharpen your blade, prepare your spells. The end of the world awaits its new hero.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Tragic Illusion: Dancer Clara Dead After On-Stage Stabbing During Live Performance. The head magician, Albert, remains hospitalized with severe head trauma. Witnesses report the prop knife had been swapped for a real blade..."


You are Albert. You don't remember who that is. You don't remember the woman in the photograph, even though someone has scratched out her eyes with a pin. You don't remember the circus, the stage, or why your hands won't stop shaking. But when you close your eyes, you see a knife and you feel something worse than guilt. You feel relief.

Wander through corridors that stretch and loop the moment you look away. The rooms behind you are not the rooms you left. Pick up old photographs, torn letters, and ruined props turn them over in your hands, inspect every angle, every scribbled note. The answer to what happened during "The Final Show" is here, buried in the debris of a mind that doesn't want to remember. Or can't. Or won't.

You are not alone. Someone is watching from the rafters. He saw what you did, and he hasn't forgiven you.

Walk softly. The floor is littered with traps, step on the wrong thing and every sound you make becomes a beacon. Breathe quietly. Run too long and your gasps will betray you before your footsteps do. Don't look up. When the sandbag falls, you won't hear it coming.

A first-person psychological horror experience. Approximately 1 hour of gameplay. An original ambient soundtrack with reactive audio.

THE SHOW NEVER ENDED

Welcome to the Crypt Club! Where all things spooky and otherworldly are of grave importance to you and your members, which is why you and up to three other friends will be venturing deep into an obscure cave system in search of an occult artifact you've heard whispers about.

Explore procedurally generated caves and shifting layouts in this first-person cooperative horror experience, where your goal is to reach the end of the cave, relic in hand. Use leftover items scattered around to help you on your descent, survive encounters with an unknown horror, and work with your team to find scattered pages that alter the environment as you progress.

Procedurally Generated Caves

No two runs are alike with procedural map generation shifting the layout, rooms, and contents within for every run! Work with your team to chart the area and find the way forward.

Avoid a Spooky Monster

Something lurks within the caves and is very territorial, so make sure to sneak, hide, or run away to avoid being grabbed or attacked.

Collect Tome Pages

Torn tome pages litter the cave, and are your means of escape! Use them to conduct dark rituals to create pathways forward and descend further. Be warned, each page has a temporarily lingering effect that will shape the challenges you face section to section. From spookier caves to a cleverer monster, choose wisely when progressing (or don't!).

4-Player Co-op

Play online with up to three other friends to round out the full squad! Experiences are best shared with friends after all, even if terrifying.

Descend & Escape

Go deeper into the caves as you look for your cool occult keepsake, as your club will need to survive several sections of caves in order to reach the final area. There's only one way out, if you live to see it.

Use Various Items

Find trinkets and items throughout the caves that can aid you on your journey! From band-aids and snacks, to a sick boombox to worthless rocks, there's a little something for everyone.

Features List:

  • Procedurally Generation

  • Character Customization

  • Up to 4-Player Online Co-op

  • Usable Items

  • Scary Lurking Monster

  • Stealth Mechanics

  • Modifier System

  • Environmental Hazards

store_data.about_the_game:
THE INDUCTED

They do not want you to die.
They want to see what you become under pressure.

The Inducted is a third person cooperative arena survival game about surviving staged combat trials inside a rebuilt ancient colosseum.

The Arena was once a place of ritual combat, punishment, and spectacle. It was abandoned for centuries, buried in dust and silence.

Then someone found it.

An advanced faction rebuilt the Arena into a controlled combat machine. Gates seal behind you. Spawn systems wake beneath the floor. Observation tiers fill with people you never see clearly. Every fight is recorded. Every choice is measured.

You are one of The Inducted.

Some were taken without warning. Some chose this for reward, freedom, or someone waiting at home. The Arena does not care why you came. It only cares what you can survive.

FIGHT AS A HERO WITH A PURPOSE

Each hero brings a distinct combat role to the trial.

The Crusader holds the front line with shield, sword, and explosive close range power. The Engineer turns the Arena against itself by placing turrets, locking down choke points, and building defenses before the next wave begins.

More heroes are coming, each designed to change how your team survives.

SURVIVE CONTROLLED TRIALS

The waves are not random. They are staged experiments.

Every gate that opens brings a new test. More enemies. Tighter pressure. Less room for mistakes. The faction is studying how long you last, how quickly you adapt, and what happens when the plan falls apart.

Between trials, use the prep phase to recover, build, reposition, and prepare for the next escalation.

USE THE ARENA AGAINST THEM

The Arena gives you tools, but not mercy.

Activate turret pylons. Place defensive panels. Create choke points. Protect weak angles. Buy your team enough time to survive the next wave.

The faction installed these systems because longer fights create better data.

Use them anyway.

STAND TOGETHER OR BREAK ALONE

Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

The Arena rewards coordination. A shield in the right place can save a teammate. A turret placed before the gates open can turn a collapse into a hold. A bad call can leave everyone surrounded.

The gates do not close.

The trials do not stop.

Someone is always watching.

The Inducted is currently in development. Wishlist now to follow progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
A mystery-focused otome game that blends narrative investigation with crime simulation mechanics.

Featuring four romanceable male characters, the game offers nine major endings, including romantic endings with each love interest, two independent endings in which the protagonist solves the final case alone, and numerous bad endings.

Unlike many traditional otome games, you are not required to reshape your personality or choices to win someone's affection. Relationships grow naturally through the story, with affection developing through both the main narrative and optional character events.

Most importantly, the way you pursue the truth is entirely up to you. Decide how to investigate, whom to trust, and how to execute the murders that drive the story forward. Every choice brings you closer to a different ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
The years of wait are finally over. DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition) is a bold reimagining of the original DVD Screensaver, originally realease in 2000.

This critically-acclaimed game, which mixes traditional bouncing simulation and real-time action, makes its Steam debut along with DSSRRDRSIUHDLCR2027─a new story arc featuring Duckward Vegaris Dunzle.

The Legend is Back

Return to the battlefield in this faithful remake of the genre-defining game. Explore hand-crafted, organic game that reacts dynamically to actions. Whether you're a seasoned DVD simulator veteran or this is your first time being thrown into the game, you're in for a true gaming experience with unrestricted exploration like no other.

Gorgeously rendered graphics

With Godot Engine 4, expansive stages are rendered with cutting-edge technology. Incredible new graphics bring the wild growth of the environment to life in exquisite detail. Characters are rendered in such fine detail.

The Genre-Defining Action, Better than Ever

DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition) includes critically acclaimed remaster of DVD Screensaver and its Revenge of Burn® expansion, together with the brand-new Reign of the Logo DLC.

Journey through the Hell-scarred land of Scanlines; faithfully preserved and enhanced with modern 2D graphics, remastered audio, and updated cinematics.

The included Reign of the Logo DLC expands upon DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Integrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition) experience with the brand-new DVD+RW DL class, an overhauled endgame, fresh mechanics, and modern quality-of-life updates.

Refined, Not Reimagined 

DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition) includes powerful quality-of-life updates without compromising DVD Screensaver iconic feel. The new customizable Disc Filter reduces screen clutter, helping you identify the gear that matters the most to you. Managing resources across characters is also easier that ever with updated DVD Binder Tabs, including dedicated tabs for loot for quick sorting.

Feeling nostalgic? Switch freely between eras and experience DVD screensaver the way you remember.

■A Beloved Tale with a Streamlined Narrative

DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition) blends a beautiful art style with Susan Kolowski's iconic designs to make very encounter feel vibrant, heartfelt, and full of adventure. From lush environments and whimsical characters, every environment is bursting with color and personality.

The genre-defining masterpiece DVD Screensaver returns, completely rebuilt from the ground up for a deeper narrative experience. Using Godot's proprietary Godot Engine, DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition) offers a fresh take on the classic saga with breathtaking realistic visuals, heart-pounding immersive audio, a new camera, and modernized controls on top of gameplay mopdes from the original game.

store_data.about_the_game:
A great magical catastrophe has shattered the peace of the Rhu Archipelago. Its inhabitants are displaced as corruption and toxic magic rain down from the sky. Become an enchanter for Enchanted Oceans Inc., equipped with the tools and magical talents to save the day. Cleanse the corruption from the land and beneath the waves and bring life back to this once thriving oceanic community! Learn to harness the magical energy corrupting the land and use it to help breath life back into the archipelago once again.

Sail the Archipelago

Take control of your own enchanted ship, fully equipped to handle every challenge. Navigate treacherous seas with a dynamic weather and wave system, transport cargo and supplies between islands, or use your crane to lift wreckage off the sea floor. Your fully upgradable magical ship is your lifeline and best tool to help restore the environment. Be sure to manage your hull integrity or you may find yourself on the bottom of the ocean yourself.

Explore the Ocean Depths

Dive beneath the waves with a realistic SCUBA diving system. Manage both your air supply and the nitrogen building in your blood to survive and avoid the getting the bends. Purge the corruption spreading across the land, twisting everything it touches into decay and death. Watch the world come alive and life return to the oceans as you cleanse them. Once restored, cast your fishing rod to try your luck catching the big one.

store_data.about_the_game:
Barrels are never where they should be!

2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved.

Features

• Classic sokoban puzzle gameplay

• Beer-powered gate breaking mechanic

• Handcrafted puzzles

• Unlimited undo

• No timers or move limits

• Hand-drawn pixel art

• 8-bit soundtrack

Gameplay

You push barrels across a grid, one tile at a time. Barrels can only be pushed, never pulled. Back one into a corner or against a wall and it's stuck, so every move is worth thinking through.

Your main obstacle is the gates blocking the way. To break a gate, the dwarf drinks a mug of beer. But it's strictly one mug at a time: drink, break one gate, drink again, break the next. And there's usually less beer on a level than there are gates, so part of the puzzle is deciding which gates to break, and in what order.

There are no clocks and no move counters, so there's never any rush. And if you slip up, any action can be undone, which means you'll never have to restart a whole level over a single misplaced barrel.

Graphics and sound

Hand-drawn pixel art in the spirit of old consoles, with a handful of 8-bit tracks for the right retro mood.

  • Narrative-driven suspense and psychological tension

store_data.about_the_game:
Let Her Stay on Your Desktop

Luo Ci Jian is an AI character companion app for Windows desktops.

The character appears on your desktop as an animated presence, keeping you company while you study, work, draw, or play other games. There is no need to open a traditional chat webpage — you can start a conversation at any time.

More Than Just a Chat Window

Interact with the character through text and experience responses shaped by her own personality and way of expression.

The character generates replies based on her character settings, the current conversation, and parts of her interaction memory, making conversations feel more coherent and allowing different characters to show distinct personalities.

Lively Character Expression

The character can respond to interactions through animated models, motions, and facial expressions.

You can freely adjust the character’s position, size, and display status, placing her in the area of your desktop that best suits your own usage.

Import Your Own Characters

With the local Mod import feature, you can add compatible character content and configure character settings and related resources.

Whether you want to enjoy the built-in character or create your own collection of desktop companions, you can choose freely according to your personal preferences.

Please Note Before Use

AI conversation features require an internet connection. AI conversation, screen-context responses, code or technical text generation, and other AI-assisted features consume in-app Memory Points. Users receive initial bonus points and monthly bonus points. Additional Memory Points can be purchased in the application through Steam Wallet if needed. AI response quality, response speed, and service availability may vary depending on network conditions, server status, and model availability.

store_data.about_the_game:
Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

This is a short game!

Estimated completion time of 1 hour, give or take. 

Map

The park includes three buildings, and each building hosts three of the nine challenges. 

You start at the park gate (bottom of map) and work your way up through the buildings as you attempt to complete all nine challenges in a row. If you make a mistake, you return back to the first challenge (either by walking if you fail any of challenges 1-3, or by taking the train if you fail any of challenges 4-9).

How to play

  • Each of the nine challenges has a lobby with an apparatus in an adjoining room.

  • The lobby has three switches.

  • One of the switches controls the apparatus in the adjoining room.

  • The others do nothing.

  • You must determine the active switch.

  • But you can only go in the adjoining apparatus room once.

  • To win the game, you must successfully determine the active switch for all nine challenges in a row.

Only one switch is active

As a demonstration of the way the switches work, the outdoor fountain is also controlled by one switch of a three-switch panel. The difference with the outdoor demonstration is that you can actually see the fountain as you play with the switches.

Just like the real challenges, the fountain demo will randomize the active switch each time you return, so it's not always the same switch.

Origin story: One Light and Three Switches riddle

This game was designed and created by me, Andrew MacMillan, as a way to help my kids solve the One Light and Three Switches riddle. Rather than simply telling them the answer to the riddle, I made this game.

The original riddle goes like this:

---

There is a light bulb inside a closet and behind a closed door. You cannot see if the light is on or off, but you know the light is off to start. Outside the closet, there are three light switches. You know one of the switches controls the light and you are allowed to flip the switches, but once you open the door to check the light, you can no longer move the switches.

How do you figure out with certainty which switch controls the light?

---

Although there are no light bulbs in closets controlled by switches in this game, my theory is that if a person can complete all nine challenges in a row, they should be pretty close to solving the original riddle too.

In any case, hope you enjoy this little game!

Andrew

store_data.about_the_game:
Bound to Rot is a dark fantasy action RPG built around one ruthless question: how long do you dare to stay and explore further?

Drop into a procedurally generated instance, cut through waves of escalating enemies, and fill your inventory with rare gear, but the longer you push your luck, the more dangerous it gets.

Die, and your character is gone. Everything. Gone.

An Anima That Wants You Dead

Explore the Anima, a sprawling, ever-deepening anima driven by a pulse that waits for no one. The pulse lights your way and keeps the darkness at bay, but you choose where it goes next. Every node cleared is a moment of truth: take what you have and walk away, or pick the next path and gamble it all. There is no exit to find. There is only the choice you make before the darkness moves in.

Itemization That Actually Matters

Six damage types. Hundreds of affixes. A spatial grid inventory that forces real decisions about what you carry out.

store_data.about_the_game:
Launch butterfly horns to reclaim nature in this score-attack action game! In "Butterfly Rebellion," your goal is to raise your Greening Rate as high as possible within a 180-second time limit.

[Overview]

Fire your horns at humans and others to take back nature and raise your Greening Rate! How much of the map can you reclaim within 180 seconds?

[Leaderboards]

Reclaim as much nature as you can to push your Greening Rate higher. Finish in the top 10 to appear on the leaderboard. Aim for the top!

Just fixing things when enemies show up isn't enough. When do you grab items? How early in each wave do you start fighting? The way you play decides your score.

[Born from a Game Jam]

"Butterfly Rebellion" was created at Sapporo Game Camp 2025 - planned, developed, and presented in just two days - and has now evolved and returned after repeated polish based on great feedback from exhibitions.

Controller support included.

store_data.about_the_game:
A gateway to Hell has opened beneath the churchyard, and the only thing standing between mankind and eternal damnation is a squad of heavily armed nuns with no intention of going quietly.

Nuns With Guns is a dark gothic top-down action roguelite where you command four battle-ready sisters defending their church from waves of demons. Position your nuns, survive the assault, upgrade their weapons, strengthen their abilities, and prepare between waves before Hell sends something bigger, uglier, and significantly less polite.

Demons pour in from below. The church stands above. Everything in between becomes a firing range.

Defend the Church

Your church is the last line between the living world and the demonic filth crawling out of the pit.

Keep the chapel standing while waves of enemies push upward from the hellhole. Your nuns can fight, fall, revive, upgrade, and reposition, but if the church falls, the parish is finished.

No pressure. Just eternal damnation and a repair bill.

Command Four Armed Sisters

Each nun has her own colour, role, weapon setup, health, and upgrade path.

Sister Mercy — aggressive, direct, and fond of solving theology with bullets.

Sister Agnes— mystical, strange, and dangerously comfortable around forbidden relics.

Sister Joan — precise, controlled, and very good at making demons regret having legs.

Sister Ruth — heavy support, tough defence, and holy firepower with bad intentions.

Switch between sisters, keep them alive, upgrade their weapons, and build your squad into a proper little holy problem for Hell.

Build Between Waves

After each wave, enter the build phase and prepare before the next demonic assault.

Spend gold to:

  • Buy and equip weapons

  • Upgrade damage, range, fire rate, health, speed, and armour

  • Heal wounded nuns

  • Revive fallen sisters

  • Prepare your defence before the next wave begins

This is where you decide whether the next wave is a heroic stand or a short funeral with reload animations.

Run-Only Blessings

Level up during a run and choose from blessing cards that change how your squad fights.

Blessings can improve weapons, strengthen the church, protect your nuns, boost your economy, or grant cursed advantages with ugly consequences.

Examples include:

  • Bullets that apply holy burn

  • Faster reloads

  • Squad-wide health boosts

  • Emergency revives

  • Church damage reduction

  • Cursed blessings that make you stronger while making the next waves nastier

Every run gives you different choices. Some are holy. Some are stupid. Most are both.

Fight Hell’s Worst

As the assault escalates, Hell sends more than ordinary demons.

Face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins, the Four Horsemen, and worse, each bringing unique attacks, pressure, and punishment. Survive long enough and the fight stops being about crowd control and starts being about whether your squad can kill a walking theological problem before it tears the church apart.

Features

  • Gothic top-down bullet-heaven combat

  • Four playable / commandable armed nuns

  • Wave-based church defence

  • Demons attacking from the bottom of the map

  • Church and squad health management

  • Build phase between waves

  • Weapon buying and equipping

  • Stat upgrades for each nun

  • Run-only blessing cards

  • Boss fights inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins, the Four Horsemen, and worse

  • Dark cathedral, cemetery, and hell-zone battlegrounds

  • Score, kills, souls, and survival progression

  • Singleplayer action with replayable runs

Gameplay Loop

Defend the church from a wave of demons.

Earn gold, souls, XP, and upgrades.

Level up and choose a blessing.

Enter the build phase.

Heal, revive, upgrade, and prepare.

Start the next wave.

Repeat until Hell runs out of demons or you run out of nuns.

Spoiler: Hell has a lot of demons.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hacklash is a typing horror game where you type against the clock while a hostile AI has a turret aimed at your spine. Survive as long as you can, beat your best scores, and climb the global leaderboards across multiple modes and modifiers.

SUMMARY

You break into a surveillance corporation called ORCA (Omni Research & Control Authority) to access their data. You go to log in to a computer, but then you get a nasty surprise.

The computer is alive, and it wants to have some fun with you before shredding your lungs.

Race against the turret timer countdown, typing randomized codes from a list of 1300+ words and trying to get through as many as you can.

You earn big points for completing words quick, but less for taking time or mistyping.

As the game progresses, ORCA will impose RESTRICTIONS on you, such as words where you can't type vowels or numbers.

The timer will shorten. You will feel cold dread and your heart rate fasten more than your fingers as you tire and

At the end of your life, you see your high score. Try to beat your best score, or those on the global leaderboards.

Hacklash offers:

  • Four Modes

  • Daily Challenges

  • 11 Achievements

  • Multiple difficulty settings and configuration options for adding more ease or challenge to the ORCA experience

  • Different Phosphor Colors

Good luck hacker.

ORCA has calculated your arrival. ORCA is ready for you to play.

WARPED is a polished arcade space shooter built around fast movement, satisfying combat, and classic sci-fi action. Pilot your ship through dangerous sectors of the solar system, survive waves of hostile UFOs, dodge asteroid fields, collect power-ups, and push deeper into space to find the source of the signal.

Fight through a campaign that takes you from Earth’s orbit to the outer edges of the solar system and far beyond, or jump straight into Endless Arcade mode for quick, high-score chasing action.

  • Multiple playable ship classes

  • Local co-op support

  • Local high scores and replayable score-chasing action

Built with the spirit of classic arcade shooters, WARPED is easy to pick up, exciting to master, and packed with colorful space action. The signal is calling, Pilot. Will you answer?

store_data.about_the_game:
Curse of Baghdad

The city of Baghdad has fallen under the grip of an ancient and mysterious curse.

When Canadian special operations officer Captain Ryan Jones finds himself trapped within the city alongside journalist Bridgette Baker and Iraqi Army officer Captain Ali Salim, the trio must fight their way through chaos, uncover the origins of the curse, and survive a nightmare that threatens to consume everything in its path.

What began as a routine mission quickly spirals into a desperate struggle for survival as ordinary civilians are transformed into monstrous husks stripped of their humanity. As the curse spreads across the city, Ryan, Ali, and Bridgette must confront both the horrors before them and the secrets buried deep beneath Baghdad's ancient past.

Tactical Top-Down Military Combat

Fight your way through a variety of dangerous environments using an arsenal of military weapons and equipment.

Battle through palm groves, abandoned facilities, horror underground basements, rooftops, 

  • Ancient locations touched by the curse

Every encounter brings new challenges as you push deeper into the heart of the outbreak.

A Story-Driven Cinematic Experience

Experience a narrative-driven adventure told through fully voiced cinematic cutscenes. Follow Ryan, Ali, and Bridgette as they uncover the truth behind the curse while witnessing the human cost of conflict, loss, and survival. Featuring a cast of dedicated voice actors, Curse of Baghdad combines military action with a character-focused story that explores friendship, sacrifice, and resilience in the face of overwhelming odds.

Face the Symbols of the Curse

Ancient forces have awakened.

Throughout your journey, you will confront powerful bosses inspired by Mesopotamian mythology. Each entity represents a different aspect of the curse that has taken hold of Baghdad.

Fight through unique arenas, survive deadly attack patterns, and overcome powerful enemies as you break the chains binding the city to its dark fate.

Built by a Family Team

Curse of Baghdad was created by a small team of three brothers working alongside family members, friends, volunteers, artists, voice actors, and supporters who believed in the project.

Every purchase directly supports our studio and helps us continue creating independent games driven by passion, storytelling, and creativity.

This project is deeply personal to us. It reflects our family's journey through immigration, hardship, and the real stories of survival that shaped our lives.

From Our Family To Yours

Thank you for taking the time to experience Curse of Baghdad.

We hope the characters, story, music, and world stay with you long after the credits roll.

See you in Baghdad.

Fight your way through a variety of dangerous environments using an arsenal of military weapons and equipment.

Battle through palm groves, abandoned facilities, horror underground basements, rooftops, 

  • Ancient locations touched by the curse

Every encounter brings new challenges as you push deeper into the heart of the outbreak.

A Story-Driven Cinematic Experience

Experience a narrative-driven adventure told through fully voiced cinematic cutscenes. Follow Ryan, Ali, and Bridgette as they uncover the truth behind the curse while witnessing the human cost of conflict, loss, and survival. Featuring a cast of dedicated voice actors, Curse of Baghdad combines military action with a character-focused story that explores friendship, sacrifice, and resilience in the face of overwhelming odds.

Face the Symbols of the Curse

Ancient forces have awakened.

Throughout your journey, you will confront powerful bosses inspired by Mesopotamian mythology. Each entity represents a different aspect of the curse that has taken hold of Baghdad.

Fight through unique arenas, survive deadly attack patterns, and overcome powerful enemies as you break the chains binding the city to its dark fate.

Built by a Family Team

Curse of Baghdad was created by a small team of three brothers working alongside family members, friends, volunteers, artists, voice actors, and supporters who believed in the project.

Every purchase directly supports our studio and helps us continue creating independent games driven by passion, storytelling, and creativity.

This project is deeply personal to us. It reflects our family's journey through immigration, hardship, and the real stories of survival that shaped our lives.

From Our Family To Yours

Thank you for taking the time to experience Curse of Baghdad.

We hope the characters, story, music, and world stay with you long after the credits roll.

See you in Baghdad.

store_data.about_the_game:
A SURGERY, BUT THE MEDIEVAL WAY!

Sure, being a doctor is hard and all. But it's the medieval times! We can just try bullshit!

Face the Doctor in his game of Organ Failure, and show him and the rest of the Murder why you deserve to have and manage your own hospital!

GAMBLE WITH SOMEONE ELSE'S LIFE

A ton of patients. Vital and Non-Vital Organs. One of them, the Sick Organ.

Extract one organ per turn, and follow the clues to the Sickness.

Don't kill the patients!... Alright, you can kill some of the patients.

Find 3 Sick Organs before your opponent to win, and crown yourself the best doctor in the Murder!

IT'S THE MEDIEVAL TIMES! MAGIC IS REAL!

Yes, extracting the heart will kill your patient, but that's where the items are!

There's a LOT of items with unique effects, inspired by both medieval fantasy, and actual medicine from the middle ages (those guys did really weird stuff!).

Find the Sick Organ, Sabotage your opponent, Steal and Copy items; Replace, Shuffle, Imbue, Rematerialize, Revitalize, Remove, Block and Alter each and every organ in the body, and the body itself! Gamble with your resources, and see how the Doctor does the same! What a rapscallion!

MANAGE YOUR HOSPITAL AND MEET WEIRD PEOPLE

Your town has been getting more popular lately. Was it the Plague? Maybe your hospital? Doubt that.

A Witch, a dungeon Skeleton, a powerful Wizard, and the King himself are just some of the characters you'll meet, and each of them add modifiers and requirements to a game that was already sufficiently hard on its own!

Taxes? Shopping lists? Exploding organs? A crow with a very cute pink bow? Things couldn't possibly get any crazier... right?
