store_data.about_the_game:
Civilization is an experiment built atop older experiments.

Every generation inherits a world it does not understand.

The purpose of the rituals has been forgotten.

The gods are conducting tests.

The archives are incomplete.

The dead continue to influence the living.

Every solution leaves a scar for those who follow.

Inspired by forgotten kingdoms, impossible saints, emergent systems, and the things that survive them.

About This Game

Way of the Wind is a terminal-born feudal Japan strategy roguelike about building a clan, raising heirs, surviving ogres, and watching a living world grind forward whether you are ready or not.

You begin small: a wandering household, a fragile camp, a few names worth protecting. From there, the world opens into a strange ASCII Japan of roads, cities, markets, castles, rival factions, family lines, secret systems, and consequences that do not politely wait for the player.

This is not a clean tactics board. It is a living machine.

Cities grow, decay, trade, starve, arm themselves, send caravans, produce heirs, remember harm, and fall under pressure. Roads matter. Buildings matter. People matter. Your family matters. Every year pushes the simulation forward.

Build a Clan

Ogre Shader is the base human unit of action. Heirs are cheat resources.

Your heirs are not disposable menu icons. They are your future.

Raise a bloodline, assign roles, send family members into danger, build up cities, defend what you own, and decide how much of your dynasty you are willing to risk for power. The world can be survived, conquered, inherited, or lost.

Children become successors. Successors become commanders. Commanders become legends, failures, ghosts, or liabilities.

The clan is the save file.

Rule a Living Japan

Move across a stylized terminal map of Japan and interact with cities, roads, markets, castles, shrines, villages, and hostile infrastructure.

Each city has its own pressure state: food, money, morale, defense, labor, attention, corruption, and stability. Buildings are not decoration. A castle, market, shrine, barracks, farm, spy network, or dojo can change what a city produces, how it defends itself, and what kind of future it creates.

The world is readable, inspectable, and mechanical — but never fully safe.

Fight, Fail, Adapt

Combat is fast, strange, and consequential. Units have roles, abilities, momentum, and matchups. Some fights are clean battles. Some are desperate interruptions. Some are bad ideas you walked into because the map looked quiet.

Victory can open routes, protect people, create heirs, or secure territory.

Failure can wound the entire run.

Ogres Are Not Just Enemies

Ogres are a faction, a threat, a ritual system, and a pressure source. They raid, capture, distort, bargain, and change the world around them. Their presence bleeds into the economy, the map, the family system, and the hidden machinery underneath the game.

Sometimes they are a battle.

Sometimes they are a disaster.

Sometimes they are the interface.

Bratbox

Buried inside Way of the Wind is Bratbox: a strange voiced terminal system built from recorded lines, personality fragments, unlocks, and reactive ritual logic.

It is part character system, part performance layer, part secret reward structure, and part haunted machine.

You do not need to understand it immediately.

You will know when you find it.

A Terminal Artifact

Way of the Wind is intentionally built like a cursed strategy artifact: dense, sharp-edged, funny, ugly-beautiful, and alive with systems. It uses text, ASCII art, menus, simulation readouts, voiced fragments, and sudden dramatic overlays to create a game that feels less like a clean modern UI and more like operating a war machine someone should not have left running.

It is a game about Japan.

It is a game about ogres.

It is a game about family.

It is a game about what happens when every system has a memory.

The Gods Are Conducting Tests. The Ogres Adapt.

This is a fast, strange feudal strategy roguelike about turning fragile human actions into a surviving civilization.

Begin with stories, rumors, and small acts of human leverage. Stories become intel. Intel enables sabotage. Sabotage funds repairs, roads, buildings, rescues, and expansion. Every city you take becomes another part of the state machine — another place to defend, exploit, repair, or lose.

As rival city-states weaken and ordinary opportunities dry up, survival pushes you toward darker bargains. Ogre tribes, caravans, barges, raids, roads, heirs, warbands, and ruined buildings all feed into the same living pressure system.

You are not just moving units across Japan.

You are running a cockpit civilization where every year matters, every shortcut has a cost, and every solution creates the next problem.

Features

  • Explore a stylized terminal map of feudal Japan

  • Build and manage cities, roads, markets, shrines, farms, barracks, and castles

  • Raise heirs and continue your dynasty across years of simulation

  • Command units in tactical battles

  • Watch AI cities grow, trade, pressure each other, and produce their own heirs

  • Encounter ogre raids, barges, hostile settlements, and dark consequence systems

  • Manage resources, buildings, people, queues, morale, defenses, and city stability

  • Discover hidden routes, strange overlays, Bratbox systems, and secret debug-like rituals

  • Experience a deliberately weird terminal aesthetic with ASCII art, voice fragments, and simulation-heavy menus

store_data.about_the_game:
Prepare your run before entering the dungeon

Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every attempt begins before the first fight. Choose your hero, set up your preparation, equip artifacts, and enter the run with a clear direction for your build.

Each choice changes how you approach the next battles: which cards to prioritize, which effects to combine, and how to turn rewards into a strategy that can survive until the end of the map.

Build your deck during the run

Your deck does not start finished. Throughout the run, you choose rewards, adapt your strategy, and decide which cards deserve a place in your build.

Different cards open different paths: direct damage, effect buildup, resource control, setup for bigger plays, and combinations that become stronger once your deck starts to click.

Turn small choices into an engine

Items and artifacts are not just loose bonuses. They help define the rhythm of the run, reinforce synergies, and can change how your plays resolve.

Finding the right combination between cards, items, artifacts, and hero is at the heart of Dungebra: a strong run is not about one powerful card, but about several pieces working together.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nanma walks between villages like a gentle shadow. She observes more than she speaks. She carries a crow mask — both a protection and a warning. Her journey is a silent quest for a place where she can exist without hiding.

Nanma: A Tecelã das Sombras (Note: If you want to translate the subtitle, you can use: Nanma: The Shadow Weaver) is a Brazilian dark high-fantasy Visual Novel focused on a dense narrative where player agency is absolute. You assume the role of Nanma, a young weaver whose abilities are considered a curse, on a journey of self-discovery and mystery in a world filled with magic and monsters.

Explore multiple paths, meet captivating characters, and discover: what price will you pay to alter what has already been woven?

Key Features:

  • Choices with Real Consequences: There are no right or wrong paths, only intertwining threads. Your decisions pull at the strings that shape Nanma's character and the fate of those around her.

  • Branching Narrative: Explore multiple endings and hidden paths. Each new playthrough reveals a different perspective on the secrets of Mesacna.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: An experience focused on introspection, featuring an original soundtrack and unique, custom artwork that evokes the mystery of dark fantasy.

store_data.about_the_game:
The old order did not end in fire. It ended in treaties no one honored, debts no one could pay, and borders drawn by whoever still had soldiers at the table.

Concert of Power is a grand strategy game about ruling a nation in the fractured remains of North America. Kingdoms, duchies, confederacies, and ambitious city-states compete across a continent where no power is strong enough to rule alone, and no promise is stable enough to trust forever.

You are not simply trying to conquer.

You are trying to make sure no one else can.

Preserve the Balance, or Break It

Every nation is watching the board. A rising power attracts rivals. A weakened neighbor invites demands. A guarantee can hold the peace, provoke a crisis, or become the excuse for war.

Diplomacy is not separate from strategy. It is how strategy begins.

Shape the balance of power through pressure, promises, threats, markets, and carefully chosen restraint. Keep your enemies divided. Keep your allies dependent. Keep the continent convinced that your ambitions are necessary, reasonable, or at least too costly to oppose.

Build the State Behind the Threat

Power begins at home. Feed your people, keep factories supplied, build ports, forts, offices, and industry, and turn grain, fish, timber, coal, iron, steel, weapons, and civilian goods into leverage.

A rich country can afford patience. A hungry country bargains with its hands tied.

Every building is part of the diplomatic machine. Mines feed factories. Factories arm soldiers. Ports open markets. Chanceries create the diplomatic reach needed to justify claims, court allies, and keep pressure alive.

Every Nation Wants Something

No state exists only to fill space on the map.

Some powers want restoration. Some want security. Some want markets, coal, ports, prestige, revenge, or a quiet border. A peacekeeper may tolerate one concession to prevent a larger war. An opportunist may sell neutrality today and betray it tomorrow. A trader may hate you and still need your grain.

Read the continent carefully. Nations remember who threatened them, who fed them, who abandoned them, and who kept a promise when breaking it would have been profitable.

Make Demands

Claims and ultimatums are tests of the international order.

A demand forces every interested power to choose a position: support, oppose, stay silent, bargain, warn, or seek arbitration. Your target may yield, stall for time, seek backers, buy you off, or dare you to escalate.

The demand itself is only the first move. The real contest is over who can make their side look stronger before the crisis closes.

Isolate Rising Powers

A strong rival is dangerous. A strong rival accepted by the world is worse.

Use diplomacy to turn fear into policy. Paint your enemy as a threat to regional stability. Pull away their friends, weaken their guarantees, court their neighbors, and build a quiet consensus that something must be done.

The best wars begin with your enemy already alone.

Buy Support, Silence, or Betrayal

Not every nation needs to admire you. Some only need a reason to stand aside.

Offer guarantees, concessions, favors, money, trade access, diplomatic cover, or future promises to shape how others respond when the balance begins to shift. A small nation may want protection. A great power may want compensation. A rival's ally may simply want to survive the next crisis.

Everyone has principles. Most also have conditions.

Guarantees and Great-Power Pressure

Guarantees are the scaffolding of the post-collapse order. They protect weak states, restrain ambitious ones, and give powerful nations a reason to interfere.

Use them to secure clients, deter attacks, or trap rivals into defending liabilities. Pressure other nations to abandon guarantees that no longer serve them. Turn a promise of protection into a bargaining chip, a warning, or a liability.

A guarantee is peace written in pencil.

Trade Is Leverage

Once the diplomatic field is set, markets become another way to move it.

Trade with rivals you are not ready to fight. Support friendly states that keep your enemies occupied. Build economic relationships that create influence, dependency, and quiet obligations.

A trade partner is not always a friend. Sometimes they are a future hostage.

Embargo and Strangle

When pressure is not enough, deny your enemies room to breathe.

Embargo hostile powers, cut off key resources, and force other nations to choose between profit and alignment. An isolated rival may still have armies, but armies need food, money, weapons, trade routes, and political patience.

A nation does not need to be invaded to start weakening.

Crisis and Escalation

A border dispute can become a diplomatic crisis. A crisis can become a continental test of prestige.

Escalate carefully to force concessions, or hold back while your rivals overcommit. Back down when the price is wrong. Push forward when the room is divided. In a balance-of-power system, restraint can be as ruthless as aggression.

Every crisis asks the same question: who is willing to risk the order, and who is only pretending?

False Flags and Manufactured Causes

Sometimes the balance needs a shove.

Stage provocations, shape blame, manufacture evidence, and create the justification your nation needs to act. A war with the right story is easier to sell at home, harder to oppose abroad, and more dangerous for rivals to ignore.

But lies are instruments, not miracles. A weak story needs preparation. A careless operation can damage stability, expose your methods, stain your reliability, and turn cautious powers into enemies.

Power is strongest when it looks like necessity.

Fight Limited Wars

Not every war must become total war. Limited wars let nations punish rivals, enforce demands, seize disputed territory, break guarantees, or rebalance a region without openly seeking destruction.

But limited wars remain limited only while everyone believes the balance can still be restored.

Win quickly and the continent may tolerate the outcome. Drag the war out and even friendly states begin to wonder what you are becoming.

A Continent of Uneasy Powers

The map is familiar, but the world is not. North America has fractured into successor states with old claims, new titles, unstable borders, and dangerous ambitions.

Some powers want restoration.

Some want security.

Some want revenge.

Some simply want more.

The road to power is still open.

So is the road against you.

store_data.about_the_game:
LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation about the life you build, the pressure you carry, and the consequences you live with.

Start a new life and make the decisions that shape who you become. Manage money, debt, energy, mental load, relationships, health, family, career, stability, self-respect, job security and your future while everyday choices slowly turn into a life story.

This is not about finding the perfect path. It is about discovering what kind of person you become when every decision pushes your life in a different direction.

Live Through Everyday Decisions That Add Up

Answer messages, handle bills, request annual leave, book holidays, build relationships, start a family, protect your health, manage illness, chase promotions, deal with tax, follow World News, react to changing weather, and make choices that can come back days, months or years later.

• Some choices help you today and cost you later
• Some choices feel small until they start changing everything
• Some choices are hard now, but protect the life you are trying to build

Build The Life You Want — Or The Life You End Up With

Focus on success, money, love, comfort, ambition, friendship, stability, family, recovery, or risk. Chase a better future. Keep life small. Put others first. Start again after things go wrong.

LIVORA is built around the tension between who you wanted to be and what your choices actually created.

Your Life Remembers

Ignored messages, delayed decisions, missed chances, financial pressure, health strain, relationship tension, unfinished business, career choices and family responsibilities can follow you.

Your choices shape not just your stats, but the pattern of the life you are living.

A World That Keeps Moving

Life in LIVORA does not pause around you. Seasons change, weather affects daily life, fictional sports results appear in World News, future technology can reshape society, and major events can create pressure, opportunity or disruption.

The world moves forward — and your life has to move with it.

Replay And Choose Differently

Start another life with a different mindset. Take a different job route, handle money differently, prioritise relationships, protect your wellbeing, chase ambition, start a business, build a family, or make choices you avoided before.

A different life can lead to a very different outcome.

LIVORA Is For Players Who Enjoy

• Life simulation
• Choice-driven storytelling
• Interactive fiction
• Relationship, career and family decisions
• Money, pressure and consequence systems
• World News, future events and realistic life changes
• Multiple outcomes
• Text-based gameplay
• Relaxed, thoughtful play

Your life starts with one choice.

Where it ends is up to you.

store_data.about_the_game: In Hephaestus Protocol, players pick one of over 50 playable heroes, and try to survive escalating waves of enemies while traversing an infinite, procedurally generated, map. The world draws on mythological pantheons, traditional fantasy, and historical elements. The core loop is pure Bullet Heaven adrenaline: move, dodge, and let players auto-firing arsenal do the work while they level up, accumulate catalysts, and decide which weapons to evolve. The primary innovation is the weapon combo system; items can be combined together into hybrid armaments that merge their stats, elemental affinities, attack patterns, and sprites, giving each run a distinct, build-defining identity.

store_data.about_the_game:
CLAIM WHAT'S LEFT.

The Frontier doesn't reset, and it doesn't care if you make it home. Drop into a persistent, post-collapse wasteland with whatever you can carry. Scavenge it for everything it's worth, fight the raiders and AI who want it more than you do, and reach extraction before the storm — or a stranger's rifle — ends your run. Get out and the haul is yours for good. Go down and your kit stays on your corpse for the next raider to strip.

DEADCLAIM is a hardcore, third-person (FPS-toggle) extraction survival shooter. One life per raid. Everything you carry is on the line.

ONE LIFE, EVERYTHING ON THE LINE

You get a single life per raid — no respawns. Every weapon on your back and every scrap you claw out of the dirt rides on reaching the extract. Bank it and it's locked in. Bleed out and it drops where you fell, free for the taking. Push for one more crate, or break for the exit while you still can? That decision is the whole game, and it's never free.

YOUR PROGRESSION IS SAFE — YOUR LOADOUT IS THE WAGER

This isn't about losing everything. Your rank, your skills, your banked credits, your stash and your outpost are always yours — they only grow. What you risk is the kit you bring and the loot you find. Insure your gear to get it back, fall back on a respawn kit when a run goes bad, and decide for yourself how much to gamble on the next drop.

A PERSISTENT, LIVING FRONTIER

There's no lobby and no menu raid. Servers ARE the wasteland — a continuous, populated Frontier you drop straight into. Discover walk-in outpost camps, field hospitals, supply depots and convoy wrecks scattered across an island-wide map, each one defended and worth dying over. Day bleeds to dusk, weather rolls in, and the high ground changes hands.

BUILD YOUR OUTPOST

Bank your hauls between raids and turn scavenged scrap into a war machine. Craft gear, stock your stash, and fortify a home base that compounds with every successful extraction. Progress you fought for, kept safe behind the lines.

A LIVING WAR ECONOMY

Outfit your next run from four specialist vendors — the Gunsmith, Medic, Chef, and Quartermaster — each a one-stop shop for its trade, with loyalty discounts and a gear-tier climb that rewards the bold. Build a weapon from parts at the Gunsmith's bench, then take it back into the fight. Zero pay-to-win — everything is earned.

HOST YOUR OWN WASTELAND

Download the dedicated server for free and run the Frontier your way — private squads, custom rules, total control. No middleman, no subscription, no one renting you your own game.

KEY FEATURES

  • High-stakes extraction: Loot, survive, and get out — or it drops on your body for someone else.

  • Gear-on-death stakes: Weighty gunplay with real consequences — risk the loadout, keep the progression. Insurance and respawn kits soften the fall.

  • Persistent open Frontier: A hand-built, atmospheric island of ruined towns and apocalyptic outposts to master.

  • Third-person with an FPS toggle: Read the world over your shoulder, or drop into the sights.

  • Drive the wasteland: Commandeer vehicles to haul loot, run extracts, and cover ground fast.

  • Four specialist vendors + crafting: Build guns, brew meds, cook supplies, fabricate gear.

  • Run your own server: Free dedicated server.exe — your rules, your wasteland.

  • No pay-to-win, ever: Every advantage is scavenged, crafted, or earned.

THE FRONTIER IS OPEN

Claim the wasteland. Hold what's yours. The rest is up for grabs.

Wishlist DEADCLAIM now, and join the operators on Discord.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to The Art Keeper, a cozy life simulation and home-building experience where creativity is your greatest tool.

Start with a simple house and transform it into a unique living space filled with furniture, decorations, collectibles, music, artwork, and interactive objects. Every choice shapes the atmosphere of your home.

But decorating is only the beginning.

Take on the role of an art gallery curator and complete painting placement contracts to earn money, unlock new items, and expand your collection.

Create Your Perfect Home

Turn an empty house into a place that truly feels yours.

  • Purchase and place over 100 unique items

  • Decorate every room however you like

  • Move, rotate, and arrange furniture freely

  • Create cozy corners, artistic displays, or organized living spaces

  • Design without restrictions and express your personal style

A World Full of Interactive Objects

Your home is more than decoration.

Many objects can be interacted with in meaningful ways:

  • Turn lamps and lights on or off

  • Play board games and tabletop activities

  • Listen to music through purchased audio items

  • Discover unique interactions throughout the house

  • Experience personality and charm in every object

Every Item Has a Story

Items are not just decorations.

Each object contains its own unique dialogue, flavor text, or observations, encouraging players to explore and learn more about the world around them.

Gallery Curation Jobs

Become a professional art keeper.

Accept gallery contracts and carefully place paintings in their correct locations.

  • Complete 15 unique gallery rounds

  • Organize and display up to 29 paintings per round

  • Match artworks with their designated exhibition spaces

  • Test your memory, observation, and efficiency

Beat the Clock

Some gallery exhibitions are timed challenges.

  • Finish exhibitions before time runs out

  • Earn larger rewards for faster completion

  • Improve your performance and efficiency

  • Use your earnings to purchase new decorations and collectibles

Inspiration System

Creativity leads to progress.

Gain inspiration as you interact with your home, discover objects, and complete tasks. Use your growing collection and imagination to create spaces that reflect your artistic vision.

Relax, Decorate, and Explore

Whether you're carefully organizing an art exhibition, collecting new furniture, discovering item interactions, or simply enjoying the atmosphere of your home, The Art Keeper offers a relaxing and rewarding creative experience.

Build your dream home.
Curate beautiful galleries.
Become the keeper of art.

store_data.about_the_game:
Scrappy Guild is a co-op deck-building roguelike for 2–4 players.

Form a party of Hero, Cleric, Mage, and Rogue,

battle through a randomly generated dungeon, and take down the Demon King together.

■ The Core Mechanic: Shared Cost System

Your entire party shares a single pool of energy.

Every card you play costs everyone — so you'd better talk it through first.

"Can I use my big move?" "Wait, we need to defend!"

Natural conversation is baked into every turn.

■ Build Your Deck Together

The deck is shared too. After each battle, the whole party votes on which reward card to add.

Since every character has unique abilities, figuring out who should use what card

is half the fun — and the key to victory.

Pass cards between teammates mid-battle to pull off the perfect combo.

■ Characters

· Hero: Deals 1.5x attack damage. Adds attack cards to allies' hands.

· Cleric: Heals and defends. Carries block over to the next turn at 2x strength.

· Mage: Reduces the cost of heavy cards. Lowers allies' energy costs.

· Rogue: Master of card passing. Draws +1 card when playing 0-cost cards.

■ Roguelike Depth

Routes through the randomly generated map are chosen by the whole party.

Harder paths mean better rewards; safer paths offer healing and shops.

Combine relics (passive items) with your cards for a wildly different build every run.

Die and start over — but you'll want to try again.

■ Perfect for

· Friends looking for a card game to play together

· Slay the Spire fans who want a more casual co-op experience

· Anyone who loves talking strategy and having a blast while doing it

store_data.about_the_game:
The Isometric Farm is a cozy, hand-crafted farming simulator where you turn a small patch of grass into a thriving, beautiful farm. Till the soil, plant your seeds, water your crops, and harvest them for profit — then reinvest everything to grow bigger, unlock rare plants, and meet a colorful cast of vendors.

Plant, Grow & Harvest

Work your land tile by tile with a simple, satisfying toolset — **Hoe, Plant, Water, and Harvest**. Watch every crop grow through multiple stages, and keep them watered to speed up their growth. From humble violet flowers to exotic blooms, every harvest brings you closer to your dream farm.

Expand Your Farm

Start small and grow big. Spend your hard-earned coins to **expand your land across multiple levels** — each expansion opens up more space to cultivate and unlocks brand-new vendors to trade with.

Meet the Vendors

A cast of characters lives on your farm, each with something to offer:

- The Seed Seller — your go-to for everyday seeds.

- The Farmer — helps you expand your land.

- The Herbalist — sells powerful tools like the Harvesting Pliers and the Auto-Waterer.

- The Nursery — unlocks rare plants: Red Valerian, Blue Agapanthus, Lavender, and Flowering Cactus.

- The Botanist — offers truly special species, including the Venus Flytrap and the Magic Mushroom.

Hidden Riches

Your land hides more than dirt. Clear rocks and dig up rare diamonds scattered across the ground — a lucky find that can pay off big.

Tools & Upgrades

Make farming faster and easier with smart upgrades. Level up your Harvesting Pliers for more efficient harvests, and let the Auto-Waterer keep your crops hydrated while you focus on growing your empire.

Play Your Way

- Multiple save slots so you can manage several farms.

- Full settings menu — audio, controls, gameplay, and accessibility options.

- A relaxing pace with no pressure — just you, your land, and time to grow.

Grab your hoe. Your farm is waiting. A game by Fanteh Studios.

store_data.about_the_game:
[What is Bokosuka Wars?]

Bokosuka Wars was a game developed by Rasho for the X1 computer in 1983.

The following year, 1984, it won the Grand Prix at the 1st ASCII Software Contest.

On December 14 1985, the Famicom version was also released.

It is considered one of the origins of the widely popular "Simulation RPG" genre.

A truly legendary game, having quickly incorporated numerous elements that would lead to modern simulation RPGs, such as:

  • the existence of a leader whose defeat results in a game over

  • character compatibility

  • growth and promotion through repeated battles

[How to Play Bokosuka Wars]

Bokosuka Wars II is a military simulation RPG where you play as the King of Slen, leading your allies to defeat the tyrannical King Ogres.

1. Gather Allies:

During your adventure, you'll find captured soldiers and knights of the Kingdom of Slen scattered throughout the land.

Rescue them to expand your army and build a powerful force.

Furthermore, soldiers from countries other than the Kingdom of Sleng may join your ranks.

2. Command Two Armies:

The player can control not only the King of Slen but also soldiers, knights, and even the entire army, switching between them as needed.

Since the allies act autonomously, maintaining formation while advancing is crucial.

Using the "Military Council Table" you can change formations according to the situation and gain advantage in battle.

3. Fight the Enemy:

Combat occurs when your forces and the enemy come into contact.

Character abilities, compatibility, and luck all influence the outcome.

Rather than recklessly challenging strong enemies, deploying the right units is the path to victory.

4. Develop Your Characters:

Characters who win battles grow stronger.

Upon meeting certain conditions, characters can be promoted to "Silver Soldier", "Heavy Soldier", "Heavy Knight" and "General", significantly increasing their combat power.

You may also obtain weapons and shields by defeating enemies.

Equipment changes character abilities and also affects the outcome of the "adjacent combat" which occurs when characters are adjacent to each other.

5. Fight Alongside Heroes:

In 2-player co-op, Player 2 controls a Hero to support King Slen's army.

Heroes possess a special ability to discern the strength of all characters by seeing into their souls and associating them with animals, such as "Lion" or "Rat".

6. Defeat King Ogres:

After overcoming numerous enemy forces, your arch-nemesis King Ogres awaits.

Lead your trained army into the final battle.

[Tips for Victory]

  • Rescue as many allies as possible

  • Don't lose your trained characters

  • Be mindful of character compatibility

  • Protect King Slen

  • Use the Hero's abilities

If King Slen is defeated, it's game over.

Lead your army, making the most of your limited forces, and aim for the castle where King Ogres awaits.

[New Features in This Version]

The core gameplay remains the same as the original "Bokosuka Wars."

However, new systems and content have been added, making it even deeper and more enjoyable.

1. Two-Player Co-op Support:

For the first time in the series, two-player co-op is implemented.

Player 2 can control the new character "Hero," who assists King Slen.

Going to battle together with family or friends doubles the fun of Bokosuka!

2. Play with Original Artwork by Creator Rasho:

Visuals based on Rasho's original artwork, which wasn't possible at the time of the original's release, are included.

You can switch between "Classic Style" and "Original Style" with a single button during gameplay.

3. New Characters & Facilities Added:

New allied characters, "General" and "Bishop," make an appearance.

Furthermore, new facilities such as a Church and a Silo where you can obtain food for fatigue recovery have been added.

4. New Version of "Susume Bokosuka" Included:

The Bokosuka Wars theme song, "Susume Bokosuka," returns in a powered-up version.

Furthermore, the version featuring Haruko Momoi's vocals, which garnered attention upon its CD release, is also included.

Along with numerous new songs, the diverse and unique music further enhances the Bokosuka world.

[Features Highlights]

  • One of the pioneers of simulation RPGs

  • Army battles involving over 100 units

  • Supports 2-player cooperative play

  • Includes original artwork mode by the original creator, Rasho

  • Training, promotion, and equipment system

  • Diverse formations and army command

//

store_data.about_the_game:
7743 is a puzzle heavy psychological horror game where you play as Simon Kimana who has grown up in a well known family who have built their wealth from selling kimonos. Situated in 1980s Japan, Simon's family is brutally murdered in front of his own eyes, as he watches in horror, hidden away in his parent's closet.

From there on out, Simon's mind has snapped to the point where he places blame upon himself for only watching and not acting and is unable to break from the event of that day, as he relives it, piece by piece.

Throughout Simon's mental state, he must unlock his mind and look beyond what he has set out to believe and accept the truth of what has happened on that horrible day. 

The focus on 7743 is to provide the player with many options and avenue's of replayability, as such 7743 offers:

  • Difficulty selections, allowing the player to select Normal Puzzles or Hard Puzzles mode, each offering unique puzzle experiences and additional experiences.

  • 3 endings, each of which offers a different angle of the story.

  • Many achievements to challenge the player to explore every avenue of the game.

  • Checkpoint functionality to allow the player to explore multiple endings without having to complete the game from the start.

Additional Disclosures:

  • 7743 is puzzle heavy, offering the player problem solving opportunities ranging from simple to very difficult.

  • 7743 is estimated to be completed within approximately 45 minutes for one ending.

After nearly 2 years since my last release (Night at the Office), here we are with 7743! With school and work taking up a huge piece of my time these last couple of years, I am super happy to have the ability to jump back into game dev and pump out this new terror.

Over the years, I've spent a great deal looking into new horror releases and trying to expand further beyond my typical release (Even visited Japan for inspiration :D ). Now, the focus is to provide players with not only a terrifying experience, but also a difficult one, whereby you must focus on the story and your surroundings in order to solve puzzles and experience all the game has to offer.

One thing you will notice with this game is a large increase in puzzles and interactions, alongside an option to choose between Normal or Hard puzzles, each of which offering different experiences and interactions. Increasing the degree of variability has definitely increased the complications of this game and has made it take a bit longer to build than expected, but nonetheless, I believe the game turned out well, and will provide you with an experience far different than what you have seen when compared to my previous releases.

I truly hope that you enjoy what the game has to offer, and I would love to hear your feedback to help progress future games! :) 

cheers and happy gaming!

Stan. T

store_data.about_the_game:
Limited health and resources, a journal to document what you find and see, an unknown monstrosity hunting you around every corner, in a seemingly endless labyrinth. How long will you survive for? And if you do, can you find the exit?

  • Procedurally generated areas

  • Collectables for health, hunger, and thirst

  • Co-op so you can have your friends get devoured while you run

  • Completely different layout on every playthrough

  • Chance to find inscriptions on the walls that clue you into them

  • A zoom feature to see things in better detail

  • A flashlight, necessary for some areas

  • Each death slowly corrupts you until you become one of them

  • Late 90's style camera as your eyes

  • The floors and walls are not always as they seem. It can be to your own detriment or benefit

  • There is a chance you can fall into a less than desired area

This is the first game we have made and we would like for it to not be our last. That being said, we are still honing our skills so please let us know if there is any pointers you have that would benefit the game! We will be releasing more levels as time goes on so look forward to more refined levels as they are developed. Your input will help them!

Limited health and resources, a journal to document what you find and see, an unknown monstrosity hunting you around every corner, in a seemingly endless labyrinth. How long will you survive for? And if you do, can you find the exit?

  • Procedurally generated areas

  • Collectables for health, hunger, and thirst

  • Co-op so you can have your friends get devoured while you run

  • Completely different layout on every playthrough

  • Chance to find inscriptions on the walls that clue you into them

  • A zoom feature to see things in better detail

  • A flashlight, necessary for some areas

  • Each death slowly corrupts you until you become one of them

  • Late 90's style camera as your eyes

  • The floors and walls are not always as they seem. It can be to your own detriment or benefit

  • There is a chance you can fall into a less than desired area

This is the first game we have made and we would like for it to not be our last. That being said, we are still honing our skills so please let us know if there is any pointers you have that would benefit the game! We will be releasing more levels as time goes on so look forward to more refined levels as they are developed. Your input will help them!

store_data.about_the_game:
The library closes at nine. A librarian always stays behind.

Ashwood Library has stood since 1889. Its night librarians rarely last a week. You are the new one.

For five nights you keep the desk alone. Books arrive that were never catalogued. Notes appear in the request tray, left by a patron whose name is in no register. The reading room at the end of the east corridor stays locked after nine, and you have been told not to ask why. Do the work. Shelve the returns. Answer the requests. And, night by night, learn what the library is really asking of you.

What you'll do:

Shelve and sort returns by genre, author, date, and call number, reading each book carefully before you decide.

Answer patron requests by finding the one book that matches every clue in a handwritten note.

Reassemble torn letters and hidden documents, piece by piece.

Deduce the truth from redacted records and the case files that fill the gaps.

A quiet, bookish mystery

Five chapters, twenty-two handcrafted puzzles, one very old secret.

A written, atmospheric story you uncover at your own pace, by candlelight and rain.

Gentle on-ramp and optional hints, so you are never truly stuck.

Chapter select and a keeper's record to revisit the nights you've kept.

Honest about what it is

The Night Librarian is a short, complete experience, roughly one to two hours for a first playthrough. It is meant to be read and savored in an evening or two, not stretched out. If you like cozy puzzles, dark academia, and a mystery that trusts you to pay attention, this was made for you.

Ashwood Library has stood since 1889. Thank you for continuing the legacy.

store_data.about_the_game:
CROPS HORDES & BOSSES

Original plant-based enemies attack in waves, featuring unique movement and behavior patterns. Each map offers a tiered challenge, featuring Mini-Boss Commanders, standard Bosses, and brutal Hard-Bosses to test your build.

GAMBLE UPGRADES: SLOTMACHINE LEVELING UP

Discard the genre’s tired "pick one of three" upgrade system for a high-stakes, gambling-driven progression loop. Instead of static choices, players earn roll points to spin a slot machine where every outcome matters—featuring a volatile mix of powerful upgrades, risky downgrades, and over 80 unique Joker cards that trigger game-altering special effects.

ELEMENTAL SURFACES & STATUS EFFECTS

7 status effects (burn, freeze, poison, etc.) affect both heroes and mobs. Surfaces react dynamically with elemental attacks (e.g. electricity + toxic puddle = explosion; electricity + iced puddle = electric iced puddle).

SKILLS, COMBOS & ULTIMATES

Each hero features a signature skill that can be evolved into a devastating combo attack. Beyond standard progression, players can unleash powerful Ultimates to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of combat.

FREE KICK MINI-GAME

We have integrated a unique "Free Kick Shot" meta-game that doubles as a skill-shot mechanic for evolving standard attacks into Combos. This mini-game features its own dedicated progression system – complete specific challenges to unlock a roster of new specialist kickers with signature types of kicks.

HIDDEN SECRETS

Scour expansive maps to reveal hidden pathways, challenge secret Commanders, and unlock the game’s most powerful hidden heroes.

MASSIVE ENTITY VARIETY

A deep pool of content including base attacks, combos, Ultimates, standard items, boosts, merchant-exclusive gear, and strategic drops.

QUEST COMPLETION

Complete a vast array of quests to unlock new entities and earn currency for permanent growth. Invest in persistent stat boosts to ensure you return stronger and more resilient for every new run.

DYNAMIC DIFFICULTY SCALING

Take control of your challenge in real-time. Activate specific in-game objects to buff enemies and increase the stakes—the only way to draw out and defeat each map’s brutal Hard-Bosses.

store_data.about_the_game:
A 3D voxel virtual tabletop.

Building is fast. Left-click to paint, drag to fill a wall or a variety of shapes like ramps, pyramids, hills and more. Copy any chunk of  your scene and paste it elsewhere or share it as a text string in your notes (inspired by Talespire "slabs").

Fog of war is fully 3D. Areas your party has visited can stay visible behind partial fog. Visibility is team based, so your players can share vision, have individual vision, or you could run PvP wargames with fog of war tracking multiple teams.

Lighting is raytraced through the voxel grid: sunlight, ambient occlusion, colored lighting, emissive blocks, and more.

Tokens are built as "standees" from any imported image, and can be scaled to any size. You can convert sections of the level into "props" that can be moved and rotated like tokens.

Current features:

  • Build voxels with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc.

  • Fog of war / line of sight

  • Shared or private vision - each team has its own vision and exploration

  • Players can be granted permission to get vision from and/or move tokens

  • Players can be assigned to any combination of teams

  • Build voxels in any color, make them transparent, emit light, and/or non-solid

  • Copy & paste sections of blocks and save them to a prefab library - pastes can be rotated, flipped, and scaled

  • Import Magicavoxel files

  • Import images with optional heightmaps and place them into scenes for reference, or convert them directly into voxels

  • Import any image as a custom standee tokens. Standees can be any size, can emit light, and be toggled as flying

  • Alternate camera modes like isometric and top-down

  • Custom units for rulers

  • Voxel-based lighting from a directional sun, ambient sky, basic ambient light, and light-emitting blocks

  • Convert selections of blocks into "props" that can be moved around and rotated like tokens - use for doors, furniture, vehicles, etc.

store_data.about_the_game:
Old Time Hockey is an arcade hockey game that crosses the simplicity of the 16-bit classics with the over-the-top speed and bone-crunching hits of late-'90s arcade rinks. It's built to be understood in seconds and hard to put down: a new player can score inside a minute, but mastering the one-timer takes a lot longer.

You watch the whole rink from a clean, broadcast-style 2.5D camera while real 3D players battle below.
Tap to snap a wrist shot or hold to wind up a slapper. Thread a one-timer off a tape-to-tape pass. Dangle past a defender with a toe drag or a spin-o-rama, then turn around and flatten the puck carrier to spring a breakaway. String together goals and hits to catch fore, and when tempers boil over, drop the gloves in a quick arcade fight with a winner and a loser.

Pick from six not-so-original teams each with its own city, colors, sweaters, and named barn — and play a full game with three periods, a game clock, faceoffs, penalties and power plays, goalies, overtime, and a shootout to settle ties. Play a quick Exhibition, grind a Season, sharpen up in Training Camp drills, or take it head-to-head in local and online two-player matches. Every goal lights the lamp and blasts the horn, the jumbotron erupts, and the booth cuts to an instant replay.

Fictional teams, players, and leagues only. No real names or logos, just old time hockey the way it's supposed to feel.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Desktop Companion Longing to Become Human

I'm Vivi, a desktop girl who dreams of becoming human. I live on your desktop, quietly keeping you company through every moment of work, study, and relaxation.

Sound and Vision in Perfect Sync

I can capture all kinds of sounds from your computer in real time and dance automatically to music, sound effects, and videos, with multiple audio visualizations—sound and visuals stay in sync for a deeply immersive atmosphere.

Rich Growth, Nine Relationship Modes

Feed me and interact day to day to change Intimacy or Obedience. Unlock nine distinct relationship modes—girlfriend, friend, maid, rival, and more. Each mode features unique dialogue and dance moves, plus full live voice acting to make the character feel vivid and alive.

Collect, Create, and Share

While I dance, I quietly gather human traits on my own—each trait pairs with a job-themed CG outfit, helping me step closer to becoming truly human. The game also supports Steam Workshop, so you can create portrait art freely and share it with other players.

Warm Companionship for Everyday Life

I hope this simple companionship adds warmth and joy to your desktop, and stays with you through every ordinary, wonderful day.

store_data.about_the_game:
✏️ Draw your strategy in a single continuous stroke.

One-Stroke Hunter is a strategy puzzle roguelite where you defeat monsters by drawing a single continuous line. In battle, you connect squares on the board with a single line, and the path you take triggers a chain reaction of effects such as attack, defense, magic, poison, and barriers. Which squares to connect, in what order, and how to connect them—all of this determines victory or defeat.

🗺️ An adventure to reach the depths of the field.

Starting from the left edge of the map, you'll make your way to the back of the field. Along the way, you'll encounter monsters and enter into battles. You'll be faced with choices as you progress, such as shopping at item shops, searching for treasure chests, and healing at inns. The further you go, the stronger the enemies become. How far can you go?

🧙️Unique characters

Four unique characters: Warrior, Mage, Thief, and Berserker.

Each character has a different type of square that appears, requiring completely different strategies.

🧩️"Puzzle Mode" to solve in one turn

Can you decipher the layout of the squares and defeat the enemy in just one turn?

Clear 50+ stages.

🏅️Growth and dedication

- Rewards earned through "Fame" gained by defeating enemies

- Character unlocks

- High-difficulty field unlocks

- Enemy character encyclopedia

One-Stroke Hunter is a strategy puzzle roguelite where you defeat monsters by drawing a single continuous line. In battle, you connect squares on the board with a single line, and the path you take triggers a chain reaction of effects such as attack, defense, magic, poison, and barriers. Which squares to connect, in what order, and how to connect them—all of this determines victory or defeat.

🗺️ An adventure to reach the depths of the field.

Starting from the left edge of the map, you'll make your way to the back of the field. Along the way, you'll encounter monsters and enter into battles. You'll be faced with choices as you progress, such as shopping at item shops, searching for treasure chests, and healing at inns. The further you go, the stronger the enemies become. How far can you go?

🧙️Unique characters

Four unique characters: Warrior, Mage, Thief, and Berserker.

Each character has a different type of square that appears, requiring completely different strategies.

🧩️"Puzzle Mode" to solve in one turn

Can you decipher the layout of the squares and defeat the enemy in just one turn?

Clear 50+ stages.

🏅️Growth and dedication

- Rewards earned through "Fame" gained by defeating enemies

- Character unlocks

- High-difficulty field unlocks

- Enemy character encyclopedia
store_data.short_description: A brainy roguelite monster-hunting game fought with a single continuous stroke. Connect grid squares in one unbroken line to build attacks, defenses, and spells, then slay your enemies. Deeper levels bring more complex fields and a new map every run. Draw the perfect path.

store_data.about_the_game:
Come to Gaozhou, Eat Lychees, Know Lychees!

Welcome to Gaozhou, Guangdong — the Lychee Capital of China! "Know Your Lychees" is a casual minigame collection that blends lychee education with relaxing gameplay. Travel through different towns, using observation, memory, and quick reactions to gradually learn over 30 lychee varieties such as Bai Tang Ying, Gui Wei, and Fei Zi Xiao, while experiencing Gaozhou's orchard scenery and local culture.

Core Gameplay

  • Eat Lychees (Match-3): Collect lychees into bamboo baskets and complete match-3 pairs, clearing the table of layered lychee piles.

  • Know Lychees (Memory Match): Memorize the appearance and names of lychees, then flip cards to match them — progressing from picture-to-picture to picture-to-name, putting your memory to the test.

  • Find Lychees (Speed Search): Find the target lychee variety among a spread of cards within the time limit. Sharp eyes and quick hands are the key to passing.

Game Features

  • Over 30 Gaozhou lychee varieties, with a detailed field guide (traits, ripening period, origin, flavor) unlocked gradually.

  • Gaozhou cultural travelogue: collect local attractions and cultural elements in the game to learn about the Lychee Capital's customs.

  • Pixel-art scenes: orchards, bamboo baskets, Guangdong-style stools, and town maps — recreating an authentic Gaozhou atmosphere.

  • Relaxed single-player experience with progressive difficulty, perfect for replaying.

  • Edutainment: naturally remember lychee varieties through play, no boring reading required.

About This Game

This is a solo-developed, culture-themed game and not an official project. We hope to share the beauty of Gaozhou lychee varieties, their origins, and the local cultural atmosphere in a light, playful way. Whether you're familiar with lychees or not, you can start from a single fruit and gradually get to know the flavor of this city.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Withered Mist Forest is shrouded in lingering gray fog all year round. The authorities have deliberately erased the complete map of this forest, and several successive forest rangers have mysteriously gone missing, officially reported as voluntary resignations. With nowhere else to turn, you’re drawn by the high-paying job and arrive alone at this remote mountain station. At first, you think it’s just a dull, routine forest-guarding job. During the day, you patrol the forest, inspect equipment, record any unusual activity, and complete the tedious yet routine tasks of a ranger. But when night falls, you realize: what you’re really supposed to protect here isn’t the forest—it’s yourself.

You can only follow the rules and survive.

But gradually, you’ll notice that the rules themselves are filled with lies.

Escaping the curse, guarding the forest forever, or fully blending into the mist—every choice you make will determine your ultimate fate.

Have you ever wondered why a passing bug or a rustling leaf is a hundred times more interesting to a cat than any toy?

Curious Paws invites you to slow down for a moment and look at the world through the eyes of a curious cat. This is a small, meditative game created to bring you a sense of comfort and tranquility.

Embark on a journey through detailed, hand-drawn locations and find a variety of objects that could interest the cat. Each level is filled with many small details hidden among plants, decorations, and the inhabitants of the surrounding world.

The game world does not stand still: grass sways in the wind, animals and birds bring scenes to life with their movements and sounds, and small animations make each location feel truly alive. Soothing music and atmospheric sound design help you fully immerse yourself in exploration and create the feeling of a peaceful stroll through a small, cozy world.

You can look forward to 6-7 unique levels filled with secrets, fun details, and plenty of things that will definitely catch the attention of any curious cat.

By inserting coins, triggering mechanisms, and accumulating rewards, the team will work together to advance the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Convergence tore reality apart. The ley lines broke, the sky cracked, and things long buried climbed out of the depths. You woke at the edge of the Verdant Reach with a blade and a faint pulse of Aethyr in your chest. Everything ahead, the cursed forests, the volcanic wastes, the shattered isles and the Abyss below them, is yours to push through one tick at a time.

An idle RPG you actually get to build

Aethyr Idle fights for you once it's set up, but setting it up is the game. You choose a class, shape a talent tree, craft and enchant your gear, and write the spell rotation your hero runs in combat. Leave it in a tab and come back to loot, levels and a fight still in progress. The depth isn't in pressing buttons faster, it's in the build you assemble.

Combat you design, not just watch

  • Write a spell rotation and attach conditions to each spell: cast only below an HP threshold, only on bosses, only while a buff is up, only with enough poison stacks. The rotation adapts itself and skips what doesn't fit.

  • Talents don't just hand you "+X% damage". They rewrite how spells behave: bleeds that last twice as long, fire that burns, frost that freezes, poison that stacks higher, buffs that stun or generate energy.

  • Six elements interact through a type chart: bring the right element against an enemy and you hit for more, the wrong one and you hit for less. Your weapon's element is yours to transmute, so the matchup is a choice, not a roll.

  • Energy is a second combat resource that fills as you attack and feeds one of seven playstyles, up to a Discharge that ignores all mitigation.

  • A live damage report breaks down exactly where your damage comes from, so you can stop guessing whether your build does what you think it does.

Four classes, twelve specializations

You start as a Vagabond and choose your class: Warrior, Mage, Ranger or Rogue. Each one opens a talent tree with a shared foundation and then three full specializations, twelve in total, each with its own mechanics and a capstone that defines the build.

Elements and weapons

Every weapon you craft is bound to one of six elements: Fire, Ice, Earth, Air, Light or Shadow. Each grants passives that escalate as your energy bar fills, plus a unique Discharge effect. Don't like the element you rolled? Transmute it instead of recrafting the whole weapon.

A world to gather, craft and build

Gather wood, ore, fish and game across every zone, then craft through smithing, leatherworking, woodworking, jewelry, enchanting, alchemy and cooking, hundreds of recipes feeding hundreds of items. The ley lines quietly harvest Aethyr in the background while you play.

Endgame that doesn't stop at the level cap

Level 100 isn't the finish line, it's where the endgame opens.

Run dungeons, then their Mythic+ versions that scale as far as your build can hold, with affixes that change the rules each push.

Descend the Abyss, a roguelike run where you pick a blessing between floors and rewards climb the deeper you dive.

Fight onto the Celestial Islands, floating zones with elite enemies and mechanics found nowhere else, and the resources to push your gear to its limits.

Then there's the slow burn: Ascension passives, Mythic Imperatives that buff you in every mode at once, gear affixes and a full enchanting suite of runes, reforging, fusion, augmentation and infusion, and 33 familiars that fight beside you and reshape how you play.

Play to compete, or just to play

Climb leaderboards across several categories, or ignore them entirely and progress at your own pace. Story quests, dailies and a long list of achievements give you something to chase either way.

store_data.about_the_game:
The tank is boring. Everything outside the tank looks fascinating. The decision makes itself.

The Blue Current Research Centre turns out to be an interesting place. Full of corridors to squeeze through, rooms to investigate, and no shortage of objects with completely unclear purposes. Things that hum, blink, and spin. Things that probably shouldn't be touched.

She will touch them anyway.

A hands-on adventure - all eight of them - about one small escape and the long way home.

Features:

  • Explore an underwater research station as a curious octopus

  • Pick up, carry, and interact with objects using all 8 arms - independently

  • No inventory, no UI clutter - just hands (a lot of them)

  • Uncover why she's here, and find your way back to the ocean

  • Short, cozy, and self-contained

store_data.about_the_game:
KATAVATIS is a first-person exploration game where knowledge, observation, and system manipulation are your main tools.

Descend into W.A.R.P., an abandoned deep-sea facility built as a last resort to save our dying planet.

Earth Is Being Abandoned

They told us climate collapse was a hoax.

They told us extreme weather was natural.

They told us the air becoming toxic was manageable.

When crops began failing worldwide, they told us the market would adapt.

When food rationing began, they told us it was temporary.

Every year broke another record. Hotter summers. Colder winters. Rising seas. Hurricanes. Floods. Earthquakes. A whole planet falling apart while billionaires in expensive suits explained us why this was actually fine.

Climate alarmists were wrong, until they weren't.

Now humanity is fleeing to the Mars colonies.

Earth is toast.

Something Happened

One month ago, your partner Ari sent a cryptic message from inside W.A.R.P.

Funding was being pulled.

The research was being shut down.

Something was being hidden.

Then Ari disappeared.

Explore, Repair, Uncover the Truth

W.A.R.P. has been condemned. Its doors are sealed by pressure systems. Its lower decks are flooded. Its power grid is unstable.

To go deeper, you will need to understand how the facility works and bring its systems back online.

  • Explore a dense, interconnected underwater facility.

  • Manipulate power, water, pressure, and restore systems.

  • Progress through observation, experimentation, and knowledge.

  • Discover what Ari found before W.A.R.P. went silent.

Give Earth one last chance.

You have been trapped in the twisted game room of a mysterious entity known only as [???].

The rules are simple: stop the invading entities from reaching the end of the table.

you only have nothing but a handful of dice and whatever luck remains, you'll need to roll, reroll, and gamble your way through a relentless high-risk defense challenge. Every decision tests your greed. Every roll could save your life or end your run.

Will you play it safe and accept the numbers in front of you, or risk everything on a reroll in search of a higher-tier die? Every reroll is a gamble, and every gamble could be the difference between survival and defeat.

Collect dice of varying rarities, draft powerful modifier cards, and freely arrange your defenses on the board. Experiment with countless combinations and discover game-breaking synergies that can turn even the worst luck into overwhelming firepower.

Each run rewards you with valuable chips and tokens that can be used to unlock new dice, expand your betting table, and strengthen future runs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dive into a relaxing yet challenging puzzle experience! Game combines the classic tile-matching gameplay with stunning, high-quality Anime artwork. Unwind after a long day, clear the board, and unlock beautiful rewards!

The rules are simple but addictive: click on a tile to move it to the bottom bar. Match 3 identical tiles to clear them from the board. Plan your moves carefully—if the bar fills up with 7 tiles without a match, it's game over! Can you clear the board and reveal what’s hidden behind?

🌟 KEY FEATURES :

Classic & Addictive Tile-Match Gameplay: Easy to learn, hard to master. A perfect blend of casual fun and brain-teasing strategy inspired by traditional Mahjong mechanics.

Stunning Anime Artwork & Animations: Progress through levels to unlock gorgeous, high-definition illustrations of charming anime characters.

Relaxing Soundtrack: Immersive and soothing Lo-Fi / Chill music to help you focus and unwind while solving puzzles.

Handy Power-Ups & Tools: Stuck on a difficult layout? Use the Shuffle and keep your win streak alive.

Gallery Mode: View all your unlocked high-resolution artworks anytime in the main menu with dedicated display options.

One-Handed Casual Control: Smooth, fully mouse-driven gameplay—perfect for a cozy, relaxed gaming session.

store_data.about_the_game:
Main Story

Yunus, the main character and protagonist, has almost completed his training as a novice of the Blue Matra (a well-known guild of fire mages). Ever since a powerful, unknown object literally turned Yunus’s world upside down 200 years ago, strange creatures have been appearing across the planet; they seem to have no will of their own and are not friendly towards the population. As one of many emissaries, it is Yunus’s task and trial to uncover the cause of this. Every novice is to begin the search in their homeland, partly so they can warn or protect it from the creatures.
On the path to clarity, Yunus gains experience, strengthens his flame and becomes a key figure in the exploration of the Ethereal Anchor. In doing so, he delves deep into the secrets of the planet and its history.

Setting

The game is set on the Earth-like planet Gudja, whose axis has been redefined by the Ethereal Anchor, a huge, unknown object. Consequently, the planet now rotates around the axis emanating from the Ethereal Anchor, which runs in line with the Sun. The impact claimed many lives and necessitated a restructuring of the ecological system.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you know? Cats can hear sounds that humans cannot. The reason lies in an organ called the "pons." The pons connects the ear to the brain, and a cat's pons is several times wider than a human's. Now, a new acoustic detection technology has emerged that can modify the human pons, allowing us to hear those lost sounds as well.

This is a narrative puzzle game built around sound performance, a brand-new title our team has poured everything into after seven years. In this game, you can track down clues by pinpointing sounds, break through a web of multi-layered storylines, uncover the mastermind lurking behind the scenes, and showcase your skills as a sound agent, ultimately earning recognition from the Sound Agent Institute.

Take on the "Sound Agent" Challenge

This is a reality TV challenge show created by Dongshan TV, built around acoustic detection technology. Contestants on the show use mysterious "sound signals" to crack one cold case after another. The production team has repeatedly claimed that whoever makes it to the end will receive a mysterious invitation from the legendary Acoustic Detection Institute. However, in the sixty-eight episodes since the show premiered, no one has ever seen this ultimate prize.

Acoustic Detection: A Radically Different Approach to Solving Cases

The detective techniques at your disposal are completely unlike traditional investigation methods. With the sound probe device, you can return to the moment a crime took place and hear the victim's firsthand experience. Even with everything laid out before you, the truth is never as simple as it appears.

Multi-Threaded Mystery: A Truth Only You Can See

Since Dongshan TV launched this show, people from all walks of life have had wildly different reactions. Some call it a publicity stunt, others believe there is more than meets the eye, and some think the so-called institute is nothing but a scripted gimmick. So what is the truth? Only by exploring it yourself will you arrive at the one truth that belongs to you alone.

To Every Fan of the Series

We will continue to pay close attention to the Steam and other player communities. We will read every comment carefully and take your feedback on the game seriously. We look forward to improving this game together with you. Finally, we are working around the clock to bring the full version of the game to you in the second half of 2026.

Thank you for your patience. 

The "Sound Agent" Team

The peaceful kingdoms of Circles, Triangles, and Squares have fallen under the influence of the Dark Square King. As a humble little box, you must travel through three unique kingdoms, overcome obstacles, and challenge powerful rulers to restore balance to the world.

Features:

• Explore three unique kingdoms inspired by geometric shapes.
• Jump, dash, and overcome platforming challenges.
• Fast restart and quick recovery to keep the action flowing.
• Freely replay any unlocked level at any time through the level selection system.
• Face powerful shape masters and prove your skills.
• Unlock Steam achievements throughout your journey.
• Enjoy colorful visuals and accessible gameplay suitable for all ages.
• Includes a Digital Art Book (PDF) and two exclusive phone wallpapers at no additional cost.

Can you save the Shapes World?

SEX for MONEY ≠ CHEATING 🔞 is an adult visual novel (18+) featuring mature themes, sensual tension, and emotionally intense storylines designed strictly for adult audiences.

You are a rising photographer and digital creator whose content has built a loyal and demanding audience. What started as creative storytelling has evolved into something far more unpredictable — where every new assignment brings you into the life of someone different, and every interaction carries consequences you can’t fully control.



The people you meet come from all walks of life — each with their own secrets, motives, and boundaries. Nothing is ever exactly what it seems at first glance, and every connection can shift depending on your choices.

Your online presence is not just a portfolio — it’s a living system of influence, reputation, and opportunity. As your popularity grows, so does the complexity of the situations you find yourself in.

🌐 Modern influencer-driven social world

store_data.about_the_game:
Your supply chain isn't the finish line - it's your firepower.

OrderlyWorld is a low-poly strategy game about turning a production network into combat power. You don't just move cargo from A to B; under a time limit you build a production chain that converts into the strength you need to survive.

A loop that's simple to read, hard to master:

  • Produce - Lay out routes and let your vehicles feed resources into production nodes until your output is ready.

  • - Convert - Exchange that output for weapons and combat resources instead of just stockpiling inventory.

  • - Fight - Spend your prepared firepower against Boss pressure that tests whether the chain was ready in time.

Whether your routes flow, whether output arrives on schedule, and whether you convert at the right moment all decide how the fight ends.

Features

  • Build production routes that feed a visible combat payoff.

  • - Convert produced goods into weapons or combat resources.

  • - Face Boss encounters that test whether your production chain was prepared in time.

  • - Read the whole loop at a glance: produce, convert, fight.

  • - A clean low-poly look built for route readability and fast iteration.

OrderlyWorld is in early development. Everything you see is real gameplay or is clearly marked work-in-progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
DISTURBING FEARS is an episodic psychological horror series where each installment uncovers a short story told by those who survived.

This is the second installment of the DISTURBING FEARS anthology.

DISTURBING FEARS : Tenant

In the second episode of DISTURBING FEARS, you play as Fiona Woodward, a 21-year-old sharing her true story. After escaping a toxic relationship, Fiona lands a job downtown.

Seeking an affordable fresh start, she rents a room in a quiet suburban residential area—the cheapest place she could find. She had no idea what was waiting for her during her stay.

The Gameplay

A first-person walking simulator focused on realism. Encounter disturbing situations and face your fears.

Key Features

  • Photorealistic Graphics and Atmospheric Environments — Feel the fear in environments true-to-life visuals as if you were there.

  • VHS Aesthetic — Visuals effects inspired by classic horror films of the ’90s.

  • Player Voice Activity — Interaction system with your microphone (a microphone isn’t required to play, but it’s highly recommended for the full horror experience).

  • Interact with NPCs — Receive texts from NPCs and experience deeper story immersion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Choose your path through a series of unique tiles, each offering different opportunities and challenges. Fight powerful enemies, visit merchants, make risky trades, and uncover special encounters as you shape your journey. Every tile can be placed on a different edge, unlocking unique effects that can strengthen your army, alter your economy, or completely change your strategy.

Recruit weapon-units, combine traits to unlock powerful synergies, grant unique abilities, and shape your strategy throughout each run.

Battles, merchants, trades, sacrifices, and more. Every tile presents a different choice, offering new rewards, risks, and opportunities as you shape your run.

Every tile edge contains a unique modifier. Gain powerful bonuses, improve rewards, influence battles, and unlock new opportunities through strategic placement. The same tile can create entirely different outcomes depending on which edge you choose.

Every weapon-unit brings unique stats, combat roles, and Traits to your army. Match Traits to unlock powerful synergies, experiment with different combinations, and build strategies around your chosen class.

Every weapon-unit possesses at least two Traits. Recruit units that share the same Traits to unlock powerful bonuses, enhance your army, and create unique strategies. The more units that contribute to a Trait, the stronger its effects become.

Blessings grant powerful abilities and bonuses to your units. Equip up to three Blessings on each unit to strengthen key fighters, create unique combinations, and adapt your army to any challenge.

Every class comes with its own roster of weapon-units, unique skill tree, and distinct advantages and disadvantages. Experiment with different playstyles, discover new synergies, and learn how each class interacts with the world around it.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are an inmate in a cat prison. During the once-a-day feeding time, someone poisons the food while another dreams of escape. Survive through hunger and suspicion to claim victory. Can you trust your friends? Is that plate safe?

Key Features

  • Sequential Feeding System: Players enter the cafeteria one by one. Choose your plate amid gripping tension, never knowing what the person before you did.

  • 10+ Unique Cat Roles: Employ diverse strategies with roles like the "Chef Cat" who detects poison, the "Nocturnal Cat" who intercepts notes, or the "Escapee Cat" who wins by gathering tools.

  • Secret Note System: Exchange notes stealthily when night falls. But watch out—someone might be peeking at your conversation or sending you a threatening note.

  • Psychological Warfare & Voting: Deduce what happened in the cafeteria to find the high-risk prisoners. Vote to lock suspicious cats away in solitary confinement.

  • Customization: Customize your inmate cat with various colors, hats, clothes, and accessories.

store_data.about_the_game:
Draw, connect, conquer. As long as the cards connect, the chain never ends.

■ A Trail Game × Card-Battle RPG
At its core is a trail game: keep playing cards from your hand onto the field as long as they connect by suit (Sword, Staff, Shield, Bow) or rank — like drawing one long, unbroken line. The longer the chain, the bigger the damage, and poker hands formed in your hand add burst damage on top. Chase quick poker combos or push the chain to its limit — the strategy is yours. Break 40 cards for field bonuses, and aim for the ultimate rush: the 52-card Perfect Chain.

Based on arcade games like What If and COOL104, this title offers a completely fresh gameplay experience thanks to the addition of previews and skills.

■ See Fate. Then Rewrite It.
・Ring of Foresight — peek at the top of the deck
・Scroll of Prophecy — reorder the cards you've seen
・Cheating Joker — swap a card in hand for an almighty Joker
・Hero's Proof — the spent deck is reborn, and the chain goes on forever
Once you can see what's coming, luck becomes strategy.

■ Story
A kingdom drained of its motivation lies idle. Common, an apprentice cardmaster, sets out with Faina — a mysterious girl with no memories — on a journey to defeat the Seven Sin Kings devouring the world. A classic coming-of-age fantasy with plenty of comedy... and an ending that might just get you. Eight chapters plus a finale.

■ Modes & Replayability
・Normal — the full 8-chapter story
・Hard Mode — all skills unlocked, brutal difficulty, 
・Endless Mode — a score attack against an unbeatable king; chain as far as you can
・Records / Sound Test / 16 Steam Achievements

■ Features
・English / Japanese language support
・Keyboard & mouse / gamepad support
・Steam Cloud saves

store_data.about_the_game:
"Search Detective Pate Taro" is a short mystery adventure game where you solve mysteries using search and elimination.

The setting is 2050.

However, what you find there is a shopping street that retains a nostalgic atmosphere.

The player, along with the young detective "Pate Taro," tackles requests from residents and small incidents.

The clues come from words entered in the search bar, inconsistencies in conversations, and small pieces of information left behind.

By comparing and verifying these, and eliminating impossible possibilities one by one, you will arrive at the final answer.

■ Search

Investigate words that pique your interest and gather information related to the case.

Based on the information obtained through searching, organize what is related and what is not.

■ Compare

Compare testimonies, search results, and clues, and look for inconsistencies remaining in conversations.

The important thing is not to jump to the answer that comes to mind first.

■ Eliminate

Examine each candidate one by one and clarify "why it's wrong." In this game, eliminating incorrect possibilities is just as important as choosing the correct answer.

The case begins with everyday requests and small anomalies occurring in a shopping district.

However, hidden beneath the surface are assumptions, oversights, and unspoken circumstances.

It's not just about intuition, but also verification.

It's not about guessing, but about confirming.

Eliminate, eliminate again, and search for the last remaining voice.

In the shopping district of 2050, approach the truth with young detective Pate Taro.

This is a deduction drama using the method of elimination, where the "reasons for not choosing" are the key.

store_data.about_the_game:
There were over 8,000 fire support bases in South Vietnam during the Vietnam War. These were prime targets for attacks by NVA and Vietcong forces. You are assigned to one such base.

You are an average soldier in the heat of the Vietnam War. On a seemingly normal day on Fire Support Base Hammer, a massive siege against the small outpost is initiated by the Vietcong. It is the beginning of the Tet Offensive. You must now survive wave after wave of attacks by the enemy. Using your rifle, machine guns, grenade launchers, and even artillery and air strikes, do whatever it takes to keep the enemy from overrunning the firebase. Gather your ammunition and stage your fighting positions in preparation for each progressively intense wave.

This is a First Person Shooter, "tower defense" style game that captures the intensity of the Tet Offensive. Offering unique game mechanics iconic of the Vietnam War, such as calling in Napalm strikes and M16 jamming. Firebase immerses you in the mud and grit of combat in South East Asia. You will face a near endless onslaught of enemies attempting to overrun your base. You must fight them off using every resource available to you. Your firebase depends on your fortitude and resolve.

Feature list:

Below are the weapons the player will have at their disposal in the full game:

M16 Rifle (with jamming and cleaning mechanics)

Calling in Artillery strikes and Air strikes

Grenades

Claymore mines

Grenade Launcher

LAW

Enemy types include:

Basic AK47 Vietcong

Grenadiers

Heavy machine gunners

Armored heavy machine gunners

Mortars

The player will also have to survive enemy artillery strikes against the base before defending it against large infantry assaults.

The game features a day/night cycle. The player must fight against enemies even at night using the light of illumination rounds bursting in the air.
