store_data.about_the_game:
Omerta is a narrative card game about loyalty, survival, and the cost of silence after your father's death in the city. You will try to run the city with your decisions. Your uncles is in the way, try to survive and flourish.

Choose your origin — where you came from shapes what doors are open to you and which ones are permanently shut.

Allocate your Charisma, Wisdom, Connections and Dexterity. They will be tested, leaning into your strength will help you navigate the world.

Every day brings a new decision. Swipe left or right. Each choice shifts your four vitals — Health, Money, Respect,

Family. Let any one of them collapse and it's over.

Some decisions trigger an attribute check: a physics-based mini-game where a ball rolls across a pentagon shaped by

your stats. The stronger your relevant attributes, the larger your safe zone.

Features

- Narrative card-swiping gameplay with branching story paths

- Three origin backgrounds with distinct starting conditions

- Point-buy character creation across five attributes

- Physics-based attribute check mini-game

- A shop system to upgrade your character mid-run

*The Day of Revenge* is a short, lighthearted narrative yuri game. The protagonist, Amelia, is a mage with very little magical talent; the story begins when she encounters a ghost named Carola. The game focuses entirely on the narrative—featuring no combat or puzzles—and has a single ending.

· Uncover the true culprit behind Carola's death and join forces to exact revenge.

· A classic "scatterbrain and grump" dynamic.

· An entry for the 27th "Ultra-Short Game Creation Contest" on the Project Forum; the theme is "Procrastination"—find a sense of healing amidst the delay.

----------------------------------------

·Thanks to community user "redsh" for providing the English translation.

Amelia·Edwards(The surname has been revoked)

She was originally the designated heir to the Edwards family of mages, but was stripped of her status due to her abysmal magical aptitude, ultimately forcing her to move into a haunted house.

Corolla

She was the original mistress of the haunted house; murdered over a decade ago, she became a ghost and has haunted the premises ever since.

This game is played entirely using the keyboard; the mouse is not supported.

Arrow keys — Movement

ESC — Open menu / Cancel

Space / Enter — Examine / Talk

"Drowned in Yesterday's Sea" is a narrative-driven short Yuri game focused on exploration and puzzle-solving.

The story is set in the scenic coastal city of Xiamen in 2024. Gu Mengzhi, a 19-year-old student at Xiamen University, encounters Shan Hu (Coral), a vibrant "Sea Elf" from the depths of the ocean. The two quickly fall in love, wrapping themselves in a sweet, romantic romance. However, their idyllic days are abruptly shattered by an unwelcome interloper—a mysterious "Stranger."

As this mysterious figure tries to abduct her under bizarre pretexts, Mengzhi realizes she has been entangled in a labyrinthine conspiracy. What is the hidden truth behind it all? Can Mengzhi and her mystical lover escape the looming danger?

·Unravel the Mystery: Collect all 8 hidden clues to pierce through the fog and piece together the final truth.

·A Journey Through Xiamen: Explore meticulously recreated iconic locations, including Xiamen University, Gulangyu Island, and Huangcuo Beach.

·A New Horizon: The development team’s very first title featuring a real-world grounded setting.

·Award-Winning Heritage: Originally created for the 28th Project1 Micro-Game Making Competition under the theme "Stranger." Search for the true identity of the unknown intruder amidst a suffocating, mysterious atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
SYSCALL

This is our world now. The world of the electron and the switch.

SYSCALL is a reverse-engineering and assembly optimization puzzle game inside a private 1990s warez BBS. You will be writing assembly programs, reading listings, tracing the machine, changing the code, and shipping the crack.

READ THE CODE THAT RUNS

Every CRACK release is a small SYSCALL CORE program. You are able to trace programs, inspect assembly instructions, get hints and watch registers move, in order to find the way to TRACE, CRACK and PATCH programs.

FOUR WAYS TO HACK THE NETWORK

  • CRACK: Read the listing, find the secret input key, and bypass the protection.

  • PATCH: Fit the smallest fix into fixed edit slots, then run the test battery.

  • WORM: Program a dynamic up to nine-core rack, route values across ports, and cut lines and cycles.

  • SCOPE: Write firmware until the live trace locks onto the ghost signal.

SOLVED IS ONLY THE FIRST POST

SYSCALL has 200+ authored puzzles across four modes, but the clear is not the end. The board keeps records. CRACK tracks clean and swift solves. PATCH scores moves. WORM scores lines and cycles against REMOTE posts. SCOPE rewards tight firmware and low power. A working answer gets you in. A clean answer gets your name on the board.

A PRIVATE BOARD WITH REAL TOOLS

Dial in, pick a node on the NETWORK MAP, read the mail, check the notes, and work the releases. The board has PHILES that teach the SYSCALL CORE, crew messages, NFOs, greets, records, and side tools. CANVAS is a freeform assembly pixel toy. TRACKER is a four-channel chip-tune maker you can set as the board music.

BUILT FOR CONTROLLER, KEYBOARD, AND MOUSE

Every screen is playable with a gamepad, including text entry. You can write assembly on your favorite handheld gaming device or your TV! SYSCALL includes a tuned on-screen keyboard, controller command bars, readable scaling, reduced-motion options, and offline play with no accounts or backend.

SYSCALL

This is our world now. The world of the electron and the switch.

SYSCALL is a reverse-engineering and assembly optimization puzzle game inside a private 1990s warez BBS. You will be writing assembly programs, reading listings, tracing the machine, changing the code, and shipping the crack.

READ THE CODE THAT RUNS

Every CRACK release is a small SYSCALL CORE program. You are able to trace programs, inspect assembly instructions, get hints and watch registers move, in order to find the way to TRACE, CRACK and PATCH programs.

FOUR WAYS TO HACK THE NETWORK

  • CRACK: Read the listing, find the secret input key, and bypass the protection.

  • PATCH: Fit the smallest fix into fixed edit slots, then run the test battery.

  • WORM: Program a dynamic up to nine-core rack, route values across ports, and cut lines and cycles.

  • SCOPE: Write firmware until the live trace locks onto the ghost signal.

SOLVED IS ONLY THE FIRST POST

SYSCALL has 200+ authored puzzles across four modes, but the clear is not the end. The board keeps records. CRACK tracks clean and swift solves. PATCH scores moves. WORM scores lines and cycles against REMOTE posts. SCOPE rewards tight firmware and low power. A working answer gets you in. A clean answer gets your name on the board.

A PRIVATE BOARD WITH REAL TOOLS

Dial in, pick a node on the NETWORK MAP, read the mail, check the notes, and work the releases. The board has PHILES that teach the SYSCALL CORE, crew messages, NFOs, greets, records, and side tools. CANVAS is a freeform assembly pixel toy. TRACKER is a four-channel chip-tune maker you can set as the board music.

BUILT FOR CONTROLLER, KEYBOARD, AND MOUSE

Every screen is playable with a gamepad, including text entry. You can write assembly on your favorite handheld gaming device or your TV! SYSCALL includes a tuned on-screen keyboard, controller command bars, readable scaling, reduced-motion options, and offline play with no accounts or backend.
store_data.short_description: Reverse-engineer a private 1990s BBS. Read disassembly, patch broken checks, optimize a nine-core rack, and write assembly firmware that locks onto live scope traces. With 200+ puzzles, full controller support and offline play, you can refine your assembly skills on all your devices!

store_data.about_the_game:
One land. A thousand years. Every border based on real history.

Silesian Wars is a turn-based strategy game played entirely on a map of real Silesia. Every province is an actual gmina with borders drawn from real geographic data; the towns, castles, cathedrals and fortresses on the map stood — or still stand — where the game puts them. You don't conquer a fantasy continent. You fight over Wrocław, Opole, Brzeg and Nysa, and the rivers and mountain passes that decided their fates.

Play history era by era

The campaign follows Silesia through the centuries — each era a self-contained scenario, and a link in a chain you can play end to end:

  • Pagan tribes raising wooden strongholds along the Oder

  • Piast unification and the Mongol storm of 1241

  • The fragmentation into quarrelling duchies

  • The Bohemian crown and the Hussite wars

  • Habsburg rule, Reformation and Counter-Reformation

  • Prussia's conquest and the age of fortresses

  • Industry, plebiscites and the divided Silesia of the 20th century — all the way to the modern day

Play any era as standalone unit with mechanics unique to them.

Leaders with real personalities

Dozens of historical dukes, kings, bishops and warlords lead the factions — each an AI character with its own temperament: aggression, grudges, loyalty, greed, faith. Their difficulty ratings aren't guesswork; every leader earns its rank in automated AI-versus-AI tournaments before it ever faces you. And beyond the mortals wait the legends of Silesian folklore, champions like Rübezahl, Lord of the Mountains.

Orders together, consequences together

Turns are simultaneous: every ruler gives orders, then the world resolves at once. Raise and move armies, colonize the frontier, develop provinces, build markets and forts shaped by the terrain they stand on — then live with what your neighbors decided at the same moment. Diplomacy is a weapon too.

Bring your friends — or face the machine

Full online multiplayer: host a match or join over the internet or LAN, pick your seats in the lobby, chat, pause, save mid-match and continue later. Fill the remaining thrones with AI leaders of any difficulty, or just spectate and watch history unfold.

A living atlas of Silesia

Landmarks appear and disappear with the centuries — a wooden gród gives way to a Gothic castle, a bastion fortress, a coal mine. Hand-crafted event paintings mark the great turning points, and map views let you read the land like a chronicle: economy, armies, faith, danger.

Features

  • Authentic map of Silesia — every province a real gmina, real geodata borders

  • Scenarios spanning a millennium, playable standalone

  • Simultaneous turn resolution — no waiting for your move

  • Historical AI leaders with distinct personalities and tournament-earned difficulty ratings

  • Diplomacy with memory: alliances, tribute, fealty and grudges

  • Terrain-aware economy and real historical landmarks

  • Online and LAN multiplayer with lobby, chat, pause, spectators and mid-match saves

store_data.about_the_game:
Clara had a steady job, a fixed salary, and a perfectly mediocre life. One day she decided enough was enough. Now she's a freelance interior designer, and her first client is already waiting.

Decorate without a safety net!

Furniture pieces are stickers, and once placed, they can't be removed. The order in which you decorate matters: a rug placed after a table will cover it completely. Every decision counts, and there's no going back once you've made a decision.

Complete orders for an impossible clientele!

Neighbours with very specific quirks, obsessive collectors, misunderstood artists... and as your career progresses, something that no longer quite fits the category of "human". Clara will handle them all. With varying degrees of grace.

Build your dream home!

Use the money you earn from orders to improve and expand your home. There are no rules here: place and remove stickers freely until it's just right. When you're satisfied, submit it for evaluation and find out what rank your taste deserves. Will you be able to build your ideal home?.

Follow Clara's journey!

Every completed order advances Clara's career as a designer. From an insecure apprentice to a respected architect, her evolution sets the pace of the story and unlocks new orders, clients and increasingly... interesting challenges.

Features

  • Furniture pieces are stickers: once placed, they can't be removed until you retry the order.

  • Plenty of furniture pieces to use on orders, buy, decorate with and enjoy.

  • Rooms of all kinds of shapes, types and sizes.

  • Progressively harder orders: more rooms, more furniture, more requirements and more... strangeness.

  • A clientele that ranges from the eccentric to the outright supernatural.

  • Free home mode: decorate your own house without pressure and submit it for evaluation to reach the maximum rank.

  • Humour-driven narrative through Clara's dialogues and her clients.

  • Layered soundtrack that evolves with each moment of the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Poverty is a calculus of losses.

The Laws of Probability is a short, intensely gripping narrative experience. You play as 13-year-old Adam. In the kitchen, on a sticky oilcloth, lie a few carefully counted coins. Your younger brother stands in the doorway, waiting for you to divide what little there is.

There are no sprawling quests or skill trees here. There is only a melancholic, overwhelming reality and the constant calculus of how to survive until evening.

What to Expect

Instead of traditional entertainment, this project is a digital exercise in empathy. Classic video game mechanics have been inverted:

  • The illusion of choice: Confront an interface that actively locks options and crosses out decisions right before your eyes. Feel the crushing weight of a situation where good intentions are never enough.

  • Paralyzing moments: When a sudden, critical situation strikes, you will face a relentless, ticking clock. Experience how overwhelming stress and embarrassment can rob you of your voice, forcing you into the worst possible scenario.

  • A silent struggle: Your stats, like Shame and Exhaustion, climb with every minor defeat. The system reacts with micro-shakes to the screen, physically translating the protagonist's mounting psychological tension.

Who This Game Is Not For

I respect your time, so let's be clear. Do not download this title if:

  • you are looking for hours of gameplay (this is a self-contained story with meaningful choices, but you will experience it in no more than 10 minutes).

  • you expect heroic battles and a "good ending." Poverty rarely writes good endings.

  • you are looking for cozy escapism (the game holds up a mirror, and the reflection is intentionally uncomfortable).

But if you are looking for mature interactive storytelling that tackles uncomfortable themes and stays with you long after you turn off the screen—pull up a chair.
store_data.detailed_description:
Poverty is a calculus of losses.

The Laws of Probability is a short, intensely gripping narrative experience. You play as 13-year-old Adam. In the kitchen, on a sticky oilcloth, lie a few carefully counted coins. Your younger brother stands in the doorway, waiting for you to divide what little there is.

There are no sprawling quests or skill trees here. There is only a melancholic, overwhelming reality and the constant calculus of how to survive until evening.

What to Expect

Instead of traditional entertainment, this project is a digital exercise in empathy. Classic video game mechanics have been inverted:

  • The illusion of choice: Confront an interface that actively locks options and crosses out decisions right before your eyes. Feel the crushing weight of a situation where good intentions are never enough.

  • Paralyzing moments: When a sudden, critical situation strikes, you will face a relentless, ticking clock. Experience how overwhelming stress and embarrassment can rob you of your voice, forcing you into the worst possible scenario.

  • A silent struggle: Your stats, like Shame and Exhaustion, climb with every minor defeat. The system reacts with micro-shakes to the screen, physically translating the protagonist's mounting psychological tension.

But if you are looking for mature interactive storytelling that tackles uncomfortable themes and stays with you long after you turn off the screen—pull up a chair.
store_data.short_description: You have exactly 5. Bread is 4, the bus fare to school is 3. What do you give up? In this short narrative experience, you play as 13-year-old Adam. Confront an interface that reacts to a painful reality, and discover that freedom of choice is sometimes nothing but a privilege.

TURN THE SWARM INTO AMMUNITION

DIPOLE is a physics-driven polarity survival roguelite.

You control a two-pole Core inside a hostile arena. Matching polarity repels. Opposite polarity attracts. Switch at the right moment to bend enemy paths, capture a useful target in your orbiting counterfield, and launch it into something larger.

BREAK THE QUARRY

In later waves, marked enemies must be destroyed before the wave can end. If a Quarry survives beyond the normal spawn window, Overtime Rage makes the remaining swarm increasingly dangerous.

BUILD A PHYSICS MACHINE

Between waves, choose whether to place a new pylon or upgrade one already in the arena. Route, accelerate, teleport, trap, and recycle enemy traffic:

  • Accelerate enemies through Impulse Gates.

  • Create linked feedback loops with Slingshot Gates.

  • Collapse crowds into a single collision point.

  • Expose Marked targets with Inertial Shackles.

  • Aim automated launches with Orbital Relays.

ENGINEER A DIFFERENT BUILD

Draft talents that change how the whole run works. Enhance your pylons, build a tank, or trade safety for extreme launch damage.

  • 20 escalating waves with marked targets and Overtime Rage.

  • 10+ pylon types designed to combine into larger contraptions.

  • Six playable Cores with distinct stats and active abilities.

  • 70 tiered talents across 25 upgrade lines.

  • Permanent Aspect progression between runs.

  • Dedicated tutorial, Codex, remappable controls, and detailed run reports.

Your enemies are closing in. Make them collide.

store_data.about_the_game:
100 Yen Exorcist is a survival horror comedy game about surviving a bizarre part-time evil-spirit cleanup job.

【 Cleanup Manual 】

Your goal is to eliminate every last evil spirit haunting the school.

If an evil spirit spots you, it will come at you hard. Explore the school, study the scattered clues, and figure out how to deal with each spirit. Act in the right order, and you can clean them up safely.

【 Lovely Company-Issued Supplies 】

The tools that might be useful for investigating the school were kindly prepared by HR, who clearly has no idea what actually happens on-site.

Use them however the situation demands.

【 Brute-Force Cleaning 】

Want to skip all that annoying investigation, even if it puts you in danger?

Then we recommend the classic cleanup method of throwing your company-issued supplies directly at the evil spirits. If you’re confident in your aim, you can abandon the investigation entirely and force your way through.

【 Pre-Work Safety Notice 】

The “Evil Spirit Rage Meter” displayed on your phone shows the current danger level of the evil spirits.

Throwing supplies at them, messing around, or charging ahead without investigating will raise the meter—and the spirits will become shockingly stronger. How you use your supplies is up to you, but if you choose violence, you do so at your own risk.

【 Voice Cast 】

Keisuke Akai as “Takumi”

Rurikoin Lazward as “Safe & Sound Paranormal Response Center”

【 Play Time 】

About 60 minutes

【 Streaming Guidelines 】

You are allowed to post gameplay videos and livestream 100 Yen Exorcist, including monetized content.

No prior contact or permission is required, whether you are an individual creator or affiliated with a company. Good luck.

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your friends are the crew of the world's cheapest space program, and you have to fly an actual rocket to the Moon, and then to other planets.
Reach your destination using a wall of about four hundred switches and buttons.
Then upgrade your ship and do it all over again, farther.
It's only rocket science. How hard can it be?

  • This is the most autistic game you can play on Steam right now.

  • In this game, you and your friends are the crew of the world's cheapest space program, and you have to fly an actual rocket to the Moon. The capsule is tiny, so try not to elbow the abort handle.

  • Once you're strapped in, you are met by a pretty intimidating task.
    You have to launch, separate the stages, survive three days of space, and land on the Moon — using a wall of about four hundred switches.
    There's a checklist to guide you through them.
    It's photocopied, page six is missing, and the friend reading it out loud has never been right about anything.

  • The detail in this game is absolutely insane. Almost every switch is flippable. You can eat beef stew from a tube, and yes — you can use the space toilet. There's a checklist for that too.
    Anyways, once you're finally off the pad, you're gonna want to keep your eyes open, because things will go wrong.
    The oxygen can fail on its own, or your friend flips the wrong switch at stage separation and turns the mission into a very expensive firework.

  • And if you start getting on everyone's nerves up there? There's an airlock button. Your friends can vent you straight into space. No meeting. No vote. Just stars.

  • Stick the landing, plant the flag, say something historic.
    Crash, and the crater gets named after whoever touched the panel last.
    It's called ACTUALLY ROCKET SCIENCE. Because it is.

  • You can reach many different planets and moons.
    Use your hologram space map to navigate the star system and reach a planet or a moon.
    Once you land, you can explore and gather resources to upgrade your ship and go even farther.
    (If you can manage not to crash it)
    Some resources may also be found during space-travel, where you'll have to space-walk out carefully to collect them.

  • You can go outside the ship in space for a space-walk to repair broken parts or collect resources from asteroids or space debris while your friend is holding the cable, desperately waiting for the moment to let you go floating into space just cuz it'd be funny.

  • It's basically a friendslop space exploration game.
    Friendslop meaning it's way simpler to understand, way funnier and fun with friends, and way more replayable.
    Think No Man's Sky's space exploration but it actually plays nothing like it and it's specifically made to be more fun with friends, but can also be played solo!

store_data.about_the_game:
Sweet cargo. Angry bees. One rolling barrel.


A giant barrel of honey is rolling its way across the meadow toward the finish line — but only as long as there's honey left inside. Your job is to keep it topped up, one heavy keg at a time. The bees would really, really like you to stop.

Every honey pot delivered pushes the barrel further along its path, but only the honey that survives the journey counts toward your final score. Reach the cave, check your results, and see how much honey you managed to save!

Game Features

  • Toss honeyballs that bowl bees out of the sky and shove anything not
    bolted down.
  • Blow giant soap bubbles that scoop up stunned bees and harvest
    drifting pollen.
  • Chase pollen clouds for sweet little buffs — but step on the wrong
    one and you'll feel it.
  • Three flavors of bee come back from the hive armed: one charges in a
    straight line, one stings from above, one bounces around like it
    owns the place. They mix and match.

Roll the barrel. Mind the swarm. Keep the honey moving.

store_data.about_the_game:
You'd think that you and your friends run a lemonade stand in a mall.
The lemonade is real. But it's also not what you're selling at all.
Real players walk up, some want lemonade. Some want... "lemonade". And they ask in code you have to read, so the cops won't hear.
Full proximity voice/text chat.

  • This is a social economy trading game with friends and strangers and their friends, and also maybe their mom will join.

  • You'd think that you and your friends run a lemonade stand in a mall.
    The lemonade is real. But it's also not what you're selling at all.
    The stand is adorable. Just try not to think about what's under the table.

  • Real players walk up all day. Full proximity voice/text chat. Some of them want lemonade. Some of them want "lemonade". And they ask in code you have to read. Get it right, and the handoff happens under the counter while you're making change. Get it wrong, and you've just made things very weird for a man who genuinely wanted a drink.

  • Some customers know what your lemonade actually means. But some are just thirsty. And some are actually cops.

  • Not real cops. Mall cops. Real players, on a segway, with a walkie-talkie and no legal authority of any kind. They can't arrest you. But they can confiscate your table. It is the most powerless badge in law enforcement, and your friends will fight over who gets to wear it.

  • The code words aren't in the game. Your group invents them. By week two, your friends are ordering "extra pulp" with a straight face, and you genuinely don't know if that's product or a beverage.

  • Compete with the other's lemonade stands to sell the most while you buy out their stock.
    Everybody who's playing is either a lemonade stand owner (can be with your friends on the same stand), or a cop.
    Lemonade stand owners can go to other lemonade stand to buy their lemonade or "lemonade". Every player is real. There are no NPCs.

  • It's called LEMONADE STAND. And officially, that's all it is.

store_data.about_the_game:
HKO: Advanced Survival is an open-world survival experience that combines exploration, construction, resource management, tactical combat, and cooperative multiplayer.

Stranded across a remote archipelago, you must explore dangerous islands, gather resources, build shelters, improve your equipment, and survive against the mysterious creatures known as the Penitents. Discover abandoned facilities, hidden landmarks, roaming traders, and valuable supplies while uncovering the secrets of the islands.

Whether you prefer to build a secure base, customize your weapons, explore with a deployable drone, or venture into hostile territory in search of rare loot, every decision affects your chances of survival.

Key Features:

• Explore multiple islands filled with forests, beaches, rivers, lakes, settlements, and abandoned locations.

• Build and customize structures using a flexible construction system with free placement and grid snapping options.

• Gather resources from the environment, including wood, stone, and valuable supplies.

• Store, organize, and manage your equipment in dedicated weapon and item storage systems.

• Customize and upgrade firearms with attachments, visual modifications, and performance improvements.

• Use drones and map markers to safely scout dangerous areas.

• Trade with traveling merchants whose locations and available items change over time.

• Face intelligent and agile enemies known as the Penitents, capable of quickly overwhelming unprepared survivors.

• Experience realistic environmental systems including weather effects, weapon condition, and survival mechanics.

PHANTOM RUNNER

Team up with up to four players in a cooperative survival scenario set within a city overrun by Penitents.

Stranded and cut off from help, your team must search for fuel, engine oil, vehicle parts, and power generators in order to repair a truck and escape before the city consumes you. Cooperation, resource management, and careful planning are essential to survive.

EARLY ACCESS

HKO: Advanced Survival is currently in active development. The initial release includes the core survival experience, multiplayer systems, and the Phantom Runner game mode. Additional islands, content, features, and improvements are planned throughout development based on community feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO SKOOT CITY 

Your keyboard is no longer just a controller.

It is the road.

In Skoot: Keyboard Brawl, nearly every key becomes a place your car can drive. Tap a key and your Skoot turns toward it, carving a path across the whole keyboard as quickly, or recklessly as your fingers can plan one.

Cut from one side of the board to the other. Fake out an opponent. Thread between hazards. Swing around and catch somebody at the exact angle needed to break their armor.

With every key press, you are choosing where to go next.

DRIVE WITH THE WHOLE KEYBOARD

Skoot’s keyboard-control system turns driving into a rapid conversation between your hands and the arena. Nearby keys create tight corrections. Distant keys create bold charges across the board. Chaining them together lets you curve through traffic, snap into evasive turns, or commit to one precise full-speed ram.

It feels immediate, strange, and surprisingly natural once your fingers start thinking like a car. The keyboard becomes your way of escaping very bad traffic.

Every collision is judged by positioning and angle. T-bone another Skoot to destroy it, while protecting your own sides from the same fate. Meet head-on and both drivers might regret it.

THE CITY THAT NEVER SKOOTS

Skoot City is full of mind-controlled, self driving vehicles, you are one of the remaining conscious Skoot. Explore shifting environments, sudden hazards, strange machines, and cars that seem determined to solve every disagreement by accelerating into it.

The atmosphere can change from a clean competitive brawl to complete mechanical chaos in seconds. Armor breaks scatter across the keys. Power-ups appear in dangerous places. Engines rise and dip as cars weave around one another.

BRAWL YOUR WAY

Jump into quick arena battles against AI or other players. Break through rival armor, survive sudden-death hazards, collect unpredictable power-ups, and score by being the last Skoot still driving.

Matches are easy to understand, but the keyboard gives you room to develop your own movement style and tactics. Experienced players carefully trace routes around the arena.

WORLDS OF SKOOT

The story mode brings the keyboard-controlled excitement to unique challenges.

Race through dangerous scrolling courses, escape collapsing routes, navigate environmental hazards, unlock new Skoots, and face oversized bosses that bend the normal rules of the road. Each chapter brings your Skoot a new adventure and usually a new reason to crash.

FEATURES

  • A unique movement system that uses the entire keyboard as a field of destinations

  • Fast paced collision combat based on timing, positioning, and impact angle

  • Breakable armor, buffs, hazards, and morph power-ups

  • A handcrafted story mode with brawls, courses, environments, and boss battles

  • Online free-for-all multiplayer or solo brawl against AI

  • Endless driving challenges

  • Unlockable car models, colors, achievements, and story progress

  • Dynamic camera movement, hand-crafted audio, atmospheric weather, music, and tactile impact effects

Choose a key. Cut off Skoots. Dodge before they do.

store_data.about_the_game:
DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler.

Descend as an adventurer into procedurally generated dungeons. Plan your route across a node map—encounter battles, resupply, growth, and random events. Every step shapes your resources, risk, and rewards for the run.

Combat revolves around dice. Roll, reroll, and assign faces; combine Blade, Heart, Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Star elements to meet skill thresholds and unleash class abilities. After each fight, pick from rewards—new dice, relics, engraved traits, and skill upgrades—to build a unique dice bag and skill board every run.

Exploration is dice-driven too. Some branching options are gated behind dice challenges—roll the required combination or pip total to unlock better rewards.

Key Features

  • Dice building — Manage your bag, upgrade faces, fuse engraved traits; amplify your archetype with traits and relics

  • Tactical combat — Skill slots, bonus sockets, Focus, and class resources (e.g. Warrior Morale / Battle Intent) drive deep turn-by-turn decisions

  • Procedural dungeons — Main paths and branches with elites, resupply, growth, danger nodes, and pre-boss tuning rooms

  • Branching events — Exploration events and choice nodes where dice tests meet risk vs. reward

  • Roguelike runs — Random encounters, random rewards, run saves—every descent plays differently

Gameplay

Explore a surreal world haunted by the number 13 as you guide Lune through a series of challenging obstacles, mysterious locations, and disturbing memories.

  • Master parkour mechanics to jump across dangerous gaps, avoid deadly hazards, and reach hidden areas.

  • Solve environmental puzzles that reveal fragments of Lune's past and uncover clues about his mother's disappearance.

  • Survive increasingly twisted levels where reality bends around the curse of the number 13.

  • Discover secrets hidden throughout the world and piece together the truth behind the voice that called out, "Little Bunny."

Every challenge brings Lune closer to the answers he seeks—but some truths may be better left forgotten.

store_data.about_the_game:
FitBlocks is a relaxing wooden block puzzle game about fitting every piece perfectly into the tray.

Drag wooden pieces onto the board, rotate them, and find a way to fill the entire shape. There are no timers, scores, or penalties. Take your time, think through each arrangement, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every piece fall into place.

Each stage is handcrafted around a pixel-art inspired silhouette, from simple shapes to more challenging layouts. Early stages are easy to understand, while later puzzles introduce more pieces, unusual shapes, and trickier spaces to solve.

Features:

- Handcrafted block-fitting puzzles

- Relaxing wooden puzzle theme

- Simple mouse controls

- Rotate and place pieces at your own pace

- No timers, scores, or pressure

- Stage select and progressive unlocks

- Challenge stages for players who want harder puzzles

- Calm background music and cozy sound effects

"Who knew cleaning an ordinary room could be this addictive?"

Team up with an adorable robot vacuum and transform dusty, cluttered rooms into sparkling clean spaces.

You may start as a weak little vacuum that struggles to pick up even the smallest speck of dust, but every cleanup earns coins that can be spent on powerful upgrades. Grow into the ultimate cleaning machine and tackle even the messiest rooms.

Vacuum every piece of dust, clear away piles of trash, and restore every room to its former shine. Unlock larger areas, face bigger messes, and discover the satisfaction of cleaning everything in sight.

Features

Satisfying Cleaning

Vacuum dust and collect trash scattered throughout each room to earn coins. Watch messy spaces gradually become spotless as every corner comes back to life.

Grow Stronger with Every Upgrade

Spend your hard-earned coins to enhance your robot vacuum. Increase your suction power, equip a mop, and unlock unique abilities like Black Hole and Chain Lightning to clean faster than ever.

A Variety of Dirt and Trash

From tiny dust particles to massive piles of garbage, every type of mess presents a new cleaning challenge.

Bigger Rooms, Bigger Challenges

Explore larger environments filled with even more dirt and debris. Upgrade your vacuum to clean areas that once seemed impossible.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Chronicle of 20"67"

Rav A'ScarraCrow JustUse'Godot: Get freed from the "Rav A'ScarraCrow" thinking. They believe they found a real clue, but in fact, you must prove you are not incapable of thinking for yourself.

Protect the Jets Entity:

Jets is a beautiful entity that probably smiles and smells great. You need to protect Jets from the evil Jolly Wo'Angar.

Defeat the Evil Jolly Wo'Angar:

The evil Jolly Wo'Angar thinks he looks like an Australian version of Cruise. He thinks he’s right because he was allowed by his own genetics to say gross things, like "hackor smallest in the world."

The Weight of the World:

The way you see Crelly rounding herself up every day and changing reminds you of the times you will never be able to achieve because of the things that keep dragging you down. It brings the fear of wondering what the reason for living is. It makes you feel like you would want to have a bit of the LimesDancey in yourself, too.

The Burnout:

Feeling emotional burnout because you keep trying to do the stuff you feel you are only allowed to do. But passing through the Squ tree each day makes you realize she keeps spreading her branches every day, because for her, her branches are her "tools"—while you feel punished by the evil Wo'Angar.

The Villain’s Mockery:

Jolly Wo'Angar would call you a dumbass and mock you, thinking he "looks handsome because he deserves it" like the worst cartoonish villain. Yet, if you want your own "third place," you always need to fight, because they judge your intentions by your look.

The Powerhouse of the Cell:

When you feel almost defeated and like giving up on your own life, you are reminded of Layna. She felt mocking to you when she said, "Issues are the powerhouse of the cell." But unlike her, you don't have a "third place" that can carry you when you are at your best or at your worst. You can't just say, "That's right, that's where I quit," and move on.

But unlike her, they're never gonna put you in a game as a 'sexy nurse' in some average, bottom-barrel horror shovelware videogame where everyone is happy, or even paste your almost-balding head on a snorshe, because in fact, who are you? You aren't some marketable looking Jets, aren't you?

What You Actually Do In This Game: Behind all the emotional burnout and Wo'Angar's mockery, this is a puzzle game about figuring things out for yourself.

Spawn Mechanics: Summon objects and tools into the world to overcome obstacles.

No Hand-Holding: Just like dealing with the weight of the world, you have to figure out how to get to the flag on your own.

A fairly short experience that is meant to be "enjoyed like a box of cherry cordials" (like what even does it have to do with game???)

When you feel almost defeated and like giving up on your own life, you are reminded of Layna. She felt mocking to you when she said, "Issues are the powerhouse of the cell." But unlike her, you don't have a "third place" that can carry you when you are at your best or at your worst. You can't just say, "That's right, that's where I quit," and move on.

But unlike her, they're never gonna put you in a game as a 'sexy nurse' in some average, bottom-barrel horror shovelware videogame where everyone is happy, or even paste your almost-balding head on a snorshe, because in fact, who are you? You aren't some marketable looking Jets, aren't you?

What You Actually Do In This Game: Behind all the emotional burnout and Wo'Angar's mockery, this is a puzzle game about figuring things out for yourself.

Spawn Mechanics: Summon objects and tools into the world to overcome obstacles.

No Hand-Holding: Just like dealing with the weight of the world, you have to figure out how to get to the flag on your own.

A fairly short experience that is meant to be "enjoyed like a box of cherry cordials" (like what even does it have to do with game???)
store_data.short_description: A short, visceral, and physics-heavy descent into a personal third place. Spawn objects, defy the mockery of the void, and reach the flag before the burnout wins. Spawn lightweight Jets entities who smell nice, even when the world feels like a burden for you. Just dunno, puzzle game.

store_data.about_the_game:
STATO is a procedural grand strategy sandbox about building a nation in a world that does not wait for you.

Every campaign begins with a generated strategic map shaped by geography, resources, borders, coastlines, population, and rival powers. From there, you create a state, define its identity, and guide it through an unstable world where industry, diplomacy, logistics, and war all shape the course of history.

Expand your economy, secure vital resources, strengthen your infrastructure, and prepare your armed forces for conflicts that can emerge from ambition, rivalry, scarcity, or fear. Every province matters: cities drive power, frontiers create tension, ports open trade, and weak supply can break even the strongest offensive.

STATO is built around emergent campaigns. Nations rise, compete, fracture, and collide across a living strategic map. There is no single scripted path to victory. Your country may become an industrial power, a cautious regional actor, an expansionist empire, or a fragile state struggling to survive between stronger neighbors.

Build a State

Create and customize your nation, shape its political identity, and lead it through a procedurally generated world. Your choices define how your country grows, how others perceive it, and how far it can push before instability catches up.

Rule an Economy

Population, industry, infrastructure, resources, trade, and supply form the foundation of national power. Growth requires planning, and military ambition needs an economy strong enough to sustain it.

Redraw the Balance of Power

The world is shaped by competing ambitions. Build alliances, isolate rivals, secure strategic resources, and exploit international crises. Every decision influences the balance of power and can change the course of history.

Command War at Scale

Mobilize forces, hold frontlines, protect supply, and fight across land, sea, and air. Wars are not only won by numbers: logistics, preparation, production, geography, and timing can decide the outcome.

Create and Replay

Use procedural generation, scenario support, and map editor tools to build new worlds and tell different strategic stories. Each campaign offers a new political landscape, new risks, and new opportunities.

Key Features

- Procedural grand strategy campaigns

- Nation creation and customization

- Province-based economy, population, resources, and infrastructure

- Diplomacy, rivalries, alliances, crises, and war

- Land, naval, and air warfare systems

- Supply, mobilization, frontlines, and strategic pressure

- Scenario support and map editing tools

- Multiple visual themes and strategic map modes

store_data.about_the_game:
Synopsis

My mother, who worked at a facility managing the belongings of those who met a gruesome end—the Kihin—has died. It was written off as a tragic accident... But was it really? Was it just an accident? I have to find out... what really happened on that day. Can a son chasing the truth ever uncover the reality? Your choices and actions will dictate the end.

Game Features

  • Uncover the Truth: Control the protagonist and solve the mystery behind the facility where your mother passed away.

  • Branching Narrative: Your choices and actions will split the story, leading to 5 unique endings +α.

  • Touch the Memories: Interact with each Kihin (the cursed belongings) to touch their memories and piece together what happened.

Estimated Playtime

  • 10–15 minutes per playthrough to reach an ending. (A short, fast-paced story designed for high replayability.)

Recommended for players who

  • Love games where choices branch the story and change the outcome.

  • Enjoy short, bite-sized games that can be played quickly.

  • Love collecting multiple endings and uncovering every secret.

System & Specifications

  • Controls: Keyboard and Mouse only.

  • Audio/Visual: Fully voiced in Japanese with custom face motions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your desktop just got a little wetter.

Pocket Pond is a cozy idle fishing companion that lives right on your desktop. A pixel-art angler drifts in his boat along the bottom of your screen - casting, waiting, and reeling in fish entirely on his own - through a transparent, borderless window that floats over everything else. No tab to keep open, no clicking to do. Just glance over now and then to see what's on the line.

🎣 Cast once, relax forever

  • Truly AFK - the angler fishes by himself while you work, browse, or play something else.

  • Always there - a frameless overlay that sits on your desktop and stays out of the way; click straight through to whatever's behind it.

  • Make it yours - drag it anywhere, scale it up or down, lock it in place, launch it at startup, and keep it always-on-top.

🐟 A whole pond to discover

  • 130 species of fish, from everyday commons to shimmering legendaries.

  • Five rarities to chase - every catch is a little hit of "what did I get?"

  • Fill your codex - log every species you've caught, its size and weight ranges, and your personal best.

🌊 Explore new waters

Travel between biomes - the calm Blue Lagoon, a vivid Coral Reef, a swaying Kelp Forest, a tangled Mangrove Delta, and steaming Volcanic Springs - each with its own backdrop and roster of fish. Work your way up through fishing levels to reach rarer, more valuable catches.

💰 Catch, sell, upgrade

  • Sell your haul for coins - space is limited, so decide what to keep and what to cash in.

  • Gear up in the shop: rods, reels, lines, hooks, and baits, each with effects that quicken bites, hook slippery fish, tip the odds toward rares, double your catch, and more.

  • Grow your stash by buying extra inventory slots as your collection expands.

✨ The calm little ritual in the corner of your screen

Hand-crafted pixel art, a gentle soundtrack, and dozens of achievements to chip away at. Pocket Pond is the perfect companion for focus, study, or winding down — a quiet pond that's always just a glance away.

Cleaning Has Never Been This Relaxing

Last night, you hosted a huge party. The music was great, the mood was lively, and your guests had an unforgettable evening.

But the next morning, you are left with complete chaos.

Bottles, cans, packaging, and all kinds of trash are scattered everywhere. Your guests are long gone, and they have left the entire mess behind. Now it is your task to restore your home and the surrounding areas, turning them back into clean and cozy places.

store_data.about_the_game:
Proud Boss Turns Into Obedient Loyal Maid - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Core Plot Introduction
Underground in Manhattan, New York, worker Ilya encountered an explosion during tunnel work and merged his consciousness with Liu Zihua to gain superpowers. He disguises himself as a low - level employee in an insect food research laboratory during the day and follows the clues of the consciousness insects to investigate the conspiracy of the FX Group at night. Meanwhile, the relationship between him and his proud boss, Natalie, is also undergoing subtle changes.

Worldview Atmosphere
The story constructs a world full of science - fiction elements. The FX Group has built an "Ancient Erosion Energy Field Core" underground, and what it has cultivated is slowly permeating the whole world. Mysterious consciousness insects, strange superpowers, and hidden conspiracies make the whole world full of unknowns and dangers.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction
Natalie, the proud boss, goes from resenting Ilya to gradually submitting to him. The interaction between the two is full of tension. Ilya uses his superpowers to protect Natalie, and Natalie signs an obedience contract with Ilya at her most vulnerable moment. This transformation is full of drama and appeal.

Tension in Character Relationships
Ilya's consciousness is merged with Liu Zihua's. He has his own self - awareness but is also influenced by Liu Zihua. The old grudges and new feelings between him and Natalie are intertwined. There is also the mysterious Sister Li who gives guidance. These complex character relationships add rich tension to the story.

Scene Features
From the damp tunnels underground in Manhattan, New York, to the insect food research laboratory, and then to the cheap rental house in Brooklyn, each scene has its own characteristics, creating different atmospheres and making players seem to be in a real science - fiction world.

Immersive Experience
Players will follow Ilya's perspective, feel his transformation from a low - level worker to a superpowered person, experience the complex emotional entanglement with Natalie, and delve into this mysterious and dangerous world, with a strong sense of immersion.

High - definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the details of the scenes and the expressions of the characters, allowing players to more intuitively feel every moment in the story.

Functional Gameplay Features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The auto - play function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function allows players to quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. High - definition CGs bring visual enjoyment to players, ensuring a smooth reading experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Faced with a planet depleted of resources, humanity turned to a desperate final measure: hyper-accelerating time to force Earth into a rapid state of regeneration. The reckless project failed, plunging the world into a state of 'zero entropy' where all energy decays into absolute nothingness.

You play as Gren, a state-of-the-art emergency protocol android built by humanity's finest minds for this exact apocalyptic scenario. Journey through dark facilities to wind back time, and forge a path to the genesis of the disaster to rewrite the future.

Gameplay & Key Features

  • Puzzle-Platforming: Navigate a atmospheric 2D pixel art world where reflexes and logic collide. To progress, you must master the flow of time itself.

  • Record and Replay Your Actions: Collaborate with your past self to overcome seemingly impossible obstacles. Record your movements and replay them to activate complex machinery in real-time. Let a past clone hold down a heavy switch, or time your jumps perfectly with a platform moved by your previous attempt.

  • Intricate Interactive Hazards: Puzzle your way through high-tech facilities filled with moving elevators, pressure plates, toggle-buttons, teleportation portals, and spatial rifts that shift direction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Royal Flush is a turn-based dueling card game built on a simple idea with deep consequences: one card, one turn, one chance to make it count. Every move is a calculated gamble. Play the right card at the right moment to unleash powerful effects, drain your opponent's health, and turn the tide of the duel before your own life runs out.

There are no sprawling hands to hide behind here. Each turn comes down to a single decision — and the player who reads the table best walks away the winner.

Play One Card. Change Everything.

Forget juggling a fistful of cards. In Royal Flush, you commit to a single play each turn. That focus turns every choice into a high-stakes read: do you strike now, set up your next move, or bait your opponent into overextending? Suits and ranks each carry their own weight, and knowing when to spend your best card is the difference between victory and defeat.

Outsmart a Cunning AI

The single-player opponent doesn't just play cards — it plays you. The AI adapts to your strategy, punishes greedy moves, and forces you to think several turns ahead. Sharpen your tactics in solo duels before you take your skills online.

Duel Players Online

When you're ready for a real challenge, take the table against other players in online multiplayer. Networked, real-time duels put your decision-making to the test against opponents who can bluff, adapt, and surprise you in ways no AI can.

Beat the Clock

A turn timer keeps every match tense and fast-paced. Hesitate too long and you'll forfeit your moment — every second at the table counts.

Key Features

  • One-card-at-a-time combat — every turn is a single, decisive choice with no filler.

  • Health & effects system — chip away at your rival's health and trigger powerful status effects.

  • Strategic AI opponent — face an adaptive solo opponent that learns to counter your style.

  • Online multiplayer duels — challenge real players in head-to-head networked matches.

  • Turn timer pressure — fast, tense rounds where hesitation costs you.

  • Slick visuals — fluid card animations and particle effects bring every play to life.

Read your opponent. Time your move. Deal the perfect card.

This is Royal Flush.

store_data.about_the_game:
SnapCats is a cozy cat sticker jigsaw game.

There are 100 cute and funny little cat scenes: stealing sushi, hiding in boxes, climbing into a fish tank, napping lazily, and more. Sticker pieces are scattered across the table, waiting for you to put them back together.
Look for clues in each cat's pose and scene, organize the table, and place each piece where it belongs. When the position is right, the sticker snaps together with a satisfying little sound. Piece by piece, the whole table fills with charming cats.

Features


  • 100 cat-scene sticker puzzles, each made from 2 to 5 pieces
  • 100 Steam achievements, one for each cat sticker
  • Freely arrange completed cat stickers after finishing a level
  • Hide the UI and take photos of your finished cat-sticker table
  • Relaxing music, soft sound effects, and plenty of cat meows and purrs

How to Play


Move sticker pieces around the table and place them in the right spots. Right-click to rotate the piece or group you are holding. Correctly matched pieces become one object, then can connect with other pieces or groups until the full cat sticker is complete.

As levels progress, more cats and pieces will appear on the table. You can zoom, pan the table, and box-select multiple pieces to search and organize more comfortably.

If you cannot find unfinished pieces, use the hint function to briefly highlight them.

Controls


  • Left mouse button: pick up, drag, drop pieces, and click buttons
  • Right mouse button: rotate the held piece or group
  • Mouse wheel: zoom the table
  • Middle mouse button / Space: pan the table
  • F: reset the table view
  • Esc: hide or show the game UI
  • H: highlight unfinished pieces

My Cats


SnapCats was inspired by real cats.

The settings menu includes a separate My Cats photo wall. It shows the five cats we have raised for many years, along with stray cats we are helping and caring for in the yard.

We are also doing our best to feed, care for, and help these stray cats so they can live more safely. We hope people and animals can live together with kindness. Thank you for visiting this small cat corner.

【Embark on a New Journey, Embrace Endless Trials】

⚔️ [Talent System: Build Your Unique Playstyle]
Earn gold in battle and push your limits! Your talent choices directly impact your damage, monster HP, and movement speed. Growth strategies shift as you progress:

  • Early Game: Play it safe and focus on Attack and Attack Range for quick crowd clearing.

  • Late Game: Push for the ultimate burst with Crit Rate and Crit Damage to land devastating blows.
    Unlock hidden [Divine Skills] to create unexpected, game-changing moments in battle!

🔥 [Divine Skill System: Your Ultimate Trump Card]
Say no to mindless auto-attacks! With Divine Skills, combat offers infinite possibilities:

  • Diverse DPS: Mix and match timed single-target snipes, small AoE blasts, and full-screen nukes.

  • Tactical Gameplay: It’s not just about massive damage. Utilize powerful buffs and debuffs to make your output even more deadly.

🔄 [Prestige System: Rebirth for Infinite Power]

Hit a damage wall? It’s time for a rebirth!

Prestiging will reset your current progress and gold, but you’ll earn precious [Crystals] based on your "Bounty Board" completion.

Crystals and their exclusive skills are permanently kept! Every rebirth means starting over with a massive advantage.

Will you prioritize boosting Attack for faster map clearing, or focus on maximizing Crystal gains? Every choice shapes your unique growth path!

🗺️ [Map System: Nine Unique Realms]

Explore 9 distinct maps, from dark forests to abyssal dungeons. Each realm features unique visuals and monster ecosystems, keeping your adventure fresh and exciting.

💌 [A Message from the Developer: One Person, One Dream, Endless Thanks]

This game is proudly built from the ground up using the Godot Engine. From art and programming to game design, it is entirely a solo indie project. This isn't just a game to me; it's my passion and dream brought to life.

Thank you to every single player who supports me! Feel free to join our community chat to discuss the game, share ideas, and grow together. I truly appreciate your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
[h2]Let Nobunaga lend you his ear[/h2]
"Encouraging Nobunaga" is a conversation app where you can speak your mind to Oda Nobunaga, the warlord who set out to unify Japan. Whatever you bring to him — something that happened today, a worry at work, a weakness you can't admit to anyone — Nobunaga takes it in with his bold, commanding voice, encourages you, and at times lights a fire under you.

[h2]Everything stays on your own PC[/h2]
Each reply is generated on the spot by a language AI running locally on your PC. Nothing you type is ever sent to an external server, and no internet connection is required. That is exactly why you can open up about the things you'd never want anyone to know.

[h2]For moments like these[/h2]
[list]
[]When you just want someone to listen at the end of the day
[]When you need a push, or a kick to get moving
[*]When you simply want to enjoy a casual chat with a warring-states warlord
[/list]

[h2]About the use of AI[/h2]
This game generates the character's reply text on the spot using a locally-running language AI. The portrait uses a public-domain painting; the talking and blinking animations based on that portrait are fixed assets created with a video-generation AI during development. Speech is read aloud by a voice-synthesis engine (VOICEVOX). The AI's responses vary every time and are not guaranteed to be accurate. Please enjoy it as entertainment.

[h2]Please note[/h2]
This is a conversation app intended for encouragement and light counsel. It does not provide professional medical, legal, or psychological advice.

store_data.about_the_game:
MegaCorp has 42 floors, one understaffed help desk, and a brand-new AI that is absolutely, definitely not after your job.

You are Analyst #15. Your monitor is your world: a ticket queue that never stops, an inbox full of escalating passive aggression, and a corporate news ticker that knows too much. Welcome to SERVICE DESK SIM — a retro-terminal IT helpdesk simulator about triage, time pressure, and the slow realisation that the machines are learning your job faster than you are.

TRIAGE OR DIE (PROFESSIONALLY)


  • Work the queue against SLA timers — accept, prioritise, resolve, and try not to apply the printer fix to the VPN outage.

  • 10,000+ hand-written tickets across 13 themed sectors, from the Basement helpdesk to the Quantum Lab to places IT support was never meant to go.

  • Multi-step complex tickets, VIP escalations, boss-level malware incidents, and department policies that change how every shift plays.

CRISES, CHOICES, AND CONSEQUENCES


  • Mid-shift Crisis Events freeze the clock and demand a decision with real, deterministic tradeoffs — no dice rolls behind the buttons.

  • Every choice feeds a hidden Human ↔ AI alignment meter. Side with your users, or keep accepting Synergy-AI's increasingly generous offers.

  • Four endings at the top of the tower — three of them gated by who you became on the way up.

BUILD YOUR ANALYST


  • 50 unlockable workflow skills — passive automations and active abilities, unlocked differently across three difficulty levels.

  • A live USER TRUST meter that rewards genuinely good support and punishes the rotting queue.

  • Combo chains, shift grades, leaderboards, and an Endless 24/7 mode for analysts who never log off.

PLAYABLE IN 8 LANGUAGES


English, English (UK), Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano — and full native-script हिन्दी (Hindi) and right-to-left اردو (Urdu), all the way down to the ticket pool and the requesters' names.

A LOVING SHRINE TO CORPORATE DREAD


CRT glow, terminal boot sequences, sticky notes with mandatory smiling policies, and a soundtrack of 13 sector ambiences. Runs on very modest hardware — if your machine can open a ticket, it can probably run the game about closing them.

MegaCorp reminds you that smiling is mandatory.

Onmyoji: Soul Legend is a strategy card game set in a dark onmyoji-inspired world. Collect yokai, shikigami, and spell cards, then build a deck around timing, resource management, card synergies, and exorcism rewards.

The game includes solo story battles, tutorial stages, roguelike trials, onmyo lair progression, and tactical card combat. Learn the core rules through story content, then enter trials where changing events, rewards, and battle conditions push your deck in new directions.

Combat revolves around your hand, discard pile, exorcism effects, spirit fire, soul equipment, and shikigami abilities. Some cards help you build tempo, some prepare a late burst, and others disrupt threats or turn defeated enemies into new advantages.

The first Steam release focuses on a verifiable desktop build, local asset stability, and a small set of platform features. More content, balance updates, and platform integration will continue after release based on player feedback.

The first Steam release focuses on a verifiable desktop build, local asset stability, and a small set of platform features. More content, balance updates, and platform integration will continue after release based on player feedback.

After four centuries of undisturbed sleep, Mercy is yanked back to life when an indie band accidentally knocks a stake out of her chest. She is an Arch-Duchess, a self-proclaimed Ethical Hematologist, and a deeply unimpressed resident of a stranger's basement.

Her ancestral mansion is gone. Her fortune is dust. And the three mortals standing over her coffin want her to be their lead vocalist.

With the Battle of the Bands three weeks away and a $5,000 prize on the line, Mercy strikes a deal. She will front the band Pinkybites in exchange for survival in a century she barely understands.

But somewhere between the tomato juice transfusions, her wounded heart starts beating again for the first time in four hundred years.

store_data.about_the_game:
Code City has stopped working.
An AI promised to take coding off everyone's hands – and the city forgot how its own code ever worked. Streets sit silent, lights are out, whole districts are frozen. The code is still there. It's just broken.

Your job: get it running again.
You don't write programs from scratch. You repair them. A wrong operator here, a missing condition there, a gap to close – small, real edits to real code. And with every line that runs again, a piece of the city wakes up: lights flicker on, fountains start, color comes back.

Coding that doesn't feel like homework.
Code Rescue is peaceful. No timers, no fail states, no high-score grind. Just you, a puzzle you can actually read, and a city that's visibly grateful you understood it. Friendly enough for your very first line of code – honest enough that you'll really learn something.

Because no one can understand it for you.
Code City collapsed because everyone trusted the AI to handle it. That's not a coincidence – it's the whole point: AI is a tool, not a substitute for understanding how something actually works.

Features:

  • Real code, gently dosed – you work with real code, but in bite-sized pieces: spot the bug, fill the gap, get the condition right.

  • A city that blooms with you – every fix visibly turns the world from grey and silent to alive and colorful.

  • Cozy, not punishing – no stress, no failure. Learn at your own pace.

  • A stance, not hype – a quiet counterpoint to the "let AI do it all for you" promise.

store_data.about_the_game:
Congratulations! You are the newest custodian at Upton-Tree Middle School, assigned to the evening shift. Armed with a checklist and a ready-to-work attitude, your job seems simple: clean classrooms, take out trash, and finish the night's duties before heading home.

Each evening begins with a cheerful recorded message from Principal Tulley, whose warm instructions guide you through your responsibilities. Yet the more nights you spend in the empty halls, the more you begin to notice that something isn't right.

Strange sounds echo through dark corridors. Lights flicker when no one is around. And as midnight draws closer, you find yourself replaying the principal's final instruction over and over:

Be finished and out of the building before midnight.

The Evening Custodian is a first-person horror game where players must complete nightly cleaning tasks while avoiding a mysterious presence that stalks the school after hours. Manage your duties, stay alert, and uncover the unsettling truth hidden within Upton-Tree Middle School.

Just make sure you're gone before midnight.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sweat Equity

Lucenti is a storied Milanese maison built on heritage, craft, and a promise stitched into every label: Made in Italy. Three weeks ago, a 22-year-old finisher named Mei Lu collapsed and died in a locked, off-the-books subcontracted workshop—one whose existence the cost targets demanded and the audits never recorded.

CEO Sandro Vianello set those targets. Now a prosecutor’s probe, a labor suit, a make-or-break runway show, and a conglomerate recapitalization are all closing in at once. And three women, each holding a piece of the truth Lucenti wants sealed away, pull him into three charged, incompatible romances. Desire becomes dangerous. Intimacy becomes leverage. Every choice asks the same question: when the next collection is already in production, what—if anything—is still worth more than the close?

Meet the Cast


Yara Esposito — The Protégé

A brilliant Neapolitan designer Sandro discovered and championed, now positioned as Lucenti’s “reformed” future. But Mei Lu hand-finished the very capsule collection meant to crown her—turning her dream into a debt she can’t stomach. Her route burns with gratitude against autonomy: did Sandro lift her up, or buy her silence with a throne?

Selene Roux — The Face

Lucenti’s exclusive campaign icon, locked to the brand by the contract Sandro signed—and the morality clause the relaunch depends on. She met Mei once at a fitting, and now the image she’s paid to perform feels like an alibi she can’t live inside. A forbidden attraction where every tender moment risks detonating careers, contracts, and the entire comeback.

Jia Wu — The Witness

Second-generation Chinese-Italian, a former workshop stitcher turned organizer, Jia carries the real ledger, the real hours, and the dead girl’s real name into Lucenti’s immaculate halls. She stitched beside Mei in the locked room where it happened, and she refuses to let the house settle the truth into a sealed number. The sharpest collision of all—outsider against steward, record against reputation.

Key Features

  • Three full romance routes. Choose whose door you walk through, then follow a complete story where love and consequence stay tightly entwined.
  • A luxury-thriller workplace drama with teeth. Prosecutors, unions, investigative press, and corporate containment collide with runway deadlines and brand survival.
  • Three distinct emotional registers. Sea-cold freedom, kitchen-warm truth, and the fragile ethics of an open cage—each heroine feels her way through a world that monetizes everything.
  • Moral pressure that doesn’t flinch. The story pushes past scandal into complicity, accountability, and what it means to put a price on a person.
  • Bittersweet, earned endings. Even after the reckoning, the machine wants to roll on—unless someone makes it stop.

Adult Content

Sweat Equity is an adult romance visual novel for mature audiences (18+). Each of the three romance routes contains explicit adult scenes, and completed scenes unlock in an in-game gallery. It also contains strong language and themes including workplace exploitation, death, grief, legal pressure, and power-imbalance dynamics. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the UFO. The whole world is below you — and all of it wants you gone.


The Confidential Disclosure is an action sandbox where you pilot an alien craft over an infinite voxel world that curves like a tiny planet in space.
Explore, abduct, destroy and uncover what humanity has been hiding — while the army, the police and the men in black do everything to capture you.

What awaits you

  • 🛸 5 unique craft — each with its own weapons, shield, cloak and special weapon: a black hole, a hunting swarm, an EMP, the 80,000-foot drop...
  • 🌍 A fully destructible world — dig through terrain, topple buildings, blast craters. It's all voxels, and it all breaks.
  • 👽 Abduct anything that moves — 85 animal species, pedestrians, ejected pilots: pull them into your ship in the tractor beam.
  • 🌎 A living world that fights back — cities, farms, an ocean you can dive into, traffic, day and night, storms and tornadoes. 30 enemy types
    across 5 factions — from armed rednecks to the Majestic discs that don't kill you: they capture you.
  • 🔺 Secrets found by navigation — Area 51, the pyramids of Giza, an island metropolis you can SINK. Each one is found by following the exact
    compass heading.
  • ⏳ Death is only the beginning — when you go down, time dilates and you rewind the last seconds to escape your end.

The truth

The aliens came to help. They were betrayed. Now it's time for disclosure.

store_data.about_the_game:
A wartime investigator handed a criminal case from the past — one night to solve it, a city crumbling around him. This isn't just a job. If the case isn't closed by morning, none of the team survive to see the next day.

Two Abilities. One Night:-

  • Psychometric Vision — The asylum's past left traces on everything it touched. Hold what they held to see what they saw.

  • Echo Memory — Some moments don't just leave marks but they leave sounds. Live what they lived and close your eyes to be able to hear what they heard.

Your Notebook Is Your Canvas:-

Open it. Write on it. Sketch on it. Your notebook is a real investigator's tool — paint your theories, map your findings, mark what matters. Everything you discover, captured in your own hand.

A Full Investigator's Toolkit:-

Lockpicks, hammer, ropes, spanner, wires, pistol, notebook, mobile phone and more. Every tool has a purpose. Every room has a secret.

Explore Every Corner:-

Climb, rappel, crawl, push, pull — this asylum was built to keep people in, and it will do the same to you.

Puzzles Buried in the Walls:-

Restore power, find passwords — the asylum's secrets are locked behind layers, and you need to peel every one of them back.

The Asylum Has Records:-

Security footage, patient files, criminal case documents — long before the war started, something happened here. The files know what it was.

Every Cassette Tells a Story:-

Scattered through the corridors, each one a fragment of a life that ended inside these walls — each one bringing you closer to the truth, or deeper into the dark.

Outside, the war rages on — bombs, sirens, smoke. Inside the asylum, a different kind of darkness has been waiting.
Solve it tonight. All of your lives depend on it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run a shop no one admits they use

Blackwater Exchange is a 2D black market pawn shop management sim set in a gritty 1990s city.

You run a legal-looking exchange upstairs while the real business happens below: stolen watches, forged documents, suspicious electronics, cursed relics, desperate sellers, and cash changing hands before anyone asks too many questions.

Every item is a gamble

A customer comes down the stairs, drops something on the counter.

Maybe the item is real. Maybe it is fake. Maybe it is damaged, stolen, traceable, underpriced, or worse. Inspect visible clues, use tools, read the seller, and decide what the risk is worth.

Negotiate under pressure

Sellers have moods, patience, lies, and limits.

Push too hard and they may walk. Push the wrong person and they may report you. Pay too much and the day eats your profit. Every offer is a choice between margin, speed, and exposure.

Move goods before they become evidence

Buying the item is only half the job.

Store what you can, stash what you must, and sell through contacts with their own prices, risks, and availability. The right buyer can turn a dirty object into clean profit. The wrong one can leave you holding the problem.

Profit gets attention

Hot goods pay better, but they also raise heat.

Bills, raids, fines, confiscation, suspicious customers, rival pressure, and corrupt enforcement keep success from becoming safe. Legal deals keep the lights on. Dirty deals build the business. Every shortcut leaves a mark.

Features

  • 2D shopkeeper management built around appraisal, negotiation, and resale

  • Questionable goods with value, condition, authenticity, and risk uncertainty

  • Customer moods, lies, scams, walkouts, and report risk

  • Limited inventory, stash decisions, tools, upgrades, and shady contacts

  • Heat system with raids, fines, confiscation, and corrupt enforcement pressure

  • Gritty 1990s crime atmosphere

store_data.about_the_game:
This game takes about 30 minutes to finish, has no sound, and is meant to be played in one sitting (meaning, there’s no save function!) 

  • Customizable Cards - Build a deck of ‘story cards,’ upgrade them to create new drafts of your poem, and perform the whole thing in front of a crowd. Each decision you make changes the story Homer tells.   

  • Historically-Informed Artwork - I originally made this game for a 10-day game jam in 2023 using pre-made art, but remastered it in 2026 with entirely new artwork that I drew myself! Each image is based on real Greek pottery.  

  • Maybe You’ll Learn Something - Learning? Gross! The game is meant to be enjoyed first and foremost, but I did include historically-informed nuggets for anyone interested in the subject. The Odyssey is one of my favorite stories, and I hope this helps make it more accessible to those who have struggled with reading it in the past! 

  • Developed Live on Stream - I created this game partly to teach myself GameMaker, and fumbled my way through developing it (as well as drawing all the new artwork) on livestreams and videos. More than 90% of the development process is available to watch on my YouTube channel! 

NOTE: This game includes spoilers for The Odyssey. (Though you did have 2,500 years to read it!)

store_data.about_the_game:
Ravengate: The King’s Last March is a medieval-themed, story-driven, decision-making strategy RPG set in a kingdom on the brink of collapse. As the newly enthroned king, listen to the people's pleas, manage your treasury, command your troops, contain rebellions, and strive to keep your kingdom afloat against internal and external threats. Every day, your decisions will impact the kingdom's future: sometimes you'll respond to the pleas of a starving populace, sometimes you'll evaluate your generals' military plans, and other times you'll face assassinations, war news, and political intrigue.

  • Kingdom Management:
    Rule as a medieval king. Make decisions, listen to your people, review incoming reports, and shape the future of your kingdom. Orders given in the throne room will have real consequences beyond the castle walls.

  • Choice and Consequence System:
    A decision that seems right in the moment may lead to greater problems as the story unfolds.

  • Medieval Story:
    Experience a dark medieval story shaped by intrigue, betrayal, and survival. The king’s struggle does not end on the battlefield; it continues within the palace itself.

  • Diplomacy and Kingdom Relations: 

    Manage your relationships with other kingdoms, make diplomatic decisions, and remember that war is not always the only answer

  • Palace Intrigue and Betrayal:
    The greatest threat to the kingdom is not always beyond the walls. Sometimes, it stands closer to the king than anyone expects.

  • Quest and Investigation System:
    Complete quests, question commanders, soldiers, and other characters connected to each event, and search for the truth behind conflicting statements.

  • Consequences of War:
    Wars shape the future of the kingdom. Fallen soldiers, wounded commanders, and broken diplomacy can change the course of the game later on.

  • Resource and Risk Management:
    Manage your city, treasury, army, and people while keeping unrest under control. If rebellion begins to rise, you must act before it spreads.

  • Branching Story Progression:
    Some events unfold differently depending on the choices you make. Punishing the wrong person may give the real culprit more time to act.

  • Single-Player Medieval Experience:
    Ravengate: The King’s Last March offers a single-player medieval experience built around story, war, choices, and atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
Save the Kingdom: Warrior Rising is a 2D hand‑drawn RPG set in the medieval kingdom of Aethelgard, where political tension and betrayal threaten to ignite a devastating war. After the new king, Farn, ascends the throne, his older brother Tod Ulfrikson, furious that the crown slipped from his grasp, secretly allies with the powerful Hrun Khanate and prepares to launch an invasion.

You play as Bryn Kelwyn, an ordinary young man who enlists in the royal army alongside his childhood friends. What begins as a duty to defend their homeland soon grows into an epic journey filled with danger, camaraderie, and the rise of unexpected heroes. As the conflict deepens, Bryn and his companions uncover hidden truths about the kingdom, the royal bloodline, and the forces driving the war.

Key Features

  • A Story of War and Brotherhood Follow Bryn and his friends as they face the harsh realities of war, political intrigue, and the weight of destiny.

  • Five Distinct Playable Classes Build your team from the Archer, Warrior, Mage, Musketeer, and Doctor — each offering unique abilities and tactical roles.

  • Strategic Turn‑Based Combat Plan your moves carefully, exploit enemy weaknesses, and combine skills for powerful synergies.

  • Hand‑Drawn Anime Art Style Explore a visually rich medieval world illustrated with detailed 2D artwork and atmospheric environments.

  • Character Growth & Equipment Level up, unlock new abilities, and craft or discover gear that enhances your heroes’ strengths.

  • Explore the Kingdom of Aethelgard Travel through forests, towns, fortresses, and battlefields as you uncover the truth behind Tod Ulfrikson’s rebellion and the looming threat of the Hrun Khanate.

Embark on a journey where ordinary soldiers become legends, and the fate of Aethelgard rests in the hands of rising heroes.
