store_data.about_the_game:
Collect letters. Build words. Beat the clock.

Word Scramble is a fast-paced arcade word game where every word you create earns points and valuable extra time. Collect letter tiles, build words from your hand, and keep your streak alive as you race against the countdown.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing word challenge or a high-score chase, Word Scramble offers multiple ways to play and endless opportunities to improve your vocabulary and word-building skills.

Features

  • Fast-Paced Word Gameplay
    Collect letter tiles and create words before time runs out.

  • Earn Extra Time
    Longer words reward additional time, allowing skilled players to extend their runs.

  • Build Streaks
    Chain together valid words to increase your streak and earn bigger rewards.

  • Multiple Game Modes

    • Easy

    • Normal

    • Hard

    • Endless

    • Challenge Modes

  • Unique Challenges
    Test yourself with special modes that change the rules and create new strategies.

  • Track Your Progress
    View detailed statistics, high scores, longest streaks, favorite letters, and more.

  • Family Friendly
    Simple controls and accessible gameplay make Word Scramble enjoyable for players of all ages.

Easy To Learn, Difficult To Master

Anyone can start making words in seconds, but maximizing your score, maintaining long streaks, and surviving deep into a run requires strategy, quick thinking, and a strong vocabulary.

How long can you keep the timer alive?

store_data.about_the_game:
Cellula is a cell biology simulator disguised as a strategy game.

Manage a colony of living cells. Build membranes from individual phospholipid bricks, place organelles, import nutrients, fight viruses, detect cancer, and divide your cells to grow.

No tutorials. No lectures. Learn real biology by keeping your cells alive.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Start with a single cell: a ring of phospholipid bricks that self-assembles through physics. Place GLUT1 transporters to import glucose, amino acid transporters to support protein production, and lipid transporters to grow your membrane. Build mitochondria to produce ATP, ribosomes to synthesize proteins, and lysosomes to break down waste. Grow your membrane by purchasing phospholipids from the Smooth ER. Use the Golgi apparatus to ship resources between cells.

Then biology fights back.

Viruses drift toward your cells and dock on the same transporters you built to feed them. They inject viral DNA, which slithers toward the nucleus. If it reaches its target, your cell becomes a virus factory and eventually bursts, releasing more viruses into the plasma.

Cancer can emerge after cell division. A dark, unstable nucleus begins growing beyond normal control and threatens the colony. Summon T-cells to hunt cancer, deploy B-cells to produce antibodies, or trigger apoptosis to sacrifice a doomed cell before it destroys everything around it.

Every lesson is learned through failure. Your cells will die of waste toxicity because you forgot lysosomes. Your colony will collapse because you placed too many transporters and gave viruses easy entry. You will learn what every organelle does, not because the game told you, but because your cells could not survive without them.

KEY FEATURES

  • Real Cell Biology — Every system is based on actual cellular mechanics: surface area-to-volume ratio, membrane transport, metabolic waste, viral entry, immune response, and cancer development

  • Physics-Based Membrane — Build your cell wall from individual phospholipid bricks that self-assemble, attract and repel each other, and can be clicked and dragged

  • Complete Organelle Economy — Mitochondria (ATP production), Ribosomes (protein synthesis), Smooth ER (phospholipid synthesis), Lysosomes (waste management), Golgi Apparatus (inter-cellular shipping), and more

  • Molecular Transport — Glucose, amino acids, and lipid molecules float in the plasma and are pulled toward matching transporters like magnets

  • Viral Infection Cascade — Viruses dock on transporters, inject DNA, and turn your cells into virus factories if they reach the nucleus

  • Immune System — B-cells patrol and produce antibodies. T-cells hunt cancer. Cytokine storms can destroy everything

  • Cell Division — Grow your membrane, split your cells, allocate organelles between daughter cells. Each cell has its own independent economy

  • Cancer Mechanic — Every division carries risk. Over generations, accumulated replication stress and instability can push cells toward uncontrolled growth.

  • No Tutorials — Learn by doing, failing, and discovering. The game never tells you what to do. The consequences teach you

BUILT BY A DOCTOR WHO LEARNED TO CODE

Cellula was created by Dr. Patrick Gallaway, a former physician with a philosophy degree, who learned C++ in real time using free AI tools.

It was built in three weeks with zero budget as proof that educational games do not need massive studios or massive funding. They need accurate simulation, meaningful failure, and respect for the player’s intelligence.

EARLY ACCESS

Cellula is in active development. Player feedback will shape what comes next, including new organelles, hormone signaling, diabetes scenarios, additional virus types, improved visualization tools, and more.

Join the community and help build the future of educational gaming.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is the free co-op edition of Mycelium Conquest. The full single-player and co-op experience — including coop and single player savegames, Steam achievements, and Steam Cloud — is available in the full game. See the note at the bottom of this page.

Mycelium Conquest: Mitosis

Mycelium Conquest Mitosis is the free, co-op only edition of the biological network automation game, Mycelium Conquest. Team up with up to 3 friends and crash-land on the alien world of Xenoterris as a living fungal organism. Grow a sprawling mycelial network together, build complex production chains, and evolve with your friends from a tiny spore into a powerful entity capable of consuming the planet.

Grow or Die Together

Start as a vulnerable nascent spore and consume alien creatures and local flora to gather biomass. Hunt, kill, and absorb everything in your path across 5 evolution stages — from a fragile organism barely surviving to a cosmic entity that consumes worlds. Divide the hunt, cover each other's flanks, and overwhelm prey no single spore could take alone.

Build Living Infrastructure Together

Construct biological structures to process raw resources through multi-stage production chains. Decompose organic matter, refine enzymes, and manage bottlenecks across sprawling factory complexes. Every connected player can build, so coordinate your layout, specialise your roles, and turn the wild into a living machine.

Automate Everything Together

Design production lines that transform basic resources into advanced materials. Optimize throughput, eliminate bottlenecks, and scale from a handful of structures to continental harvesting operations spanning vast distances. Your network grows as fast as your team can build it.

Defend Your Network Together

Your growth attracts hostile alien creatures in escalating waves. Fight back with acidic spray attacks and build defensive structures. The bigger your network, the bigger the threats — and with friends at your side, the bigger the fights you can survive.

A note on this free edition

Mycelium Conquest: Mitosis is a free, cooperative multiplayer-only version of the game Mycelium Conquest, playable with up to 4 players — but the following features are not available in this edition:

  • No co-op saved games — your session lives only as long as it's running. There is no autosave and no manual save.

  • No Steam achievements

  • No Steam Cloud

  • No single-player mode — co-op requires at least one friend to start the game.

If you have enjoyed the co-op game and would like to unlock these features, kindly search for Mycelium Conquest on Steam.

store_data.about_the_game:
Twist Master

Twist Master is a relaxing and challenging 3×3 cube puzzle game designed for players of all skill levels. Experience smooth, realistic cube controls with both mouse and keyboard support. Whether you're a beginner learning your first solve or an experienced cuber chasing faster times, there's always a challenge waiting for you.

Five Game Modes

Classic Mode
No time or move limits. Relax and enjoy solving at your own pace.

Timer Mode
Race against the clock and complete the cube before time runs out.

Moves Mode
Solve the cube using a limited number of moves and discover the most efficient solutions.

Memory Mode
Study the scrambled cube, memorize its state, then solve it from memory after it disappears from view.

Direction Mode
Observe a target cube pattern and recreate it on a blank cube using your observation skills.

Customize Your Cube

Upload your own images and apply them to all six sides of the cube. Create unique designs and save your favorite styles.

Beginner Friendly

Learn with step-by-step tutorials designed for new players. No experience required.

Features

• Adjustable sensitivity and rotation speed
• Multiple language support
• Immersive sound effects and music
• Clean and intuitive interface

store_data.about_the_game:
[Game Overview]

Embark on a narrative-driven 2D pixel-art Metroidvania RPG. Explore an interconnected world, uncover hidden secrets, and let the story guide your journey.

[Story]

"Ever since I became an Administrator, my workload has only grown..." Yuka sighed.

She used to be an ordinary girl without any strong convictions. It was only at her best friend's insistence that she joined the Matrix Management Council. Yet, to everyone's surprise, she was unexpectedly elected as an Administrator in the last Node Election.

"Sister, there's a letter for you... it's... it's from Lord Luna Zhu!" her younger sister, Yuri, called out in a hurry...

Thus, a newly appointed Administrator sets out on an experiment that intertwines her fate with the world—and her own Doomed Wish.

[Combat]

Designed with a low difficulty curve, the game offers a smooth and accessible experience, featuring two distinct types of combat:

Exploration Combat: Engage enemies in adventure zones to clear paths and unlock new areas. (Though sometimes, running past them is a valid exploration strategy!)

Story Boss Battles: Face off against formidable foes at key narrative milestones. Defeat them to push the story forward.

[Exploration & Items]

Discover multiple interconnected maps, with new regions unlocking as the story progresses. Utilize a diverse array of items in your inventory to overcome obstacles and enrich your exploration experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your squad grows. The map tears you apart.

Fading Reel is a wave-based Roguelike where you lead a chained squad through a forgotten 1930s animation reel. You aim and move as the leader; teammates follow every step and fire on their own. A longer chain means more bullets — and more risk when the arena splits you apart.

Chained squad combat

The HUD tracks Leader and Mate HP in separate rows. If a Mate is crushed or cut off mid-wave, they leave the field — but your roster bench refills missing squadmates at the next wave start. Stack damage, fire rate, spread, and cohesion upgrades after each horde; detached Mates stop firing until you reattach (some Evolutions change that rule).

Map events split your formation

The arena is not scenery. Closing gates, sweep beams, lockdown zones, and anchor tethers force split-second calls: regroup fast, or keep fighting understrength. Circle back to reattach before the horde closes in.

Linked Blink

At Wave 12 start, unlock Linked Blink — teleport the entire attached chain together (~0.4 s, 1.5 s cooldown). Attached units are briefly invulnerable; mistime it and the HUD flashes a deny pulse. Essential for dodging Blaster ground bursts and Hydra charges.

Survive the wave. Stack your build.

Clear each horde wave, then pick one of three random run upgrades from a pool of stat boosts — fire rate, max HP, heals, move speed, projectile damage, chain resilience, knockback resist, map-pull resist, and squad-scaled perks.

Milestone waves 3, 6, and 13 auto-add a squad member and play a Reel Sync story beat (no upgrade menu on those waves).

Evolve after the mini-boss

Wave 11 is the mini Hydra fight. After you win, choose one of three randomly rolled Evolutions from 19 run-long paths — e.g. Twin Reel, Rail Line, Living Chain, Long Leash, or Gate Runner. That pick defines your Act II identity (Wave 11 has no normal upgrade menu).

Act II and the final reel

Wave 12 is a Blaster-only intro (ground-burst dodging), then Act II (Waves 13–21) hits with the full six-type roster — Chaser, Skirmisher, Bruiser, Shooter, Splitter, and Blaster — longer spawn windows, and stacked map events. Wave 22 is the final Hydra; beating it wins the run.

Meta progression between runs

Spend currency on 12 permanent branches (3 tiers each): Squad Roster, Vitality, Constitution, Field Triage, Swift March, Chain Bond, Steady Line, Anchor Grip, Trained Trigger, Cracked Rounds, Hollow Points, and Bounty Hunter. Each failed run funds the next attempt.

A memory reel aesthetic

Sepia, grain, vignette, and inked cartoon silhouettes — like a worn film strip playing inside a distant memory.

Play in your language

Full interface localization for 31 Steam languages (menus, upgrades, and in-run UI).

Fadestrand Games · Built with Godot

store_data.about_the_game:
Start with nothing and work your way up through a city full of opportunities, risks, and rewards.

Take on small delivery jobs transporting everyday goods such as groceries, electronics, and liquor. As you earn money and improve your equipment, more lucrative opportunities become available, including the transportation of weapons, drugs, chemicals, and other high-value cargo.

The more valuable the delivery, the greater the danger. Criminals may attempt to ambush you and steal your cargo, forcing you to defend yourself and complete the job under pressure.

Expand your carrying capacity by purchasing larger backpacks, allowing you to accept bigger and better-paying contracts. Buy firearms and other equipment to protect yourself when jobs become dangerous.

As your finances grow, purchase vehicles that unlock entirely new ways to earn money. Work as a taxi driver, transport passengers across the city, or haul large cargo shipments for higher rewards.

Eventually, you'll be able to purchase your own property. From your home computer, gain access to exclusive high-risk delivery contracts and a darknet marketplace where rare weapons can be purchased and delivered to secret drop locations.

Survival is about more than making money. Your character must eat, sleep, and manage hunger and energy while balancing increasingly demanding jobs.

• Open-world urban sandbox
• Delivery jobs ranging from everyday goods to high-risk contraband
• Dynamic enemy ambushes during dangerous deliveries
• Backpack and inventory progression system
• Firearms and combat system
• Vehicle ownership and driving
• Taxi and cargo hauling jobs
• Property ownership and home computer system
• Darknet weapon marketplace
• Hunger and energy mechanics
• Save and load system
• Multiple paths to earning money and progressing

store_data.about_the_game:
Not good. Just fun. That’s the plan.

Another Slop Game is a chaotic medieval platforming game about jumping across impossible ruins, dodging oversized weapons, falling into the abyss, and blaming your friends for everything.

Play solo or team up online with friends and try to survive a ridiculous obstacle course floating high above the water. Every jump matters, every mistake hurts, and every “easy” section somehow becomes a disaster.

This is not a heroic medieval adventure.

This is not a serious test of honor.

This is a stupid, painful, funny climb through a broken world full of traps, floating platforms, cannons, swinging axes, questionable physics, and very bad ideas.

[h2]Jump. Fall. Blame someone else.[/h2]

Cross floating stone platforms, unstable bridges, moving obstacles, giant weapons, cannons, spike traps, weird medieval machinery, and whatever else was clearly a mistake to build.

One wrong step can send you flying, falling, or dragging your entire team into chaos.

Play solo or with friends online

Take on the course alone, or play online co-op with friends and turn a difficult climb into a complete social disaster.

Work together, rescue each other, argue over who jumped too early, and try not to ruin the run for everyone.

A medieval world that makes no sense

Climb through floating ruins, broken castles, watchtowers, stone bridges, wooden traps, giant weapons, cannons, and strange objects suspended above a vast blue abyss.

It looks epic.

It plays stupid.

That is the point.

Features

  • Chaotic medieval platforming

  • Solo and online co-op gameplay

  • Floating ruins, castles, towers, and impossible obstacle courses

  • Giant swinging weapons, cannons, spike traps, moving platforms, and other hazards

  • Checkpoint-based progression

  • Timer for speedruns and painful comparisons

  • Co-op rescue mechanics when things go horribly wrong

  • A stupidly difficult climb designed to create funny moments

  • No deep message. No noble destiny. Just slop.

Can you reach the end?

Probably.

Will it be clean?

No.

Will someone fall?

Yes.

Will it be your fault?

Absolutely not.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE SYSTEM REMEMBERS YOU.

You are not the hero. You are an intrusion — a strain of malware loose inside a hostile machine, and the antivirus is learning. It profiles your movement, predicts your dodges, adapts its pursuit mid-run, and carries everything it learned about you into the next one. Every run, the system knows you a little better. Every run, you have to become something it hasn't seen.

INFECT. Choose your strain — the regenerating WORM, the life-leeching TROJAN, the greedy RANSOM, the untouchable GHOST, or the walking apocalypse LOGIC.BMB — and carve through endless waves of security processes, each generation procedurally mutated.

EVOLVE. Fifteen weapons, each with five levels and an evolved form. Then it gets stupid: fuse two evolved abilities into one of 225 fusion combinations, each with its own name, color, and quirk. Fuse two primed fusions and ascend to the OMEGA tier — if you can survive long enough to build one.

SURVIVE THE PURGE. Boss-class defense programs hunt you every five minutes — a ravenous snake that rages when it feeds, a corrupted DVD logo that locks you in the arena, a blackout that swallows the screen whole. Kill the third and choose: extract with your stolen DATA, or go endless and see how deep the system goes. The fast and the bold will find things hiding past the fifteen-minute mark that we won't spoil here.

FEATURES

  • An adaptive AI director that profiles your playstyle and persists between runs

  • 15 weapons → evolutions → 225 fusions → OMEGA fusions

  • 5 virus strains with unique passives, permanent upgrades, and a fusion codex to fill

  • Dimension rifts: first-person 3D maze raids for high-value loot, mid-run

  • Secret bosses, warp gates, a black hole, and a 0.5% mythic jackpot someone will clip

  • CRT arcade mode, colorblind assist filters, full neon-on-black synth aesthetic

You have one job: don't get deleted.

store_data.about_the_game:
Taskbar Syndicate is a desktop idle crime-management game about building a tiny criminal empire at the bottom of your screen.

Assign little criminals, hackers, lookouts, smugglers, cleaners, fixers, and crooked accountants to jobs while you work, browse, or do something else. Jobs progress passively, but every few minutes something goes wrong.

An inspector asks for double. A driver gets boxed in. Marked bills show up. A rival offers a suspicious deal. Your accountant starts acting extremely normal.

Make one quick decision, take the consequences, and keep the syndicate running.

A TINY CRIME EMPIRE IN YOUR TASKBAR

Run jobs from a compact bottom-screen strip designed to be glanced at, not babysat.

PASSIVE PROGRESS, ACTIVE DECISIONS

Your crew works in the background, but the important moments are quick choices with real consequences.

DIRTY MONEY AND CLEAN MONEY

Earn dirty cash from jobs, then launder it through suspiciously successful front businesses.

CREW WITH PROBLEMS

Recruit criminals with traits, loyalty, stress, heat, injuries, rivalries, and questionable backstories.

HEAT, EVIDENCE, AUDITS, AND RAIDS

Push too hard and investigators start building a case. Burn evidence, bribe officials, hide crew, or sacrifice a front business to survive.

PANIC HIDE MODE

Instantly collapse your criminal operation into a very innocent-looking productivity strip.

Taskbar Syndicate is built for players who like idle games, management sims, compact strategy decisions, and funny emergent stories, but want something sharper than a pure number-go-up game.

Small screen. Big crimes. Bad decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Verdantis begins in the soil

Verdantis is a puzzle-adventure game, set in a ruined, overgrown research facility. Once a cutting-edge complex for alternative energy experiments. Today vines, and rust reclaim the laboratories, and reactors.

You play as R-0B, a small quadruped assistant robot. Your task: restore power across the entire complex, zone by zone, puzzle by puzzle. The story unfolds through exploration, researchers' journal entries, and traces of disaster in the environment.

Mechanics

  • Block pushing – push blocks and plan your movement through tight, logical spaces

  • Switches and activators – open doors, route power, and trigger devices, no time pressure

  • Electric charges – take on a positive or negative charge and manipulate plants

  • Floating plants – cross flooded labs where vegetation responds to energy

  • Light reflection – guide beams through light-reflecting plants to trigger reactions in other plants and create platforms

  • And more

The world is split into eight connected zones: from industrial ruins to dense vegetation at the heart of the facility. You can explore the facility in any order.

The game offers about 2 hours of play time. Progress saves automatically.

Visual style

Verdantis stands out with a distinctive look: cel-shading with bold outlines, comic-book readability, and post-apocalyptic technology overtaken by nature. Rusted machines, dense overgrowth, and gradually returning light create the mood of an abandoned lab slowly coming back to life.

Who is it for?

For players who want a calm adventure built on logic and exploration with a readable world, consistent puzzles, and a strong, original visual identity.

store_data.about_the_game:
Time is a weapon. And it runs backward — at you.

BORROW or ROB is a sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder steeped in 1990s analog tech — a hand-drawn, '90s-illustration "used future" (cassette-futurism, not neon) — built around one idea: time inversion. This isn't a simple rewind — every boss battle is a palindrome.

⏳ One Battle. Fought Twice.

• Phase 1 (Forward): You fight normally. But the formidable boss enemies are attacking from the future rewinding time backward.

• Phase 2 (Inversion): Get hints while phase1, You can rewind the time and revenge them with your own strategy.

What your enemy will do is already written. The only question is — how will you use it?

🤝 BORROW, or ROB

It's a palindrome.

You can borrow resources from the past of yourself.  -or, your enemy robs your past.

Greed versus survival, every single turn.

🎴 Analog Combat the AI Can't Hack

In a world ruled by the Pantheon AI, the human resistance — The Ghost — fights with 1990s analog tech the AI can't infiltrate. Your cards are software, encoded like punch cards.

• Dual-Lane Tactical Board: Position, distance, and melee vs. ranged all matter on a 1D battle line.

• AP / BA Resource System: Attacks and skills cost Action Points; movement costs Bonus Actions — a dual-resource system inspired by BG3.

• Color Archetypes: Each agent has a unique color identity. Build around synergy keywords — Kinetic, Corrosion, Execute, Override, Sync.

☠️ Bosses That Bend Time

Every boss is a puzzle with one unique time-inversion mechanic. Observe its pattern in Phase 1, then decode it in Phase 2 — one locks your position, one splits itself apart, one reverses its own artillery system. Each boss demands a different read.

🔧 Even Death Is an Asset — the B.O.R.R.O.W. System

Win or lose, every run earns Points. Invest them in a permanent skill tree that raises your baseline power for every future run — borrowing strength from past timelines. The roguelite meta-progression mirrors the game's core theme.

🌐 The World

The Pantheon AI has declared humanity obsolete. Future descendants stole Pantheon's time-inversion tech and sent it back to the past — a device called BORROW or ROB. The Ghost's final goal: reset the Pantheon AI, and end the war between human and machine.

Features

🔄 Palindrome time-inversion combat — fight every boss battle forward AND backward

🃏 The BORROW vs ROB choice — tension on every reversed turn

♟️ Position-driven dual-lane tactical board

🎭 5+ unique agents with distinct color archetypes

📈 B.O.R.R.O.W. skill system roguelite meta-progression — grow stronger even when you lose

​King-Sized Roommate is a comedy NSFW visual novel packed with memorable characters from different realities for you to meet and get to know intimately~

When your home world is under threat, defying the almighty Lord of Darkness takes colossal courage. You have to summon all your wits, map out a strategy, weigh hundreds of options for victory, and... finally, realizing just how bad things are, flee to another dimension to become a corporate drone in Japan under a human guise.

Oddly specific? Well, that is exactly what Prince Reinard did. An incubus from the monster realm, he now goes by the name Kisaragi Rei and blends right in with humans.

Three years have passed since his great escape. Life is miserably boring, but at least it is peaceful and safe... Right up until the moment that very same Lord of Darkness teleports into this world using the exact same method. He calls himself Obsidian, the King of Monsters. His presence is terrifying, and his towering frame literally hits the ceiling of Rei's tiny studio apartment.

Meet the Main Characters!

A short beginning of the story of this visual novel featuring the opening act of the plot and the first tastes of Rei and Obsidian living together.

Grow Closer!

Every choice you make influences your relationships and twists the upcoming story.

Early Access

We are actively working on the project, but the game will always remain 100% free for everyone.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crownrats

Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG about a small mouse settlement trying to survive and expand in a dangerous forest. Start from a home colony, explore procedurally generated rooms, push through narrow passages, clear fog of war, gather resources, build defenses, recruit allies and capture new territory. Every run creates a different forest layout with mines, markets, watchposts, wild animals, weather hazards and rival enemy colonies. Play solo with bot companions or prepare for co-op runs where players share the same colony, fight together, divide tasks, and react to raids in real time. Your team can mine resources, defend rooms, help develop the village and sometimes launch their own risky expeditions.

store_data.about_the_game:
A card battle game that blends the strategy of the Chinese poker game Thirteen Cards with a roguelike item system, supporting both single-player stages and online two-player versus on Steam.

How To Play:
survive 24 rounds with your chips.
Each round has 2 battles. Compare your three rows after attacking.
13 cards into Front 3, Middle 5, and Back 5.
Back must be at least Middle, and Middle at least Front, or you foul.
After a battle, there is a chance to gain an item.
Hand ranks low to high: High Card < Pair < Two Pair < Three < Straight < Flush < Full House < Four Kind < Straight Flush.
Front has only 3 cards, so it compares High Card, Pair, and Three.

store_data.about_the_game:
You ran. The Company found you. Now you work it off — bottle by bottle.

Labeloop is a darkly comic incremental game about the debt you can't outrun. Slap labels on an endless line of suspicious products, ship them for cash, and hand almost all of it back to your patron every night as "rent." Fall behind three times and your contract — and you — are terminated.

The catch: clearing your debt doesn't set you free. The Company thanks you for your service, retires you the permanent way, and you wake on the same cold floor — a new cycle, a bigger balance, the numbers climbing from pocket change toward utopian billions. The only question left is whether you'll still be a good little debtor when the final ledger comes due... or whether you'll find another way out.

Label like your life depends on it (it does)

  • The Loop — five escalating debt cycles. Clear one and the Company "promotes" you into the next, deeper hole; money, rent and rewards scale from a few dollars to the absurdly utopian.

  • Precision labeling — every bottle is a gamble: a crooked label loses money, a perfect one pays big. Upgrade your Luck to bend the odds.

  • Build the line — unlock a conveyor belt and an automatic arm to label hands-free while the quota climbs.

  • 20 products, 5 tiers — from the humble Classic Bottle to the infamous Black Label.

  • A patron with a voice — a Company that's unfailingly polite, deeply menacing, and always watching the cameras.

  • 36 achievements, multiple endings, and a way out — if you're willing to go off the books.

  • Full English & Turkish support.

Hit your quota. Smile for the cameras. Welcome back to the family.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise an army. Hold the line. Take the world.

You don't control single soldiers. You choose who to summon and where, then watch your troops crash into the enemy and fight over the one frontline that decides the battle.

Command dragons, giants and dark magic.

Eight races and dozens of units, from plain spearmen up to dragons, mammoths and a literal Cthulhu, each with its own ability: cavalry charges, teleporting assassins, lightning, dark magic. Charge your ultimate with kills, then unleash it to flood every lane at once.

Conquer the world.

Win a battle and take that kingdom, then spend your gold between fights on new units and upgrades: sharper weapons, thicker armour, faster training. Your army carries over and snowballs across the whole map.

I grew up on Ben Olding's Flash game Warlords, and that feeling never left me. I built my own version at university and finally polished it into this, for anyone who remembers it.

Experience virtual spring gobbler hunting at it's finest! Whether you are a turkey hunter that needs off season action or a game enthusiast that enjoys playing true to life hunting simulations 'Pro Turkey Hunting' is the fix you need. Game play centers around the four wild turkey sub-species residing in North America; easterns, osceolas, rios and merriams. Harvesting each sub-species is referred to as the 'Grand Slam' of turkey hunting. Get close to that gobbler and use your calls and decoy to lure him in. But be careful not to move too abruptly, these old gobblers have incredible eyesight! Challenge yourself and see if you have what it takes to earn the coveted 'Grand Slam'!

* Turkey Hunting Realism- strutting gobblers, hens, realistic calling interaction.

* Four different sub-species available to hunt.

  • Trophy room for top gobbler harvests.

store_data.about_the_game:
Surf the dark. Smash the stars.

You are loose in a vast neon void, and the only way through it is speed. Build momentum, ram everything to dust, charge your core to OVERLOAD, and tear a path toward the guardians waiting at the edge of the dark.

Momentum is the weapon

There is no trigger to hold. You surf. You dash. You smash asteroids, towers, and hunters apart by hitting them hard enough, then ride the wreckage straight into the next kill. Chain a dash-nova through a crowd and watch it come apart.

Every run is a different void

Each zone reshuffles into a new shape: open void, asteroid belts, pylon corridors, fence mazes, dense cluster fields. Then the anomalies bend the rules.

  • SWARM - the void teems with far more hunters.

  • GOLD RUSH - salvage doubled, and well defended.

  • VOLATILE GEOMETRY - the debris detonates, so smash at speed or bleed.

  • MAGNETIC STORM - rogue currents drag your ship off course.

  • OVERCHARGE - your energy charges faster, and so do your enemies.

  • HUNTED - apex predators stalk you from the first second.

[/list]Every anomaly radiates from a rift somewhere out in the dark. Seal it to end the effect, or leave it humming and take the risk.

Mutate your run

Trade hull at the void shrines for mutations that bend your ship's rules, and bank permanent perks and cores. Every run goes a little further.

Break the guardians

Something waits at the end of every zone, and a guardian falls to the same rule as everything else: hit its corners, at speed, until it shatters.

Built to be felt

A neon look drawn in pure light, a fully synthesized score and sound, hit slow-mo, screen shake you can dial to taste, and full controller support.

The stars are not ready. Go anyway.

Following the death of his mother, Aozora Haru, an art student who is a member of a highly prestigious and selective art program in his school, feels lost. Although fortunate enough to pursue his passion and dreams, the listlessness of his daily life leaves him in a constant state of longing. Besides a group of extremely close friends that he holds dear to him, Haru finds it difficult to attach significant meaning to anything at all, instead seeking solace in the never-ending chambers of his thoughts and dreams. However, unbeknownst to anybody at all, Haru and his friends are bound together in a cruel and twisted, yet beautiful lattice of fate. Through his perspective, unravel the story of a young man staring down the barrel of what it means to be himself. 


- Featuring over 10 hours of visual novel/kinetic novel gameplay, a fully unique OST, FHD backgrounds and sprites.

- Multiple endings and bonus content upon completion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cats eat sushi.

The cat loves sushi. This cat will go anywhere for it. Place sushi to guide the cat onto a waiting car, then watch it set off for a new place in this unique puzzle game.

The cat follows its natural instincts. If it spots sushi in the same row or column, it will chase it. It gets distracted by toys, runs when barked at by dogs, and may even fall into holes. Learning how the cat behaves is the key to solving every puzzle.

Eating sushi makes the cat fatter, opening some paths while closing others. As the game progresses, you’ll discover new mechanics and use them to solve increasingly challenging handcrafted puzzles.

Featuring over 50 handcrafted puzzle stages that gradually introduce new mechanics, including toys, dogs, breakable walls, and holes.

Key Features

  • Guide a sushi-loving cat by placing sushi.

  • The cat always moves toward the nearest visible sushi in the same row or column.

  • Eating sushi makes the cat fatter, opening some paths while blocking others.

  • Use toys, dogs, and environmental objects to overcome new challenges.

  • Learn every mechanic without text.

  • Original artwork, music, and sound effects created by a solo developer.

store_data.about_the_game:
You arrive at the gates of Novum with nothing — no gear, no reputation, no right to enter.

The town is barely standing. The guild is hollow. The surrounding lands are overtaken by creatures that grow bolder every season. Nobody is coming to save it.

That part is up to you.

PROVE YOURSELF

Start as an Outsider. The gate guard does not let strangers through without reason. Earn

your place through action — complete tasks, push back the threats closing in on the town,

and climb from Outsider to Stranger to Journeyman and beyond. Seven guild ranks stand

between you and Legendary Grand Master. Every one of them has to be earned.

REBUILD NOVUM

Novum was not always ruins. It was a living town before the fire took it — and it can be

again. Restore the Blacksmith, the Guild Hall, the Infirmary, the Inn, and more. Each

building you bring back changes the town, opens new services, and pushes back the feeling

that this place is already lost. The town grows with you.

CHOOSE YOUR CLASS

Four classes. One chance to pick.

The Warrior absorbs punishment and hits back harder. Iron plate, sword and shield,

and the stamina to outlast anything in front of them.

The Mage keeps distance and turns enemies to ash. High damage, low health —

positioning is survival.

The Ranger controls the battlefield from range. Traps, poison, precision shots,

and the cheapest dodge in the game.

The Rogue hits fast, hits hard, and disappears. The highest burst damage of any

class and the highest skill ceiling to match.

FACE WHAT LIVES IN THE DARK

The Verdant Rot Swamp is the first thing beyond Novum's gates. The Bramblekin

have overtaken it — twisted thorn creatures spreading rot outward from their

hive. At the heart of the swamp, rooted in the Heartroot Clearing, is the

Thorn Matriarch. Ancient. Patient. She has been there longer than the town has

existed, and she is not done growing.

This is only the beginning of what lives beyond the walls.

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE

Weapons and armor do not stay basic for long. Gather materials, bring them to

Brennan at the Blacksmith, and upgrade your gear through tiers. At Tier 3,

elemental modifiers unlock — fire, void, nature — each changing how your weapon

behaves in combat. The right upgrade for the right encounter can change everything.

FEATURES

  • Real-time combat with a rhythm-based system that rewards timing and precision

  • Four playable classes each with unique abilities, stats, and playstyle

  • Seven guild ranks with a living progression system tied to quests and town restoration

  • A town restoration system where Novum evolves visually and functionally as you rebuild

  • Multiple biomes, each with their own enemy faction and multi-phase boss encounter

  • Weapon and armor upgrade tiers with elemental modifier selection at Tier 3

  • A quest system with single, chain, progression, and repeatable quest types

Built in Unreal Engine 5

Join our Discord and Forge your path through the Darkness!


Roadmap

2026 Early Access Roadmap — The Journey Begins

We are officially announcing Shadows of Beginnings for Early Access on PC via Steam, targeting Q4 2026.

The foundation is done. Phase 1 is complete — the combat layer, player controller, animation systems, core HUD, and the hub world of Novum are built and running in Unreal Engine 5. Everything from here is content.

Here is where we are headed.

PHASE 2 — IN DEVELOPMENT

We are actively building the class and progression system, the full quest system, enemy expansion with escalating AI behavior, combat and ambient audio, and a town systems preview with Novum's first restorable buildings. This is the content layer going on top of a complete core.

DEMO — FALL 2026

A playable demo drops before Early Access launch. It includes the full opening of Novum, the Warrior class from start to upgrade, the Bramblekin biome, and the Thorn Matriarch boss encounter. If you want a taste of what this game is before committing, the demo is your window.

EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH — FALL 2026

Full audio pass, VFX polish, Steam integration, achievements, cloud saves, and a public trailer. We are not shipping until it feels right.

BEYOND

New zones beyond Novum. Additional enemy types and boss encounters. New character classes. Story continuation. The roadmap gets updated based on what the community tells us matters most.

The vision is simple. A dark, immersive action RPG that respects your time and rewards your legend.

store_data.about_the_game:
When the apocalypse came nearly  everyone died... But you regenerated.

Idle Regenerator is a deep, systems-rich idle RPG where your hero fights on automatically but every decision you make shapes how they fight. Unlock powers, forge equipment, build a roster of sidekicks, and watch a cascade of interlocking systems carry your character from a lone fighter to a force that reshapes reality itself.

A living idle game, not just a number that goes up

While you're away, your hero keeps fighting. When you return, offline progress fills your pockets with rewards earned while you slept. But Idle Regenerator rewards engagement just as much as patience. The deeper you push, the more complex and satisfying the systems become.

Key Features

  • 99+ unique powers — each with distinct effects, proc rates, and scaling. Choose which powers define your build at key level milestones, then amplify one to Signature status.

  • Five major game modes — unlock Adventure, the World Dungeon, the Heaven Spire, the System Labyrinth, and Rebuilding as you reach deeper chapters. Each mode is a fully realized system, not just a reskinned arena.

  • Deep character progression — primary stats (Strength, Vitality, Agility, Dexterity) flow into a full derived stat sheet: hit rating, evasion, crit, block, pierce, elemental damage, and more.

  • Equipment forging — craft, find, and upgrade gear across five slots. Push rare pieces through Artifact and Divine tiers with the Equipment Forge.

  • Sidekicks and Pets — recruit companions with unique power sets, deploy them to quests, and enhance them through their own progression tree.

  • Prestige and Constellations — reset for permanent multipliers and unlock the Constellation board for cross-run bonuses that compound over time.

  • Cultivation Manuals — 21 learnable manuals granting passive bonuses that persist through prestige.

  • Achievements and Automation — 40 achievements across 7 categories, plus an Automation tab to set-and-forget your farming loop.

A story that unfolds as you grow

Five chapters of narrative guide your hero's journey, with branching story nodes, dialogue choices, and milestone moments tied to your progress. The world has lore. The dungeons have names. The spirit beasts have history.

Play your way

No energy systems. No forced wait timers. No pay-to-win. Idle Regenerator is a game about building something — and watching that something become unstoppable.

The longer you play, the deeper it goes. [incrementaldb_verification: SuccessfulGrinding120]

终于与「他」重逢。

在这期间

又结识了两位珍贵的同伴。

她也终于实现了自己的夙愿……

store_data.about_the_game:
Travel across mysterious islands filled with ancient ruins, hidden caves, dangerous jungles, and realistic dinosaur encounters. Use interactive VR tools to excavate fossils, solve environmental puzzles, unlock secrets, and survive terrifying predators in an immersive world built for virtual reality.

Whether you are carefully uncovering dinosaur bones, escaping a giant carnivore, or exploring forgotten research facilities, every moment is designed to make you feel inside a real dinosaur adventure.

Climb, Explore, and Survive

Use your hands to climb walls, scale cliffs, and reach hidden areas.

Virtual reality movement places you directly inside the adventure, making every jump, climb, and discovery feel real.

Search every corner carefully because valuable artifacts, dinosaur eggs, and hidden collectibles may be waiting where few explorers dare to go.

Discover Fossils and Ancient Artifacts

Become a true prehistoric explorer by collecting fossils, ancient relics, and rare treasures during your journey.

Piece together the history of the island and uncover the mysteries left behind by an ancient civilization connected to the dinosaurs.

TONS OF TERRIFYING TRAPS

Keep an eye on your environment to find creative ways to boff your enemies! Decapitate the undead with spinning blades, fry them to a crisp with fire traps, crush them with a well-placed boulder and more. You wouldn’t set them on your team mates … would you?

OODLES OF PUZZLING PREDICAMENTS

Keep those peepers peeled for suspicious clues, secret entrances and ancient contraptions that need re-awakening! Who knows what alluring treasures and buried riches await you on the other side…

store_data.about_the_game:
"You saved me at the beach, remember? It was just you and me…!"

I saved you at the beach?!

 

Zero social skills. A terrible personality.

At twenty-one, I still can't even talk to people properly.

There's no way I'd be the kind of person who'd save a stranger I don't even know……!!

"Then I'll just have to make you remember.

If I can help you recall that day,

If I can make you realize that you're the one who saved my life…"

 

"Will you let me fulfill my promise?"

 

What kind of crazy nonsense is that?

A heart-pounding memory hunt with a suspiciously handsome stranger!

If I just keep that damn promise…

…he'll let me go, right?

Time to uncover the memories I lost ten years ago!

[clear cherry ice.] is a fresh summer youth BL visual novel!

Sometimes it is dazzlingly refreshing, and other times it can be a summer of suffocating chaos.

Let's get to know Jiwon and Chaehyun, two mysterious handsome men,

and build a relationship with them that is either friendship or something more.

And...

Depending on your choices, someone will be saved.

Watch to see what pasts and secrets they are hiding!

Experience personal routes for both men, with endings shaped by who steps up to lead their relationship.

It is entirely in your hands which one you save and in what way!

With stunning illustrations to enhance your immersion in the story,

Dive into the mysterious romance of three people!

Your choices will change the course of the story.

You may need time to agonize to reach the ending you desire.

Their past seems to hold something hidden...

Uncover the truth alongside the cynical protagonist, Junhui!

store_data.about_the_game:
Kingdom Chronicle is a full-fledged turn-based fantasy strategy SLG where you take command of a warlord house and set out to unify a war-torn continent. Through governance, diplomacy, intrigue, and open war, bring an age of rival warlords to an end.

■ Build a Prosperous Domain

Develop your land to raise national power, conscript and train a formidable army, and grant relief to keep your people loyal. Funds, power, loyalty, and renown intertwine into a balancing act that decides victory.

■ Diplomacy & Intrigue

Build trust through goodwill and fight side by side through alliances—or undermine your rivals from within with schemes (raids, rumors, sabotage and more) and officer poaching. Use espionage to read your opponents' hand.

■ 6 Troop Types, Real Trade-offs

Cavalry, archers, and spears form a rock-paper-scissors triangle (cavalry > archers > spears > cavalry). Swords never dominate but are a steady all-rounder that holds its own against any type, while magic is a high-variance gamble—devastating when it lands, unreliable when it doesn't. Armor is a defensive specialist that comes into its own on the counterattack rather than the assault. Soldier counts, training, and special skills all sway the outcome, and with marching, intercepting, reinforcing, and even calling on allies, each war is a battle of wits.

■ A Cast of Distinct Officers

Around 168 officers, each with their own stats, troop type, special skill, and personality. Recruit, poach, or capture them to your side—officers who serve you are recorded in your collection.

■ Endless Replayability

Area and nationwide campaigns, three difficulty levels (Easy/Normal/Hard), and multiple paths to victory—unification or alliance—make every playthrough different.

■ After You Conquer: Forge Your Own Officers

Conquer the nationwide campaign to unlock officer creation. Design your own officers—custom stats, troop type, special skill, and personality—and lead them into future runs.

■ About the Steam Edition

The Steam edition includes additional officers. Thank you for supporting the game's development—enjoy!

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a dark fantasy action RPG focused on undead summoning, army cultivation, and faction confrontation. A complete single playthrough takes about 6–10 hours, delivering an immersive growth experience as a powerful necromancer.

Players take on the role of a newly risen necromancer in the undead realm and embark on a dangerous journey from scratch. Explore a variety of distinct undead territories and hunt skeletons, vengeful spirits, corrupted beasts, and countless undead creatures. With forbidden necromantic arts, you can harvest remains and absorb soul energy from fallen enemies. You may also resurrect and recruit defeated monsters as your loyal combat companions to build and expand your own undead legion.

Core Progression System

Raise your cultivation and level through continuous battles to unlock stronger necromantic powers. All undead units come with unique attack patterns and attribute strengths. You can freely adjust your army composition by mixing frontline tanks, assault damage dealers, and ranged spell units to create a battle formation that suits your personal playstyle. Collect deadly relics to enhance your spell power, soul endurance, and overall survivability, constantly breaking through your power limits.

Core Goals & Endgame Challenges

As a dark existence of the undead plane, you stand in absolute opposition to the holy light faction. After exploring dangerous zones, eliminating powerful regional foes, and reaching the peak of your cultivation, you will unlock cross-realm invasion privileges. Lead your massive undead army into the holy light domain, wage all-out war against angelic forces, challenge powerful high-rank angel bosses, and determine the final fate of the eternal conflict between darkness and light.

Key Game Features

Free Undead Recruitment: Almost every defeated undead creature can be revived and recruited as your fighting unit, offering extremely high freedom for army building.

Blend of Action & Strategy: Control your necromancer to cast spells in real time while commanding your undead army to position, flank, and focus fire. The combat system combines fast-paced action gameplay with tactical team management.

Dual-Faction Narrative: Experience a complete lore background centered on the long-standing confrontation between the undead darkness and the holy light faction.

Atmospheric Original Soundtrack: Custom soundtracks are designed for both the dark undead realm and the radiant holy light territory, greatly enhancing the immersive dark fantasy atmosphere of your conquest journey.

About this game:

idle koi! is a server-driven idle pet collection game about hatching, breeding, training, and battling magical koi. Every koi begins from an egg and grows through its own genes, appearance parts, rarity, skills, lineage, and battle history. Breed different bloodlines for a chance at mutation and leap evolution, then form 3-koi teams and send them on expeditions that keep fighting even while you manage other teams.

Key features:

- Hatch starter, bred, event, and limited genesis eggs.

- Breed koi with inherited body parts, fins, decorations, expressions, colors, and hidden genes.

- Chase rare leap evolutions that improve growth, power, and long-term value.

- Build up to five 3-koi battle teams for idle expeditions and replayable battle history.

- Trade and manage valuable koi through server-authoritative ownership, with Steam Inventory support planned for the Steam economy.

idle koi! is a server-driven idle pet collection game about hatching, breeding, training, and battling magical koi. Every koi begins from an egg and grows through its own genes, appearance parts, rarity, skills, lineage, and battle history. Breed different bloodlines for a chance at mutation and leap evolution, then form 3-koi teams and send them on expeditions that keep fighting even while you manage other teams.

Key features:

- Hatch starter, bred, event, and limited genesis eggs.

- Breed koi with inherited body parts, fins, decorations, expressions, colors, and hidden genes.

- Chase rare leap evolutions that improve growth, power, and long-term value.

- Build up to five 3-koi battle teams for idle expeditions and replayable battle history.

- Trade and manage valuable koi through server-authoritative ownership, with Steam Inventory support planned for the Steam economy.
store_data.short_description: Hatch koi eggs, breed unique bloodlines, evolve rare traits, and send 3-koi teams into idle battles. Build a living collection where genes, rarity, lineage, and battle growth decide every koi's value.

store_data.about_the_game:
Latticefall is a quiet game about a small colony and a slow apocalypse.

The danger here doesn't arrive all at once — it creeps. An infection seeps across the land, quiet and relentless, and your job isn't to crush it head-on but to endure: raise a settlement, draw a line, and take ground back one step at a time. Every push forward costs something — and you see the price and the risk before you make the move. No fast hands needed: pause, weigh it, decide. This is a game about deliberate choices, about the rhythm of advance and retreat, about calmly holding what you've built.

Your colony grows through the ages — from the first campfire to late-game technologies. You research, develop your base, hand tasks to your lieutenants, and decide for yourself how far to reach and what to give up when the infection presses against your walls.

What Latticefall believes:

  • It exists for how you feel, not for the beauty of a concept.

  • It must run smoothly even on weak, old hardware — smoothness is respect for you.

  • It speaks to you in your own language.

  • If something's missing, you can build it in yourself, with no programming.

  • And underneath is an engine that can open different worlds: today it's an infection, tomorrow you could turn it into encroaching snow.

content_descriptors.notes:
Latticefall is a dark post-apocalyptic survival game. Most of its mature content is delivered through text (in quests and codex entries); the visuals are stylized, with no graphic on-screen depictions.

The game contains violence: combat against infected creatures and hostile humans, use of weapons, and references to blood, wounds, death, and corpses. Occasionally there are heavier text descriptions — medical procedures (amputation without anesthesia), executions for crimes, and experiments performed on an infected human (with their consent). It also features psychological horror elements: nightmares, the voices of the dead, and an oppressive atmosphere.

Colony life involves alcohol and tobacco, as well as the medical use of painkillers/narcotic substances (anesthesia, sedation). The game includes mild profanity and dark gallows humor about death and survival.

The game contains NO sexual content, nudity, sexual violence, recreational drug use, or depictions of suicide or self-harm.

store_data.about_the_game:
After the colonial era ended, new nations rose one after another on the former colonies, and conflicts among various ethnic groups also began to surface. Instigated by ambitious schemers, the exiles suffered massacres and expulsions. To survive, they had no choice but to flee and resist. Can you lead these exiles to build a new nation? How will you carve out living space in the crevice of the Cold War? And when facing battle after battle, can you still win by surprise?

★★★ Triple-Layered Gameplay: Narrative Choices → Resource Management → Tactical Battles ★★★

       Unique triple-layered system: In this interactive cinematic game, you make critical choices. Your decisions reshape both your resource income and the story's direction.

       On the management panel, you turn those resources into industrial chains. Build a haven for the exiled. Through diplomacy and trade, sustain the fragile lifeline of your newborn nation.

       Step by step, resourceful management secures ever-greater advantages for your tactical battles. Then deploy a variety of tactics to win the fight!

★★★ Secure International Support through Diplomacy and Trade ★★★

       From underground resistance in the colonial era to the treacherous currents of the Cold War among great powers, navigating countless perils demands your judgment!

       Under the crippling blockade of hostile nations, you must maneuver and make choices among the major powers, securing diplomatic aid and trade support.

       There are no eternal enemies, but a kind and resilient nation will surely have its friends.

       And of course, the support of various ethnic groups will make your efforts twice as effective.

★★★ 400+ Min Epic Saga · Countless Choices · Lasting Impact ★★★

Will your exiles survive in the bloodtide? Can you hold back the tide of overwhelming invasion?

Can hostile peoples set aside their hatred and unite? How will you keep a new nation from crumbling?

Diplomacy is never easy — but the real question is: can love and friendship bear the brutal weight of politics?

This is not a series of fancy cutscenes between battles.

This is a living, breathing epic — and it's yours to shape.

★★★ Build × Trade × Manufacture —— Lead the Exiled to Build a New Homeland ★★★

They are defenceless — cast out, hunted, with nothing but their will to survive. You are their only hope.

And only you can carve out a sanctuary from the wilderness.

In a land stripped of plenty, you'll solve the problems of balancing resources and supply chains under pressure.

Raise buildings, collect taxes, secure food, power, materials, machinery and forge your weapons to defend.

The cost of war may choke your treasury, but as long as your people stand with you, no mountain is too high to climb.

★★★ Fog-of-War Combat × Rich Battlefield Factors × Authentic Command Experience ★★★

Every combat formation has its own distinct armaments and attack ranges!

Different unit types and formation sizes demand careful consideration!

Players must maneuver stealthily under enemy vision, locate the weakest flank, strike with most effective weapons.

Utilize 16 distinct terrain types! Deploy 4 specialized fortifications, each with its own tactical emphasis!

Master line-of-sight to avoid detection, outflank the enemy, and launch devastating surprise attacks!

Combos! Crits! Extra actions! These interlocking tactical setups will send adrenaline and dopamine surging together!

Even popular support can feed your army critical intel, granting you the upper hand in the fog of war.

★★★ 1,000 + Cinematic Combat Clips — 400 + Unique Battle Outcomes ★★★

Tactics are no longer abstract. Every move is brought to life with stunning visual fidelity.

Combine different units, weapons, and terrain — and see an entirely different cinematic replay for each choice.

Hide your infantry in mountains, rain mortar fire from afar — and watch it all happen before your eyes!

★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★     WE WANT YOU!     ★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★

Defend your home, end the wars, protect those you love!

And carve your name into an epic of Asterhaven that will never bow.

store_data.about_the_game:
TUNG. TUNG. TUNG.

He hears the island. He hears you.

Tung Tung Tung Sahur does not stop. He does not tire. He does not forget where you ran.

Little Sahur Island is his domain, and every sound you make, every snapped branch, every kicked stone, every panicked breath, is an invitation. Learn his patterns. Respect his persistence. Or don't make it to morning.

KEY FEATURES:

  • An island that wants to trap you. Explore a fully realized 1km × 1km open environment with dense biomes, hidden structures, and secrets that reward the brave and punish the reckless.

  • Scavenge to survive. Hunt down scattered boat parts across the entire island. Every component brings you one step closer to freedom, if you can reach it.

  • A relentless pursuer. Tung Tung Tung Sahur actively hunts you across the island. No safe rooms. No sanctuaries. Only distance, darkness, and luck.

  • Dynamic tension. Manage noise, light, and movement as you scavenge. The tools that help you find parts are the same ones that give you away.

Can you repair the boat before he finds you?

Little Sahur Island remembers everyone who came. It has yet to let anyone leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the year 2577, civilization had long since died, and the only world that remained was a single last island.

Five hundred years ago, a global nuclear war triggered the reversal of a "nuclear winter"—uncontrolled greenhouse effects and thousands of underwater nuclear explosions turned Earth into a water world. Today's oceans are a highly acidic, radioactive hell, where no life can survive except for mutated deep-sea leviathans.

We are the last of humanity. In this era of severe technological collapse, high-energy batteries are the Holy Grail, sharp alloy fragments are divine iron, and bows and arrows are luxuries more precious than gold. We wield blades forged from scrap of the old world, clad in armor stitched from mutated beast hides, struggling on this isolated island shrouded in pollution.

But the island is shrinking. As tectonic plates subside, seawater is slowly swallowing the highlands inch by inch. The only hope lies at the highest point of the island, a place legendary as the "Quantum Dome." According to archives from the old world, it was the launch silo for the Ark and the sole wormhole leading to extraterrestrial colonies.

24 survivors, a lone island, a legend. Will you share scarce resources to strengthen your defenses, or become a predator and seize everything from others? Remember, here the sea will corrode your skin, mutated beasts will tear your throat apart, and the most dangerous... is always the human behind you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a deck. Summon an army. Win the battle.

Your deck is your army — and every card is played in real time.


Floodline Legion blends two genres that rarely meet — the deckbuilding roguelite and the real-time autobattler. Every card in your hand is a soldier waiting to enter the fight. Drop a unit onto the single lane, and it advances, clashes, and falls on its own. But when to summon, what to save your mana for, and how to turn your deck into a snowballing army are entirely up to you.


Mana builds continuously, and cards trickle into your hand a few at a time. Every moment asks a small question — spend now to hold the line, or save for the card that can end the fight?

Forge a build, not just a deck


Within the Human faction, three archetypes pull your deck in different directions — and the strongest runs weave them together:


  • The Swarm — cheap conscripts arrive several at a time, supported by banners and war horns that strengthen every ally based on your growing Host. Pack the lane wall-to-wall with bodies.

  • The Blessing — slow to start, terrifying once it gets going. Stack permanent buffs across your entire army, then field elite units that scale with those stats. A single blessed unit can clear the screen by itself.

  • The Contagion — death is contagious. Venom ignores defense, grinds enemies down over time, and spreads to nearby enemies when its host dies. Hold the line long enough, and the enemy army collapses on its own.


These archetypes do not exist in isolation — they naturally connect through cards, keywords, and the engraving system.

Cards, keywords, and engravings that bend the rules


Units are not the only things fighting. Some cards and engravings rewrite the very rules of battle.


  • Keywords — over twenty keywords and status effects each add their own tactical twist. For example, Rear and Front make unit placement matter even on a one-dimensional frontline. Charge grows stronger the longer you hold it in hand, and Venom spreads when its host dies. Every keyword opens up a new line of play.

  • Engravings — permanent upgrades etched onto individual cards. Variant engravings go even further, transforming a unit into a different archetype. An ordinary Mage can become a Blessing Mage, a Venom Mage, or a Host Mage. Mix and match variants to build something far stronger.

  • Rule-bending cards — build your deck and summon your army from over 60 cards. Some cards do more than add power — they change the shape of the battle. The Rewind card sends only the enemy back to the start of the previous round, while your army stays exactly where it is. Buy time, build a powerful formation, and turn a single card into a complete reversal.

store_data.about_the_game:
The mountain wind feels heavier than days before.

Master left in haste, leaving only a pill room, a lit fire, and unfinished words. Taking over for him, you expected a few quiet days.

But the visitors are not ordinary... Each hides secrets.

The fire still burns.
The scent lingers.
More will come.
Heal them.
And find out why they all came.

Instead, the systems are failing. Terminals are offline. Telemetry is stale. Crew logs contradict each other. Somewhere between Earth and orbit, something has gone wrong, and you are one of the few people left who might still be able to fix it.

Space Lift is a narrative-driven sci-fi adventure about an engineer trying to keep a failing orbital transport system alive. Your journey begins on Earth, continues up the space elevator, and leads into stations, spacecraft, and remote off-world locations.

Explore service decks, maintenance rooms, spacecraft interiors, and quiet facilities where the crew should still be. Restore power, unlock terminals, repair damaged machinery, operate a remote-controlled drone, and piece together what happened from logs, diagnostics, maps, and missing mission records.

The game uses a side-view 3D perspective: readable and cinematic like a side-scroller, but built as a fully 3D world with depth, navigation, and spaces to investigate.

The deeper you go, the less reliable the systems become.

store_data.about_the_game:
BitVoxel is a voxel sandbox game where you build real digital circuits inside a 3D world.

Create logic systems using AND, OR, XOR, NOT, switches, LEDs, wires and other circuit blocks. Build simple gates, full machines, computers, or massive logic creations in an endless sandbox world. Whether you want to experiment, learn how digital circuits work, or push the limits of what can be built, BitVoxel gives you the tools to create it.

Use advanced editing tools like copy, paste, move, rotate, and flip to speed up large projects. Build freely, test your designs, expand your creations, and save your worlds as you experiment with different circuit ideas.

BitVoxel also includes a component tool that lets you select a circuit, save it as a reusable component, and place it again later. Build your own library of circuit parts and reuse them across different worlds, making it easier to create larger and more complex systems without rebuilding the same designs from scratch.

BitVoxel is designed for players who enjoy building, logic, engineering, automation and creative problem solving. Start with a simple switch and light, then work your way up to more complex systems using real digital logic.

BitVoxel is currently focused on sandbox building and circuit experimentation. Future updates will expand the game with more structured learning, challenges, and progression.

Build, test, improve, and create systems only limited by your imagination.

store_data.about_the_game:
Highway Station Sim is a first-person management simulation where you turn a small roadside stop into a fully equipped highway station.

You start with a single fuel pump and a handful of empty shelves. Vehicles pull in, customers shop, sales stack up — and every dollar goes back into growing the station.

Fuel Sales

Pick up the nozzle, walk to the vehicle, attach it and hold to pump. The gauge fills, the sale closes. Keep an eye on the tank pool and restock before it runs dry.

Market & Ordering

Browse the order terminal, pick your products, wait for the delivery truck, carry the containers to the shelves and stock them by hand. Keep the shelves full, keep the customers happy.

Electric Vehicle Charging

EV customers pull in and charge automatically — no interaction needed. Invest in solar panels to raise your price per kWh and earn passive income while you focus elsewhere.

Station Upgrades

Buy new fuel pumps, extra underground tanks, electric charging stations and solar panels from the upgrade terminal. Every purchase shows up physically in the world — the station visibly grows.

Market Design

Place shelves from delivery, rotate and snap them to the market floor grid. Swap floor and wall materials to make the interior your own.

Live Traffic

Vehicles roll in from the highway based on your station's capacity. Fuel, electric and parking customers can all be active at once — manage your time across all three.

Checkout

When a customer queues at the register, step up and take payment. Fuel charges are fixed; market items are confirmed one by one. Reject an item and it goes straight back on the shelf.

store_data.about_the_game:
A return to Dreamcast-era survival horror, where every encounter is a moral choice.

Explore the cursed town of White Creek as exorcist Alicia Morelli, unearth its buried traumas, and decide whether to kill the possessed or save their souls.

Shoot or exorcise? The choice is yours. Between action and reflection, you can take the risk of exorcising the possessed and adopt a more pacifist approach to your investigation… but at what cost?

Alicia has several weapons at her disposal, in addition to her psychic powers. These abilities allow her to detect spiritual anomalies, whether they are found within the possessed or hidden throughout the environment.

Alicia can also capture and record them using her mobile phone, a crucial tool for exploration, investigation, and puzzle-solving.

Face the Exorcism Overdrive sequences, intense gameplay phases where Alicia comes face to face with a particularly corrupted possessed soul. Speak to them, confront them with the evidence gathered throughout your investigation, break through their illusions, and finally bring peace to their soul.

White Creek features around ten chapters, offering approximately 5 hours of gameplay, excluding optional content.

Support us on Kickstarter!

The Lund family lives in the woods just outside Greyford, a small village nestled within Veridia.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tech Store & Repair Simulator is an immersive business management tycoon and life sim that tests your entrepreneurial spirit. Set in a vibrant open world, you will start with a modest shop and build a massive electronics retail empire from the ground up.

This is not just about standing behind a cash register. You must master complex inventory control, perform delicate hardware repairs, and survive the daily grind of a dynamic economy to become the ultimate tech mogul!

Comprehensive Retail & Shopkeeper Mechanics

A premium electronics store requires flawless logistics and resource management. Purchase a wide variety of stock from the wholesaler, including the latest smartphones, premium tablets, headphones, chargers, and stylish accessories.

Physically unpack your deliveries and strategically organize your display tables and wall racks. Decorate your store with plants to increase customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends, adjust your pricing, and ensure your shelves are never empty in this highly realistic simulation.

Realistic Hardware Repair System

Stand out from the competition by offering expert technical support! You are not just a seller; you are a technician. Throughout the day, customers will bring in their broken devices. Step up to your workbench and dive into the detailed phone repair mechanics. Diagnose the issue, unscrew the chassis, replace dead batteries or faulty internal components, and reassemble the device. This highly detailed system provides a crucial secondary income stream to fund your tycoon expansion.

Time Management & Survival Elements

Success requires stamina. Tech Store & Repair Simulator features core survival and life sim elements that directly impact your strategy.

Time is money, but you cannot run on an empty stomach. Keep a close eye on your character’s hunger. If you forget to eat, your movement speed will drop, crippling your time management and making it harder to serve customers. Navigate the city streets, buy food, and sleep in your bed to stay refreshed for another profitable day.

Store Customization, Automation, and Expansion

What starts as a single, humble shop can evolve into a massive tech paradise. Use your hard-earned profits to purchase the adjacent property, doubling your floor space and inventory capacity. Experience true sandbox freedom by designing your store layout exactly how you want it.

As customer foot traffic increases, step into the role of an HR manager. Automate your daily operations by hiring a dedicated cashier to process sales and a cleaner to maintain a premium shopping environment. Pay their daily wages, optimize your overhead costs, and watch your automated retail machine generate massive wealth!

Key Features

  • Deep Business Simulator: Buy, price, and sell a huge variety of tech products in a dynamic economy.

  • Hardware Repair System: Take apart broken smartphones, replace faulty components, and repair them for extra cash.

  • Open World Life Sim: Navigate a vibrant city, manage your hunger by buying food, and sleep to restore your energy.

  • Shopkeeper & Sandbox Design: Place display tables, wall racks, checkout counters, and decorations with full freedom.

  • Tycoon Automation: Expand your business to 2 large stores and hire staff to automate your workflow.

  • Resource & Time Management: Balance your daily schedule, finances, and personal survival to keep your business afloat.

store_data.about_the_game:
People come through the door carrying things they can't let go of.

Shen Bo, an elderly clockmaker. On the night his wife passed, he slept too deep to hear her final words — and the recording of that rainy night has been sitting in his drawer for three years. Awu, a café girl who goes suddenly quiet on certain topics. Some memories she's afraid to touch. Lin Zhixia, a career woman who isn't looking for a specific memory. She's looking for "the person I used to be." Xiao Man, a silent child with a small oil lamp, searching for someone who "shouldn't be forgotten."

And they're not alone. A young office worker on the edge of burnout. A retired teacher who only appears at dusk. A delivery driver who holds onto childhood through a can of soda… The door keeps ringing. Over thirty stories, more than twenty keepsakes — each visitor a complete journey.

You are the keeper. You listen. You take the keepsake they hand you — an old clock, a train ticket, a child's stone — and you dive into their memories. Inside, the colors have drained, voices are buried under rain, and fragments hover in empty frames. Your job is to put them back together.

  • Jigsaw repair: Drag floating light-motes back into empty frames, watching faded scenes bloom with color again

  • Sound repair: Turn a dial against the static of rain to pull a single buried sentence toward you

  • Presence: Sit quietly beside someone in the hardest moment — sometimes the kindest thing is just being there

No time limits. No fail states. The act of repairing is the healing — and every repair pieces together a fragment of your own story, too.

The Hall of Gathering Light is more than a house. An empty picture frame on the wall is waiting — for your portrait. A floating companion named Ying has watched every keeper come and go. And the Eraser — the previous keeper — lurks in the dark, scrubbing painful memories away. He believes it's mercy. You don't.

Five acts. Four seasons. Multiple endings. From the Prologue to the final choice — stay, leave, pass the lamp on, or reunite beneath its light — every visitor you help, every goodbye you witness, shapes the path to your ending.

Some things stay with you. When a visitor finally lets go, they leave a gift behind — a sentence, a painting, a pebble. They hang on your collection wall, the memory of this house. And on certain gifts: the shape of a lamp…

Wishlist now to be the first to experience this journey of gentle goodbyes.

"The clock… wind it up. Don't let it stop. A house needs sound when you're alone… I was afraid you'd be lonely."

With help from their parents, they created this game, and proceeds go towards the £3,600 they each need to raise to attend. If that target is reached, all additional proceeds will go towards creating new adventures for Sofie Scout.

Run fast, jump high and make it to Poland.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE FARM OF THE LIVING is a dark, text-based interactive adventure where your choices dictate the thin line between survival and ruin.

The winter is coming, the silos are burning, and the dead are gathering outside the walls. As the First Ranger of the last agricultural sanctuary, you are responsible not only for defending the gates, but for holding a fracturing community together.

Will you rule with iron-fisted Authority, preserve your Humanity at all costs, or walk the path of Shadows to uncover the truth?

KEY FEATURES:

  • 15 Unique Endings & High Replayability: Your choices are never cosmetic. With a complex branching narrative of 400 sections, the story can conclude in 15 radically different ways. Will you establish a new civil order, be exiled into the freezing wastes, spark a bloody civil war, or see the sanctuary burn to the ground? Every playthrough reveals new secrets and paths.

  • 17 Tracked Statistics: Your character sheet is a living document. The game constantly monitors 17 different parameters, including your personal traits (Authority, Cunning, Humanity, Shadow), community resources (Supplies, Morale, Defenses, Stability), and your changing relationships with key factions and characters.

  • Investigate the Sabotage: A devastating fire has destroyed your winter food supply, and the locks were sealed from the inside. Search for clues, manage key evidence, cross-examine suspects, and expose the traitor before the community tears itself apart from within.

  • Tense Faction Intrigues: Maintain a fragile peace inside the walls. Balance the demands of the political Council, the ambitions of the aggressive local Militia, and the loyalty of your own Rangers. One wrong move, one biased accusation, and the sanctuary will plunge into internal warfare.

  • A Grim, Fully Illustrated Journey: Immerse yourself in the bleak atmosphere of the homestead. The game features a complete gallery of over 340 unique illustrations and generic backup scenes that bring the cold wind, the burning grain, and the dread of the non-dead to life.

Prepare to face the winter. Prepare to face the Hollow. What are you willing to sacrifice to keep the living alive?
