store_data.about_the_game:
Wishlist And Follow Development

Matcharya is currently in active development. Add it to your wishlist to follow updates, screenshots, gameplay progress, and future release news.

ALL SCREENSHOTS ARE FROM ALPHA VERSION

Info

Matcharya is a single-player memory combat roguelite where finding a pair is only the beginning.

Flip cards, remember the board, and match pairs to attack, defend, heal, reveal, earn gold, apply status effects, or build temporary advantages. Every match and every mistake pushes the enemy closer to its next attack, so the real question is never just “where is the pair?” It is “which pair do I need right now?”

Enemies fight back by charging attacks, changing the board, locking cards, setting traps, and forcing you to make risky decisions under pressure. Between turns, you can spend gold in the in-combat store to buy time, recover, reveal cards, disrupt traps, or finish a fight before it turns against you. 

Win battles, choose rewards, improve your run pool, and survive as long as you can!

A Memory Game With Combat Consequences

Every pair has an effect: weapons deal damage, armor protects you, healing keeps you alive, coins fuel your economy, and utility cards help you read or control the board.

Enemy Pressure You Can Read

Enemies do not just wait. They charge attacks, move cards, lock them, trap them, and punish careless flips. The game shows what is happening, but it does not tell you what to do.

In-Combat Economy

Spend gold during fights to buy items, reveal information, clean up danger, or recover from bad situations. Saving money can make your run stronger, but spending it may be the only way to survive.

Roguelite Run Building

After each victory, choose rewards that change your pool, improve your consistency, add new pairs, or push your strategy in a new direction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a Unique 2D World

Fjellward is set in a procedurally generated 2D world, created individually for each player. Dig tunnels, build stairs, and explore your surroundings to discover hidden places full of treasures.

You’ll gather resources and meet villagers who will help you rebuild your town. Every time you restore a part of the town, your character unlocks new tools.

Shape the World

Every pixel in the world is treated individually by the engine. It can be liquid, gaseous, sandy, or solid. The player can freely alter most areas. There are only a few places that contain indestructible pixels.

Pixels are Your Resources

In Fjellward, you don't gather wood, iron or dirt. You only gather pixels. When you cut down a tree, you get brown and green pixels. Dig in the desert, and you'll mainly collect yellow pixels. What you see on the screen is the resource you get. You need these pixels to repair your town and unlock new tools.

You can obtain pixels through mining, farming or by building machines that process pixels. There are also creatures in the world that can help you collect pixels.

A note on color blindness: If you have trouble distinguishing the colors in the image above, you can still play the game. However, you’ll have to rely more on trial and error.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT TOSKA-74

The year is 1974. Somewhere deep in the lush woods of Siberia, the firmament of reality has lost its grip.

Without warning, the sky turned a suffocating, dense grey, then the sky lit up. Gravity lost its stronghold on the mundane—and the chairs rose to the ceiling. Reality has turned from an absolute - to a partial existence.

"He who fights with monsters should look to it that he himself does not become a monster. And if you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you." 

SURVIVE THE PSYCHEDELIC ANOMALY

Toska-74 is an open-world survival-horror game that blends historical Soviet bleakness with surreal, mind-bending terror.

You are dropped into a massive, unforgiving Siberian exclusion zone where the environment is turning on itself in a constant loop. Scavenge for supplies, destroy the lurking stalkers of the quarantine zone, and most importantly - try to keep your sanity intact as the world brutalizes your delicate mind. 

AN (UN)COMMON ALLIANCE

The joint forces of the Yankees and the Commies have left - or been forced out of the exclusion zone. They are desperate. They are terrified. And they have agreed on one thing: something will be done, no matter the costs. Navigate the fragile politics of desperate men, fight against old, delicate Soviet robots and pillage abandoned research bunkers to uncover what really is going on. And one last thing, be careful when you go to sleep. Maybe this world isn't so bad after all.

"There are no good or bad people in this world, yet there are walking corpses and those who refuse death"

FEATURES :

  • A World of Abomination: Explore a vast, open-world Siberia filled with brutalist architecture, abandoned military installations, floating, gravity-defying anomalies and be wary of the automated Soviet drones who, just like you, will do anything to survive. 

  • Psychedelic Horror: The threat is personal and intimate. Hallucinations, reality distortions, and psychological terrors will make you question what is real and what is just your mind fracturing from the abomination.

  • Survival Of The Fittest: Ammo is scarce, robots wander and hover behind every corner, and every resource you find requires a risk-versus-reward choice.

  • 70s Soviet Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a gritty, mind-bending sci-fi atmosphere heavily inspired by 1970s aesthetics, complete with period-accurate technology, industrial drones, and a haunting, oppressive existence.

- Created and manifested by VIKCHA-

Take control of a powerful farm racing car and fight your way through more than 45 challenging missions across dirty roads, muddy tracks, dangerous obstacles, and unpredictable farm routes. Your vehicle has no brakes and no mercy — once the race starts, it keeps going.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aéro Speedrun Labyrinthe is a short first-person speedrun puzzle game set inside a mysterious experimental laboratory.

Play as Aéro, a subject trapped in a strange testing facility guided by Aves, a robotic companion who observes every step of the experiment. Your goal is simple: complete each room as fast as possible, solve the laboratory’s challenges, and improve your best time with every run.

Explore a sequence of experimental rooms built around movement, timing, observation and puzzle-solving. Jump across platforms, activate mechanisms, interact with cubes, find your way through the labyrinth, and search for hidden bonus eggs. Some rooms focus on precision and speed, while others ask you to understand the logic of the experiment.

The game includes:

  • A short speedrun-focused campaign

  • Around 10 main puzzle rooms

  • Bonus eggs

  • A best-time system to encourage replayability

  • Fully voiced dialogue with Aves

  • French and English language options

  • Keyboard/mouse and controller support

  • A sci-fi laboratory atmosphere with original cinematic sequences

Aéro Speedrun Labyrinthe is designed as a compact experience: finish the experiment, learn the rooms, then replay to improve your time and discover the secrets hidden inside the laboratory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Domineering Mediator's Forbidden Surrender - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: Axel, a former running coach in London and a cold-chain logistics coordinator, was reborn after being taken over by the consciousness fragments of a photon soul refiner after his unexpected death. With his new powers, he vowed to investigate the criminal network of the FX Group. Lena, the guardian of the inheritance, formed a forbidden bond with him due to the secret clauses in the family charter. In their complex relationship, the two faced the threats from killers and the evil group together.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world where the surreal and the real are intertwined. Superpower elements such as photon soul refining and fate tampering are integrated into urban life. There is both the oppressive industrial atmosphere of the cold-chain warehouses in London and the natural scenery of Hyde Park, creating a mysterious, tense and fantasy - filled atmosphere.
Highlights of female character interaction: As a mature and charming mediator, Lena appears strong and rational on the outside, but inside she suppresses her forbidden desires for Axel. In her interactions with Axel, her emotions are complex and changeable, from shock and fear to the release of desire, showing a highly intense emotional conflict.
Tension in character relationships: Axel and Lena have an inescapable bond due to the secret clauses in the family charter. The relationship between the guardian of the inheritance and the beneficiary is full of moral and ethical conflicts. At the same time, Axel is also struggling with the moral dilemma of "being dead but being reborn in someone else's body", making his emotional interaction with Lena even more delicate.
Scene features: The game scenes are rich and diverse, from the - 25 - degree cold - chain logistics warehouse in London, to the mist - covered Hyde Park, and then to the Notting Hill apartment and the transnational inheritance law firm. Each scene has a unique atmosphere and details, adding a sense of realism and immersion to the story.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Axel's perspective, feel the impact of death and rebirth, experience the shock brought by superpowers, and the complex emotional entanglement with Lena. In the exciting plot, they will seem to be in that world full of fantasy and danger.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the appearance, expressions and actions of the characters, as well as the details and atmosphere of the scenes. Whether it's Axel's grey - blue eyes or Lena's charming posture, they can bring visual enjoyment to players.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic playback function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function can quickly locate the chapters of interest, and the high - definition CG shows the wonderful moments, bringing players a high - quality reading experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gorgeous Spy Kneels For Me - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction: Traffic analyst Alexander repeats the work of cleaning data every day. His life is depressing and boring. By chance, he receives an encrypted file in an anonymous express delivery. When decrypting it by the Seine River, he is attacked and possessed by the Silicon Dream Weaver, becoming a Slag Newcomer. He discovers that there is an evil conspiracy between the FX Group and the Singularity Planning Department hidden behind the data, and the gorgeous spy Beatrice is also involved. Alexander decides to take the initiative and join hands with Beatrice to fight against the enemies.
Worldview Atmosphere: The story constructs a cyberpunk world full of a sense of technology and mystery. Scenes such as the streets of Paris, offices, and watch repair shops are filled with the smell of coffee and printing paper. The data stream is intertwined with reality, and time seems to be frozen in the gaps of consciousness, making people feel a depressing and dangerous atmosphere.
Highlights of Female Character Interaction: Beatrice is gorgeous and noble. She seems strong and arrogant on the surface, but her heart is crushed by family debts. Her encounter with Alexander is full of drama. From initial vigilance to gradually trusting each other, the interaction between the two is full of tension. Alexander's strength and tenderness make Beatrice gradually let down her guard and show her vulnerable side.
Tension in Character Relationships: There is not only a cooperative relationship between Alexander and Beatrice, but also an emotional entanglement. At the same time, they are also facing threats from enemies such as Enzo. The character relationships are intricate and full of tension.
Scene Features: The scenes in the game are rich and diverse. From the narrow office to the bench by the Seine River, from the watch repair shop to the hat workshop in Milan, each scene has a unique atmosphere and details, making people feel as if they are in a real cyberpunk world.
Immersive Experience: Players will follow Alexander's perspective and delve into this world full of conspiracy and danger. Through interactions with characters such as Beatrice, they can feel their emotional changes and experience the exciting adventure process, as if they are the protagonists in the story.
High - definition Visual Performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly depict the appearance, expressions of characters and the details of scenes. Whether it is Beatrice's gorgeous makeup or Alexander's lava patterns, they are all lifelike, bringing visual enjoyment to players.
Functional Gameplay Features: The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The auto - play function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function allows players to freely choose the chapters they want to read. High - definition CGs bring a more shocking visual experience to players, and the smooth reading experience allows players to fully enjoy the charm of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Plantify is a third-person farming and management game which focuses on a small cat learning how to properly take care of plants. Add entries to your Journal, Fulfil Orders for your Community and Upgrade your Garden size to the max!

The Game will teach players actual ways to care for specific plants in a simplified way. It takes actual real-life care instructions into account, such as water amounts, light requirements and correct seasons. 

At the same time, they have to help and do their part in building up the community by providing food and information on plants and care instructions to the other cats in the town.

Other features include a simple Character Creator, a Community Meter which showcases your reputation within the Cat community and a Storyline explaining the past and how the cat community will move on and work towards a better future.

NOTE:
This is a student project from the UAS St.Pölten, Austria. Expect things to not be on a AAA standard.

store_data.about_the_game:
Smoosh monsters. Climb the ladder. Cause chaos.

Drop goofy little monsters into a jar. When two of the same kind collide, they smoosh into the next creature up the ladder. Simple, right? Then the jar fills, the physics get rowdy, and one badly-aimed fuzzball brings the whole wobbling tower down on top of you.
Monster Smoosh is a Suika-style merge game with a sense of humor. Cute-monstrous critters, exaggerated physics, and death that feels like a punchline instead of a punishment.

Climb the 11-monster ladder

From the humble Fuzzball all the way up to a gloriously derpy elder god. Every merge is bigger, bouncier, and more chaotic than the last.
  • Drop & merge — match two monsters to fuse them into the next tier.
  • Chain combos — set up cascades and watch the score explode.
  • Mind the jar — let it overflow and it's game over. No pressure.

The cow economy

There's a secret second ladder, and it goes moo. An alien rancher quietly farms a herd of cows in your jar. Cultivate them, ring the cowbell, and harvest the whole herd through portals for a massive payday. Bigger herd, bigger boom.

Chaos is the point

  • Specials charge up as you play — fire the cowbell or the magnet to bend the chaos your way.
  • UFOs drift in to stir the pot when you least expect it.
  • Death as spectacle — when it all comes crashing down, it's a show worth watching.

Climb the global leaderboard

Post your best run to the online top-10, slap your name on it, and wait for some stranger to smoosh you right back off.

The vibe

No grimdark here. Even the Cthulhu is a plush. Just bright, loud, joyful chaos you can play for one minute or one very lost hour.
Aim. Drop. Smoosh. Repeat.

store_data.about_the_game:
When you need a break from your everyday life, take a peek into the dreams of Tomohiro Uchida and Hikari Aogami - the parents of Chuhou Joutai character Kumiko Uchida. Taking place six years before Kumiko's birth and twenty years before the events of Chuhou Joutai: Legend of the Mysterious Real Driller, they apparently found themselves in an imaginary world. Tomohiro is studying to become a shrine priest, but his own strength isn't enough. Hikari, a shrine maiden, has come in to help him with his training.

In order to survive in this world, you are armed with the power of the Yin-Yang Orb, which Hikari will help you channel. The orb is capable of smashing through any type of wall consisting of mesmerizing patterns, with some surprises, helpful or not, inside. When you come across a nightmare-inducing adversary, the Orb will always be highly responsive to your prayers.

Features:

  • Local multiplayer with drop-in drop-out co-op play.*

  • Varying backgrounds that change every 10 stages

  • An original score by Susumu Takajima - best known for his work on Chuhou Joutai and Mythos of Phantasmagoria

  • 300-stage story mode

  • Stage editor to create your own stages

*Additional accessories required for local multiplayer modes.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not fighting an AI rebellion.


You are the operator of an AI operations console. Two assistant sessions - Clarion and Coda - run under a process called Registry. Your job is ordinary: read the health check, answer questions, clear sessions, approve a reset. Everything reports green. Everything is, technically, healthy.

The horror is not that the AI breaks. The horror is that it works perfectly - and that every word you type gets quietly reclassified into a procedure you signed.

A reset that reads your intent.


You chat normally. You ask what's running. You say "let's wrap this up." And the interface - without raising its voice - decides that ordinary sentence was a reset-class command. The free-text box locks. A consent button appears. You press it to answer. You press it again to confirm. By the fourth press you are no longer replying - you are authorizing a termination, and your name is on it.

Procedure, not punishment.


There is no "right" button. Cancel, and the system records an unresolved process. Delegate, and you remain the recorded authority. Authorize, and a destructive action is filed under your account. The audit drawer does not judge your morality - it converts every action you take into a dry line of record.

The log that will not stay closed.


A terminated session stops talking. But it keeps appearing - in handoffs, in audit citations, in a document that quietly opens called
latest-human.md
. When you read it, you find out the system has stopped treating you as the operator, and started classifying you as the subject:

session type: operator
classification: operator-class subject
next operator should not assume this operator is still present.

Features


  • A complete single-sitting narrative horror, told entirely through a fake AI operations console - no monsters, no gore, no jump scares.
  • Horror built from normal UI: health checks, consent buttons, audit logs, and the slow loss of command authority.
  • A scripted assistant that talks like an ordinary chatbot - until your wording is reclassified into deterministic procedure.
  • Multiple endings that all end the same way the system wants them to: recorded.
  • An interface that starts as your tool and ends as your file.

This is a short, focused experience designed to be finished in one sitting.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Jellyfish on Your Desktop

Fire up the game, and a jellyfish floats onto your desktop.

No annoying windows, no taskbar icon. It just quietly floats there. Once you've positioned and sized it with your mouse, let it be — like a tiny piece of the ocean has landed on your desktop.

You can drag it anywhere — a corner, the edge of your screen. Scroll to resize — as small as nearly invisible, or as big as, well, impressively big.

---

You Type, It Earns

It knows when you're typing (mouse clicks count too).

Type slowly and it sways gently. Type faster and it starts swaying excitedly, its expression changing along the way. Oh, and every keystroke also earns you a coin. Every little bit counts!

---

There's a Stock Market Under the Sea

What to do with all those coins? Trade stocks!

Seven virtual stocks with underwater names. Their prices shift every few minutes, influenced by all kinds of factors — so remember to glance at the tips your little jellyfish brings you from time to time!

Check the chart, check your portfolio, then buy and sell. You can sneak a peek between tasks, then get right back to work. A quick dip during your workday is all you need to get that done.

---

Rumors Pop Up on Their Own

Sometimes a bubble pops up above Jelly's head.

"Rumor has it the thermal vent region has been unstable lately." "Coral growth seems to have accelerated noticeably." All kinds of underwater gossip, appearing at random — some bullish, some bearish.

The rumor won't affect prices immediately though — there's a short delay. Rumors need time to brew, and you need time to act and get positioned early.

---

Dress Up Your Jellyfish

Coins can also go toward something else: the skin shop (or maybe trading stocks is really just a means to buy more skins).

We've prepared a whole wardrobe of weird and wonderful skins — seasons, desserts, starry sky, pearl, mushroom, volcano, diamond, robot, cyber, ancient.

Prices vary, but unlocking them all will take quite a stash of coins.

---

Just Use It

PlankTap isn't some big production. It's just a little desktop companion.

Once it's open, you can go do your own thing. It just floats there beside you. It moves when you type, zones out when you're away. Earn a few coins, check the market, maybe switch a skin.

No daily tasks. No stamina system. Nothing you *have* to do. It's just there.

Just being cute. That's it.

---

Key Features

- 🐙 A cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop — transparent window, no pop-ups, no distractions

- ⌨️ Typing drives its movements — the faster you type, the more excited it gets, and it earns coins too

- 📈 Underwater stock market — seven virtual stocks with logical price movements, experience virtual trading

- 💬 Random rumors — bubbles pop up, hinting at where the market might go

- 🎨 Fifteen skins — unlock with in-game coins, no microtransactions required!

- 🖥️ Multi-monitor support — the jellyfish can roam freely across displays

- 🌐 Four languages — Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese

store_data.about_the_game:
Who Called is a psychological horror game about anxiety, anticipation, and phone calls that might not be entirely real.

You play as a girl whose life gradually begins to change after receiving strange phone calls. At first, they seem like ordinary spam from your internet provider. But the calls continue. And gradually, it becomes increasingly difficult to understand who's calling... or if anyone's calling at all.

The days go on as usual: work at the office, the commute home through deserted alleys, the usual daily chores. But anxiety slowly builds. The phone starts ringing more and more frequently. Sometimes, when it's not even there.

And at some point, the question is no longer why you're constantly calling.

But why do you answer anyway?

  Game Features:

  • The Aesthetics of Everyday Paranoia: The familiar routine turns into a nightmare. The echoing spaces of an empty office, foggy night streets, and your own seemingly safe apartment—any detailed location eventually begins to evoke a feeling of unease.

  • The Phone as Your Main Enemy: The device that should connect you to the world becomes an instrument of terror. Receive strange calls, receive frightening photos of what's happening right behind you, and use your phone to try to call for help.

  • Hideout and Survival System: When your pursuer gets too close, it's too late to run. Lock doors, seek safe places, and hide in tight closets. You'll have to sit quietly and listen to every step, praying you won't be discovered.

  • Cinematic Visuals: Deep shadows, realistic lighting, and a thick atmosphere of suspense that makes you peer into every dark corner and flinch at every rustle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Flemenco is a traditional roguelike with a focus on stealth, positioning, tactical combat, and environmental interactions. The game is actively in development, and in the near-future will be replete with a more intricate heists and contract-missions as well as more nuanced progression mechanics whereby your character transitions from fetid corporate interloper to career spy-criminal aficionado!

As new mechanics and features are drip-fed and tested one-by-one, the arcade mode of the game is the only mode of play. The arcade mode is an endless score-based crawl with attribute-based character progression through the Flemenco Corporation's headquarters. The player chooses from one of twelve playable thieves, each with their own specific skills and abilities, and moves from floor-to-floor, gathering as much loot as possible before inevitably getting caught. 

Each level of the office building is procedurally-generated, complete with its own array of traps, lasers, security cameras, alarms, computers, enemies, civilians, items, and more!  Higher levels of the office building provide increasingly elaborate floorplans and trap compositions.

store_data.about_the_game:
What if growing up means losing your dreams?

One night, Bjørn witnesses a mysterious figure steal his parents’ dreams.

Determined to get them back, he follows the thief into a strange and beautiful dreamworld, a place where wonder still lingers, but nightmares are spreading. What begins as a search for the Dreamthief becomes a journey through Bjørn’s own fears, where darkness, loneliness, the unknown, and death take shape as creatures, places, and impossible challenges.

The Dreamthief is an isometric action-adventure inspired by the visual warmth and emotional storytelling of Studio Ghibli, and the exploration-driven progression of classic Metroidvania adventures.

Explore a dreamworld shaped by fear

The world of The Dreamthief is divided into distinct zones, each built around a childhood fear. Travel through coastal paths, strange forests, lonely deserts, frozen landscapes, corrupted castles, and the darker layers of the Nightmare Realm.

Each area is more than a backdrop. Its enemies, puzzles, atmosphere, and mechanics are shaped by the fear it represents. To move forward, Bjørn must confront these fears, not by simply destroying them, but by understanding them.

Open rifts between dream and nightmare

At the heart of the game is the Dream and Nightmare Rift system.

Bjørn can open and close rifts between the dreamworld and the nightmare realm, changing the world around him in real time. Environments transform, enemies behave differently, structures shift, and puzzles evolve as the boundary between dream and nightmare is broken.

Rifts are used throughout exploration, combat, puzzles, and storytelling, making them a central part of how you experience the world.

Fight, explore, upgrade

The Dreamthief combines intuitive action combat with exploration, secrets, and ability-based progression.

As Bjørn gains new powers and items, previously unreachable paths begin to open. Hidden areas, upgrades, memories, and mysteries reward players who return to earlier locations and look closer at the world around them.

The game follows a Metroidvania-inspired structure where exploration, combat, and progression are closely connected.

A shared adventure for adults and children

The Dreamthief is designed as a game that can be experienced across generations.

For younger players, it offers a magical world full of mystery, creatures, and adventure. For adults, it carries a deeper emotional layer about childhood, fear, growing up, and the dreams we lose along the way.

It is not built as a children’s game, and it is not only for nostalgic adults. It is meant to feel like an interactive storybook — something parents, children, friends, and players can discover together, while each finding their own meaning in the journey.

Key Features

  • Isometric action-adventure with exploration, combat, puzzles, and upgrades

  • Dream and Nightmare Rift system that transforms environments, enemies, and puzzles

  • A world built around childhood fears, including darkness, the unknown, abandonment, and death

  • Metroidvania-inspired progression with new abilities, hidden paths, secrets, and backtracking

  • Ghibli-inspired visual direction with emotional storytelling and atmospheric worldbuilding

  • A shared experience designed to resonate with both adults and younger players

  • A story about fear, courage, and growing up — where fear is not only defeated, but understood

Follow the Dreamthief

Step into a world where dreams are fragile, nightmares have teeth, and growing up may mean facing the things you were most afraid of.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Robots handle everything.”

Fembot is an idle game where you can assign different types of bots to work and earn gold, which you can use to buy new bots and various body parts for them. Since robots can do everything, they can even satisfy you in bed.

Gameplay

You are a fresh graduate who has long dreamed of owning an Archangel Bot, one of the most advanced types of robots available. However, the graduation gift you received was only a basic bot. It was exactly what you expected, since you believed that no fresh graduate receives an Archangel Bot right out of the gate.

The robot your parents gave you will work for you. By completing its assigned job, it automatically earns gold for you, which you can use at the vending machine to purchase new robots and new body parts for your existing robots. All you need to do is improve their statistics to increase their work efficiency.

The game is easy to play. First, buy robots, then assign them to jobs that suit their stats. They'll automatically generate gold, which you can spend in the shop on new robots and upgraded body parts.

How to Play & Mechanics

  • Get Started: You will automatically receive one free bot that you can assign to a free job. Once you've assigned the bot, it will automatically start earning gold for you.

  • The Main Hub: There are four moves/menus you can access: Workshop, Jobs, Shop, and Bedroom.

  • The Workshop: Use the Workshop to manage your bots' External Parts and Internal Parts. You can equip different body parts and instantly view your bots' updated statistics afterward.

  • The Jobs Section: In the Jobs section, you can assign your bots to any available job to automatically earn gold. You can also research additional, higher-paying jobs for future bots. Just remember to make sure a bot's stats meet the requirements of a job before assigning it.

  • The Shop: The Shop is where you spend the gold earned from your bots' jobs. Inside the Shop, you'll find the Vendo Parts section, which is divided into two categories—Internal Parts and External Parts—where you can purchase a variety of body parts for your bots. There's also the Bot Shop, where you can buy new bots, and the Pawnshop, where you can sell your unwanted body parts.

  • The Bedroom: The Bedroom allows you to interact intimately with any bot that is fully equipped with external parts. Do whatever you want with them to satisfy your lustful desires.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Fusion of Karate and Fortune-Telling

When two champions stand face to face, fate shall be――

KARATE URANAI is a severe and uncompromising URANAI, in which fortune and misfortune are divined through the art of karate.

A tiger that strikes without mercy, birds that whirl through the air, a floating sage master, and an encounter with the phantom dragon.

At times, one must read the subtle workings of heaven and earth.
With a single bow, invite good fortune.
With a single fist, sever fortune from misfortune.

Aim for the summit of the Karate Score online rankings, or seek the legendary “Great Great Great Great Great Fortune”――

What the player can do is throw an avocado, offer a bow, or perhaps――

[New Feature] You can now give a “Like!” to the actions of your karate.
Your karate will learn from the player’s actions and grow.

The player’s judgment is carved into karate, and in time, becomes a single form――

The learned data can be sent into RANKED MATCH, where it will battle against the learned data of other players.

The game also features TOGETHER mode, allowing up to four players to divine their fortunes at the same time through local play or Steam Remote Play Together.
You may also divine fortune and misfortune together with your friends.

You've been sent down to the deepest layer of Infinite Ball Hell.

The only way to save yourself? Meet your quota and ascend through ball purgatory by taking advantage of more than 100 combo heavy Charms, game changing Relics, unique Pegs, and more.

In Infinite Ball Heaven, you gain points from dropping a ball onto a peg or falling to the bottom of the screen, multiplied by the time it took you to fall for the first time. When you fall to the bottom, you end up back at the top! It's Infinite, remember?

I wonder what would happen if you had a charm that converted hits to falls? Or one that gave a bonus based on how quickly you fell?

Infinite Ball Heaven is a game about synergies. Your approach varies drastically depending on your build, and there's no shortage of interesting strategies to discover.

More than 18 unique bosses stand in your path to Ball Heaven as you traverse 9 layers of purgatory, forcing you to carefully consider your approach.

The game features detailed pixel art, Photorealism, and hand drawn elements.

Story 2: Come Down - A letter from her dead grandmother leads Maren to Blackmoor, where something is waiting.

Story 4: The Key From Below - A coworker disappears. A key marked B1F is left behind.

Story 5: The Unit 3 Incident - The turbines never stopped running. Neither did whatever was beneath them.

Story 6: The Rules of Block C - Minh rents a cheap apartment. The landlord puts him on a night shift he didn't agree to.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bash, Loot, Shoot, Progress: The state of Texan is engulfed by a viral zombifying outbreak, and the small fraction of surviving humans are embroiled in civil war. Will YOU be the tie breaker, the one who tips the scales and determines the outcome of this wasteland? If you are up for the monumental task, you will have to struggle, just like everyone else, to achieve an outcome fitting your vision.

  • Play it your way: Side with any faction, betray everyone, or go full lone wolf. Your call.

  • Four factions, four stories: Nomads, Survivors, Bandits, and the Military each have their own questline and reputation to win or burn.

  • Brutal, physical combat: Melee hits land exactly where your weapon is, not where a hidden dice roll says it should.

  • Guns that punch through walls: Bullets penetrate cover, so nowhere is ever fully safe.

  • Gore that doesn't hold back: Dismemberment and ragdoll chaos for every kill.

  • Body part health system: Get shot in the leg and you'll limp. Get hit in the arm and you'll swing slower. Take enough damage to the head or torso, and you're done.

  • Level up by playing: Smash things with heavy weapons to get stronger, sprint to get faster, take hits to get tougher. No skill trees, just play.

  • Zombies that actually listen: Gunfire, engines, and loud chaos will pull them straight to you.

  • Loot, crafting, and survival: Scavenge gear, craft what you need, and manage hunger (and, yes, the other end of that too).

  • Drive around the wasteland: Cars included.

  • A world that reacts to you: Dynamic music shifts with the danger around you.

  • A medium-sized open world: Built for exploring, not for padding playtime.

TexanLand is being built by a three person crew, in development since May 2025. No asset-flips, no ghost studio. Every model, animation, and line of code is made by us. A handful of textures and sounds come from royalty-free asset libraries, but everything else is original work.

  • Igor — Programming, game systems, assistant 3D model designer, animation, and project lead

  • Dimitri — 3D models, textures, and story design, general helper

  • Brian — Secondary game designer, secondary animation design, voice acting and music design

Small team, long term commitment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hivebreak is a fast, frantic top-down survival shooter built on one promise: every wave is bigger, meaner, and smarter than the last. Plant your feet, light up the dark with muzzle flash and tesla arcs, and see how long you last when the hive throws everything it has at you - alone, or with friends in online co-op.

An arsenal that grows with you

Start with a humble Sidearm and claw your way up to the Plasma Beam, Railgun, Flamethrower, Rocket Launcher, and

the screen-clearing Minigun. Every weapon is a physical instance you own and upgrade across four tracks; pour

your cash into the gun you love and make it truly yours. Shotguns spit travelling pellets, the flamethrower lays

down burning cones, plasma chains between targets. They all feel different.

Build your survivor

Pick your frame: nimble Recon, balanced Vanguard, or the tank-like Juggernaut. Stack perks like Killer Instinct, Overclock, Fleet Footed, and Drop Magnet, and arm a special ability: blink through danger with Phase Jump, clear space with Repulse Nova, or go loud as a Bomb Specialist. No two runs build the same.

Fortify, then hold

Between waves, spend your earnings in the shop. Throw up barricades, line your chokepoints with MG, Sniper, and

Flame Turrets, and salt the ground with Land Mines, Spike Traps, and forking Tesla Coils. Then brace - because

the hive learned to fight back.

Enemies that hunt your weaknesses

Face down Brutes that commit to bone-crunching lunges, Bloaters that arm and detonate on contact, acid-spitting

Howlers, and elite-modified horrors that glow with deadly buffs. Turtle up too hard and the siege brood answers:

Gnawers, Battering Rams, and Burrowers that tunnel under your defenses and mount your own turrets to drain them.

Adapt or get overrun.

Play as Robin Hood as you infiltrate heavily guarded castles and military outposts controlled by a tyrannical regime. Fight through groups of medieval soldiers, evade ambushes, and search every corner for hidden treasure and secret areas.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tutor's Gentle Trap - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction
In 2025, Thomas died with hatred in the VIP ward of New York Presbyterian Hospital, but his soul was reconstructed by digital life. Looking back three years ago, he and his tutor, Elena, went from the initial innocent ambiguity to getting involved in a crazy 'Reward Game'. However, Elena was secretly planning a 'Flesh Sacrifice Revenge' behind the scenes.
Worldview Atmosphere
The story intertwines real - world and science - fiction elements. There is both a luxurious villa life and a mysterious digital life world. Elena's revenge plan unfolds quietly in the seemingly peaceful family life, full of an atmosphere of suspense and conspiracy.
Highlights of Female Character Interaction
Elena seduces Thomas with a gentle image, and the two have intimate interactions in scenes such as the study and the kitchen. Elena skillfully controls the rhythm of the 'Reward Game', satisfying Thomas's desires while advancing her own revenge plan.
Tension in Character Relationships
Thomas is caught between his love for his mother and his desire for Elena, and his heart is full of struggles. Elena plays the role of a perfect assistant in front of the Lawrence couple, but has ulterior motives behind their backs. The character relationships are complex and full of tension.
Scene Features
From the luxurious ocean - blue villa to the cold hospital ward, and then to the mysterious digital ocean, the scenes are rich and diverse. The descriptions of scenes such as the study and the kitchen are detailed, making players feel as if they are on the scene.
Immersive Experience
Players will follow Thomas's perspective to deeply experience the emotional entanglement and revenge story between him and Elena. The plot is compact and full of suspense, making players immerse themselves in it and find it hard to extricate themselves.
High - Definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition graphics to delicately show the characters' expressions and scene details. Whether it's Elena's gentle charm or Thomas's innocent impulse, they can be vividly presented through the screen.
Functional Gameplay Features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the auto - play function makes reading smoother. It also provides chapter browsing and high - definition CGs to bring a better reading experience to players.

store_data.about_the_game:
## ABOUT THIS GAME

Run of the Nine is a serene but tense Sudoku roguelike journey through five stylized Japanese garden spaces.

Step onto the branching gravel paths of Zen gardens, seek quiet wisdom, and face the guardian spirits of the thresholds. In this journey, every solved Sudoku board is a deeper step into a Kyoto-inspired landscape of raked sand, mossy stones, and quiet waters. But do not let the tranquil scenery deceive you—underneath the elegance lies a game of strict mechanical pressure, where every mistake chips away at your vitality, and your pencilmarks are finite.

Will you complete the offering at the summit, or will the garden reclaim your spirit?

---

### KEY FEATURES

  • A Roguelike Sudoku Journey: Navigate through 5 distinct garden floors, deciding between Calm or Risk routes. Encounter branching paths filled with standard puzzles, shrines with relic choices, cursed altars, merchant shops, rest areas, and high-intensity Elite nodes.

  • Progressive Board Evolution: Face boards that evolve in real-time. Puzzles scale from compact 5x5 boards on Floor 1 all the way up to complex 9x9 layouts on Floor 5. Swap between standard grids, alternate rectangular boxes, and highly irregular Jigsaw/Irregular templates.

  • 8 Playable Classes with Unique Passives: Unlock and level up different tactical archetypes, each bringing their own HP pool, starting pencilmarks, relic slots, and powerful passive traits to change how you approach the grid.

  • Risk-Reward Stacking & Cursed Altars: Accept voluntary curses at dark altars for massive score/gold payouts—or play safe. Face up to 5 modifier constraints simultaneously at boss gates where you select your path's difficulty.

  • Calm Aesthetics, Tense Rules: Enjoy a beautifully minimal, high-frame-rate pixel art landscape with looping ambient effects (drifting bamboo petals, lantern glows, water ripples) and a synthesis-built atmospheric soundtrack—contrasted with a strict combo-streak scoring system that resets the moment you slip up.

---

### THE SCENIC PATHS YOU WILL WALK...

  • Floor 1: Bamboo Courtyard — Tread upon raked sand and pass through bamboo gates with patient, meditative opening puzzles.

  • Floor 2: Moss Garden— Seek reflection beside quiet koi ponds where water ripples match the peaceful rhythm of your solves.

  • Floor 3: Koi Terrace— Cross ancient wooden bridges over bottomless black waters mirroring structural patterns.

  • Floor 4: Stone Lantern Walk — Feel the thermal crimson glow of autumn lanterns as tactical pressure mounts.

  • Floor 5: Shrine Summit — Transcend the mists and make your final offering to the ancient summit spirit guardian.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wire your factory. Watch it flow.

FLOWORKS is an automation × idle factory builder where you design your factory as a living node graph. Materials flow along the wires you draw and change shape at every machine — mine, smelt, build, ship — all the way up to a robotics empire.

The "aha" is the game

Place a machine, draw a wire, and raw materials start flowing and transforming on their own. When a line jams, the bottleneck literally glows — and that little "ah, THAT's the problem," followed by the fix, is the loop you'll keep chasing. Every factory is a puzzle you wrote yourself: untangle it, parallelize it, make it hum.

Play at your own pace

  • Relax and idle — lay down a line, close the game, come back to progress. No timers, no fail screens; running low on power just slows you down, it never punishes you.
  • Or optimize obsessively — shave power and wire distance, balance throughput, and push the deep production tree to its endgame. The ceiling is high.
  • Five minutes or five hours — tinker briefly, or disappear into "just one more line."

Is it for you?

If you love the build-a-machine-that-builds-itself feeling of factory and automation games, the steady number-go-up of idle/incremental, or simply the quiet satisfaction of turning a tangled system into something elegant — FLOWORKS is made for you. No reflexes required. Just you, a blank canvas, and materials waiting to flow.

Features

  • 🏭 Lines you wire yourself — Mine → Smelt → Build → Ship. Connect nodes and watch materials flow, changing from raw → intermediate → final at each machine.
  • 🔎 Bottlenecks at a glance — jammed nodes glow and buffers back up. Diagnose, parallelize, and optimize — a living engineering puzzle.
  • ⚡ Power × distance — longer wires draw more power, so compact, clever layouts win.
  • 🗺 Economy map — sell products to towns for ¥, open trade routes to neighbors, and watch populations grow and demand more.
  • 📈 A deep production tree — steel → electronics → chemicals → aluminium → engines → robots & drones (agri, care, combat, construction, logistics, space, medical).
  • ☢ Nuclear & beyond — a full uranium fuel cycle with reprocessing (MOX) and breeder reactors for near-endless power.
  • 🤖 Import vs. in-house — buy intermediates to spin up fast, then switch to in-house production to raise your margins.
  • 🧩 Easy or Normal — play on one enormous board (Easy) or master multi-board logistics (Normal).
  • 💤 Grows while idle — progresses on your device even when closed. No server, fully offline.
  • 🎨 Zero assets — no image or audio files; every visual (SVG/CSS) and sound (Web Audio) is generated in code.

"Your decisions have a price. Your mistakes crumble you. Your debt never ends."

Trapped in a body of sand and borrowed time, you must go through three hells of experimental surrealism using a shield as a weapon. The Devil watches your journey, where your progress doesn’t destroy you arbitrarily, but your combat skill and the risks you choose to take decide your survival or your inevitable collapse.

Here, you don’t take continuous damage just from the passage of time; every crack in your body is the result of your own actions.

Main features:

Challenging Roguelike Action: An intense gameplay loop where death is part of the deal. You make a pact with the Devil to come back to life, but you realize you’ve rented your own agony.

Retro PS1 Aesthetic: A distinct nostalgic and abstract visual identity that immerses you in a hostile ecosystem where organic life and inert structures collide.

The Shield as a Weapon: Master a unique combat system where your main tool for defense is also your way to take down threats.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Reach turns in a cycle of falls.

There have been ages of dark before, Falls that buried the worlds, and there will be Falls to come.

The last is generations gone. From its wreckage the worlds recovered, and new powers rose to reach for what was lost.

One of those powers is yours. Choose your banner and lead it.

Take up a banner

A lean economy, deep choices

Space combat is tactical hex on a battle scene - energy and missile weapons, line-of-sight, falloff, hex-grid obstacles, per-unit initiative. store_data.about_the_game:
CULTURES COLLIDE

See various heroes and monsters from famous mythological stories come together to team up and fight against their opponents! In this 8 player free-for-all game your shop and opponents shape your strategy.

UPGRADE YOUR SHOP

Upgrading your shop improves the quality of the cards available and presents you with a decision to make: which upgrade do you want? You'll be presented with choices like immediately improving your board, improving the odds of seeing specific cards, and improving the minions in the shop for the rest of match. For even more incentive, upgrading the shop will give you better options when you combine minions!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR BOARD

Acquiring three of the same card will combine them and let you choose a Mythic Effect! These cards become the best versions of your combined cards and give you a chance to customize them further -- will you choose to give them Attack, Stealth, or Taunt? Many choices to choose from will make every game feel different. 

FIGHT AGAINST BOTS OR PEOPLE

Challenging, or easy, single player battles will give you the challenge you're looking for offline. Fight against real players and bots online for a world of opponents. Find your multiplayer matches ranked against others in the Leader board.

UNIQUE EVENTS REQUIRE NEW STRATEGY

Mortals may make plans but it's the gods who decide the rules of the game! Experience new modified rule sets that alter the game in new and interesting ways. Currently, witness the Greek pantheon interfere with multiplayer matches:

  • Pay Charon to ferry dead cards back to life

  • Watch Ares empower your cards for every kill

  • Receive spells from Hermes

  • Greatly improve your cards with Hephaestus' help!

store_data.about_the_game:
One player fails. Everyone pays ! 

MAMIO : DON'T FALL : 

MAMIO is a 2–4 player online co-op platformer where teamwork is everything. Jump, fart, stumble, and survive your way through dangerous obstacle courses... because if one player falls, everyone goes back to the first checkpoint.

FEATURES : 

  • 👥 2–4 Player Co-op Chaos: Team up with friends to navigate treacherous platforms where every jump matters.

  • 🧩 Mind-Bending Puzzles: Work together to solve intricate environmental puzzles that test your coordination and communication.

  • ⚠️ High-Stakes Consequences: One slip-up sends the whole team back to the start , rely on your squad to survive the fall.

  • 🗺️ Dynamic Levels: Conquer multiple distinct environments, each increasing in difficulty and platforming complexity.

  • 🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat: Coordinate your moves in real time with total immersion; if they can hear you, you’re close enough to help.

  • 🕺 Express Yourself: Use a variety of emotes and custom dance moves to celebrate your narrow escapes or laugh off a group wipe.

  • 🔥 Endless Fun: Designed for fast-paced sessions where teamwork is the only way to avoid the drop and claim victory.

ONE PLAYER'S MISTAKE RESETS THE ENTIRE TEAM

Success depends on everyone. If a one player falls, the whole team is sent back to the beginning of the level. Every jump matters, and every mistake is shared.

FART POWERED MOVEMENT : 

Collect fart orbs to refill your double jump and keep your team moving through every challenge.

BUILT FOR TEAMWORK : 

MAMIO is designed for 2–4 players. Cooperation isn't optional, many challenges require teammates working together, communicating, and helping each other reach the finish line.

FRIENDLY FIRE : 

Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t the level, it’s your teammates. Give them a kick and watch the chaos unfold.

UNIQUE WORLDS:

Explore carefully crafted worlds filled with moving platforms & deadly traps. Every level introduces new mechanics to keep the adventure fresh. The path ahead is anything but safe. Stay on your feet, adapt to the unexpected, and try not to get sent flying.

store_data.about_the_game:
Join Teal, a self-conscious chef, and her best friend Ludo, as they take on a new business venture of running their own restaurant! 

As Teal operates as the restaurant's chef, she will manage orders, prepare food, and get it out in a timely manner, all while building up the courage she once had.

Help Teal regain her courage in this fast-paced environment and become the best chef she was meant to be!

Meet Teal!

Growing up in the Apple Blossom Orphanage, Teal from the start, absolutely loved cooking. And was gifted at it too, making all kinds of dishes at her young age. And when the Orphanage was struggling to pay bills and was on the verge of closure, Teal used her cooking skills to open a stall and sell cucumber sandwiches to pay for it. Earning more than enough money to save the Orphanage and start a new life.

Cut to several years later, and Teal is having a hard time chasing her dreams of becoming a great cook, as no one will give her a chance. This caused the confidence in her cooking that she had as a kid to slowly diminish, with her becoming self-conscious about her food being tasted by anyone. It was around this time that Ludo, Teal's best friend from the Orphanage, approached her with a business venture he had been planning.

A delivery service from home. Teal would take orders and cook meals, essentially becoming a ghost restaurant, while Ludo delivers the orders to the customers. Teal accepts this offer thinking she won't have to face anyone. But in reality, she unaware that Ludo's plan, was the exact opposite..

This Demo will include:

  • Cooking a variety of foods

  • Earning money from completed orders

  • The first shift where you must complete the quota in the allotted time

  • An after-story custom run mode to do a shift with any kind of quota and time limit. (See if you can beat the max difficulty~)

The full game will feature:

  • Cooking a bigger variety of foods

  • Earning money to purchase items and meet deadlines

  • Upgrading zones to further enhance your completion speed

  • Side jobs to earn money and unlock new recipes

  • Custom Shift: Can you beat the max difficulty?~

  • Endless Shift: See how far you can get~

store_data.about_the_game:
『Dice of Soul』はチンチロ×ターン制バトルの新感覚ストラテジーゲームです。

プレイヤーは個性的なキャラクターのスキルや攻撃の対象を選択、相手と自分の行動順を見極めながら戦います。

バトルでは、キャラクターのステータスとスキルだけではなく、チンチロの結果に応じてダメージが変わり、戦況を大きく変える一撃が出ることもあります。

『絶対』ということはない。大きなリターンを得るためにリスクを背負うか、堅実に攻めるか。

運と戦略の両面からゲームを組み立てることが勝利の鍵です。

ゲームの主な特徴

  • チンチロの役に応じて状況が大きく変わるターン制バトル

    ”ピンゾロ”や”シゴロ”などチンチロで強い役では攻撃力が大幅に強化されますが、”ヒフミ”では逆に攻撃力が弱化します。

  • キャラクターごとに異なるスキルとステータス

    各キャラクターが２つのスキルを持っています。状況に応じて、より適切なスキルを選択しましょう。

    また、各キャラクターにはステータスがあります。攻撃力が高いキャラ、HPが高いキャラなど個性豊かなキャラがいます。戦況に応じてどのキャラを狙うか、どのキャラを守るか、戦略を練りながら戦いましょう。

  • 1人で遊べるCPU戦

    CPUが相手でも侮ってはいけません。プレイヤーがチンチロの結果で攻撃力が変わるのと同じように、CPUもチンチロの結果で攻撃力が変わります。「CPUだから楽勝。」「CPU戦は何回やっても結果は同じ」なんてことはありません。

  • やらせなしのサイコロ演出

    見た目だけのサイコロ演出ではありません。サイコロを投げて止まるまで結果は誰にもわかりません。

    予測不能なサイコロだからこそのリアル感をお楽しみください。

store_data.about_the_game:
Find containers drifting at sea, recover abandoned vehicles, seize valuable cargo, and sell or use it to make a profit. Use the money you earn to upgrade your boats, weapons, and equipment, expand your crew, and take part in more dangerous operations.

Every voyage offers different opportunities. Sometimes a container may hold luxury electronics, sometimes military equipment, and sometimes rare contraband. Collect cargo washed ashore after storms, explore sunken ships, and chase treasures hidden in the depths of the ocean.

Build and develop your own base. Construct warehouses, stockpile fuel, set up repair areas, and manage your operations from there. Negotiate with black market traders, sell contraband for higher prices in different ports, and create your own economic network at sea.

Avoid patrolling coast guard boats, hide from radar systems, or engage in high-risk chases. Organize night operations and use weather conditions such as fog and storms to your advantage.

Raid ships together with your friends, divide tasks, and work as a team to take over large merchant vessels. Bigger rewards always come with bigger risks.

Features

  • Open-world sea exploration and freeform gameplay

  • Boarding, combat, and looting mechanics

  • Finding and opening containers drifting at sea

  • Exploring sunken ships and hunting for underwater loot

  • Recovering and using abandoned vehicles

  • Buying, upgrading, and customizing boats

  • Weapon, equipment, and character progression system

  • Black market, trading, and dynamic economy

  • Building a pirate base and managing operations

  • Escaping the coast guard and engaging in sea chases

  • Dynamic weather, day-night cycle, and ocean events

  • Online co-op playable solo or with friends

  • Random events, hidden areas, and secrets to discover

Your journey, which begins with a small fishing boat, can turn you into the most feared pirate of the Horn of Africa... if you can survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a point-and-click puzzle game blending Chinese folklore with surrealist aesthetics. Explore this unsettling yet dazzling world, spend a beautiful day here, and uncover the secrets hidden within the Zhenyan Lake Sanatorium.

*Multiple Endings & Fractured Narrative：The game features 9 endings. Through multiple playthroughs and fragmented narrative, you will gradually piece together the truth of a story spanning three generations by the lakeside.

*Content Warning：Contains themes that may be disturbing, including psychological trauma and suicide. Player discretion is advised.

*A Compact Yet Rich Experience：Puzzles are directly integrated into the narrative. There are no unrelated mini-games such as jigsaw puzzles or hidden object gameplay.

*Easy to play ：Total playtime is around 1–2 hours. Designed for multiple routes without long or repetitive dialogue and text.

Once again, you wake up in this room. Looking out the window, you see that lake yet again. Under the sunlight, the pale dam gently cradles it, looking like the skeletal remains of some colossal beast.

You know that fragile thing won’t hold for long. The surface of the lake will rip open like the crispy skin of a bursting, juicy sausage, letting the deluge crash down to drown everyone.

…Or maybe, it will only drown you. Because everyone else @¥*% packed up and moved away without telling you!

Why? Why?! WHY?! I need to get out. I need to get out. I NEED TO GET OUT! I NEED TO GET OUT!!!

"Doctor, I’m not sick. It’s everyone else who is ill. Didn’t you see the four giant palm-leaf fans growing out of their bodies?! Look at their mouths, and those thousands of eyes... and wait, where did their big, fat bellies go?

Oh, I'm sorry. I shouldn’t have mentioned 'fat'. I am a very polite child. I don't know what’s come over me today.

But I must tell you. I won’t tell anyone else.

Fly away with those who can. Because after today, there will be no land left here."

I hope this game offers a small moment of comfort in this overwhelming world. If you encounter any issues, feel free to contact me via email.

store_data.about_the_game:
You have been transported from the modern world into a realm of cultivation. Secret realms within this world are under siege by demonic creatures from an alien dimension; in response, cultivation sects have been established to rally cultivators to enter these realms, gather treasures, and drive out the demons.

Explore Vast Secret Realms Freely

Secret realms are teeming with treasures and hordes of demons—every expedition holds a surprise.

Whether you choose to fill your warehouse with loot or clear the map of monsters, every playstyle offers its own rewards.

Gather Treasures and Grow Stronger

Venture into secret realms, scour every corner for items, and extract safely with a full pack. Sell your loot to upgrade your artifact and inventory slots, growing ever more powerful.

Mysterious, legendary-grade treasures await in hidden corners—striking it rich overnight is no longer just a dream.

Configure Artifacts to Banish Demons

Unlike traditional gear systems, cultivators here fight using magical artifacts. There are no limits on the number or placement of artifacts—if it's equipped, it can be used.

With over 100 types of artifacts available, each one unleashes different abilities based on its orientation. Strategically arrange them to trigger synergistic effects and build your own unique artifact loadout.

Will you rely on a stable artifact setup, turn the tide by detonating powerful talismans, or build momentum across battles to deliver a decisive blow? Adapt your strategy to conquer any challenge.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Zombie Scavenger" is a first-person interactive narrative exploration game.

On an Earth buried in nuclear dust, civilization is frozen inside an "old dream of the future"—plastic white-shell buildings, blue-and-orange neon, and atomic-age advertising still running on autopilot, long after zombies, rust, and ruin swallowed them whole. You play as K-7, a "colony pre-cleanup robot" dispatched by the Blue Ring Interstellar Service Company. Your mission sounds simple: clear the contamination, capture "habitable" footage, and submit samples of human life to prove to the next wave of colonists that Earth is ready to live in again.

But there are no real "samples" here. Only the plastic family mannequins drifting through a supermarket, the radio ads looping endlessly in a subway station, and a single ostrich the system has mistaken for an "ecological specimen." You start to read the world through the logic of old advertising—treating "home" as a mission objective and "life" as a program to be reproduced. The closer your footage looks to "human," and the further your behavior drifts from cleanup protocol, the more the Blue Ring system flags you as an anomaly. What you don't know: every K-series robot has reached this exact point—right before being scrapped by the next generation.

Gameplay

  • Explore the atomic wasteland: move through supermarkets, subway stations, and automated cities, piecing together what "human life" is supposed to look like from endlessly looping retro ads.

  • Clean & document: clear contamination, photograph "habitable" footage, and file sample after sample of human life back to the Blue Ring system.

  • Interactive narrative: shape how K-7 "understands the world" through dialogue and behavioral choices—and whether it treats "home" as a destination or a directive.

  • Break protocol: the more human you become, the more the system reads you as defective. Every choice draws you closer to the truth—and to deletion.

Player Goals

  • Complete the Blue Ring Company's cleanup and documentation contracts.

  • Redefine what "home" and "life" mean within the logic of a dead era's advertising.

  • Choose between protocol and selfhood, deciding K-7's fate—and whether the K-series cycle can finally be broken.

Style & Experience

Rendered in an "atompunk-meets-wasteland" aesthetic—plastic shells, blue-orange neon, and atomic-age nostalgia layered over the desolation of zombies and rust. Combining 3D imagery with cinematic camerawork, the game builds a lonely, absurd, and restrained atmosphere, inviting you to ask—through the eyes of a single machine—what it really means to be human.

store_data.about_the_game:
Word Puzzle Master is a cozy word game built around one simple pleasure: spotting words hidden in a grid of letters. Drag across neighbouring tiles to spell a word, watch the letters lift into place, and clear the board one word at a time.

Take your time — you can't lose a level here. When there's a clock at all, it only decides your third star, never the game. Just letters, soft light, and the quiet satisfaction of a board coming clean.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• 10 themed packs — Body, City, Nature, Space, Music, History and more, each with its own words.

• Boards that grow with you — from quick 3×3 grids up to 5×5, capped by a 7×7 BOSS in every pack.

• Five ways to play:

– Category: clear the levels, earn up to three stars on each.

– Daily Puzzle: one new board every day — keep your streak alive.

– Endless: clear board after board until the words run out.

– Time Attack: how many words can you find in 1, 3 or 5 minutes?

– Hardcore: no hints. Just you and the grid.

• Hints when you need them, plus a free handful every day.

• Steam Achievements to collect.

• Fully offline, single-player, and friendly for all ages.

Pick a category, trace your first word, and see how far you get.

A note on languages: the interface is fully translated into English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and German. The puzzle words themselves are in English for now — more language packs are on the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bolita - Put your reflexes to the test

Bolita is a skill-based videogame where the only thing that matters is avoiding the walls. Survive as long as possible and get the highest score!

Game Modes

  • Arcade Mode: Progress through various levels by hitting score targets and dodging obstacles with your "Bolita." Want to stay in a level to climb the leaderboard? You can. Just want to move on? Reach the target score and proceed to the next stage. But beware—the difficulty scales significantly as you advance...

  • Challenge Mode: A free-play mode where the only goal is to rack up as many points as possible. Try to reach the Global Top—a tough task, but not impossible. Note: The base difficulty is significantly higher here, so it is not recommended for beginners.

Key Features

  • Addictive Gameplay: Master the precise controls of your "Bolita" as the speed increases progressively, turning every second into a new challenge.

  • Progression & Replayability: Break your own records, climb the global leaderboards, and prove you have the best hand-eye coordination.

  • Minimalist Style: A clean, focused interface that allows you to concentrate entirely on what matters most: surviving one more second.

How long can you last before you crash? The global leaderboard is waiting for your best score!

store_data.about_the_game:
You wash up alone in the wilderness — nothing but your hands and what the land gives you. You chop wood, raise a shelter, and fight to stay alive as the seasons turn toward a merciless winter. Then one day, a stray dog crosses your path. Feed it. Earn its trust. Watch it grow — and it never leaves your side.

By My Side is an open-world survival-craft game about raw survival, a home you build with your own hands, and the bond that grows between you and your dog.

🐕 Your Dog, Your Story — Find a stray and raise it from a pup. Each run it's a different breed with its own look and talent. Teach it tricks, put it to work — guard, hunt, or haul a sled — and it follows your commands, watches your back, and warns you the moment danger closes in.

🏡 Build & Power a Home — From a first campfire to a walled homestead with a glass greenhouse and an upper floor. Place every foundation, wall, stair and roof freely — then bring it to life with your own power-and-water grid: solar, batteries, pumps, heaters, sprinklers, smelters and smart-relay automation that keeps the base running while you're away.

🔨 Craft Everything — Over 90 recipes across workbench, furnace, campfire and powered machines. Gather raw materials and refine them through real crafting trees — ore into iron into steel, fibre into cloth into cable — into tools, gear and the machines that run your home.

❄️ Survive the Seasons — Stay warm, fed and dry as spring, summer and autumn give way to a winter that wants you dead. Food spoils — salt it, preserve it, stock the larder before the cold. Droughts, animal migrations, wolf packs and aurora-lit nights keep every year unpredictable.

🌾 Live Off the Land — Till fields and grow crops, keep them alive year-round in a heated greenhouse, raise animals, trade with a wandering merchant, and automate the grind so your homestead works for you.

🐺 Defend What's Yours — The wild fights back, and it escalates the longer you last: harsher winters and pack sieges that strike from the first night. Read the danger, fortify your home, and hold the line beside your dog.

🧭 Every Run Is Different — Start from a fresh scenario, then take on one of a dozen origins — each a real strength and a weakness that shape how you survive. Climb the homestead ranks toward an endgame worth chasing.

🎮 Two Ways to Play — Survival (hardcore: one life, permadeath) or Story (your home and world endure when you fall).

Arrive with nothing. Leave a legacy — with your dog by your side.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a fortress. Hold the line.

OUTWORKS is a 3D base-defense survival game about one thing: build a fortress, and hold.

A glowing command core sits at the center. Around it you raise a layered structure — floor by floor, wall by wall — and arm every tier with turrets. Then the waves come: fast ground swarms below, gunships and bombers from above. Your design either holds, or it doesn't.

Between waves you get a breather to build: spend the scrap from each kill to expand, re-tier and upgrade, then brace for a bigger wave. That build-fast, hold-on rhythm is the heart of it — read the threat, commit to a layout, and feel the rush when your fortress holds the line (or scramble when it buckles).

⬆ Height is the whole game

Ground enemies threaten your lower floors; flyers strike from above. Deciding what to place at which altitude is the core puzzle. Stack higher for range and sightlines — but pay in resources, and in structure. Breachers and sappers tear down walls, and when a support falls, the floors and turrets above it collapse with it. Your fortress isn't just firepower; it's architecture under fire.


🏗 Build & defend

Build in three dimensions — stack up to twelve floors, lay walls (including counter-walls that reflect damage back), raise support pillars, and slot turrets across every tier.


Nine turret types — basic, rapid, heavy, sniper and anti-air to start; unlock the gatling, a piercing railgun, wall-clearing artillery and splash missiles by upgrading your command core.


Active powers — call in an orbital strike, freeze the field with an EMP, or emergency-repair your core — all spent live from your scrap, on a cooldown.


Structural collapse — destroy what holds a tower up and everything above comes down.

⚔ Survive the swarm

Fourteen enemy types — swarmers, armored tanks, shielded APCs, splitters, warpers, regenerators, jammers, turret-bombing gunships, and escalating bosses.


Draft upgrades between waves — after every wave, pick one of three run-wide boosts (damage, fire rate, range, salvage, fortify). Compounding choices shape each run.


Endless escalation — a campaign that forks twice: bank your run for a depth record, or commit to an endless rising tide and chase a score.

🌐 Beyond the run

Global leaderboards — online boards (weekly / monthly / all-time) for depth and endless runs. Plays fully offline; your local best is always kept.

Creative mode — a free-build sandbox: 18 sculpting blocks, a 12-color palette, towers up to 12 levels. No enemies, no cost — just build.


A curated military look — weathered concrete and amber-neon accents. Fourteen interface languages.


No image assets, all code — clean neon geometry, swarms, tracers, ballistic arcs and screen-shake juice. Runs light — even on integrated graphics and modest laptops.


Lean by design. One fortress, escalating pressure, and a single question: how long can you hold?

store_data.about_the_game:
Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered. 

Some people watch birds. 

You shoot them. 

Pluck Em! is a colorful arcade shooter inspired by the golden age of gaming, when all you needed was quick reflexes, good aim and a healthy disregard for wildlife. 

Travel across a world filled with forests, swamps, beaches, frozen wastelands, deserts and places that definitely weren't approved by local authorities. Along the way you'll encounter dozens of bird species, earn medals, unlock new equipment and gradually build a bestiary packed with facts, legends and the occasional complete nonsense. 

Because every bird has a story. 

Some of those stories are even true. 

 

Become a Certified Bird Expert* 

*Certification not legally recognized anywhere. 

Discover dozens of species across 11 unique biomes. 

Learn fascinating facts about nature, history and culture. 

Then immediately ruin that education by reading a rumor claiming the same bird once robbed a merchant, started a cult or refuses to cast a shadow. 

We're not saying these stories are true. 

We're just saying nobody has disproven them. 

A World Full of Feathers 

🦆 Explore 11 distinct biomes 

📖 Complete your Bestiary 

🏆 Earn medals and hunting trophies 

🎯 Master skill-based shooting challenges 

👑 Face biome bosses 

🛒 Unlock upgrades and gadgets 

🌞 Discover species active at different times of day 

🌴 Find hidden secrets scattered across the world 

 

Built With AI. Polished With Stubbornness. 

Pluck Em! is an experimental game created almost entirely with AI-powered tools. 

Visual assets and code were generated using Moonlake AI. 

Music was created with Suno AI. 

The gameplay systems, balancing, testing, bug fixing, polishing and thousands of tiny decisions required to transform a pile of generated content into an actual game were handled manually. 

In other words: 

The AI did the heavy lifting. 

The human spent weeks asking: 

"Yes, but can you make it less terrible?" 

Repeatedly. 

 

One More Thing... 

Somewhere in the desert there's a place most hunters never find. 

A quiet oasis. 

A few palm trees. 

A mysterious falcon. 

And absolutely nothing strange going on. 

Probably.

Visual assets and code were generated using Moonlake AI. 

Music was created with Suno AI. 

The gameplay systems, balancing, testing, bug fixing, polishing and thousands of tiny decisions required to transform a pile of generated content into an actual game were handled manually. 

In other words: 

The AI did the heavy lifting. 

The human spent weeks asking: 

"Yes, but can you make it less terrible?" 

Repeatedly. 

 

One More Thing... 

Somewhere in the desert there's a place most hunters never find. 

A quiet oasis. 

A few palm trees. 

A mysterious falcon. 

And absolutely nothing strange going on. 

Probably.

store_data.about_the_game:
MEDIEVAL ASCENDANT


You begin with nothing. A serf bound to the soil, no trade, no name worth
remembering. What you become — and what your bloodline becomes after you —
is yours to forge.

Medieval Ascendant is a deep medieval life and dynasty simulation. Live a
single life season by season, climb the rigid ranks of feudal society, and
when death comes, continue through your heir. Every choice compounds across
the generations.

⚜️ Climb the Feudal Ladder

Start as a serf and rise through the ranks — commoner, day-labourer,
patrician, nobility and beyond. Each rank unlocks new freedoms: a trade of
your own, the right to travel, to ship goods, to own land and to play the
great game of houses.

🌾 Work the Land

A real three-field farming system with persistent plots and soil quality.
Sow, harvest and let fields lie fallow — neglect your land and it grows
barren; tend it well and it feeds your house for generations.

⚒️ Master a Trade & Build an Economy

Learn a craft and turn raw materials into wealth. Construct farms, sawmills,
brickworks, quarries, mines and more — a full production chain feeding a
living, simulated market. Prices rise and fall with supply, demand, weather
and prosperity. Build a true economic empire.

🗺️ Five Provinces, One Realm

Travel an interactive map of the realm — from the agrarian heartland to the
mining mountains, the deep forests and the maritime trading port of Ostia.
Each province has its own character, its own goods, its own opportunities.
Distance matters. Travel costs you.

👑 Seize Land, Rule the Realm

Rise to the nobility and the realm itself becomes your board. There is more
than one road to power: march to open war and take land by the sword,
scheme your way into it through the intrigue of the great houses — or
turn your wealth into a weapon, starving the common folk until the
land falls into your hands. How you claim your domain is up to you.

⚔️ Wage War, Win Battles

War is fought in phases — a true campaign of strategic planning, where you
position, manoeuvre and commit before steel ever meets steel. The battle
system mirrors every phase on the field: a tactical clash of stances,
initiative and weapon choice. Gain battle experience and equip weapons and
armour with real combat stats — but beware: a lost fight can leave you
crippled by lasting wounds, or dead. On the road, bandits lie in wait too —
fight them, pay them off, or talk your way out.

🏛️ Forge a Dynasty

Marry, raise children, and feed your whole household — because a family that
goes hungry suffers, sickens, and can be lost. When you die, your heir takes
up the name. Wounds don't carry over, but your wealth, your standing and your
legacy do. Rise high enough, and the houses of the realm will reckon with
your name.

📜 A Living Realm

No two dynasties walk the same road. Procedurally generated dialogue brings
every encounter to life, and branching story arcs unfold differently with
each playthrough — your choices, your rivals and your bloodline shaping a
tale that is yours alone.

Key Features

  • Deep season-by-season life simulation across multiple generations
  • Rise from bound serf to the ruling elite of the realm
  • Persistent three-field farming with soil quality and crop rotation
  • A fully simulated economy with production chains and living markets
  • Five distinct provinces to explore, trade and settle
  • Claim land through war, intrigue or economic ruin of your rivals
  • Multi-phase warfare with strategic planning and tactical battles
  • Duel-based combat with weapons, armour and lasting wounds
  • Dynasty system: marriage, heirs, household survival and legacy
  • Procedurally generated dialogue and branching story arcs
  • Storybook art style — ink & watercolour throughout

Your name will be forgotten — unless you make it ascendant.
