store_data.about_the_game:
"Welcome to Consolidated Dynamics. Your training begins today."

You just started at Consolidated Dynamics. It's basically the bell-Labs of this world but bigger. They are making something big, and your work is what is making it possible, and your job, for now, is to show up, sit down, and get through the day.

The coffee's fine. The people are friendly enough. Every morning there's a cassette on your desk with the day's instructions on it. It's a good job, better than you expected. You should probably stop turning it over in your head.

What this is

A seated VR mystery that plays out over your first twelve days on the job. You sit at your desk with everything in reach. You pick things up, push the buttons, turn the dials, and you listen. No walking, no locomotion, no motion sickness. Four to six hours, start to finish.

The work

The days fall into a rhythm. A cassette in the morning with your briefing. A voice on the headset to walk you through the tasks. A newspaper on the desk if you want it. In the evening, a "Relaxation Protocol" tape with a game designed to make you feel "relaxed"  the company sends home, which is their idea of helping you switch off.

The tasks are hands-on and a little strange: switchboards, pneumatic tubes, banks of analog machinery that has no business still running. What all of it actually produces is something you piece together as you go.

The people on the line

You'll get to know a few of your coworkers over the two weeks, mostly over the phone. Sam's in your corner from day one. Dr. Larson answers a slightly different question than the one you asked. Dr. Chen deals only in numbers. Morgan would rather be anywhere else and doesn't bother hiding it. And Voss? Voss just wants the The numbers to go up. Listen closely. It matters more than it looks.

The world

It's the present day, more or less, just not the one we ended up with. Somewhere back in the 1930s the technology forked and never found its way back. Computers stayed analog. Phones stayed wired. The whole place is beeping, glowing and filled with tubes and spinning tape reels, and every bit of it has real weight in your hands.

How it ends

[redacted] many ways, depending on [redacted], but at one point [redacted]  the moment, and it won't ask you to [redacted] eventually You'll [redacted] most of them, [redacted] and then you live with it.

From us

We wanted to make something quiet and a little uneasy, the kind of thing that works best alone and late, headphones on, lights low. Give it an evening. We think you'll want to talk to someone about it afterward.

Thanks for clocking in.

— The team at Shababeek Labs

Features

  • A seated VR mystery across twelve in-game days, roughly two to four hours

  • multiple  hands-on analog tasks that get sharper and stranger as you go

  • Three endings, decided by a single choice

  • Full English voice acting with subtitles ( when it does not break immersion)

  • Plays entirely seated: no walking, no locomotion, no motion sickness

  • A cassette-futurism world, all analog, all tactile

  • Accessibility options: height adjustment, reach assist, colorblind friendly 

  • Runs on Meta Quest 2/3/3S/Pro (Link/Air Link/Steam Link), Valve Index, HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Windows Mixed Reality

Content notes

This one trades in unease rather than scares: psychological themes, a slow sense that something's off, and some mild language. No jump scares, no gore, nothing sexual, no sustained loud noise. There's one optional moment with flashing visuals you can turn off in the settings.

store_data.about_the_game:
HALLS OF JÖTUNN

is a first-person atmospheric dungeon crawler set in the ruins of a forgotten Norse world where Ragnarök has already happened.

Ragnarök is no longer a prophecy. It has become a state of the world — a slow collapse of memory, faith, and meaning that nobody noticed happening.

You awaken at the edge of death, a broken warrior abandoned upon a rain-soaked battlefield. In that final moment, Ilar reaches toward you from the mist and offers a single bargain: help her reclaim what was taken from her, and she may return you to life.

You do not seek glory, vengeance, or the salvation of gods.

You seek only a way back to your family.

Neither voice guiding you through the dark tells the whole truth. One speaks with the voice of someone deeply wronged. The other speaks with the voice of order. Both are right. Both are hiding something.

FEATURES

• Slow, tactical first-person melee combat
• Fatigue system affecting both you and your enemies
• Limited inventory space that turns every item into a meaningful choice
• Explore crypts, flooded chambers, forgotten halls, and ancient ruins
• Discover fragments of lost True Names hidden throughout the world
• A dark story about memory, identity, sacrifice, and what remains after the end

COMBAT THAT DEMANDS PATIENCE

Combat is deliberate, brutal, and costly — not a power fantasy.

Every fight is fought at close range. Every swing matters. As battles drag on, both you and your enemies grow exhausted. Attacks become slower, breathing grows heavier, and mistakes become harder to recover from.

Victory belongs to those who manage distance, timing, and endurance.

SURVIVE WITH LIMITED RESOURCES

A single rune stone serves as your refuge, healing your wounds and preserving your progress. Its power returns slowly, forcing difficult decisions about when to push forward and when to retreat.

Your backpack can carry only a handful of items. Every weapon, shield, torch, and scrap of food competes for precious space.

Nothing is collected simply because it exists.

EVERY NAME MATTERS

The halls are filled with fragments of forgotten identities.

Names carved into stone. Names hidden beneath water. Names preserved in ruins long abandoned by gods and men.

In this world, true names are more than words. They are fragments of memory, identity, and fate.

To uncover them is to uncover what really happened when the world began to die.

WHAT THIS GAME IS NOT

This is not heroic fantasy.

Not a power fantasy.

Not a hack-and-slash adventure.

Not a colorful retelling of Norse mythology.

This is a journey through silence, ruin, and the fragile need to protect what remains human in a world already preparing for its end.

Every hall remembers a name.

Yours is the only one left to discover what that means.

store_data.about_the_game:
What is Shine on savior?

Shine on Savior is an action platformer where you try to survive a zombie apocalypse and use anything as a weapon. Inspired by Dead Rising and Metroidvanias, we wanted to encapsulate the spirit of Dead Rising and give it a retro spin on it.

Story

Shine on Savior takes place in 2009 in the city of New Delmarr. You play as Roy Rogers who leaves New Delmarr for work for a few months and comes back to see his city overrun with Dregs (a person that is transformed into a being that feeds off of people to gain intelligence and evolve). Your mission is to save the city of New Delmarr from the Dregs, reconnect with your friends and find the truth of what happened to your city. You get to play as Rae, Roy's sister, after meeting everyone in the Shelter.

Mechanics

Shine On Savior is a single player and COOP action platformer that takes you through the city of New Delmarr and kill hundreds of dregs. Anything in this city can be used as a weapon (baseball bats, street signs, boxes). A ritual has been set in New Delmarr in which all of the humans and dregs resurrect upon death, in which the dregs have unlimited food sources to feed. The player will lose levels, weapons, food, and books upon dying. The player will always spawn back at the Savior shelter.

Leveling up

Players will level up by killing Dregs, picking up Scripture Pages and defeating bosses. Scripture Pages can level you up but cannot redistribute levels. The Trainer can help you redistribute your levels. Dying will cause the player to lose levels completely.

Health - HP

Storage - How many weapons you get (start = 1 weapon slot + Lvl)

Food - How much rations you could carry

Strength - Affects STR weapons

Dexterity - Affects DEX weapons

Tenacity - Affects TNC Weapons and Fists

Scripture Pages

When the player defeats a hard enemy (Zealots), or just wanders into the right spot, the player will receive and read a Scripture Page. This is essentially one of the player’s leveling up system. The player can pick to level up either Health, Storage, food, Str (Strength), Dex (Dexterity), or TNC (Tenacity). These affect the scaling of which type of weapon you are using.

Health - HP

Storage - How many weapons you get (start = 1 weapon slot + Lvl)

Food - How much rations you could carry

STR = Melee Weapons

DEX = Melee/Ranged Weapons

TNC = Boxes/Barrels, Fist, Joke Weapons

NPCS

Other than Roy and Rae, you will be able to explore New Delmarr and reconnect with your friends that will help you in your cause to save the city.

Healing and Merchant NPC

At the Savior shelter, the players will be able to get food rations from a Merchant NPC. Throughout the game they will find vending machines that will give them food. Players can find food throughout the level, but it is not guaranteed. Food is used to heal the player when they take damage. Be resourceful as each player only has 5 rations of food at the start. Players can level up food attributes to carry more food.

Trainer NPC

If you find Andrew Braxton and recruit him for the cause, he will be able to be used as a trainer at the Shelter. The Trainer can help you redistribute your levels.

Books and Librarian NPC

Books can be used to give you certain attributes. Unlocking the Librarian NPC will give you a library of books to choose from at the Savior shelter. The Librarian has a limited library when unlocked but the player can find books throughout the levels to add to the Librarian’s library. Books will affect which attribute the player levels up and gets stronger with the type of attribute. (Books below are subject to change)

Book Types

STR:

Whetstone 101: Bladed weapons get a % damage boost

Band Session: Musical Weapons get a % Damage boost

Can you lend a Hand?: 2 Handed weapons get a % Damage Boost

Fine I’ll Do It Myself: 1 Handed Weapons get a % Damage Boost

Play Nice: Attacking/Throwing an STR weapon decreased durability %

DEX:

Sharpshooter: Guns get a % damage boost

Sniper’s Guide 101: Rifles get a % damage boost

Quick Draw: Pistols/Pistol types get a % attack speed

Pitcher’s Guide To the Galaxy: Throwing weapons get a & attack speed

Gun Cleaning 101: Attacking/Throwing a DEX weapon Decreases durability %

TNC:

How to Box: Fighting Style changes to Boxer Style

Wing Chun 101: Fighting Style Changes to Wingchun Style

Mover’s Guide: Attacking/Throwing a box/barrell decreases durability %

GENERAL:

GOOOOOAAALLL - Sports Weapons get a % damage boost

Toys for Tots: Toy weapons get a % attack speed

Mechanic NPC

Once you find the Mechanic NPCs in the game, you will be able to unlock the Mechanic, an NPC in which they will give you 3 free weapons at the shelter (They might be really good weapons too).

Weapons

Anything is a weapon! We will design and create weapons that seem seamless in the world (Use Dead Rising as reference) There will be no combo weapons (Duct tape nails to a baseball bat). Each weapon will have a 1st attack and a 2nd attack. Players will be able to carry only 4 weapons at the start. All Weapons will have durability. All weapons can be thrown but in exchange will be discarded from the player and damage towards weapon durability will be applied.

Melee (Str Leveling) - These weapons are up close and deadly.

Ranged/Melee Ranged (DEX Leveling) - These weapons range from, close, close/far, and far distance. Some weapons have ammo and will have to wait to be recharged.

Tenacity (TNC Leveling) -These weapons can be used as a melee weapon. These weapons are very strong but can break easily or can be very weak but have fast attack rate. This also includes your fist.

Death

The player will experience death at some point. Lore wise, every human and dreg cannot die forever and therefore will resurrect. The player will respawn after death, losing all weapons, books, food, and levels. The player will respawn at the Savior shelter.

Enemies

Dregs

The Dregs are like zombies, walking around eating every living thing in sight. They will bunch up into hordes making navigating New Delmarr a nightmare. (More Dreg variations are in development)

Zealots

Special types of Dregs that have ascended to super human form. They will periodically prey on the player and attack them throughout the levels.

Attack - Deals damage and slices any human to pieces with their sword arm

Berserker - With strong arms, able to punch through anything and hurl boulders

Merc - Armed with a gunblade, able to shoot and slash at their foes

Sniper - Long ranged foe able to shoot from far away and throw grenades

Bosses

Bosses are evolved Zealots that have been chosen by the Church of Mor. They all carry Mirror Shards that can transport you to any boss room once defeated. 11 Mirror Shards are needed to enter Buccio’s Lair.

Fisherman - Buff guy with a fishing pole as an arm and talk to fish. Pole is Angler Fish

Zookeeper - Evolved with wings, can communicate to any animal

Weeb - Gained enough strength to wield a Giant Sword. Dressed like any anime character

Cop - Gluttonous being that spews acid

Planetarium Owner - Awakened with a third eye, she controls cosmos

Construction Worker - Evolved Strength to lift buildings

Priest - Awakened with insight, allows to control elements

News Reporter - Gained all knowledge

Rockstar - Ability to manipulate sound

Doctor - Ability to manipulate their body

Shine on Savior takes place in 2009 in the city of New Delmarr. You play as Roy Rogers who leaves New Delmarr for work for a few months and comes back to see his city overrun with Dregs (a person that is transformed into a being that feeds off of people to gain intelligence and evolve). Your mission is to save the city of New Delmarr from the Dregs, reconnect with your friends and find the truth of what happened to your city. You get to play as Rae, Roy's sister, after meeting everyone in the Shelter.

Mechanics

Shine On Savior is a single player and COOP action platformer that takes you through the city of New Delmarr and kill hundreds of dregs. Anything in this city can be used as a weapon (baseball bats, street signs, boxes). A ritual has been set in New Delmarr in which all of the humans and dregs resurrect upon death, in which the dregs have unlimited food sources to feed. The player will lose levels, weapons, food, and books upon dying. The player will always spawn back at the Savior shelter.

Leveling up

Players will level up by killing Dregs, picking up Scripture Pages and defeating bosses. Scripture Pages can level you up but cannot redistribute levels. The Trainer can help you redistribute your levels. Dying will cause the player to lose levels completely.

Health - HP

Storage - How many weapons you get (start = 1 weapon slot + Lvl)

Food - How much rations you could carry

Strength - Affects STR weapons

Dexterity - Affects DEX weapons

Tenacity - Affects TNC Weapons and Fists

Scripture Pages

When the player defeats a hard enemy (Zealots), or just wanders into the right spot, the player will receive and read a Scripture Page. This is essentially one of the player’s leveling up system. The player can pick to level up either Health, Storage, food, Str (Strength), Dex (Dexterity), or TNC (Tenacity). These affect the scaling of which type of weapon you are using.

Health - HP

Storage - How many weapons you get (start = 1 weapon slot + Lvl)

Food - How much rations you could carry

STR = Melee Weapons

DEX = Melee/Ranged Weapons

TNC = Boxes/Barrels, Fist, Joke Weapons

NPCS

Other than Roy and Rae, you will be able to explore New Delmarr and reconnect with your friends that will help you in your cause to save the city.

Healing and Merchant NPC

At the Savior shelter, the players will be able to get food rations from a Merchant NPC. Throughout the game they will find vending machines that will give them food. Players can find food throughout the level, but it is not guaranteed. Food is used to heal the player when they take damage. Be resourceful as each player only has 5 rations of food at the start. Players can level up food attributes to carry more food.

Trainer NPC

If you find Andrew Braxton and recruit him for the cause, he will be able to be used as a trainer at the Shelter. The Trainer can help you redistribute your levels.

Books and Librarian NPC

Books can be used to give you certain attributes. Unlocking the Librarian NPC will give you a library of books to choose from at the Savior shelter. The Librarian has a limited library when unlocked but the player can find books throughout the levels to add to the Librarian’s library. Books will affect which attribute the player levels up and gets stronger with the type of attribute. (Books below are subject to change)

Book Types

STR:

Whetstone 101: Bladed weapons get a % damage boost

Band Session: Musical Weapons get a % Damage boost

Can you lend a Hand?: 2 Handed weapons get a % Damage Boost

Fine I’ll Do It Myself: 1 Handed Weapons get a % Damage Boost

Play Nice: Attacking/Throwing an STR weapon decreased durability %

DEX:

Sharpshooter: Guns get a % damage boost

Sniper’s Guide 101: Rifles get a % damage boost

Quick Draw: Pistols/Pistol types get a % attack speed

Pitcher’s Guide To the Galaxy: Throwing weapons get a & attack speed

Gun Cleaning 101: Attacking/Throwing a DEX weapon Decreases durability %

TNC:

How to Box: Fighting Style changes to Boxer Style

Wing Chun 101: Fighting Style Changes to Wingchun Style

Mover’s Guide: Attacking/Throwing a box/barrell decreases durability %

GENERAL:

GOOOOOAAALLL - Sports Weapons get a % damage boost

Toys for Tots: Toy weapons get a % attack speed

Mechanic NPC

Once you find the Mechanic NPCs in the game, you will be able to unlock the Mechanic, an NPC in which they will give you 3 free weapons at the shelter (They might be really good weapons too).

Weapons

Anything is a weapon! We will design and create weapons that seem seamless in the world (Use Dead Rising as reference) There will be no combo weapons (Duct tape nails to a baseball bat). Each weapon will have a 1st attack and a 2nd attack. Players will be able to carry only 4 weapons at the start. All Weapons will have durability. All weapons can be thrown but in exchange will be discarded from the player and damage towards weapon durability will be applied.

Melee (Str Leveling) - These weapons are up close and deadly.

Ranged/Melee Ranged (DEX Leveling) - These weapons range from, close, close/far, and far distance. Some weapons have ammo and will have to wait to be recharged.

Tenacity (TNC Leveling) -These weapons can be used as a melee weapon. These weapons are very strong but can break easily or can be very weak but have fast attack rate. This also includes your fist.

Death

The player will experience death at some point. Lore wise, every human and dreg cannot die forever and therefore will resurrect. The player will respawn after death, losing all weapons, books, food, and levels. The player will respawn at the Savior shelter.

Enemies

Dregs

The Dregs are like zombies, walking around eating every living thing in sight. They will bunch up into hordes making navigating New Delmarr a nightmare. (More Dreg variations are in development)

Zealots

Special types of Dregs that have ascended to super human form. They will periodically prey on the player and attack them throughout the levels.

Attack - Deals damage and slices any human to pieces with their sword arm

Berserker - With strong arms, able to punch through anything and hurl boulders

Merc - Armed with a gunblade, able to shoot and slash at their foes

Sniper - Long ranged foe able to shoot from far away and throw grenades

Bosses

Bosses are evolved Zealots that have been chosen by the Church of Mor. They all carry Mirror Shards that can transport you to any boss room once defeated. 11 Mirror Shards are needed to enter Buccio’s Lair.

Fisherman - Buff guy with a fishing pole as an arm and talk to fish. Pole is Angler Fish

Zookeeper - Evolved with wings, can communicate to any animal

Weeb - Gained enough strength to wield a Giant Sword. Dressed like any anime character

Cop - Gluttonous being that spews acid

Planetarium Owner - Awakened with a third eye, she controls cosmos

Construction Worker - Evolved Strength to lift buildings

Priest - Awakened with insight, allows to control elements

News Reporter - Gained all knowledge

Rockstar - Ability to manipulate sound

Doctor - Ability to manipulate their body

store_data.about_the_game:
ΠΟΛΙΣ is a single-city historical strategy game set in classical Athens. You take the city from Solon's reforms (594 BC) to the Lamian War and the end of the democracy (322 BC) — one complete, unbroken arc of 272 years.

This is not a sandbox. History has a current, and it runs toward 322 BC. Persia withdraws, Sparta endures, Macedon rises, Chaeronea falls in 338, the democracy ends in 322 — and no internal policy can wash those away. What you *can* change is everything in between: who holds power, which faction prevails, whether the gods favour you, how the empire's silver is spent. Even the great counterfactuals of history — making peace at Pylos, vetoing the Sicilian Expedition, holding the line at Aegospotami — are on the table, but only as steeply-priced gambles that converge back to 322 BC.

The event illustrations throughout are public-domain paintings on classical themes; the city itself is reconstructed in a clean 3D style.

**Features**

• **272 years, one city** — a complete historical arc with 332 researched events, from the archaic reforms to the Persian Wars, the age of Pericles, the Peloponnesian War, and the Macedonian dawn.

• **Tension, not number-walls** — balance the pull of aristocratic families, the favour of the Olympian gods, and the demands of the Delian and Second Athenian Leagues. Every gain is bound to a cost.

• **Statesmen with stories** — appoint historical figures, weather their ambition and the envy of rivals, face ostracism and impeachment.

• **107 public-domain paintings on classical themes** illustrate the events — drawn from museum collections in the public domain (not original artwork), each shown in a gilded frame and an in-engine sketch variant.

• **Nine languages** — English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian.

• **3D Athens** — an archaeologically-minded reconstruction of the city: the Acropolis on its limestone crag, the Agora, the Long Walls to Piraeus, the rivers of the Attic plain.

• **A shareable epitaph card** seals each playthrough; emergent endings and meme achievements reward replaying the same arc a different way.

• **For the hardcore: Ironman** — achievements are earned only in Hard + Ironman: a single ever-overwritten save, no reloading, your choices final. Normal mode plays freely with full saves for everyone else.

store_data.about_the_game:
ELE — Mages step into trials to claim keys and secure victory. Allies may stand together, or stand against each other.

Victory is earned by carrying a complete key to the evacuation point. It demands both skill and coordination.

Elements and Attributes

There are five elements. Players start with none, and must acquire four basic ones through spellbooks—Water, Fire, Ice, and Lightning. They form a cycle, each countering the next.

The fifth is Earth—a greater power that resides in Gravity Stones. Only those who already carry a basic element may pick one up.

Beyond Health, Mana, and Stamina, players have four attributes: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Faith. Elemental damage scales accordingly:

  • Fire — Strength and Faith

  • Water — Intelligence and Dexterity

  • Ice — Intelligence and Strength

  • Lightning — Dexterity and Faith

  • Earth — all four

Combat and Action

Staves can fire rays or strike in melee. Dash, wall-jump, glide—and mark targets for teammates.

Spells can be obtained by defeating monsters, opening chests, or trading with merchants—including projectiles, traps, decoys, backstabs, and parries.

Inventory and Weight

The pack holds potions, buffs, spellbooks, Gravity Stones, and more. Spells and items can be used when conditions are met. The pack has weight—heavier loads slow the bearer.

Key Fragments and Evacuation

Fragments are found through various means. Three fragments combine into a complete key. Carrying a key reveals its bearer's position; when a key is assembled, its location is broadcast to all. If left unclaimed too long, it vanishes and reappears elsewhere.

Attribute Menu and Sites of Grace

Points can be allocated to Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Faith to adjust physical damage and status buildup. Respec is only permitted at Sites of Grace.

Death and Revival

Upon death, the player becomes a spirit and roams the field. Teammates can revive them on the spot. If the fallen carried a complete key, allies may respawn beside them.

Souls are accumulated through death itself—whether by enemy players, monsters, or the hazards of the land.

Map and Enemies

Each match is set in a procedurally generated Magic Academy, filled with Sites of Grace, teleportation arrays, crystal traps, and chests.

The Summoner is among the most dangerous foes. It keeps its distance, summons knights to hinder you, and casts powerful ranged spells. Both Summoners and Knights can shift between the four basic elements to counter yours—unless you hold Earth.

Merchants

Two merchants appear: the Rune Merchant and the Soul Merchant. Defeating players earns Runes; death earns Souls. Their wares differ. Key fragments are sold only by the Rune Merchant—death alone should not grant easy passage to victory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Paint the bunny man — a hide-and-seek where you blend in like a chameleon.

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Hide & Seek"

The rules are simple. Split into the Seeker team and the Hider team and play hide-and-seek. The Seekers win if they find everyone before time runs out.

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Disguise"

The way you hide is a little special. You're a pure-white bunny man — not a speck of color on you, which makes you the perfect canvas. Bunnies aren't natural-born hiders, but you'll read the environment like a chameleon and paint yourself a coat of camouflage:

  • Sample: pull colors straight off the objects around you

  • Light: match the direction of the light so your highlights and shadows fall in the right places

  • Material: tune metalness, roughness, and transparency/refraction until you look like plastic, like tile, like glass, like a pool of water

Where you hide, the pose you strike, and above all how precisely you dial in your materials — that's what fools the Seekers' eyes. Pull off a mimicry that would make a real chameleon do a double-take, and bury this little white bunny in a scene full of clutter.

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Four Stages" (with more to come)

Every map has its own "material trap," each one drilling a different lighting skill:

  • Toy World: plastic, plush, tin, and building blocks all piled together — the busiest materials and the loudest colors. The easiest map to start on. (One bunny man tucked into a wall of stuffed animals — who's going to spot it?)

  • Museum: hard spotlights, black backgrounds, hard shadows. Get your shadow direction even slightly wrong and you're made — your shadow is your biggest tell.

  • Neon Funfair: after dark, colored lights wash everything in a tint — and the lights flicker and shift color. Lock in one color and you'll be wrong half the time.

  • Backrooms Pool: endless tile and still water, eerily empty. Transmission, refraction, underwater caustics, and wet-floor reflections all tested at once — the ceiling for water-based materials.

(Every map also hides a "looks perfect, actually a death trap" spot — feeling lucky?)

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Matching"

Of course you can play with friends, but you can also play with people you don't know. (Create a server that isn't set to private, and anyone can join freely.) Streamers can easily host viewer-participation games. The maximum number of players depends on the host's network environment.

Paint the bunny man — a hide-and-seek where you blend in like a chameleon.

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Hide & Seek"

The rules are simple. Split into the Seeker team and the Hider team and play hide-and-seek. The Seekers win if they find everyone before time runs out.

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Disguise"

The way you hide is a little special. You're a pure-white bunny man — not a speck of color on you, which makes you the perfect canvas. Bunnies aren't natural-born hiders, but you'll read the environment like a chameleon and paint yourself a coat of camouflage:

  • Sample: pull colors straight off the objects around you

  • Light: match the direction of the light so your highlights and shadows fall in the right places

  • Material: tune metalness, roughness, and transparency/refraction until you look like plastic, like tile, like glass, like a pool of water

Where you hide, the pose you strike, and above all how precisely you dial in your materials — that's what fools the Seekers' eyes. Pull off a mimicry that would make a real chameleon do a double-take, and bury this little white bunny in a scene full of clutter.

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Four Stages" (with more to come)

Every map has its own "material trap," each one drilling a different lighting skill:

  • Toy World: plastic, plush, tin, and building blocks all piled together — the busiest materials and the loudest colors. The easiest map to start on. (One bunny man tucked into a wall of stuffed animals — who's going to spot it?)

  • Museum: hard spotlights, black backgrounds, hard shadows. Get your shadow direction even slightly wrong and you're made — your shadow is your biggest tell.

  • Neon Funfair: after dark, colored lights wash everything in a tint — and the lights flicker and shift color. Lock in one color and you'll be wrong half the time.

  • Backrooms Pool: endless tile and still water, eerily empty. Transmission, refraction, underwater caustics, and wet-floor reflections all tested at once — the ceiling for water-based materials.

(Every map also hides a "looks perfect, actually a death trap" spot — feeling lucky?)

Boing! Super Bunny Man "Matching"

Of course you can play with friends, but you can also play with people you don't know. (Create a server that isn't set to private, and anyone can join freely.) Streamers can easily host viewer-participation games. The maximum number of players depends on the host's network environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ultimate Guess Game is a digital adaptation of the classic, beloved social game where two players hold mysterious images on their foreheads, completely invisible to them, where every player needs to know what image he is holding before opponent does!

The Gameplay

Your goal is simple but challenging; be the first to identify the image you are holding. You’ll take turns asking strategic, "Yes or No" questions to narrow down the possibilities.

  • "Is it a living creature?"

  • "Is it a household object?"

  • "Am I something you find in nature?"

The Path to Victory

Every answer is a vital piece of the puzzle. You must use your deduction skills, listen closely to your opponent's clues, and race to piece together the truth before they do. The first player to correctly declare their image wins the match!




Features

  • Play with Friends: Challenge your friends! the thrill of outsmarting your opponent in real-time is just a click away.

  • Variety: Never get bored with a large library of images!

  • Customized Challenges: Tailor your experience by choosing the category that suits your mood. Before the game starts, you and your opponent can select specific themes to ensure the questions remain fresh, exciting, and perfectly suited to your interests.

store_data.about_the_game:
Drift with a cat, through a slightly weird universe.

The space cat memu floats through a weird, neon-soaked universe. Neon grids, a melting sun, shapes you can't even begin to name. It's way too much information — so much that your brain just gives up trying to process it.

So much chaos, somehow cozy. And wait — what even is a space cat?

◆ There's nothing to do (really)

Leave it be and memu drifts on its own. You can just watch. Feel like it? Take the wheel, pull up to a planet, snap a photo. Don't feel like it? Do nothing. That's fine too.

◆ Every day, a whole new universe

Planets, pockets, ruins of no known purpose. Roam places scattered at random. Sky, color, shapes, sound — all different every time. Today's universe is today's only.

◆ Bookmark the ones you like

The same universe never comes back. Pull a weird one and you can show it off to friends, or just keep it to yourself. Your "huh, I kinda like this" collection slowly piles up.

◆ Grab a cat can, if you want

There are cat cans lying around. Pick them up, or drift right past. There's nothing in this universe you have to do.

◆ Loose achievements fill in on their own

No rush. No failing. Nothing to clear. Drift, find things, grab the odd can — and somehow it's filling up.

No goal. No hurry. Just melt your brain in a weird space, with weird sounds. While you work, while you laze around — just drift.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pounce into a handcrafted pixel art world as ‘maustrap’, a particularly nimble and adventurous cat. Chase scampering mice, destroy their hidden nests, and complete jobs for iconic characters. Explore scenic landscapes, discover a museum full of art, or just loaf around. You're a cat, after all.

Complete Jobs, Unlock Cats, Levels, and Costumes

Progress through Career mode by completing jobs. Unlock new levels and chapters that will bring you through farms, sewers, pirate ships, and space. You'll be able to unlock up to three cute cat characters, each with a unique personality, appearance, and customisables.

Move Like a Cat

String together jumps, double jumps, wall slides, and satisfying pounces to reach any ledge, or pesky mouse. Need a break? Loaf anywhere to regain stamina quickly and watch the clouds drift by.

Not Every Day Is For Fighting

Enter Adventure mode and start exploring expansive handcrafted worlds. Peruse the fine art and natural history exhibits at our Museum. Travel by cable car into the rural mountains of Japan and step into a steaming Onsen bath. Trek through the dense bush of the Kaimai ranges in Aotearoa.

Track Your Stats, Earn Achievements

Earn achievements for completing small challenges. If you're feeling confident, try beat the golden time for each job, or finish each job as each of the three furballs.

A Few Words From Meadowfern

Meadowfern is a three-person international team founded in Aotearoa, New Zealand, and 'MAUS TRAP' is our very first game. Our goal is to create a genuinely creative, functional, and visually appealing game that is fun to play. We love feedback almost as much as we love building games, so if you've spotted a bug or want to give us a suggestion, please feel free to drop into our Discord and let us know.

Cold Beauty Boss's Exclusive Punishment List - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: Alexei is a member of the Brooklyn Waste Recycling Studio. Once, when he was disassembling an old - style server, he found a yellowed postcard, which triggered the fusing protocol and caused an explosion. On the verge of death, he was saved by Liu Zihua and given three abilities, becoming a super digital life form. Later, he met the cold and beautiful contract negotiation strategist, Ksenia, who signed a contract with him. At the same time, Tatyana, who was gentle but had a hidden edge, appeared. Their actions also attracted the monitoring of FX, and an adventure full of mysteries and challenges began.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a future world full of cyberpunk elements. This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

This is a popular tourist spot in Fangchenggang, with beautiful scenery, perfect for traveling.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
A bottomless pit, hundreds of wacky chickens, and countless eggs! Egg-cremental is a first-person incremental tycoon game that strips away complex mechanics to deliver pure addiction, optimization, and the ultimate sense of progression.

Your task is beautifully simple: gather the eggs produced by your feathered friends, hurl them into the mysterious abyss, pocket the cash, and reinvest every penny into pushing your production to absolute madness! There is only one way to find out what lies at the very bottom of the pit: toss more eggs!

🥚 Key Features:

  • Hurl & Earn: Take control in a fully immersive 3D first-person perspective. Launch eggs into the void and enjoy the immediate financial rewards and unparalleled satisfaction of every single drop.

  • Expansive Tech Tree: Invest your profits strategically. Increase your chickens' laying speed, unlock rare and exotic new breeds, multiply egg values, or purchase automated systems for the pit.

  • Manage Your Poultry Army: Start small with basic coop residents and scale up. Discover rare, highly productive, and completely absurd 3D chickens to transform your humble coop into a massive egg-producing factory.

  • Automation & Progression: Optimize your setup as you advance. Set up automatic funnels and collection systems so the eggs flow into the pit entirely on their own while you sit back and watch the numbers skyrocket.

  • Relaxing & Satisfying ASMR Experience: Escape the stress. Immerse yourself in vibrant visuals and the deeply satisfying sound design of eggs plunging into the depths as the hours melt away.

store_data.about_the_game:
]Novalex Project Zero


Start with a single garage and a sketch. Build the automaker that outlasts the century.

Novalex Project Zero is a turn-based car tycoon. You found a fledgling automaker and grow it one decision at a time — engineering the cars, financing the factories, reading the market, and fighting 30 AI manufacturers for every sale. There's no twitch reflex here: every turn is a deliberate bet on technology, price, and timing. Out-engineer your rivals, or watch them bury you.

Design cars from the chassis up

Every model is yours to engineer. Choose the body, size the engine, pick your components, and balance the trade-offs with fine-grained tuning sliders.
  • Engineer the trade-offs — performance, comfort, reliability, fuel economy and cost all pull against each other. There is no perfect car, only the right car for the segment you're chasing.
  • Live with your decisions — defects, aging stats and facelifts decide whether a model stays competitive or quietly stops selling.
  • Build a lineup, not a one-hit wonder — cover the segments that matter, retire what's gone stale, and time each successor.

Research the tech that wins decades

Progress down a historical technology tree and unlock the engines, materials and features that define each era.
  • Time your research bets so your cars lead the market instead of trailing it.
  • New tech reshapes what's possible — and quietly makes last decade's bestseller obsolete.

Run the whole business

A great car is only half the company. Build and manage the operation behind it.
  • Manufacturing — factories, production lines, shifts and retooling. Match output to demand without drowning in unsold stock.
  • Money — fund R&D, manage cash flow, and use financing to grow faster than your balance sheet should allow.
  • Brand — marketing, reputation and prestige compound over time. A trusted badge sells cars a spreadsheet says it shouldn't.

Outplay 30 living rivals

The competition isn't scenery. All 30 AI manufacturers run the same logic you do — designing, pricing, researching and reacting, turn after turn.
  • Scout rivals, read the standings, and exploit the gaps they leave open.
  • Survive market shocks and events that punish the complacent.
  • Climb the rankings to the top of the industry — or go bankrupt trying.

Read everything, miss nothing

Deep reports turn the simulation into decisions: company value over time, market share, profit margins, sales versus the competition, financials and cash flow, and a full company history. When the run ends, a detailed scorecard and leaderboard tell you exactly how you stacked up.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE BRIDGE IS YOURS. THE GALAXY AWAITS.

Step into the captain's seat of the Odyssey, a state-of-the-art exploration starship lost in the uncharted sectors of the frontier. In this narrative sci-fi command simulator, every decision rests on your shoulders. From the safety of your interactive bridge console, you must guide your crew through anomalies, hostile encounters, and complex diplomatic crises.

MANAGE YOUR CREW AND SHIP

You are only as good as your officers. Delegate tasks to specialized departments: Science, Engineering, Security, and Tactical.

  • Specialized Officers: Choose the right lead officer for each mission. Astrofisicists, security veterans, and combat specialists bring unique traits and passive bonuses to the table.

  • Stress & Fatigue: Space exploration takes a toll. Push your officers too hard during high-risk maneuvers, and they will suffer from stress or injury. Manage duty rotations and order rest to keep your crew operating at peak efficiency.

  • Ship Upgrades: Customize the Odyssey by installing new shields, improved warp drives, and advanced offensive modules to survive increasingly dangerous sectors.

CRITICAL DECISIONS AND ETHICAL DILEMMAS

There are no easy choices in the deep void. Will you strictly enforce the Non-Intervention Protocol when encountering primitive worlds, or bend the rules to save lives? Every choice impacts your ship’s resources:

  • Balance Hull Integrity and Shields during tactical space battles.

  • Keep Crew Morale and Trust high to prevent breakdown of order on the bridge.

  • Manage Diplomatic Standing with rival alien factions and your own High Council.

AN EVER-CHANGING VOYAGE

Featuring a deep, branching narrative event system, Odyssey Bridge Quest offers immense replayability. Encounter space smugglers, investigate derelict ghost ships, contain alien pathogens, and chart unknown stellar anomalies.

How will history remember your captaincy? Will you return home as a decorated explorer, a pragmatic diplomat, or will the Odyssey become another lost wreck in the silence of the void?

store_data.about_the_game:
Ocean Threshold

An immersive descent into the space between life and death, and the journey back.

Ocean Threshold is a 2-3 hour narrative experience that explores the liminal threshold between trauma and transformation. Blending psychological depth with mythic structure, it unfolds as an interactive labyrinth shaped by memory, perception, and emotional states.

About This Experience

The experience begins in the suspended aftermath of a suicide attempt - a moment outside of time.

You step into the fragmented psyche of an unnamed avatar, entering a dreamlike, mythological labyrinth that reflects an inner world in flux. What follows is a journey structured around an ancient cycle: descent into darkness, transformation within the unknown, and return to life with new meaning

Each space within the labyrinth is an expression of emotive architecture: shattered memories, subpersonalities, and paradoxical dreamscapes. Rooted in archaic mythological traditions, Ocean Threshold draws on the idea of “threshold states”: moments where the boundary between worlds dissolves.

This is not a story told through dialogue, but through space, sensation, and presence.

Key Features

Emotive Architecture

Explore environments that function as psychological constructs rather than static levels. Gravity shifts, scale distorts, and sound evolves in response to your interaction, reflecting internal emotional states.

Experimental Mechanics

Ocean Threshold is designed more like an installation than a conventional game:

  • Zero-gravity navigation and disorientation

  • Sensory deprivation and minimal interface

  • Dynamic environmental transformation

VR-First Experience

Built primarily for VR to maximize immersion and presence, with a desktop version available for accessibility.

Mythic Autobiographical Narrative

Artistic Vision

This is a personal work, created at the intersection of psychology and art, reimagined through symbolic and spatial storytelling. Rather than direct narration, the experience uses metaphor and structure to evoke empathy and interpretation.

It transforms a lived experience of crisis into a mythic and architectural journey. By structuring pain into symbolic form, the project opens space for reflection on depression, despair, and transformation.

Inspired by immersive installations and ancient myth, the experience invites players into a vulnerable psychological space where meaning is not given, but discovered.

A Socially Conscious Work

Ocean Threshold is intended not only as a game, but as a therapeutic and socially conscious art installation.

By placing the player within a vulnerable internal landscape, it creates space for recognition and empathy, allowing players to see aspects of their own experience reflected and restructured.

It contributes to ongoing conversations around mental health, suicide awareness, and the role of storytelling in healing.

Wishlist & Follow Development

If this project resonates with you, consider wishlisting to follow development.

We are building a labyrinth where pain is restructured and despair is transformed, and we invite you to be part of that journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
SKINSHIFT is an asymmetric multiplayer hide-and-seek game about mimicry, built on Unreal Engine 5. You're either a Hunter from the cleanup squad, or a Mimic — a sneaky little creature that can pass itself off as anything. And no, nobody turns into teapots and crates here (that would be too easy): Mimics reshape their own bodies, copy the material of a surface, mold themselves into a silhouette and freeze in the most ridiculous pose imaginable, just to pass for part of the scenery. Meanwhile, Hunters look for that one detail that "somehow doesn't fit." This is lighthearted hide-and-seek mischief with a side of "funny tension": cute little figures frozen absurdly in the corners, while someone with a dead-serious face combs the room in search of that one extra elbow.

Two sides

Players split into Mimics and Hunters — and each side has its own kind of fun.

Mimics (the hiders)

Your body is putty. Crawl across walls and ceilings, curl up into a ball, squeeze into the most brazen hiding spots. Grab a brush, repaint yourself to match any color around you — and blend into the background. Blended in? Freeze and hold your breath so the cleanup squad walks right past. After that — roam free and cause all the mischief you like.

Hunters (the seekers)

You're the cleanup squad, the bane of every Mimic. The task is simple: spot the troublemakers and catch every last one. Keep your eyes peeled, don't trust a single suspiciously flat wall, and don't miss the slightest oddity. Clear the location — and you've earned your bragging rights.

Two game modes

  • Free Mode — all colors and materials are right at hand from the start, nothing to collect. Switch your texture whenever you feel like it, grab the eyedropper and paint yourself to a tee. Jump in and play — all your focus goes to disguise and posing, not gathering.

  • Sticky Paws — at the start of the round, Mimics stock up their palette with their paws: they touch surfaces and lick up their colors and materials. Once the hunt is on — you can't run off for a refill, so make do with whatever you managed to grab. This isn't a warm-up anymore — it's real strategy.

The main hook — manual body posing

You twist your own arms, legs and torso in real time — like pulling invisible strings. You can fold your hiding little body into any pose you want: stretch out along a wall, scrunch into a lump, stick to the ceiling, or absurdly "fold" yourself under the furniture. You sculpt the silhouette to match an object by hand, freeze — and whether you get busted or mistaken for part of the decor depends on how convincingly you held still.

How to survive

  • Freeze smart. The perfect color won't save you if your elbow's sticking out around the corner and you've tucked yourself in the wrong spot.

  • Don't twitch. One extra move at the wrong moment — and bam, you're busted.

  • Ham it up with purpose. Color is only half the job: strike the right pose to fully melt into the background.

Key features

  • Asymmetric co-op hide-and-seek: some hide, others hunt with relish.

  • A unique manual body posing system — everyone sculpts their own clumsily-alive silhouette by hand.

  • Material palette gathering: the start of the round is already strategy, not a warm-up.

  • Cute stylized visuals and that signature "funny tension."

  • Maps with dozens of static "landmarks" that are oh-so-easy to get lost among.

One last thing you should know

Somewhere in this room a Mimic is lurking and quietly giggling. There's only one question — will you spot it before it slips away? Freeze. And hold your breath.

store_data.about_the_game:
A forgotten theatre lies beneath a drowned world

House of Tides is a first-person psychological sci-fi horror game set inside a shifting labyrinth of memories, imagined lives, fractured identities, and impossible stages.

Follow an anomalous signal into a theatre that has survived for centuries below the ocean. Built with the wondrous technology of a civilisation before its collapse, the theatre can recreate entire spaces from memories, plays, archives, dreams, and fictional worlds.

As you descend, its systems begin to open around you: rooms become stages, memories bleed into performances, fictional characters carry private wounds, and places return changed by grief, guilt, obsession, and the need for absolution.

At the centre of House of Tides is a story about human tragedy, isolation, and the fragile ways people try to reach one another, even across memory, performance, fiction, and forms of life whose nature is uncertain.

A first-person psychological sci-fi horror experience

House of Tides is built around exploration, perception, sound, diegetic interaction, environmental investigation, and narrative discovery. Examine objects, read fragments, operate strange theatre systems, follow distant sounds, and use your technological bracelet to connect with the theatre and shift between different spaces.

Some areas behave like labyrinths. Others unfold as environmental puzzles where rooms, props, memories, and staged scenes must be transformed to open a path forward. Many puzzles are diegetic, tied closely to the history of the place, the people inside it, and the emotional logic of the scenes you are moving through.

Horror develops through atmosphere, sensory dissonance, silence, spatial distortion, intimate memories, unstable performances, and the gradual collapse between fiction and reality.

Memories, plays, and lives that refuse to stay separate

The theatre unfolds as a surreal labyrinth shaped by personal memories, theatrical works, damaged archives, fictional characters, and unstable projections. You will move between remembered places and staged worlds, often watching them merge until it becomes unclear which details belong to a life, a performance, a trauma, or a character invented to survive it.

The people you encounter are human, strange, wounded, funny, secretive, and difficult to fully understand. Their stories move through mystery, humour, dreams, beauty, fear, and hidden trauma.

Sound as part of the narrative

Sound is central to the experience. Distant voices, distortions, echoes, recordings, breathing, music, silence, and impossible sounds are used to guide attention, create tension, reveal meaning, and provide clues for progression.

Some moments are designed to be understood through listening before they are understood through image.

Key Features

  • First-person psychological sci-fi horror set inside a forgotten theatre beneath a drowned world.

  • Explore a shifting labyrinth of memories, plays, imagined lives, damaged archives, and fractured identities.

  • Investigate environments through objects, documents, recordings, staged fragments, and diegetic interaction.

  • Use a technological bracelet to connect with the theatre’s systems and shift between different spaces.

  • Solve diegetic puzzles that transform rooms, stages, memories, and fictional settings to open a path forward.

  • Navigate surreal spaces where memories, theatrical works, fictional characters, and personal trauma gradually merge.

  • Follow sound as a narrative and mechanical clue: voices, echoes, music, silence, distortions, and distant signals can guide progression.

  • Encounter complex characters shaped by mystery, humour, dreams, beauty, fear, and secret wounds.

  • Experience a story about grief, guilt, obsession, isolation, and the fragile need to connect with others.

  • A compact narrative horror experience with no traditional combat focus.

store_data.about_the_game:
Description

Iliad is an epic exploration adventure, a Metroidvania that borrows more than just unlocking new powers from it's retro origins. Classic map mechanic are weaved into the design of the game, from teleporting between map edges to obscure clues from unexpected NPCs. In order to complete the trial ahead you will travel across two worlds tightly linked together, that grows as you discover new powers and defeat bosses, using their attack patterns against them. 

Story

As the heir to the Iliad throne you must prove your worthiness by going through a trial that will have you travel between Olympus and the Underworld in search of new powers. Your Trial will place you on a path through the five Guardians protecting Medusa, who's soul is roaming over the land. Only a true hero will be able to gather all the Guardians' Souls to lead Iliad in peace and prosperity.  

Features

  • ~5h of gameplay.

  • Power ups and light backtracking, with a map and waypoints.

  • Over 300 screens to explore across 2 handcrafted worlds.

  • More than 20 types of enemies, and at least 6 bosses.

  • Two endings. 

  • Cryptic messages from NPCs instead of a tutorial (That's a feature).

  • Inventory and map with a waypoint system.

  • Steam Deck compatible.

Backstory

Iliad was the largest game I made for a defunct platform, and and probably one of the largest made for it. It might have been a smashing hit if not for the fact that it was originally made in 2007... the year of the reveal of the first gen iPhone at Mac World. Everything changed overnight, and by the (short) time I finished and shipped Iliad the platform had been sold and bought and merged into larger things, so very few people actually played it in the end.

This is a port that I started a decade ago from the original Java code, first as a "drop in replacement" for C# of the original SDK it was built on, and it slowly just became the game. I have "upgraded" the game with some QOL changes and new mechanics, a few more boss attacks too, mainly because no one will ever be nostalgic about the original so I took liberties.  

19 years in the making (but maybe 6 months of work, I had other stuff to do...), here is Iliad!

store_data.about_the_game:
GamePlay

Play as the Messenger Cat — move, crouch, jump and dash to reach the finish line.Use special combo key moves to beat levels faster!Or stay observant and hunt for weird hidden little nooks?

During the journey, you may also encounter many companions. Your interactions with them might influence the subsequent course!

The game’s main storyline takes approximately 3 to 5 hours to complete. Aside from the main campaign, we also offer a wealth of additional game content!

Players can choose their playstyle freely. The main story chapters are fairly straightforward, ideal for players who have never tried similar games. At the same time, we have prepared matching challenges for players who enjoy speedrunning, collectible hunting, or puzzle-solving!

Game Plot

In this game, players step into the paws of a messenger cat. You travel across a shattered land to deliver letters that stand for hope to its inhabitants, and uncover long-forgotten secrets buried deep underground along your journey.

The game boasts several maps with unique themes, such as wild mountains, castles, mine tunnels and towering spires. Every themed area features exclusive environmental settings and level mechanics.

The game is still in early development. All art visuals, level designs and narrative presentation may be revised and optimized in the future.

Development Team

Cold Tone Development Team is a three-person crew made up of two fanatical creators, three stubborn visionaries, ten brainstorming minds, two pet cats, two game designers, two programmers, two artists, one hundred and fifty-five scattered ideas, and a fire extinguisher. The team devotes itself to developing various compact, highly playable games of diverse genres, aiming to bring players unforgettable gaming experiences.

StrayCat marks the team’s debut commercial project. We still have a long journey ahead to finish the full game. If there’s any content you’d love to see implemented, or if you want to keep up with all game development news, come join our community to share your thoughts!!! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us!

Communication Hub

Catch the latest, exclusive development updates!

-Discord

-QQ Group

The game boasts several maps with unique themes, such as wild mountains, castles, mine tunnels and towering spires. Every themed area features exclusive environmental settings and level mechanics.

The game is still in early development. All art visuals, level designs and narrative presentation may be revised and optimized in the future.

Development Team

Cold Tone Development Team is a three-person crew made up of two fanatical creators, three stubborn visionaries, ten brainstorming minds, two pet cats, two game designers, two programmers, two artists, one hundred and fifty-five scattered ideas, and a fire extinguisher. The team devotes itself to developing various compact, highly playable games of diverse genres, aiming to bring players unforgettable gaming experiences.

StrayCat marks the team’s debut commercial project. We still have a long journey ahead to finish the full game. If there’s any content you’d love to see implemented, or if you want to keep up with all game development news, come join our community to share your thoughts!!! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the next generation.

You are not managing the first team. You are building the players who will define the club’s future.

In Football Academy Director, you take charge of a football academy and guide young players from early youth squads to the U19 academy team. Follow the pathway from U11 prospects to older academy players, plan future squads, and decide which talents deserve the time, focus and responsibility needed to reach the next level.

Every season is a test of your academy

Choose training camps, run youth camps, scout promising players and compete for the signatures of emerging talent. The best player is not always the right signing. You need to judge ability, potential, personality, squad fit and the opportunities available inside your own academy.

Shape the squad, not just the star

Set training plans, focus extra attention on selected players during training periods, manage playing time, and use the Squad Planner to track your entire academy pathway. Build depth across age groups, prepare future promotions, and create a team around your best prospects.

Lead from the dugout

Before every match, choose your formation, assign player roles and review how well each player is expected to perform in that role. Matches are presented through text commentary, statistics and detailed match information, keeping the focus on your decisions and their consequences.

Answer to the board

Success is not only about winning matches. Meet board objectives, earn rewards, improve facilities, upgrade your academy, hire staff and build an environment where young players can thrive. Strong seasons can unlock new possibilities. Poor seasons can put your job under pressure.

Chase academy glory

Climb the Youth League pyramid, fight for Youth Cup success, watch your players earn national team call-ups, and build a lasting legacy through the players you develop year after year.

store_data.about_the_game:
The line doesn't take jobs. It made this one.

Anthros Robotics turned the dead GM stamping plant in your hometown into the world's first lights-out humanoid factory — forty Echo units building more Echo units in the dark. You're the engineer who made them run, and the local face who sold the town on the idea that the machines were the jobs coming back. In eleven days the company goes public, and the whole story rests on one word: Autonomous.

Three weeks ago, in a trainer cell forty feet from your desk, an Echo unit swept through its certified path into the space a person's body was in. Her name was Josie Pell. She was twenty-seven, you recruited her yourself, and the safety stop that should have caught it was inhibited.

You signed off inhibiting it.

Eleven days. Three people who know. One question: who pays.

Manual Override is a mature, choice-driven visual novel about the week the cover-up starts to come apart — and the three women tangled in it, each holding a different piece of the truth.

  • Annika — the engineer who can prove what the logs really say.
  • Sadie — the one who refuses to let Josie become a line item.
  • Zola — the one whose job is to make the problem disappear before the bell rings.

Features

  • Three full romance routes with distinct branching paths and endings
  • A tense corporate-thriller story about automation, accountability, and guilt
  • Mature themes and explicit adult content (18+)
  • Hand-crafted art, animated CG scenes, and an original score
  • Full localization in 7 languages: English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Simplified Chinese

"Infinitely Playable" Minesweeper!

WayBackers is an arcade-style 2D puzzle game based on the classic rules of Minesweeper. Your mission? Dig deeper and deeper while dodging deadly mines!

Dig Like Crazy!

There’s no time to sit and overthink. This Minesweeper comes with a time limit! Trust your experience and intuition—dig, dig, and keep on digging!

Step on a Mine, and It’s Game Over

The game features a variety of modes, but every single one demands absolute, unwavering concentration. A single second of carelessness, and BOOM—it’s an instant Game Over!

Challenge the High Scores!

Your best scores will be saved on the leaderboard. The game uses a password system, allowing you to easily share codes to compete for the highest score with friends, your favorite streamers, or your own community.

...And, lest we forget this sin...

The game also features a brand-new, original "Story Mode." Witness the conclusion of this tale with your own hands.

(Please note: Story Mode text is currently available in Japanese only.)

store_data.about_the_game:
You're in the vault. Now get out.

The hard part of any heist isn't breaking in — it's breaking out with the cash. You start where every other thief wants to end up: inside the vault, loot in reach. Grab the stash — sometimes more than one — and fight your way back out through the entire building. Every bank is a puzzle box, and your body is the only tool you need to crack it open from the inside.

A heist is just physics with attitude
Run, jump, crouch, slide, and charge up throws to send the loot exactly where it needs to go. There are no weapons and no gadgets — just momentum, timing, and the perfect line. Master the moves and the fastest way out is yours to find.

72 escapes, 8 escalating jobs
From your first quiet getaway to a final tower bristling with every hazard in the game, each level introduces one new idea, then dares you to combine it with everything you've already learned. Fundamentals give way to verticality, hazards, security, heavy loot, and finally jobs that throw all of it at you at once.

Clean out the vault
Some jobs hand you a single bag. Others scatter multiple stashes across the floor — grab every last one before you make your exit.

Climb, float, and fly
Bounce pads, wall-jumps, wind tunnels, and moving platforms turn every escape route into a vertical playground.

Survive the security suite
Sweeping lasers, panning cameras, alarm meters, killswitches, pressure plates, and snap-shut gates stand between you and freedom. Read the room, time your run, and don't trip the alarm on your way out.

Heavy is a whole different job
Some stashes are too heavy to throw — haul them, drop them on pressure plates, and outrun the gates before they slam shut.

Find your line
A clean critical path gets first-timers out alive. A faster, riskier line underneath it rewards the players who want to chase the perfect getaway.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore an endless procedural universe where every journey can lead to a new discovery, a new danger, or a new opportunity.

Mine valuable resources, trade across distant regions, fight ruthless pirates, uncover forgotten locations, and build your own space stations among the stars. Upgrade your ship, expand your influence, and choose your own path through a game built around exploration, commerce, combat, and survival.

Ore Bastards is designed as a living universe rather than a fixed sequence of missions. Stations develop their own economies, with prices, supplies, and demand changing according to the traffic, trade, and activity around them.

Miners travel between asteroid fields and trading hubs, merchants move goods across regions, and intelligent NPCs pursue their own goals. Pirates search for vulnerable targets—sometimes attacking directly, sometimes waiting in ambush, and sometimes luring careless captains into carefully prepared traps.

The universe continues to move around you, creating new opportunities, dangers, and unexpected encounters wherever you travel.

Ships, equipment, weapons, internal systems, and loot are procedurally generated, creating an effectively endless variety of builds and discoveries.

Every new ship can offer a different combination of hardpoints, cargo capacity, armor, speed, energy systems, and internal modules. Every weapon or piece of equipment can open new tactical possibilities, encouraging you to experiment, adapt, and develop a ship that reflects your own strategy.

No two expeditions need to play the same way. You may become a heavily armed pirate hunter, an efficient industrial miner, a wandering trader, an explorer searching for forgotten secrets—or something between them all.

As you travel deeper into the galaxy, you may discover rich mining fields, abandoned wrecks, hidden pirate caches, mysterious signals, derelict vessels, and locations shaped by events that happened long before you arrived.

Some discoveries may offer profit. Others may lead to danger—or reveal another trail worth following.

Build your own space stations, establish new centers of trade, defend your territory, and watch the surrounding economy respond to the world you help create.

There is no single path, no final frontier, and no last adventure.

In Ore Bastards, there is always another region to explore, another ship to discover, another fortune to claim, and another threat waiting in the dark.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the show where everything goes wrong.

You're a contestant on a chaotic game show, and the course ahead is a gauntlet of disasters — a flat tire, a ninja attack, a goose with a grudge, the plane going down. Every one of them stands between you and the finish line.

You clear them by playing combos of tool cards — a pool noodle, a car battery, a bucket of fried chicken, whatever's in your hand — and pulling off a gloriously stupid plan with them. Build your deck, weigh your odds, ride your luck, and race to the finish. Clear a disaster and roll to advance; wipe out and you're stuck, but you draw a fresh tool for next time.

Two games in one

With a crowd — the party game. 2+ players, online or local. You pitch your absurd plan out loud (or type it), and everyone bets karma on whether you'll actually pull it off — backing you boosts your odds, doubting you is just a wager. It's loud, it's social, and the table is the judge. Friends without the game join from a phone as a bet-pad, or watch the live couch-feed.

On your own — the strategy deckbuilder. Solo and 1v1 strip away the table and sharpen into a tight roguelite: read the odds, build your deck, manage your karma, and outrace the field. Solo sends you up a full ladder of rival bots; 1v1 Duels are a head-to-head battle of nerve and deck. Quieter, headsier — all the tactics, none of the table noise.

Features

  • A deckbuilder's tool economy welded to a betting table — a prediction market in karma where the only lever on your odds is positive (no griefing, ever).
  • A roster of quirky contestants, each with a signature move, plus unlockable skins.
  • A bombastic MC calling the chaos — and a collectible comic "Funny Pages" gallery you unlock as you play.
  • Earn FAME between runs to unlock characters, skins, and tougher difficulty tiers.
  • Dozens of absurd disasters across three flavors — mundane, absurd, and dire-played-for-laughs.
  • Full controller support and a Steam Deck–friendly layout. Solo & local play work fully offline, no account needed.

store_data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the show where everything goes wrong.

You're a contestant on a chaotic game show, and the course ahead is a gauntlet of disasters — a flat tire, a ninja attack, a goose with a grudge, the plane going down. Every one of them stands between you and the finish line.

You clear them by playing combos of tool cards — a pool noodle, a car battery, a bucket of fried chicken, whatever's in your hand — and pulling off a gloriously stupid plan with them. Build your deck, weigh your odds, ride your luck, and race to the finish. Clear a disaster and roll to advance; wipe out and you're stuck, but you draw a fresh tool for next time.

Two games in one

With a crowd — the party game. 2+ players, online or local. You pitch your absurd plan out loud (or type it), and everyone bets karma on whether you'll actually pull it off — backing you boosts your odds, doubting you is just a wager. It's loud, it's social, and the table is the judge. Friends without the game join from a phone as a bet-pad, or watch the live couch-feed.

On your own — the strategy deckbuilder. Solo and 1v1 strip away the table and sharpen into a tight roguelite: read the odds, build your deck, manage your karma, and outrace the field. Solo sends you up a full ladder of rival bots; 1v1 Duels are a head-to-head battle of nerve and deck. Quieter, headsier — all the tactics, none of the table noise.

Features

  • A deckbuilder's tool economy welded to a betting table — a prediction market in karma where the only lever on your odds is positive (no griefing, ever).
  • A roster of quirky contestants, each with a signature move, plus unlockable skins.
  • A bombastic MC calling the chaos — and a collectible comic "Funny Pages" gallery you unlock as you play.
  • Earn FAME between runs to unlock characters, skins, and tougher difficulty tiers.
  • Dozens of absurd disasters across three flavors — mundane, absurd, and dire-played-for-laughs.
  • Full controller support and a Steam Deck–friendly layout. Solo & local play work fully offline, no account needed.

Buy once. Play forever.

No pay-to-win, no predatory nonsense — just optional expansion packs and cosmetics down the road if you want them.
store_data.short_description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

store_data.about_the_game:
JokerJack is a hypnotically additive deckbuilder that takes the classic game of 21 and cranks it to the breaking point. Forget everything you know about playing it safe; here, "busting" is just a missed opportunity for a massive multiplier.

Combine the fundamentals of Blackjack with a growing collection of over 60 unique Joker cards to create game-breaking synergies. Whether you're adding flat chips for every Face card played or triggering an exponential Multiplier for hitting exactly 21, your goal is simple: reach the target score, survive the Blind, and keep the run alive.

With seeded runs, deep strategic discards, and a retro-neon aesthetic, every hand is a fresh chance to find the ultimate combo. Do you have the strategy to outsmart the deck, or will you go bust trying?

Key Features:

The Power of the Joker: Discover and equip over 60 distinct Jokers, each with unique rarities and game-altering effects.

Massive Scoring: Master the Chips×Multiplier formula to turn a simple hand of 21 into a billion-point payout.

Deep Roguelike Strategy: Navigate through escalating Blinds, utilize limited discards to sculpt your hand, and buy powerful upgrades in the Shop between rounds.

Endless Variety: No two runs are ever the same. Unlock new decks, hidden card types, and "Exotic" Jokers as you climb the ranks.

Master the Seed: Compete on the same RNG with friends or the community in Seeded Runs to see who can build the most broken deck.

store_data.about_the_game:
American Dream is a realistic strategy simulation about building wealth through real estate and business across the United States.

You begin with almost nothing — an inherited duplex in a modest city — and work your way up through rent, upgrades, financing, and reinvestment. Cities use real economic data, so buying in Tulsa feels very different from buying in San Francisco. Every market has its own costs, risks, and upside.

Grow at your own pace: acquire residential and commercial properties, unlock new asset types through research, travel to new markets, and scale from hands-on landlord to portfolio owner. Hire property management agencies to automate leasing, repairs, and day-to-day operations so you can focus on your next acquisition. Expand into hotels, launch businesses, and invest as your empire grows.

Success is not luck — it is capital discipline. Decide when to buy outright or finance, which tenants to accept, when to upgrade, and how to allocate cash across your portfolio. Setbacks are real, but so is the payoff: a portfolio that eventually earns more in a day than most people make in a year.

If you want a tycoon game that feels grounded, strategic, and satisfying — where the fantasy is earning your way to the top — American Dream is your path.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Do you insult me, sir? I shall not stand for it!" A man's dignity shall not be impugned, and the only recourse is a battle of… the mind? Gunfighting is a game of perfect balance, so use your brain to set your aim by positioning numbered tokens around a circle. Use special actions to turn the tide, and when there are no options left– FIRE! 

Why would you risk your life in a duel? The unfolding story gives you so many excellent reasons to pick up your flintlock that you might forgive some of the poorer reasons. Jilted loves, pride, being down-on-your-luck, greed– you’ll experience them all.

Key Features:

  • Shift your crosshair over the enemy by placing the numbered tokens in the right direction. You'd better have room to get that token where you need it!

  • Move your enemy's crosshairs away from you; if they hit their target, that's a loss too.

  • Use the coins you earn to buy special actions in the shop. Lay traps, push the opponent away, or double the value of tokens. These are all ways to get out of trouble.

  • You'll get access to more powers as you play through the delightfully silly single-player story. Someone watched too much Blackadder growing up.

  • You can also pass-and-play in a simple local multiplayer mode—it's quite a challenging duel for two players.

Originally made for iOS, Pistols at Dawn was too good to keep on the shelf. Now brought back to life on Steam, you can experience a fully original game by a crackpot developer who wants nothing more than to make you smile.

古き良きレトロスタイルのアートで綴られる　"ゲイトライク"　サバイバルクラフトアドベンチャー！！
突如、謎の屋敷に転送された「わたし」の運命は！？
危険な闇の中を探索し、素材を見つけ、アイテムを創造し、生還せよ！！

もし君が、見知らぬ謎の屋敷の中庭で目覚めたとする。

ここはどこなのか？　自分の身に何が起きたのか？

屋敷を調べようにも、中は闇に閉ざされ一寸先も見えない。

残念ながら手元には空のトランクケースが一つだけ。

明かりになりそうなものはない。

そんな時、君ならどうするだろう？

私の答えは――

なければ作れ！　クラフトシステム

光源、武器、防具、食事、ベッド、作業台、炉……探索に必要なアイテムや設備は自分でクラフトしよう！

敵地に住みつけ！？　中庭を（勝手に）拠点化！

屋敷の中庭に、クラフト用の設備や家具を（勝手に）設置。どんどん住み心地が良くなるぞ！

基本はポイント＆クリック方式アドベンチャー

6つのコマンドとアイテムを駆使して探索を進めよう！　もちろん「セルフ」に使うこともできる！？

殺意に満ちた罠たち！

仕掛けられた罠は致命的！　迂闊な行動をとれば即座にあの世行きだ！

襲い来る奇妙なモンスターを撃退せよ！

不思議なアミュレットの力を借りて、敵の行動を予見せよ！　すべての攻撃がどの方向から来るか分かっているのだから、避けられないはずがない！　あとは武器で反撃するだけだ！

ゲイトライク……？

往年の名作ADVからの影響を強く受けた、どこか懐かしい特徴的な語り口のテキストとクラシックスタイルのドットアート。

Step into the shadows of a cryptic wilderness. In Into the Lumberwoods, you are a cryptid fighting for survival in a shifting, hostile ecosystem.   • Dynamic Grid-Based Exploration: Chart your course across a randomly generated map. Hunt down elusive NPCs, unearth hidden artifacts that alter your play style, and adapt to as you push deeper into uncharted territory.

THE HUNT IS ON

From the lumbering, flesh-bound Globsters to the terrifying, pinpoint accuracy of the Observers, every entity in the woods has a strategy to end your run.

The dishes won’t finish themselves—and the kitchen is crawling with trouble.

Finish The Dishes! is a fast-paced arcade shooter set across a chaotic kitchen countertop. Blast through waves of filthy pests, defend the sink, and stop anything that tries to slip past you.
