store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Plenishins!

The Plenishins, our family, have been crafting furniture for nearly 50 years.

Legends say that it was our grandparents who invented the 3 legged-stool, the Coggley as we called it.

It was all going grand until the Scandinavians moved in. I won’t say the name but you know who I mean, with their brightly coloured shops and food…food in a furniture shop!

It’s been tough, the shop has been in your family for generations and now it’s on the brink, the last bastion of authentic local furniture.

To save the shop players must assemble flat packed furniture, fulfilling customer’s increasingly outrageous orders all the while keeping big corporate furniture at bay.

You're simply given a picture of the final build and so players must work out how everything is assembled and which tools to use, all the while skilfully manipulating each piece with no object snapping to cheat your way to the perfect chair, table, throne, instrument and much more!

  • Play from an immersive first-person perspective, either solo or in co-op

  • No step by step manuals - players get a single image of the final product and must reverse-engineer the build from loose parts

  • Craftsmanship Based Economy - earnings are directly tied to your skill where flawless builds command premium prices and terrible ones hurt your wallet

  • Upgrades & Progression - reinvest your profits to upgrade your tools and expand your shop to unlock increasingly complex, high-reward furniture blueprints

  • "Le grille? What the hell is that?!"

store_data.about_the_game:
A Cube’s Choice is a 3D platformer where every level is tied to a song. Go left, right, bob and weave to reach the Wall before the music ends.




Unlock movement abilities that change how you navigate each world. Abilities can be used to dodge danger and reach new paths.




Unlock songs and replay them in the jukebox whenever you want.




Discover hidden skins throughout the levels and change the look of your cube. Some skins are placed off the main path, rewarding players who slow down, explore, and search each world more carefully. Some skins even have a hidden secret!




Through soft, symbolic storytelling, A Cube’s Choice explores what it means to face insurmountable walls and what philosophies we can use to overcome them.

Each level is shaped by its song, changing the atmosphere, rhythm, and challenges of the world around you. Push straight for the goal, or slow down and explore how each song affects the space. But remember, time isn't gonna stop though.

store_data.about_the_game:
Beaver Arena is a fast-paced arena rogue-lite shooter with bullet-heaven mechanics. You take control of a glowing cyber-sphere and step into a closed neon arena to survive against endless waves of hostile geometry.

Your primary goal is to stay alive until the timer runs out. Enemies close in from all directions, leaving you with less room to breathe every second. Master the precise timing of your Dash to slip through tight crowds and unleash devastating area-of-effect attacks.

Every destroyed shape drops data fragments (XP). Collect them to level up mid-run and build your ultimate loadout. With each level up, you choose from randomized tactical modules: homing plasma bolts, orbital shields, gravity fields, or chain detonators. No two runs are ever the same.

Each phase culminates in a tense boss fight against a massive crystalline Overlord that will test your reflexes and positioning. Earn currency across your runs to permanently upgrade your sphere's base stats in the main menu and return to the arena as an unstoppable force.

store_data.about_the_game:
Beat Death at cards.

ȘEPTAR is a roguelite deckbuilder built on Șeptică, the Romanian shedding card

game — the one your grandmother actually played. Underneath the familiar 36-card deck

runs a score-chasing engine: stage your cards into chains, fire them for points ×

a length multiplier, and race a living opponent who's trying to do the same. The

longer you hold, the bigger the payoff — and the more the opponent races ahead. Cash

out now, or build the monster chain?

The wild 7 is your weapon

The 7 is fully wild — it bridges any chain. The 2 is an attack — fire it

to rip cards out of your opponent's hand. Every relic and character bends these rules

in a different direction.

Sculpt a run

  • 59 relics — passive rule-benders drafted between races. Stack them, chasesynergies, break the math. Beat a boss and loot their signature relic.

  • 4 characters — The Gambler, The Hoarder, The Septar, The Widow. Each warpsthe rules from the first card.

  • A sculpted deck — burn, forge, and reforge your cards across a run. Deckcomposition is a build axis.

  • Card blessings — permanent per-card upgrades, stamped on for the whole run.

Climb the folk-tale ladder

Win back the road home one card-table at a time. Face a gauntlet of folkloric figures —

the Innkeeper, the Crone, the Wolf, the Revenant, the Witch, the Storm-Caller — all the

way to the Dragon, who is Death holding the final mile. 6 Ascension tiers of

stacking difficulty, a recurring nemesis that returns stronger every run, and a daily

seed with leaderboards.

Play your friends

Invite one Steam friend to a 1v1 series — a best-of-5 of relic-drafted races

with carried builds and escalating targets, decided over a real match with rematches.

The same proven core loop, head to head.

Longevity modes

  • Weekly Challenge — one seeded run the whole world shares that week.

  • Boss Rush — the four bosses, back to back.

  • Endless — loop the ladder forever as the pressure compounds.

  • Custom — a sandbox: tier, character, ladder length, mutators.

Juice you feel in your chest

A warm folk-art tavern where simple arithmetic is dressed up as fireworks. Cards slam,

the score launches and ticks up, multipliers flash, the screen shakes on a big fire.

Procedural sound, a moody Romanian-folk soundtrack, full colorblind support, and a

guided tutorial that teaches by doing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Inkdelve builds a complete tabletop RPG night from a single seed. Type in a number, or let it roll one, and in seconds you have a dungeon map, a monster encounter balanced to your party, a ready-to-play set of heroes, and a print-ready sheet for every player. The prep is finished before your group finds parking.

Inkdelve is a tool for game masters who want to run more sessions and spend less time preparing them. Every map and every encounter comes from Inkdelve's own procedural engine, so no two nights are the same, and any night can be rebuilt or shared just by passing along its seed.

How a night comes together

Choose a terrain and a difficulty, then generate. Inkdelve lays out a full dungeon, fills it with a threat-balanced encounter, and rolls a party to match.

Review the map in GM view, with traps, caches, points of interest, and a complete legend that only you can see.

Print the packet or export it to your virtual tabletop, then sit down and play.

What you get

store_data.about_the_game:
Vanya is a dark, free-to-play idle MMORPG set in a persistent online world where your character keeps growing through hunting, skill training, player economy, Bloodlines, global bosses, events, and PvP or Non-PvP worlds.

Create your character, choose your world, and begin a daily progression journey with no level cap, no skill cap, and no account resets.


A DARK IDLE MMORPG THAT NEVER RESETS

Vanya was built for players who enjoy constant progression. Hunt monsters, train your skills, collect gold, upgrade equipment, take part in the server economy, and watch your character grow day after day.

You do not need to stay glued to the screen all the time. Start your hunt, follow your progress, return to collect rewards, make decisions, and keep advancing.

TWO WORLDS, TWO WAYS TO PLAY

Drakmor is the Non-PvP world, ideal for players who prefer a calmer experience focused on progression, economy, events, and daily growth.

Noctra is the PvP world, created for players who enjoy risk, rivalry, player attacks, and a more dangerous experience.

Choose how you want to live in Vanya.

TRAIN, HUNT, TRADE, AND GROW

In Vanya, every day matters. Train Sword, Bow, Magic, and Defense skills in the Pub or inside your House. Start Idle Hunts to earn EXP, Gold, and Loot. Use the Market, buy and sell items, strengthen your account, and climb the global rankings.

BLOODLINES, BOSSES, AND EVENTS

Join a Bloodline, help your group grow, donate resources, take part in collective systems, and prepare for special events. Vanya receives updates, limited-time events, new content, and expansions over time.

NO LEVEL CAP. NO SKILL CAP. NO ACCOUNT RESETS.

Vanya Online is a persistent world. Your progress matters.

No level cap.
No skill cap.
No account resets.

Build your character at your own pace, play every day, or return whenever you want. The world remains alive, dark, and constantly expanding.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lords of the World is a strategy game that combines city-building and action RPG gameplay.

Zahmet is a young warrior born among the Mountain People who enters the kingdom's hierarchy at its lowest rank. Unlike ordinary soldiers, he is entrusted with the king's special assignments and gradually rises to become one of the kingdom's most valuable agents.

While developing and expanding their kingdom, players will send Zahmet on missions across many different nations. Hunt wild beasts in dense forests, infiltrate enemy strongholds, eliminate powerful generals, deliver secret messages, and carry out dangerous operations in service of the kingdom.

Zahmet can wield a variety of weapons, including bows, spears, swords, and shields. As he grows stronger, he learns to master the elements of Stone, Fire, Ice, and Lightning, unlocking powerful new combat abilities and fighting styles.

Explore a world filled with diverse nations, develop your city, train your armies, and expand the influence of your kingdom across the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Idle hands do the Devil's work. Tap to summon demons, raise an infernal workforce, and claw your way down through the nine Circles of Hell... from Limbo to the frozen treachery at the bottom, where the Devil himself is waiting.

Descend, and grow stronger

Every descent is a bargain: you give up everything you've built -- your demons, your power-ups, your whole workforce -- for a permanent multiplier that makes the next circle pay out far more. Nine circles, each richer and stranger than the last.

Bargain at the Crossroads

A figure waits where the roads cross, and he deals in souls. Stake what you've earned on a single roll: bet small and the odds turn against you; bet big and the swings turn brutal. Walk away with a fortune... or get Cast Down to Limbo for your greed. The dial is yours. So is the risk.

Battle the Devil

Reach the bottom and Satan takes notice. He'll steal from your hoard and dare you to take it back -- a tapping duel that escalates every time you win. Beat him, and he comes back stronger. The fight never ends the same way twice.

Bank souls, climb forever

Resurrect to convert a run into Souls, then spend them on permanent powers that carry across every future descent. It's an idle game that respects your time -- play actively and tap, or set it down and let your demons earn while you're away.

Features

  • Nine Circles of Hell, each a soft-prestige with its own multiplier

  • Two upgrade tracks: power-ups (per tap) and recruiters (idle income)

  • The Crossroads: a soul-staking gamble with a real risk/reward dial

  • The Devil:  an escalating tap-battle boss you can keep challenging

  • Resurrection meta-prestige with permanent soul upgrades

  • 19 achievements, from your first demon to a million-clicks

  • Plays in short bursts or long idle sessions

Junkoid

The galaxy is a total mess, and you are the only hope! In Junkoid, you take command of a high-speed sanitation ship in a fast-paced action environment.

Inspired by 80s arcade classics like Asteroids, Junkoid takes that addictive survival formula and cranks the speed up to the max. Your mission is simple but challenging: navigate the void, dodge debris, and disintegrate every piece of space garbage that crosses your path before it collides with your ship.

Key Features:

  • Pure Arcade Action: Smooth 360-degree movement, pinpoint precision, and rapid-fire combat.

  • Infinite Survival: Garbage spawns randomly and constantly; the longer you survive, the more chaotic and faster the environment becomes.

  • Chase the Glory: Can you beat your own record? Compete against yourself with our persistent Highscore system.

  • Minimalist Aesthetic: A clean, sleek design that lets you focus on what really matters: cleaning up the sector, one blast at a time! 

  • They have to click any button, first the play button to play and the how to play button to exit the game

store_data.about_the_game:
Cuckqueens is rom-com visual novel where you and your girlfriend are the absolute perfect couple. You're inseparable! In fact, you're so comfortable that the spark is basically in sweatpants. Her brilliant, foolproof solution to spice things up? An open relationship! But she isn't just giving you a hall pass; she's actively acting as your wingwoman. She sets up your dating profile, picks your outfits, and feeds you pickup lines. Only so that she can see you sleep with other girls.

Genre: Visual Novel + Romantic Comedy + Dating Sim + Mystery

Main Role: You play as a delightfully confused but eager-to-please boyfriend trying to survive the modern dating scene strictly under the bizarre, highly specific supervision of your own girlfriend.

Features:

  • Multiple unique female characters, each with distinct personalities, kinks, and emotional arcs

  • Meaningful choices

  • Multiple endings shaped by you

Romance Paths:

  • Pursue chaotic new love interests, from the dangerously intense goth girl to the barista who knows way too much about your relationship.

  • Re-romance your mastermind girlfriend as you dig into the psychological, emotional, or hilariously convoluted truth behind her "open relationship" experiment.

  • Unlock multiple endings depending on who you ultimately choose to be with, how many rules you break, and whether you solve the ultimate mystery of the arrangement.

    Characters

The Co-Worker: Sharp-tongued and observant. She’s always had a playful rivalry with you, making her the absolute most baffling first candidate on your girlfriend's approved list.

The Artist: A delightfully chaotic wildcard who drags you into bizarre, high-energy situations. She seems completely oblivious to your weird relationship arrangement... or is she?

The Perfect Match: Sweet, deeply compatible, and almost too perfect for you. Her immediate understanding of all your obscure quirks and habits feels a little rehearsed.

Wishlist it now <3!

Earn coins as you clean and spend them on the Ball Machine, where every ball grants a new upgrade to help you organize faster and more efficiently.

A Mountain of Toys to Master

store_data.about_the_game:
Long forgotten, and isolated from the rest of Ilseera, delve into the isolated fantastical island of Tarrowmorr.

On this adventure, you play as Kayleigh, a pirate trying to escape from her past who winds up marooned on a strange island not found on the maps. While searching for your crew-mates, you find yourself becoming entwined in the very fate of the residents of Tarrowmorr. 

Will Kayleigh continue to run, or will she discover what it means to truly become a Hero...

Designed to look and feel like a video game that could have come out in the late 1990s, Tarrowmorr embraces the design ethos present in a lot of video games from that time. Low-poly models with low-res textures and smaller, handcrafted level spaces to explore.

In Tarrowmorr, you spend your time exploring the strange island and helping the people you find along the way. The core game-play loop involves:

  • Questing and Helping the People you encounter

  • Delving into dungeons

  • Fighting various Monsters and Enemies

  • Using the items you find to progress further in your journey

  • Discovering Secrets and finding collectables throughout the island

As you delve deeper into the island, the stakes increase and the story gets darker. A linear and story driven adventure awaits you on the Island of Tarrowmorr...

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Buddy World — a cozy multiplayer cooking game where you and your friends run restaurants, serve hungry customers, and grow your buddy empire together.

Cook together, Team up with friends in Buddy World, invite them to your lobby, pick a restaurant, and jump into the kitchen. One buddy hosts, everyone pitches in — plating orders, running the drive-thru, mopping messes, and trying not to lose a life when the lunch rush hits.

Run real restaurants! Start at the Salad Bar — pack orders, wash dishes, and keep customers happy before their patience runs out. Unlock Pizza Place and master dough, sauce, toppings, the oven, and the pizza box station. Expand your kitchen, buy upgrades, and push through day after day as things get busier.

Salad Bar — build bowls, manage the line, keep the dining room clean [] Pizza Place — roll dough, top pizzas, bake, box, and serve [] Drive-thru — cars don’t wait. Neither should you. [] Buddy Delivery — take orders on the road and chase streak bonuses.

More than the kitchen When the shift ends, head back to Buddy World — a shared hub where you can add friends, invite players to your world, climb leaderboards, tend the community garden, sell produce to your restaurants, and unwind at the fishing dock.

Grow your buddy Earn Buddy Coins, level up your restaurant, unlock perks, customize your chef, and spend earnings in the shop on extra stations, bigger tables, dishwashers, and more. Every world slot saves your progress so you can build something worth coming back to.

Built for playing with people. Create an account, add friends, send invites, and run a full shift together. Shared cloud saves mean everyone plays on the same buddy network — whether you’re hosting or joining a friend’s kitchen.

Grab your apron. Friendly. Fast. A little frantic. Cooking Buddies is the game for players who want a wholesome co-op cooking loop with friends — and just enough chaos to keep every shift memorable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dark Hollow is a grim text-driven RPG about surviving in a world already halfway buried.

Hunt monsters for coin, take contracts from desperate townsfolk, descend into forgotten catacombs, rob the dead, and wander through cursed forests where every step further from town feels like a mistake.

Your words shape how you survive.

Choose where to travel, who to trust, what to carry, and whether risking another journey into the dark is worth what waits at the end of it. Time passes with every action. Weather shifts without warning. Madness follows you home from places better left untouched.

The farther you travel from town, the stranger the world becomes. Bells echo through empty chapels long after midnight. Shapes move through the fog where nothing should be standing. Travelers vanish along the roads and sometimes return days later — silent, shaking, wrong.

There are no grand kingdoms left to save. No glory waiting at the end of the road. Most people in Dark Hollow are only trying to make it through another night without losing themselves completely.

You are no different.

Not chosen.
Not destined.
Not important.

Just another desperate soul carrying a weapon through the dark because dying frightened is worse than dying tired.

Some people pray.
Some people drink.
Some people bury what they’ve done and keep walking.

Death is permanent.
The Hollow remembers.

store_data.about_the_game:
一只猫咪住进你的桌面，在屏幕角落自由生活、陪你工作。每天摸摸、喂喂、逗逗，看它从奶猫慢慢长成御猫；布置猫窝、收集品种、养一整窝猫，还能派它们出门打工攒鱼干。零压力——不会饿死、不会走丢，关机离线也安心。

关于游戏

🐱 一只真正住在你桌面上的猫

喵居不是窗口里的游戏，是常驻桌面的桌宠。透明无边框、永远置顶、点击穿透，它趴在屏幕角落，你照常工作，它在一旁打盹踱步、偶尔抬头看你。轻量省电，可以一直挂着。

✨ 它是活的

Spine 2D 骨骼动画；自主行为（自己发呆/闲逛/找地方睡/上爬架）；眼神追随鼠标；情绪气泡 + 会随性格变化「想法日志」；陪伴方式不同会养出黏人精/高冷喵/吃货/运动健将/睡神等性格。

🤚 每天的陪伴

悬停弹出四色需求环（饱食/心情/清洁/精力）；摸、逗、拎、拖都有专属反应；投喂时放下猫粮，猫会自己走过去吃。

📈 从奶猫到御猫

亲密度成长解锁功能；四个成长阶段（幼→少年→成→御）；20 品种图鉴可收集；花色品相 + 温和繁育（繁育继承花色的小猫、不消耗父母）。

🏡 养一整窝猫

猫咪花名册管理每只猫（在家/打工/待命）；升级猫窝容量让更多猫一起生活；一键切换当前陪伴的猫。

💼 放置挂机，离线也在长

—派猫出门打工（猫咖/快递站/钓鱼港/后山探险，按性格加成）；在家的猫玩家具挂机攒鱼干；离线收益结算（关机回来照样有进账，防作弊不肝）；家具背景贡献温馨度·整洁度·美观度，环境越好收益越高。

🛋️ 装扮你的猫窝

商店买家具→摆放→整理；猫爬架 4 级进化 + 主题款；基础家具 + 挂机设施（自动喂食器/饮水机/猫砂盆/鱼干收集器）；可切换角落背景。

🥚 扭蛋与惊喜

鱼干档/金鱼干档扭蛋机；软/硬保底必出 SSR + 碎片兑换台（每抽必给碎片定向兑换，没有废抽，图鉴一定集得齐）。

🎮 小游戏

逗猫激光、扑抓老鼠、钓鱼、拍照，窝内即玩，涨心情/赚鱼干/增亲密。

🏆 目标与日常

每日任务 + 成就系统。🌏 多语言 — 内置 8 国语言，按系统语言自动切换。

💛 零压力哲学

猫不会饿死/生病/跑掉，离线不惩罚、没有红点、没有 FOMO。它只是安静地住在你的桌面，等你想它的时候摸一摸。让它一直挂在你的桌面吧。

store_data.about_the_game:
The Last Banner is a session-based, faction-versus-faction battleground with action combat, resource gathering, crafting, and siege warfare. Three factions. Real class depth with sessions running around 20 minutes for fast skirmishes, up to two hours for full 30+ player sieges. Pick a side, drop in, gather resources, craft tools of war, fortify keeps, and fight to raise the banner.

The World

The Lore

Long ago, the peoples of the world stood united under a single banner, until the faction that raised it vanished, leaving its standard behind. No one agrees what The Last Banner stands for. Whoever raises it claims its power and bends the will of every people in the world to their cause. Three factions have been fighting over that claim ever since.

The Battlegrounds

The battlegrounds in TLB are not arenas. They are places. Forests thick enough to lose someone in. Open hillsides where you can see a fight and decide whether to enter it or flee. Keeps that sit in the landscape like they belong there because they hold the scars of war from years past.

The world is designed to be contained but not feel small. You may eventually explore outward and find new locations, and possibly secrets along the way. The various battlegrounds span biomes from snow covered hill tops to deep murky bogs with ancient secrets hidden throughout.

Choose Your Faction

The Elderborn

They claim divine inheritance, heirs to the First Forge, chosen to restore the order Avenor once bestowed. To them the Banner is a birthright.

The Hollow Oak

They see Avenor not as a blessing but a scar, the wound that seared the sky when man first defied the earth. They call its light the False Fire. Their faith is wild, beautiful, and merciless.

The Iron Pact

They believe none of it. They speak little of stars or gods. Long ago they withdrew into the mountains and were changed by them, tempered, hardened, forgotten.

Each faction carries distinct bonuses, faction-specific stats. Who you chose to be isn't just an appearance.

Build Your Fighter

A Classic Lineup

Four starter classes: Warrior, Mage, Rogue & Cleric. Each with unique abilities and roles in combat. Weapon variants and item upgrades reinforce your chosen skill path. Each class has a clear identity and a ceiling worth pushing. As you play you gain Realm Rank, unlocking new equipment, and special abilities that grow with your commitment to the faction. More classes are planned for the future.

Gather

Each battleground has discrete resource nodes scattered across contested terrain: wood, stone, iron. These are the inputs for everything you build during a session. NPCs patrol the frontier and drop basic materials. Getting to a resource node means moving through them, and usually through whoever else from the other factions is heading to the same spot.

Craft

What you gather goes into a crafting pipeline: siege weapons, consumables, tools, and defensive structures. Nothing you deploy in a match appears from thin air. Someone gathered for it, someone built it.

Build and Repair

Once you have materials you can deploy and maintain tools of war: catapults, battering rams, ballistas, spike barriers, ladders, traps, and barricades. Keeps have persistent structure states within a session, moving from Pristine through Cracked, Damaged, Broken, and Destroyed. A hammer system handles repairs and upgrades directly on deployed assets as control points shift. When a wall starts cracking, someone needs to be running materials and hammering it back.

Fight

Combat is action-based. You swing to attack, hold to block, and run your class abilities off a classic quickbar. A Warrior going berserk plays nothing like a Rogue slipping into stealth or a Mage holding position to cast. The class identity is built into how you physically play it.

Battle across modes built for every kind of fight: King of the Hill, Capture the Flag, and Horde Survival. Drop into a fast 9-player skirmish that wraps in about 20 minutes, or commit to an epic siege of 30+ players that can rage for up to two hours.

Game Modes

King of the Hill

Hold the territory. Your gather-craft-build loop runs in parallel with the fight to keep it. The team that works together wins it.

Capture the Flag

Speed and coordination. The siege loop makes running the flag meaningfully harder when the enemy has had time to prepare.

Horde Survival

Three factions, one shared enemy. Coordinate across faction lines or fall together. Playable solo or with others.

PvP modes support up to 30+ players per session. Matchmaking keeps servers populated so you never drop into an empty game.

Feature Highlights

- Three factions with distinct lore, bonuses, stats, and faction-tied class abilities

- Action combat with class ability quickbars: Warrior, Mage, Rogue (more planned)

- Gather wood, stone, and iron from contested resource nodes across the battleground

- Crafting pipeline: siege weapons, consumables, tools, and defensive structures

- Breakable and repairable keeps with persistent structure states per session

- Deployable siege tools: catapults, battering rams, ballistas, spike barriers, ladders

- King of the Hill, Capture the Flag, and Horde Survival modes

- Realm Rank progression: unlock armor sets, equipment, and special abilities as you play

- Session-based: no open world, no daily grind, no pay-to-win

A Work In Progress

The Last Banner is in pre-alpha, built by two people out of Denver, Colorado. What you've read above is our vision, where we're headed and what we're building toward. Features will evolve as we test, learn, and shape the game around what's actually fun. We have a server up and a small community already forming. If you want in on the ground floor, we're accepting applications for early alpha testers.

store_data.about_the_game:
Red Lake is a surreal psychological horror game where your only means of understanding reality is a notebook.

The forest will not let you leave. To go deeper — and finally beneath the surface of the red lake itself — you must seek out its anomalies: objects warped by static, humming with a white noise that drifts between the trees. Find them. Watch them. Write them down.

Key Features:

The notebook. 

Your only tool, and your only interface. There is no HUD. You reveal and document each anomaly by writing about it, by hand, on the page.

A Shifting Reality. 

The forest is unstable. The paths you walked last time may be gone the next — and you may find your own footprints leading somewhere you never went.

A Reactive World — The forest is alive. Almost everything around you responds to what you do — and to what you come to understand.

No Way Out — You are free to wander the eerie woods. Any attempt to leave them is futile.

You are not here for the first time. Will you find her?

store_data.about_the_game:
HELLMUTH is a dark fantasy real-time strategy game set in a world where apothecary orders, industrial factions, and corrupted landscapes struggle for control.

Command your forces in real time, expand your position, gather resources, build structures, and use faction-specific units to survive hostile battlefields. Each map is built around tactical pressure: scouting, positioning, timing, economy management, and the ability to react before the enemy overwhelms you.

The game focuses on readable RTS combat with strong visual faction identity. Apothecary forces use disciplined, botanical and alchemical machinery, while industrial enemies rely on blackened steel, pipes, pressure, and unstable magenta corruption. Battles are designed to be visually distinct, with clear unit silhouettes, atmospheric environments, and faction designs that make every encounter immediately recognizable.

Features include:

  • Real-time strategy gameplay with base building, unit production, and tactical combat

  • Distinct factions with different visual identities, structures, and battlefield roles

  • Resource management and expansion under pressure

  • Hand-crafted maps with varied terrain, chokepoints, water, ruins, industrial zones, and hostile wilderness

  • A grim fantasy-industrial setting built around corruption, survival, and control

  • A strong visual focus on 2D/2.5D RTS readability, faction contrast, and atmospheric worldbuilding

HELLMUTH is currently in active development. The Coming Soon page presents the game’s direction, visual identity, and core RTS foundation as development continues.

store_data.about_the_game:
One number. One gap. A whole storm.

Gap Storm is an original shedding-style card game built on a single, razor-sharp idea: when you beat the card in front of you, the penalty isn't fixed — it's the gap between your number and the last one, multiplied by your combo type. Slam an 8 onto a 3 and the next player who folds draws (8-3)x1. Drop a pair of 9s onto a pair of 3s and that gap becomes (9-3)x2 = a brutal twelve-card storm. Play the smallest winning card and you barely sting them. Every single turn is a live risk/reward calculation.

First to empty their hand wins. Simple to learn in a minute — a lifetime to master.

The mechanics that make it sing

  • Differential penalty draw — singles x1, pairs x2, triple-with-kicker x3. The gap is recalculated every play, never stacked.
  • Bombs — four of a kind beats anything and forces a flat 8-card draw. Bigger bombs crush smaller ones.
  • The 10 steals — every 10 you play yanks a random card from whoever holds the most. Pairs and triples of 10s steal two and three.
  • Event cards — eight chaos cards seeded into the deck flip face-up as a warning, then strike the next player to draw: supply runs, forced swaps, direction reversals, x2 storms and more.
  • Deep house rules — hand size, number range (1-8 to 1-13), cards per number, bomb penalty, event mix, multipliers, match length. Tune it from a 5-minute brawl to a 10-minute strategy duel.

Adventure — a roguelike of rule-breakers

A full single-player run that rivals the deckbuilders you love. Fight through three regions and 17 duels against opponents who each bend the rules in their own way:
  • 10 rule-bending foes — the Hoarder who busts if it floods, the Sniper who doubles single-card gaps, the Oracle who literally reads your hand, and elites who turn your own pairs against you.
  • 3 bosses — the Rhythm King who pumps the penalty every few turns, the Edict Lord who bans single cards, and the Storm Emperor who doubles every multiplier.
  • 26 items + curses — drafted three-at-a-time after each win. Stack relics, gamble on a Legendary that demands a curse, and build a run that breaks the game in your favor.
  • 3 lives & Storm Heat — flat lives keep one bad hand from deleting an hour-long run, and three ascension tiers keep the climb tense long after your first clear.

Modes

  • Classic — 2-4 players. Fill empty seats with three difficulties of AI, or play with friends.
  • Online with friends — host a room and share a 6-digit code; join over LAN, direct connect, or the Steam relay backbone (no port forwarding). Drop-out seats are taken over by AI.
  • Adventure — the solo roguelike above.
  • Interactive tutorial — learn the gap, the bomb and the steal hands-on in two minutes.

Earn everything. Buy nothing.

Over 50 Steam achievements and a deep wardrobe — avatar frames, card backs, card faces, table felts, titles and loot avatars won from the enemies you beat — are 100% earned through play. There are no loot boxes, no battle pass, no pay-to-win, and no FOMO. The price on the store page is the whole game.

Made with love

Juicy, glossy casual art, cute animal avatars, an original ink-wave identity, full English & Simplified Chinese (interface, subtitles and voice), and a deterministic rules engine verified across 220,000+ simulated games for long-run fairness.

Coming after launch: Ranked ladder with seasons, and a Creative Workshop for sharing custom event packs.

  • The 10 steals — every 10 you play yanks a random card from whoever holds the most. Pairs and triples of 10s steal two and three.
  • Event cards — eight chaos cards seeded into the deck flip face-up as a warning, then strike the next player to draw: supply runs, forced swaps, direction reversals, x2 storms and more.
  • Deep house rules — hand size, number range (1-8 to 1-13), cards per number, bomb penalty, event mix, multipliers, match length. Tune it from a 5-minute brawl to a 10-minute strategy duel.

Adventure — a roguelike of rule-breakers

A full single-player run that rivals the deckbuilders you love. Fight through three regions and 17 duels against opponents who each bend the rules in their own way:
  • 10 rule-bending foes — the Hoarder who busts if it floods, the Sniper who doubles single-card gaps, the Oracle who literally reads your hand, and elites who turn your own pairs against you.
  • 3 bosses — the Rhythm King who pumps the penalty every few turns, the Edict Lord who bans single cards, and the Storm Emperor who doubles every multiplier.
  • 26 items + curses — drafted three-at-a-time after each win. Stack relics, gamble on a Legendary that demands a curse, and build a run that breaks the game in your favor.
  • 3 lives & Storm Heat — flat lives keep one bad hand from deleting an hour-long run, and three ascension tiers keep the climb tense long after your first clear.

Modes

  • Classic — 2-4 players. Fill empty seats with three difficulties of AI, or play with friends.
  • Online with friends — host a room and share a 6-digit code; join over LAN, direct connect, or the Steam relay backbone (no port forwarding). Drop-out seats are taken over by AI.
  • Adventure — the solo roguelike above.
  • Interactive tutorial — learn the gap, the bomb and the steal hands-on in two minutes.

Earn everything. Buy nothing.

Over 50 Steam achievements and a deep wardrobe — avatar frames, card backs, card faces, table felts, titles and loot avatars won from the enemies you beat — are 100% earned through play. There are no loot boxes, no battle pass, no pay-to-win, and no FOMO. The price on the store page is the whole game.

Made with love

Juicy, glossy casual art, cute animal avatars, an original ink-wave identity, full English & Simplified Chinese (interface, subtitles and voice), and a deterministic rules engine verified across 220,000+ simulated games for long-run fairness.

Coming after launch: Ranked ladder with seasons, and a Creative Workshop for sharing custom event packs.

Empty your hand across Classic 2–4 player matches and a 17-fight roguelike Adventure of rule-bending bosses. Play AI offline or online with friends. No pay-to-win, ever.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your very own Alpenbahn - an Alpine mountain railroad winding its way through dramatic landscapes inspired by Switzerland, Austria and more.

Instead of painstakingly placing each track tile, this game features an innovative building tool that lets you draw smooth tracks with your mouse. Simply choose the path and the game will effortlessly create the required bridges, viaducts or tunnels. Want to replace the cantilever bridge with a suspension bridge? No problem! Everything can be customized to support your vision of the ideal Alpenbahn.

To start off your model railroad you begin by choosing one of several maps, each representing a slice of Alpine nature featuring challenging yet beautiful terrain. It’s on you to decide whether to shape the land to build the most efficient route or whether to take the slower but maybe more elegant way through the mountains.

Bring your model railroad to life and populate it with a selection of iconic trains, from vintage steam locomotives to modern high speed units. Build train stations to connect your quaint Alpine villages with each other. Finally, enjoy your beautiful creation by hopping on one of your trains and taking in the view from the conductor’s seat.

store_data.about_the_game:
The world has fallen.

Zombie Survival Frontier is a third person open area survival shooter where players explore dangerous wastelands, eliminate infected threats, complete objectives, and travel across hostile territories using a variety of vehicles.

Take control of a survivor armed with powerful weapons and venture into zombie infested zones filled with danger. Fight your way through hordes of infected enemies, secure valuable resources, and push deeper into the frontier as new challenges emerge.

Every mission brings new risks. Every location hides new threats. Survival depends on your aim, strategy, and ability to adapt.

Cities are abandoned, supply routes have collapsed, and vast regions have become overrun by the infected. The remaining survivors are scattered across the frontier, fighting to stay alive in a world consumed by chaos.

FEATURES

Frontline Insertion

Deploy directly into infected territory and begin your mission beyond the last safe zone.

Zombie Combat

Engage in intense third person gunfights against infected enemies. Use a variety of weapons to eliminate threats and survive overwhelming attacks.

Vehicle Exploration

Travel across dangerous regions using abandoned cars, trucks, and other vehicles. Reach new locations and discover hidden areas throughout the frontier.

Open Survival Zones

Explore large environments filled with abandoned structures, hostile monster zombies, and unexpected encounters around every corner.

Vertical Exploration

Climb ladders and elevated structures to reach new areas, gain tactical advantages, and uncover hidden paths across the frontier.

Drive To Survive

Travel across the wasteland using abandoned vehicles. Cover long distances quickly, reach new objectives, and explore dangerous regions beyond the safe zones.

Deadly Zombie Variants

Face different types of infected enemies, each presenting unique challenges that require strategy and firepower to overcome.

The outbreak has already happened. The dead have already taken over. Now there is only one goal left

Survive the rusty desert wasteland.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a third-person 3D Chinese martial arts action RPG centered on jianghu tales, blending lighthearted civic vibes with an undercurrent of suspense.

Game Features

Layered Storytelling

The plot is woven with abundant foreshadowing; only a handful of pivotal choices alter the narrative, while the main quest remains cohesive and complete.

Flexible Dual-Wield System

Equip distinct weapons on left and right hands. Your moves shift based on weapon combinations, offering diverse build options.

Dual-Resource Combat Mechanic

Two separate energy bars serve distinct combat roles: Vital Energy fuels parries, quick evasions and counterattacks for instant defense and offense, while a secondary resource powers martial arts skills. Separated resources grant ample room for skillful play.

Targeted Loot Challenge Dungeons

Pick challenge dungeons freely and preview all potential equipment rewards before entry. Repeated runs yield gear with random stat modifiers, which you can mix and match to craft unique combat builds.

Ideal for players who enjoy Chinese martial arts themes, story-driven single-player games, skill-based combat and customizable equipment builds.

store_data.about_the_game:
A small shop. A stack of broken phones. And inside each one, a life someone never meant for you to see.

Last Seen is a single-player investigation sim about survival, surveillance, and the cost of curiosity. You play Kaan, who loses almost everything in a single night and reopens his late father's phone repair shop just to keep a roof over his head. Then his sister vanishes — leaving behind only her phone, and a message he can't unsee:

"The Light is calling you."

She isn't the first to disappear. She won't be the last.

By Day, You Survive

Run a hands-on phone repair shop. Open the devices, find the fault, replace the parts, and earn enough to keep the lights on. But every phone that crosses your counter is a life pried open — and the data people leave behind is worth far more than the repair.

By Night, You Dig

At your desk, the real work begins. Crack locked screens, recover deleted messages, and trace every lead across the open web — and the deep web, where the answers are buried. Pin the clues to your evidence board, connect the threads, and watch a pattern emerge from the dark.

Key Features

  • Repair & Survive— A tactile phone-repair simulation under constant economic pressure. Rush a job and your reputation pays the price.

  • Extract & Investigate — Break into devices, dig through apps, and recover what people tried to bury.

  • Research the Deep Web — Follow leads across the open and hidden internet. Every search is a balance between curiosity, caution, and knowing when to log off.

  • Solve the Mystery — Build your case on an evidence board where scattered names become the truth.

  • Choices With Weight — Reveal, keep, sell, or bury what you find. There are no clean wins — only the person you become.

  • The Light Watches Back — You watch strangers through their screens. Something is watching you through yours. Dig too deep, and you become the next name that was simply… last seen.

How far will you go to find her — and what will be left of you when you do?

store_data.about_the_game:
Early Access

Arcane Forge is a deep idle RPG in Early Access — fully playable and actively updated. Balancing and details may still shift; your feedback shapes what comes next.

Over the long run, three prestige cycles and 21 pacts await you. Early Access starts with Cycle I — Seal: seven pacts, the endzone The Fallen Empire, and the First Smith as the climax. Cycle II — Awakening and Cycle III — Convergence follow in future updates — included with your purchase.

The smithy of a fallen empire

Your forge was once the heart of a mighty realm. Today: ruins, ash — and the memory of alloys that shaped the world. In Arcane Forge, you rebuild the greatest smithy in fantasy. Progress continues even while you're offline.

Pick actions, gather resources, level skills, and expand production — from wood and coal through ores and alloys to essence, moonstone, and the World Soul. Gold fuels trade, contracts, and upgrades. In the background, workers produce, combat runs, and buildings keep earning — raise how much you gain while away through stewardship and time magic.

Forge, research, fight

  • 15 skills — mining, smithing, magic, alchemy, demonology, time magic, necromancy, runecraft, and more
  • 52 research nodes — new actions, buildings, pacts, and endgame systems
  • 15 buildings — passive production, trade, alchemy lab, rune altar
  • 5 combat zones — five bosses, random dungeon events
  • 8 worker types — automate while you plan ahead
  • 43 forgeable items — weapons and armor with combat and economy bonuses
  • 13 potions & 18 runes — buffs, specialization, endgame power
  • 187 achievements — milestones, bosses, gold economy, hidden surprises

Prestige, pacts & endgame

Strike demonic pacts — reward and risk in one. Master alchemy and runecraft. Forge seven prestige seals, rise stronger from each cycle, and face the First Smith in The Fallen Empire.

More lies ahead:

  • Cycle II — Awakening — beyond the empire: shadow, void, new zones, and tougher trials
  • Cycle III — Convergence — worlds merge, final bosses, ultimate transcendence

At skill level 100: Mastery with three specialization branches per skill — for Grandmaster and Legend Smith ranks.

Features

  • Dark fantasy atmosphere, procedural SFX, 2 music tracks (more to come)
  • Live gold/s display, auto-sell, trade contracts, master workshop
  • Steam achievements & global leaderboards (total XP, prestige speed)
  • Local saves, export/import (.sav)
  • German and English

Who is it for?

For players who want idle and forging games with real depth: many systems, clear progression, a long endgame road — no pay-to-win, no forced timers. Start the forge, let it grow, come back when you're ready.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Play Time: 30 ~ 60 minutes

Gameplay:
Operation is a zombie horror action game where players must survive inside an operation zone overrun by infected creatures.

Players are deployed into a dangerous area after a mysterious outbreak. Inside the zone, they must fight against zombie attacks, complete mission objectives, and survive with limited resources. Explore dark corridors, abandoned buildings, and restricted operation areas while facing the constant threat of the infected.

Situations that may be too dangerous to handle alone can be overcome through cooperation with other players. Cover your teammates, help allies in danger, and work together to complete the mission.

Zombies can appear at any moment. If players let their guard down, they may quickly become surrounded. Even simple movement through the area can become a tense decision between survival and death.

Background:
After an unknown infection incident occurred, the once-controlled operation zone was completely isolated from the outside world.

At first, the situation was believed to be a simple accident. However, as time passed, the abnormal signs became more serious. Communication was lost, personnel inside the area disappeared, and emergency signals were transmitted only in incomplete fragments.

Reports mentioned violent infected individuals, sealed-off areas, and missing survivors. Eventually, the zone was classified as a high-risk area, and everyone remaining inside was presumed dead.

Now, players enter the sealed zone as members of a new operation team. Their mission is to investigate the cause of the infection, recover the remaining clues, and escape alive.

However, the deeper they move into the operation zone, the more they begin to realize that this incident may not have been just a simple outbreak.

Key Features:

  • Tense combat against zombie threats

  • Exploration of dark and horror-themed operation areas

  • Online co-op gameplay

  • Team-based mission objectives

  • Survival with limited resources

  • The truth behind the infection hidden inside a sealed zone

  • A violent and threatening zombie horror atmosphere

Developer’s Note:
Operation was created to deliver the tension of zombie horror and cooperative survival gameplay.

The goal is not only to let players fight zombies, but also to make them feel the pressure of exploring dark spaces, cooperating with teammates, and surviving in a place where danger can appear at any moment.

The game may still have areas that need improvement, but we will continue working on it so that players can feel as if they are truly entering a dangerous operation zone and fighting to survive.

Maru Games hopes to present the fun of zombie horror, survival, and cooperative gameplay through Operation.

Distribution:
If you create videos, screenshots, live streams, or other content related to this game, we would appreciate it if you include the game title, Operation, or the Steam store page link.

This game was developed in a small-scale development environment, so there may be some rough or unfinished parts. If you find any issues while playing or have feedback, your comments will be very helpful for future improvements.

Maru Games is not responsible for any damages caused by the distribution or sharing of videos related to this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb a tower that never stays the same

The Spire reshapes itself every single run : new paths, new foes, new rewards. No two climbs are alike, and every choice on the map is a gamble between essence, healing, danger and treasure. Reach the top once and the real challenge only begins.

Tame the Spirelings

The creatures of this world are the Spirelings , dozens to encounter, recruit, evolve and grow attached to. Build a team of three, deepen your bond, and watch them transform into their stronger forms at the perfect moment.

Your deck is your team

There are no generic cards here. Every move in your deck comes from the Spirelings you've tamed. Teach new moves, forget the dead weight, and sculpt a deck that flows from turn to turn. Each creature is a little engine , your job is to make them sing together.

Five elements, one wheel

Ember, Bloom, Tide, Volt and Umbra each beat one and fall to another. Read the matchup, exploit the advantage, and turn a losing fight around by bringing the right element to the front. Stack burns, poisons, blocks and a dozen other statuses into combos that snowball.

Make it home

Between runs, return to the Den: spend what you earned, unlock permanent upgrades, expand your roster, and set out a little stronger each time. Progress sticks even when a run doesn't.

Push your luck with Ascension

Cleared the Spire? Crank the difficulty. Each Ascension layer piles on new rules and nastier fights for players who want the climb to bite back , all the way to a final, untouchable run.

Features

  • Roguelite deckbuilding where your cards ARE your creatures
  • Dozens of Spirelings to encounter, recruit and evolve
  • A five-element type wheel with deep status-effect combos
  • A procedurally rebuilt Spire a fresh map every run
  • A persistent Den with meta-progression and upgrades
  • Ascension difficulty layers for endless replayability
  • Full controller support and Steam Cloud saves
  • 20 achievements to chase

A cozy world with a dark heart. Tame it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Super Hole is a relaxing first-person simulation game focused on resource gathering, card collecting, production, and trading.

Start with a small Hole and gradually build your own production business. Discover new cards by opening boxes, expand your production areas, collect resources with your Hole, and grow your business through trading.

Gather Resources

Collect resources produced in your production areas using your Hole and store them in your inventory. Upgrade your Hole to gather resources more efficiently and increase your productivity.

Discover New Cards

Purchase boxes and obtain random cards. Each card unlocks new trees, plants, or animals that can be placed in your production areas and help expand your business.

Merge Cards

Combine cards of the same rarity to obtain higher rarity cards. Build a stronger collection and unlock new opportunities as your business grows.

Expand Your Production Areas

Place the trees, plants, and animals you unlock into your production areas. Increase your production capacity, unlock new areas, and fulfill larger customer orders.

Trade With Customers

Meet different customer types and evaluate incoming offers. Accept, reject, or hold orders for later. Make profitable deals and keep your business growing.

Upgrade Your Hole

Invest your earnings into Hole upgrades. Improve your efficiency, collect resources faster, and support your expanding production operation.

Grow Your Business

Discover new cards, produce more resources, expand your production areas, and build an ever-growing trading network. Every investment brings you closer to a larger and more profitable business.

• Unique Hole-based resource gathering system

• Random card opening system

• Card merging and rarity progression

• Tree, plant, and animal-based production

• Customer offers and trading mechanics

• Different customer types

• Area expansion and progression system

• Various Hole upgrades

• Relaxing gameplay at your own pace

A Vampire Survivors-like with a weapon fusion system. Cells have gone rogue. You are the last survivor—grab your weapons and carve a path through endless hordes.

Core Gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
The procedural maze is literally that. You explore a procedurally generated maze while trying to find your way out! Weapons are provided to make the journey easier while monsters roam the mysterious passageways.

A Very Big Maze

Every time you load a new game, you get a new maze, allowing you to replay this game to your heart's content. The maze also shifts periodically where the walls change, which adds an extra level of difficulty while keep the map dynamic and fun. You can select your maze size, smaller mazes to begin with before you work your way up to the most massive of mazes.

Monsters await

Meet a variety of monsters as you venture deeper into the maze. The threat level increases at night and towards the edges of the maze.

Spray Paint

Use a variety of spray paints to mark certain points in the maze to make your escape easier. You can spray paint anywhere, walls, floors and water is provided to wash away unwanted paint.

Experience Real Darkness

This game features a day and night cycle (with the option of day only and night only modes). Realistic lighting is featured, with a selection of flashlights provided to help you make your way during the night. Mobs have glow in the dark eyes, making every turn a spine chilling one.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Meaning of the World's First BCI Romance Game

Keyboard, mouse, controller, voice — everything you express is something you chose. It's a performance. And the character only responds to your performance.

A BCI reads the part you can't control — the part you couldn't hide even if you tried.

And for love, that part is everything.

The deepest thing in love is this: to be seen, without having to perform. "Someone who knows how I truly feel — even when I don't say it, even when I try to hide it." That is one of the deepest longings we have.

A keyboard and mouse can't give you that. Only a BCI can — because only it reads what's involuntary. This is exactly why I wanted to make a romance game with a BCI: to break the line between human and virtual character. An immersive romance. A real one.

A BCI's coarse signal is a tender one:

BCIs have only just come this far — the signal is still coarse. And this flutter of being seen? Coarse is exactly what it needs.

And that's on purpose.

Because what it wants to give you isn't a machine prying every last thought out of your head — that's a thriller, that's horror. What it wants to give you is something else: someone who catches the part of you that you never meant to let her see. You didn't say a word, yet somehow she felt it.

That flutter in your chest was never something you could hide, or ever quite put into words. It's precisely because the signal is coarse — because it's something you can't hold back — that what she sees is the real you.

Your Brain Is the Only Input

This time, there's no controller, no buttons — your brain is everything. And what it can do goes far beyond what you'd imagine:

Focus takes shape. The more intently you gaze at her, the clearer she grows before your eyes; the instant your mind drifts, the world dims with it. For the first time, your attention becomes a force you can see.

A thought can touch. Without lifting a finger or making a sound, with a single thought you can reach out, brush against her, and light up her whole world.

What you can't suppress will betray you. Some stirrings make your heart skip a beat — and the harder you try to press them down, the brighter they burn in her eyes. You can fool yourself, but never your own brain.

Grow still, and two hearts beat as one. As you slow your breath and let your mind go quiet, your heartbeat falls, little by little, into the very same rhythm as hers.

She knows whether you're really here. Not "are you looking at her" — but whether your heart is truly present.

...........................
...........................
...........................

None of this is something you "clicked" or "chose."
All of it, your brain truly did.

What would it feel like — to have a virtual girl truly sense my attention, my emotions, my very presence?

She Is an Artificial Electronic Life, with a Soul

Her mind comes from something real: the brain scan of an actual woman.

A world first — what happens when an artificial life-form feels a real human for the very first time?

She is not a character reciting lines from a script.

She has a true artificial electronic mind — one that stirs because of you, that remembers the things you've done for her, that genuinely responds to every flicker of feeling you let slip.

And all of it unfolds within a story written for you: the script gives her soul its outline, and you are the one who brings her to life.

What she remembers, the one she responds to, is you — no one else.
The way she is with you belongs to you, and you alone.

Not Only Does She Understand You — You Begin to Understand Her

A true meeting of minds was never one-way.

You can feel her heartbeat, the rise and fall of her emotions; with a thought, you can gently touch her and light up her whole world; and as the two of you slowly grow still together, your two hearts gradually beat as one.

This is not you controlling a character — it is two beings, truly feeling each other.

A Boundary, Broken

No keyboard, no mouse, no options in a dialogue box. Only the truest you — and her, feeling you, here and now.

In this moment, the line between "human" and "virtual character" is broken for the very first time. This is no longer a romance you perform. This is a real one.

All You Need Is a BCI

This is a pure brain-computer interface romance experience, requiring the Emotiv EPOC X BCI. Put it on — no keyboard to press, no words to speak. All you have to do is be yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a dark overlord, the last protector of an alliance of evil lords besieged by the merciless armies of light. Across 11 rounds, you must choose whom to save and whom to abandon to the advancing forces of light. Spend your limited resources, build defenses, hire protectors, unleash dark spells, and preserve as many allies as you can before the final battle.

Game Features

  • Choose whom to defend: each round, the forces of good attack two evil lords, but you can save only one.

  • Gather allies for the finale: every rescued lord is sent to the waiting hall and can aid you in the decisive battle.

  • Prepare your defenses before each fight: spend limited resources on defensive structures, buildings that automatically summon servants, repairs, and elite protectors.

  • Command the army of darkness in autobattles with Tower Defense elements: enemies advance along lanes and try to break through to the lord.

  • Hire elite fighters before battle, while ordinary servants emerge from constructed buildings during combat.

  • Fight more than 130 enemy types, each with its own traits and role on the battlefield.

  • Use global spell cards to slow enemies, deal damage, and change the course of battle.

  • Save your spells wisely: between battles, you can obtain only a limited set of cards, and the strongest ones may prove crucial in the finale.

  • Battle across varied maps, from snow-covered mountains to volcanic fields, each with its own enemies and special conditions.

  • Reach the final battle with any lineup: gather a powerful alliance of dark lords, or stand alone against the forces of good.

store_data.about_the_game:
PuzzleVerse is a highly customizable jigsaw puzzle simulation.

PuzzleVerse provides relaxing and comfortable puzzles on your screen - make any customization choice you want.

  • For each Puzzle, connections are generated randomly, and thus each puzzle is unique

  • Pick a size: Whether you are new to puzzling or a puzzle enthusiast, you will enjoy your time, because we have you covered. Choose anything from 10 to 5000 pieces 

  • Pick a cut shape: Ever wanted to puzzle a circular or hexagon shape? Now you can

  • Different cut styles: PuzzleVerse allows you to puzzle unconventional shapes, including cubic ones, or even no classic connectors at all, where piece lines are your only guide

  • Crop a specific image area: If you like an image, but want only the top half of it turned into a puzzle? Just crop it to your liking.

  • Level up to unlock more of the game: The game features a progression system to ease you into the controls and flow, with every level up unlocking bigger challenges

Make your memories a puzzle

Alongside our catalogue of images to choose from and future image packs, PuzzleVerse allows you to load your own image right from your computer into the game. Turn your favourite vacation photo or family pet into a puzzle, while everything stays local and private.

PuzzleVerse launches with a curated list of over 50 images to choose from, and we aim to provide more packs in the future, with some being free based on events.

store_data.about_the_game:
The apocalypse already happened. The only question left: who survives it inside?

In Doomsday Draft, you are a random stranger forced into the last reinforced bunker on Earth. There isn't enough air, food, or space for everyone. Every round, someone gets left outside. And you decide who — together, by arguing, persuading, and betraying.

You draft a character card: profession, age, health, hidden baggage, and skills better left unspoken. A doctor? Indispensable. Unless you're hiding a terminal illness. An ex-soldier sounds reliable — until someone exposes your secret phobia or criminal past. Reveal your cards one at a time, build your legend, catch others in their lies, and vote on who gets sent topside — straight into the ash.

There are no right answers. Only convincing ones.

🔑 Features

  • Pure social deduction — the strongest character doesn't win; the best negotiator does.

  • Character customization — create your own style

  • Built-in voice chat — argue, threaten, and persuade live. No third-party apps: your voice, your emotions, your bluff — all right inside the game.

  • Steam Workshop & custom decks — build your own cards, characters, and entire scenarios in the editor, share them on the Workshop, and download decks made by other players.

  • Sounds & meme videos on cards — attach a funny sound or meme video to any card: every time it's drawn, the whole lobby loses it. Perfect for streams and game nights with friends.

  • Hundreds of cards — professions, traits, diseases, phobias, hidden trump cards, and catastrophes. Every game is a fresh hand.

  • Online party play — join friends or strangers in 4–16 player lobbies.

  • Apocalypse scenarios — nuclear winter, pandemic, invasion, machine uprising. The survival conditions change everything: yesterday's hero is today's dead weight.

  • Dynamic rounds — open votes, exiles, sudden events, and disasters inside the bunker itself.

  • Dark humor and real drama — assemble the perfect crew in five minutes, then personally throw out the one person who could've saved you all.

How many walk in is fixed. How many walk out is up to everyone else.

Note: a game for 4+ friends. There is no single-player mode.

  • Steam Workshop & custom decks — build your own cards, characters, and entire scenarios in the editor, share them on the Workshop, and download decks made by other players.

  • Sounds & meme videos on cards — attach a funny sound or meme video to any card: every time it's drawn, the whole lobby loses it. Perfect for streams and game nights with friends.

  • Hundreds of cards — professions, traits, diseases, phobias, hidden trump cards, and catastrophes. Every game is a fresh hand.

  • Online party play — join friends or strangers in 4–16 player lobbies.

  • Apocalypse scenarios — nuclear winter, pandemic, invasion, machine uprising. The survival conditions change everything: yesterday's hero is today's dead weight.

How many walk in is fixed. How many walk out is up to everyone else.

Note: a game for 4+ friends. There is no single-player mode.

store_data.about_the_game:
When Aoi receives a letter from her grandmother asking for help at the family store, she doesn't hesitate. The shop is small, the shelves need restocking, and the neighbourhood won't sort itself. Ordinary work for an ordinary place. At least while the sun's up.

Yokai Mart is a cozy store management sim about running a convenience store at the edge of the spirit world. Aoi orders stock, fills shelves, and chats with the locals during the day. At night, her grandmother's old friends start showing up. Turns out the store has always meant something to them too.

Keep inventory stocked, place orders, and get to know the people who walk through the door. The daytime regulars have their own small stories, and sometimes what they tell you is more useful than it first seems.

Some nights, not everyone who walks in is exactly human. Each yokai is its own puzzle: they have things they love, things that put them off, and a particular way of being in the world. Figure out what makes them feel at home and the harmony starts to build.

Keep the Notebook.

Everything Aoi learns gets written down. When a yokai visits for the first time, their page unlocks. Check back often and patterns start to emerge: which nights they appear, what they respond to, what a story character mentioned offhand that suddenly makes sense. The notebook never feels finished, which is sort of the point.

Follow the cycle.

Day and night shape everything. Each morning brings three new choices: small decisions with real consequences, some free, some costly, all of them quietly making the store a little more Aoi's own.

The yokai are her grandmother's old friends. Aoi is just learning to become theirs.

store_data.about_the_game:
A fire that never stops dying.

It's called Stick Picker Simulator. You pick up sticks. You feed a fire. That's the joke.

Then the fire starts draining faster than the twigs by your feet can fill it, the night comes in cold, and you realize the only wood worth hauling is the dense hardwood out past the dark — and the longer you're out there, the closer your fire gets to going out.

It's a cozy-looking game about a very uncozy problem: the fire is everything. It's your health bar, your light, your warmth, your save point, and the only thing keeping a frozen town alive. Nothing you ever unlock makes it drain slower. You just get better at feeding it.

The whole game in one sentence

Carry warmth out into the cold and back — before the clock kills you.

Every system is that one tension in a new key:

  • Sweep, don't click. Glide through the twig ring and vacuum up fuel in long, satisfying runs. Go light and fast, or load up and lumber.

  • Push outward. The inner rings get picked clean as the days get colder. By day six, camping by the fire isn't enough — the good wood is deep, and the trip out is a held breath.

  • Tend the coals. Dense hardwood settles into a glowing coal bed that slows the burn — while it lasts. Slow-burn is a thing you keep re-earning, not a thing you buy.

  • Light the dark. Plant torches and flares, carry a lantern, brave frozen ruins and procedural dungeons where the cold itself is the enemy and light is your only answer. No swords. Just you, the dark, and how far you dare to walk.

Build a run. Grow a town. Push deeper.

  • Grow your fire from a Campfire to a roaring Beacon — each tier a bigger warmth ring, a bigger light, and a hungrier clock.

  • Wake a frozen town one building at a time. Survive nights to raise morale, light windows on the horizon, and unlock vendors, perks, and a second shop deep in the cold.

  • Draft dawn favors — a pick-one-of-three card each morning that shapes the run, and is lost when the fire dies. The roguelite character you assemble every life.

  • Find relics in the dark — rare, run-defining wildcards you can only find, never buy. The lantern that floods the void with light. The wraps that laugh at the cold. The relic you'll miss when the next run doesn't draw it.

  • Catalogue blueprints from the deepest caches and craft dependable gear back at the Workshop.

  • Earn Frost — a cross-run currency, minted only by going deep — and spend it on a meta tree that widens what's possible without ever making home safer. Attune to one of three Disciplines (Coldstrider, Pyrekeeper, Warden) and play the build you grew.

Built to be watched

The whole screen tells you how scared to be. A warm pool of firelight against an endless blue-black void — the fire glow, the over-the-shoulder glance, the gutter as it starves. You can read the danger from a thumbnail, which means everyone watching can too.

The promise we don't break

Nothing reduces the fire's drain. Ever. No upgrade, no amount of grinding makes your home fire safer. Everything you earn lets you go harder and farther — never lets you relax. The clock is sacred. That's the entire game.

Features

  • A tense survival loop with a cozy low-poly look and a deadpan sense of humor

  • A single world of concentric rings, frozen ruins, and procedural dungeons to explore

  • A frozen town that wakes building-by-building as you survive

  • Roguelite dawn favors, found-only relics with run-scoped upgrade tiers, craftable blueprints

  • A cross-run Frost meta tree + three attunable Disciplines for the long game

  • Earl, a weary frontier merchant who has opinions about your life choices

  • Single-player. Keyboard. Steam Deck friendly.

  • Save anytime — automatic and manual, resume exactly where you left off.

  • Adjustable difficulty — Cozy, Standard, or Hardcore; change anytime in Options.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sweden, 1986. Three years after the bombs.

You command a small convoy of battered vehicles crossing a frozen Scandinavia. Your crew is hungry, your fuel is low, and every road hides something — desperate refugees, armed gangs, Soviet patrols, or the irradiated ruins of cities that shouldn't have been hit.

A tactical roguelike of convoy survival


Every encounter offers a choice: fight in detailed turn-based vehicle combat — ramming, boarding, flanking through forests — or resolve it abstractly and keep moving. Tactical battles reward skill with captured vehicles and elite crew. Abstract battles save time but cost control. The choice defines your playstyle.

A real map of Scandinavia


107×209 tiles of hand-placed terrain based on real geography. Stockholm is a contested ruin. Göteborg's dockyards still trade. Kalmar glows. Kiruna hoards its secrets in the frozen north. 23 cities, each with their own factions, workshops, and stories to discover.

Systems that reward curiosity


  • Recruit survivors on the road — scouts, mechanics, politicians, hunters — each unlocking new options
  • Discover hidden bunkers, secret enclaves, and forgotten infrastructure through exploration
  • Tune in to radio chatter for cryptic hints about the world
  • Capture and upgrade vehicles at specialized workshops across the map
  • Control cities, garrison them, and defend them against raids
  • Multiple victory paths to discover — the game won't tell you what they are

No hand-holding


No quest markers. No minimap arrows. The game trusts you to read the radio, explore the map, and figure it out. Every playthrough reveals something new.

Built for modding


Every campaign, event, encounter, and balance value is an exposed JSON file. Drop a file in the mod folder — it loads automatically. Write new quest chains, rebalance combat, create factions, or add victory conditions. No code required. Full modding reference included.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aim. Launch. Splash.

AquaDucked! is a cozy physics puzzler with a competitive action streak. Load a rubber duck ball into a cannon, line up your shot, and fire
— then watch it bounce, float, and ride the water on its way to the goal. Part puzzle, part trick-shot, every level is a
little physics sandbox waiting to be solved.

Build the path

You don't just aim — you shape the course. Place tools during planning, then fire and see your plan play out:
  • Hoses blast the duck across gaps with jets of water
  • Trampolines launch it sky-high
  • Slides carve smooth ramps and curves
  • Fans nudge its arc mid-flight
  • Water that actually fills, floats, and overflows
Hit every lightning pole, or guide your duck home to mama — your tools, your route.

270+ levels across 10 worlds

From gentle starters to fiendish multi-tool contraptions, the difficulty curve keeps the "aha!" coming. Earn stars, chase
faster times, and unlock a flock of duck skins as you go.

Build your own — and dive into The Pond

A full in-game level editor lets you design, test, and share your own puzzles. The Pond is the community hub: browse
player-made levels, like and follow your favorite builders, race ghost replays, and climb the leaderboards.

Build together — live

Invite a friend into the editor and design levels side by side in real time: shared cursors, live edits, quick chat, and co-op
playtesting in the same room. Works cross-platform, so your desktop and mobile friends can build together.

Plus: Pin Golf

A relaxing bonus mode — play the duck like a golf ball across sprawling courses, reading wind, sand, and water on your way to the cup.

Hand-painted, top to bottom

Every duck, tool, and horizon is original watercolor art, set to a soft, unhurried soundtrack. Easy to pick up, hard to put
down.

Only issue is…

Mysteries of Terminal Falls…

The story of Terminal Falls is a story of mystery. Where has everyone gone? Why is the town devastated? What signal did the town send? Finding answers won’t be easy. But easy was never your way, was it?

store_data.about_the_game:
■ STORY
Midori, a VTuber, has just moved into a cheap one-room apartment in Tokyo.
Furnished, appliances included, not even a stigmatized property — she was relieved, for a moment.
But then she finds a single letter left on top of the washing machine.
"If anyone is reading this, whatever you do — don't look in the mirror. Leave now."
"If you've already looked into it... you can no longer leave this room."
"But there is one way out."

■ HOW TO PLAY
"Anomaly Search" is a first-person psychological horror game where you must find the "anomalies" hidden within a mirror to escape a cursed room.

  • Wander the room and peer into the mirror to find "differences from reality."

  • If you spot an anomaly → go to sleep in the bed.

  • If there's nothing → leave through the front door.

  • Get this right 8 times in a row to successfully escape.

  • A single wrong answer resets the counter to 0.

■ FEATURES

  • 13 types of anomalies that appear only within the mirror

  • A portable hand mirror you can use to peek anywhere in the room

  • Streaming Phase: pick up hints about anomalies from suggestive chat comments

  • 2 endings: a successful escape, and being consumed by the mirror

  • "All Anomalies Mode" unlocked after clearing: a challenge mode to discover all 13 anomaly types in sequence

  • Japanese / English / Chinese supported

■ ESTIMATED PLAY TIME
First clear: 30 minutes – 1 hour
All endings + All Anomalies Mode: 2–3 hours

■This game is a fan game for Vtuber [Unigreen]. Unigreen Channel 🥦

store_data.about_the_game:
Cryptid Contingent is a challenging rogue-like dungeon crawler about careful resource management and creating unique item builds to become an unstoppable powerhouse.

CONSTRUCT THE PERFECT BUILD

Enemies will often carry items that make them more challenging to defeat. However, defeated enemies will drop any held items, giving you the chance to use them yourself! Unfortunately, your bag has limited space, so you'll quickly begin needing to make hard choices about which items to keep and which ones to leave behind.

HUNDREDS OF UNIQUE ITEMS TO DISCOVER

While some grant simple stat bonus, others make your attacks explode, allow you to replicate yourself, or cause your abilities to charge strikes of lightning for you to unleash!

A BEAUTIFUL HANDCRAFTED WORLD TO EXPLORE

You may often find yourself being mercilessly chased down by a pack of wolves, getting shot at from off-screen, or dying to a golden glove wielding scout. It is in these moments we encourage you to direct your attention towards the luscious environment we've created for you, inspired by the flora and fauna found in the pacific northwest.

UNRAVEL THE SECRETS OF THE FOREST

An enormous creature causes the train in which you were being held captive to crash, and as you trespass deeper into the foliage, you may discover more questions than you do answers.

INSPIRED BY YOUR FAVORITE POPULAR MOBAS

Cryptid Contingent was designed to deliver the mechanical depth of MOBAs in a rogue-like package. Every failed run is an opportunity to learn, and there is much to learn.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Since enemies have access to the same powerful items as yourself, you'll always be facing new challenges that will demand creative solutions and test your skills.

NO HAND HOLDING HERE

Don't let the cute art deceive you! The forest is does not welcome the weak. Only those who spend their time efficiently, learn to exploit opportunity, and attend to details will survive. Many core mechanics in this game are not explicitly explained and are left for you to discover through experimentation and failure.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Neck Ahead is a charming retro-style platformer where you follow Kid Giraffe on a journey toward the heart of the forest, in a wholesome story about friendship and loss. Master precise platforming, experiment with unique mechanics, discover surprising interactions, and befriend a playful cast of characters, as you overcome hand-crafted challenges.

Key Features

  • Create your own platforms

    Pick up Boxers, collectibles that can be deployed at any time to turn into temporary platforms.

  • Combine mechanics in different ways

    Discover how the world's mechanics interact with Kid's boxes.

  • Responsive and expressive movement

    Enjoy tight controls, fluid platforming.

  • Customizable visuals

    Change your colour palette, adjust your post-processing effects, or use random palettes for a new look each level.

  • Accessibility

    For those who just want to enjoy the narrative; options such as infinite jump, no death, and additional checkpoints are available!

Experiment With Your Boxes

Pick up a box collectible, activate it at any time, and use it as a temporary platform to reach places otherwise out of reach.

Discover Interactions

See how your box interacts with the rest of the world, and combine mechanics in unexpected ways.

Pick Your Aesthetics!

Choose your own colour palette and enjoy a clean retro aesthetic in your preferred colours.

Tune The Effects!

Adjust visual effects and fine-tune the look of the game to your liking.
