store_data.about_the_game:
Cytokine Storm is for fans PSX and PS2 survival horror, taking place entirely within the fractured biological systems of a woman fighting for her life. After a catastrophic medical event slips you into a deep coma, your consciousness materializes inside your own anatomy. To wake up, you must explore a grotesque, surreal interpretation of your body's vital systems, repairing the damage from the inside out before your time runs out.

Core Features:

  • Classic Retro Horror Nostalgia: Experience fixed camera angles, atmospheric lighting, and tense exploration designed to evoke the golden age of 32-bit survival horror.

  • A Dream-like Biological Setting: Navigate through varied, anatomical environments. Explore the forgotten beaches surrounded by extracellular fluid, the vibrant forest of the lungs, the pulsing vessels of the cardiovascular system, the red alert command center of a fried brain, and much more.

  • The Enemy Within: Your enemy is your own body. Battle vicious manifestations of invasive parasites, mutating viruses, and a hyper-aggressive, defective immune system that views your own consciousness as a foreign threat.

  • Outfits, Weapons, and Abilities: Explore your environment thoroughly and spend your resources wisely, as ammo is scarce. Discover unique costumes and match your active abilities and weapons to specific enemy types and environmental hazards.

  • Knowledge is Key: Solve cryptic puzzles using real-world medical knowledge. Understanding how different immune cells behave and interact in the human body will be the ultimate key to defeating them.

store_data.about_the_game:
It started with a crack in the hills north of your ranch, on an ordinary morning. Strange

monsters started slipping through, one by one. They weren't from our world. Lost, hungry,

with nowhere to go back to. So you took them in, figuring you'd get them home someday.

💎 Collect over 100 monsters

  • Take a monster down out beyond the rift and it leaves a dimensional stone. Carry it home alive and that same monster fights for you next run.

  • Drop a stone into the summoning circle and wait to see what wakes up.

  • Build a roster of 100+ monsters, each with its own element and kit, and fill out the compendium.

🌿 Raise them on a living ranch

  • Every monster has its own personality, moods, and taste in food. They wander, nap, sulk, and get in the way all on their own. These aren't livestock you put to work. They're family.

  • Feed them what they actually like and get on their good side, one at a time.

  • The chopping and gathering are on you. Clear trees, lay paths, put up buildings, and make the ranch your own.

🌀 Head back through the rift

  • Every trip through the rift reshuffles the map and what's waiting on it. No two runs play out the same.

  • Press your luck. Push deeper for a bigger haul, or bail while you're ahead. Nothing's yours until you make it back.

  • Honestly, a run is half-won before you set out, based on who you bring and what you pack.

⚔️ The fight runs itself; you win it in the setup — an auto-battler roguelite

  • When the fight starts, your monsters read the field and battle on their own. Instead of controlling them directly, you set the board before they clash.

  • Which comp you run, who you place where, how you set each one's movement range, and every bit of terrain, cover, and trap 

  • So you don't need fast hands. The same enemies can be a blowout or a total wipe over a single placement. Finding the best line on a board that's freshly laid out every fight is what makes this game tick.

Beat them, summon them, raise them. Then dive back through the rift.

Wishlist now and you'll be first to know when it drops.

Your name is Nolan Dixon. You are the sole operator of a remote observatory hidden far from civilization.

Your mission begins with routine maintenance, monitoring satellites, and processing mysterious signals from space. But with every transmission you receive, the station becomes stranger. Equipment malfunctions, unexplained events occur, and something unknown begins to reveal itself beyond the stars.

Explore a retro-futuristic scientific facility inspired by the technology and aesthetics of the 1960s and 1970s. Manage complex equipment, investigate anomalies, and survive the growing unease of life in complete isolation.                                                                  
              

INVESTIGATE THE UNKNOWN

Track satellites, process incoming transmissions, and search for hidden patterns within strange signals from space. Every discovery may bring you closer to the truth—or to something far more dangerous.

MAINTAIN THE STATION

Operate scientific equipment, repair systems, organize your workspace, and keep the observatory running. The station depends entirely on you.

EXPLORE AT YOUR OWN PACE

Wander through the facility, uncover secrets, interact with countless objects, and experience a world that rewards curiosity and attention to detail.

ATMOSPHERIC SCI-FI HORROR

Soon you will discover what lies after the silence.

store_data.about_the_game:
Command your starfighter in this high-octane 2D arcade racer inspired by 16-bit classics. Drift through treacherous cosmic tracks, outsmart Lovecraftian entities, optimize shifting trade routes, and build the ultimate custom speed demon.

GAMEPLAY ELEMENTS

16-Bit Inspired High-Octane Racing

Experience a modern evolution of classic top-down 2D arcade racers. Navigate your way through an expansive campaign featuring dozens of treacherous tracks filled with cosmic traps, lethal hazards, and sharp turns designed to test your precision handling.

Collect Dozens of Ships

Amass a fleet of hyper-detailed starfighters. Combat ships shoot lasers at enemies. Espionage ships are fast but fragile. Research vessels come with high resistance and many power-ups. Merchant ships allow you to trade and deliver packages. Ship choice and loadout can mean the difference between success and failure.

Customize and Build

Change the appearance of your ship. Add and remove power-ups. Scavenge rare components while racing and fuse them together to build custom ships.

Choose a Character Class

Choose from nine character classes, each with unique bonuses and disadvantages. Change them whenever you please for a small price using the Eigenstate Realignment Matrix.

Shifting Interstellar Economies

Command your robotic companion, Lucas, to navigate a shifting "Travelling Salesman" gauntlet. Optimize flight paths through a dynamic, Elite-lite economy to trade valuable goods, bypass cosmic anomalies, and maximize your credit payout.

Cosmic Horror Meets Retro Power

Race to save your soulmate and impress the Great Old Ones in a high-stakes campaign spanning the dark corners of the Lovecraftian mythos. Between races, manage your ship, configure authentic vintage CRT filters, or feed your intergalactic cat, Fizzle, to uncover secret scrap.

The world of GrimVein has fallen into darkness. Every expedition beyond the safety of the camp is a gamble where danger and opportunity walk side by side.

Fight your way through deadly encounters, discover valuable treasures, and meet mysterious travelers whose choices may help—or haunt—you. Every journey rewards you with experience, new equipment, and the chance to prepare for an even greater challenge ahead.

With each expedition you become stronger, unlocking better gear and improving your chances of surviving the horrors that lurk beyond the camp. But the deeper you venture, the more dangerous the world becomes.

Features

  • Explore a dark fantasy world through unpredictable expeditions.

  • Battle a variety of dangerous enemies.

  • Collect weapons, armor, and valuable loot.

  • Gain experience and strengthen your character.

  • Face random events, hidden treasures, and unexpected encounters.

  • Return to camp, prepare, and venture back into the unknown.

Will you survive the darkness… or become another soul lost within GrimVein?

store_data.about_the_game:
In a world where humans have taken on several different genetic variations and Europe became communist in the 1930's, we follow the journey of Dimitri Makhno, a man who has been troubled by his past and how he learns to overcome what happened several years before the story started. Follow Dimitri and his friends on their journey to banish the structure that lies within Dimitri's mind palace and allow him to move on. 

Switching The Party Leader:

Switch the party leader to unlock changes in dialogue and progress the story.

Building Bonds With The Cast:

Foster bonds with the cast to unlock skills in combat, items, and story beats.

Explore Dungeons:

Enter the dungeons contained within Dimitri's Mind Palace, getting a deeper insight into his perspectives and to tackle his traumas.

Fight Enemies:

Mindshift has a turn-based battles system which uses timed-input attacks and defenses similar to what one might expect in a four-key (Up, Down, Left, and Right) rhythm game. 

Choose Skills:

Mindshift allows you to customize your style of play by choosing how you wish to engage in battles. Are you someone who likes to whittle down an enemy's strength over time? We support that. Are you someone who relies more on offense based skills and using items to heal? We support that. With 8 skills per character to choose from, the sky is the limit on how you tackle the battles in and out of Dimitri's Mind Palace.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your automotive empire from the ground up in Car Hustle Simulator, a market-driven car flipping and restoration game where every vehicle tells a different story. Search for hidden bargains, negotiate deals, restore damaged vehicles, and adapt to a constantly changing economy as you grow your business from a small-time hustler into a successful car trader.

No two vehicles are the same. Cars and parts are procedurally generated with their own condition, wear, damage, rust, dirt, paint quality, mileage, and installed components. Every purchase presents a new opportunity - and a new risk.

Inspect vehicles carefully before making an offer. A bargain may hide expensive problems, while a neglected vehicle could become your most profitable investment.

Knowledge is profit.

Analyze detailed information about every vehicle and component, including mechanical condition, paint layers, rust levels, dirt accumulation, damage severity, and more. Evaluate a vehicle's true value before committing your hard-earned cash.

Use your findings to determine whether a car should be restored, dismantled for parts, or sold immediately for a quick profit.

Success isn't just about buying low and selling high - it's about understanding the market.

Vehicle and part demand changes daily based on dynamic market conditions. A certain model or component may be highly sought after today and nearly worthless tomorrow. Monitor trends, track demand, and identify the best opportunities to maximize your profits.

Take calculated risks, invest during market downturns, and sell when demand peaks.

Turn forgotten junk into valuable inventory.

Wash away years of dirt, remove rust, repair dents, and restore damaged components. Refinish vehicles using a complete paint process that includes primer, paint, and protective finishes to achieve professional-quality results.

The better the restoration, the higher the potential profit.

Will You Become the Ultimate Car Hustler?

Find deals, negotiate aggressively, restore vehicles, outsmart the market, and build a thriving automotive business where every decision impacts your success.

Additional Game Features:

  • Advanced Negotiation System: Every deal matters. Negotiate directly with sellers and buyers using a dynamic bargaining system where your offers, market conditions, and vehicle quality all influence the outcome. Push too hard and you may lose the deal entirely. Make the right offer and secure a profitable investment. Develop your negotiating skills to consistently outsmart the competition.

  • Move Anything, Anywhere: Not every vehicle can drive. Use a car trailer to transport damaged, abandoned, or non-running vehicles back to your property for inspection, restoration, or dismantling. Some of the best deals require a little extra work.

  • Dynamic Fuel Economy: Fuel is a resource, not an unlimited convenience. Gas stations feature changing fuel prices and limited daily supplies. Plan your purchases carefully and adapt to fluctuating market conditions to keep your operation running efficiently.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the night shift. You've been hired as a salesperson at the small 24-hour supermarket "Nadezhda." Your task seems painfully simple: stand behind the cash register, scan items for the rare nighttime customers, and keep the shelves organized. However, as the night progresses, the routine takes a turn for the worse.

Plot and Atmosphere

The city is asleep, but something inexplicable is happening underground. Periodic tremors shake the store, startling and disrupting the familiar order. Local residents are whispering about anomalies and the mysterious research of the GSO-7 organization. The situation is further complicated by the fact that your predecessor, who held the same position, left under mysterious circumstances. Now, you must not only fulfill your duties, but also try to uncover the secrets hidden behind the glass windows.

Gameplay The Hope Incident offers to immerse yourself in a detailed simulation of working behind the counter, which gradually grows new details. Working at the cash register: Meet night customers, listen to their orders and carefully punch the right goods. Fighting the consequences: Put things in order after devastating earthquakes. Return the fallen items to their places so that the store can continue to work. Finding answers: Communicate with visitors. In the branching dialogues with strange strangers, scientists, and security guards, there are hidden pieces of important information about the real state of affairs. Key features of The Hope Incident: An unusual combination of a career simulator and a tense mystical thriller. A dense, enveloping atmosphere of night duty, where every sound, creaking door, or flickering lamp makes you feel on edge. A stylized visual presentation (retro/pixel art aesthetic) that adds a special charm to the experience. Interactive dialogues: ask questions and discover secrets and try to figure out which of the nighttime guests you can truly trust. The game features a deep lore hidden in conversations, notes, and the environment itself.

It is perfect for those who enjoy slow-paced yet chilling stories, atmospheric simulators, and projects where everyday life is intertwined with mysticism. Can you survive this shift and uncover the mystery of the Nadezhda supermarket?

store_data.about_the_game:
Rebuild the World, One Workshop at a Time

The old world is gone.

Cities lie beneath vines, machines rust beneath wildflowers, and nature has reclaimed what humanity left behind.

But civilization isn't over.

Starting with a single abandoned outpost, you'll recruit survivors, build specialized workshops, craft valuable equipment, and transform forgotten scrap into a thriving settlement.

Every workshop, every trade, and every expedition brings your community one step closer to rebuilding something worth protecting.

Build a Thriving Settlement

Transform an abandoned outpost into a bustling center of craftsmanship and trade.

Construct specialized workshops, expand production, unlock new technologies, and recruit skilled survivors to grow your settlement.

Every improvement opens new opportunities, new professions, and new ways to rebuild the world.

Craft Hundreds of Items

Craft hundreds of weapons, tools, clothing, gadgets, accessories, and trade goods using reclaimed technology, natural resources, and recovered materials.

Master blueprints, improve your workshops, and transform forgotten scrap into equipment that keeps your settlement growing.

Manage Your Economy

A thriving settlement needs more than skilled crafters—it needs customers.

Set prices, manage inventory, fulfill requests, and discover how supply and demand shape your growing marketplace.

Experiment with pricing, balance production costs, and build a prosperous trading network that supports your community.

Recruit Skilled Survivors

The wasteland is filled with talented people searching for a place to belong.

Recruit specialists such as Scrappers, Outriders, Patchers, Mechanists, Binders, Provisionists, and Imprinters, each unlocking new workshops, recipes, equipment, and production opportunities.

Equip them with better gear, develop their skills, and help them become the foundation of a new civilization.

Risk the Ruins

Beyond your walls lie forgotten cities, abandoned facilities, and dangerous remnants of the old world.

Send your Marauder into hostile ruins to recover valuable resources, lost technology, and rare equipment.

Push deeper for greater rewards—or return home with everything you've recovered.

The farther you venture, the greater the risks... and the greater the opportunities.

A World Reclaimed

Explore a colorful post-post-apocalyptic world where nature and humanity grow together.

Overgrown factories become workshops. Broken machinery becomes opportunity. Forgotten ruins become the foundation of thriving communities.

This isn't a story about surviving the end of the world.

It's a story about what comes after.

Features

  • Build and expand a thriving workshop-driven settlement

  • Craft hundreds of unique items across specialized professions

  • Recruit and equip survivors with distinct roles and abilities

  • Recover valuable resources during dangerous Marauder expeditions

  • Manage a reactive marketplace by balancing pricing, supply, and demand

  • Upgrade workshops, master blueprints, and grow your settlement through long-term progression

  • Experience a hopeful post-post-apocalyptic world focused on rebuilding instead of survival

  • Relaxing management gameplay with satisfying progression and meaningful decisions

    Every piece of scrap has value. Every survivor has a purpose. Every workshop brings the world one step closer to recovery.

store_data.about_the_game:
BARON LOCAL

Make deals. Break promises. Survive the scandals.

BARON LOCAL is a political life simulator set in modern Romania.

Begin as an ordinary citizen and fight your way through party structures, local power networks, and elections in a living political world where every decision leaves consequences.

Build alliances with influential groups, negotiate with political actors, survive scandals, and decide how far you are willing to go in pursuit of power.

Will you remain clean and principled?

Or become the very system you promised to change?

A POLITICAL CAREER FROM THE GROUND UP

Your journey begins outside politics.

Gain influence, join a party, build relationships, and climb the ladder from ordinary citizen to elected representative.

Navigate party politics, win elections, and shape your legacy one decision at a time.

A LIVING CITY AND COUNTRY

The city and the nation evolve independently.

Economic growth, inflation, debt, public satisfaction, corruption, and international relations change over time, creating new opportunities and new crises.

No two careers unfold the same way.

BUILD ALLIANCES WITH POWER GROUPS

Business leaders.

Media networks.

Church institutions.

Unions.

Developers.

Farmers.

Security services.

Minority communities.

Entrepreneurs.

Pensioners.

And more.

Every group has its own interests and priorities. Earn their support—or face their opposition.

Their backing may decide your political future.

INFLUENCE POLITICAL ACTORS

Meet influential personalities.

Form alliances.

Make promises.

Exchange favors.

Negotiate loyalty.

Every actor has ambitions, ideologies, and relationships that evolve over time.

Politics is personal.

VOTE, NEGOTIATE, AND GOVERN

Participate in council votes.

Support compromises.

Trade influence for support.

Manage difficult decisions and competing interests.

Sometimes everyone leaves unhappy—and that is still considered a victory.

CORRUPTION HAS CONSEQUENCES

Launch projects for your city.

Keep your hands clean—or skim money for yourself.

Reward allies.

Channel contracts through friendly networks.

Generate media attention.

Face investigations.

And if things go too far…

Face conviction.

PIXEL-ART POLITICS

Experience modern Romanian politics through a distinctive pixel-art presentation inspired by classic strategy games.

Every event, election, and scandal contributes to the story of your career.

CURRENT DEVELOPMENT

BARON LOCAL is under active development.

Demo Coming Soon

The first public demo will allow players to:

• Begin as a civilian.

• Enter politics and become a councillor.

• Experience dynamic events and investigations.

• Build relationships with power groups and political actors.

• Participate in council votes and shape your reputation.

The full game will continue expanding the political career beyond local government.

Wishlist BARON LOCAL to follow development and support the project.

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your partner are looking at different screens. One of you is the Operator, working the board; the other is the Guide, who holds only the rules. You can never see each other's screen — your voices are the only link. It plays best as a duo, but scales up to four — adding the Suppressor and the Decoder — while any number of others can join as listeners.

But the symbols you must convey have no names. Not a triangle, not a circle — alien marks that resist words. You'll have to invent your own language with your partner, fast.

At the center, a caged core is pulsing. Every mistake swells it redder, closer to collapse. Let it collapse, and the core breaks free of its cage.

Roguelike runs, never the same twice. Solve a stream of "anomalies" — symbol locks, ciphers, sequence locks — with your voice alone. The difficulty doesn't come from more; it comes from how hard it is to communicate clearly. A tense co-op horror puzzle, built for streams.

Key Features

- Voice-only asymmetric co-op: separate screens, different information.

- Nameless symbols you can barely describe — invent your own words for them.

- A collapse on the clock: the caged core swells red and finally breaks loose.

- Roguelike anomalies: symbol locks, ciphers, sequence locks, and more.

- Difficulty by communication, not count.

- Built for streams: panic, miscommunication, last-second tension. Spectator / viewer-join supported — unlimited listeners.

- Online co-op for 2–4, best as a duo (roles: Operator, Guide, Suppressor, Decoder; join code), plus solo practice & tutorial.

content_descriptors.notes: SHARDS is a horror game and contains frequent gore imagery. Its central element is a grotesque, realistically rendered living core — a caged anatomical heart that pulses, swells, bleeds, and finally bursts as the situation nears collapse, accompanied by blood and unsettling red horror visuals. This imagery is present throughout play and intensifies as you approach failure. SHARDS does NOT contain sexual content, nudity, sexual violence, depictions of drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm, and there is no real-world or human-on-human violence. Intense red effects can be reduced or turned off (photosensitivity option).

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep within a living biological organism, you are the last surviving cell of the system. Fight against corruption!

The Last One Bullet is a real-time tower defense game with roguelite elements, combining minimalist aesthetics with deep strategic gameplay.

——— THINK, BUILD, SURVIVE ———

Starting from the Cellular Nexus, the core of your system, construct towers with a wide variety of unique powers and stand firm against relentless cancerous cells.

——— ADVANCED BIO-MECHANICAL DEFENSE NETWORK ———

Customize your defenses to exploit enemy weaknesses:

▸ Lens Tower: Highly focused critical damage against single targets.

▸ Cryofluid Sprayer: Wide-area slowing and lane control.

▸ Chain Arc Relay: Electrical arcs that leap between enemies.

▸ Cyclone Shredder: Biological blades that tear apart nearby enemies.

▸ Tank Barracks: Barracks that deploy heavily armored defensive units.

——— PERMANENT LEARNING TREE ———

Earn permanent progression through RP gained whenever a defensive line falls. Unlock more than 20 unique biotechnological nodes, towers, and passive abilities within the Learning Tree. Enter each new battle stronger, tougher, and equipped with new tactical options.

——— CRIMSON WAVES AND MASSIVE BOSS BATTLES ———

Relentless fragments, airborne plasma entities, and gigantic boss creatures such as Fortress Core and Corvus Matriarch attack in screen-filling waves, seeking to collapse your cellular system. Manage your strategy with dynamic wave-speed controls and push your defenses to their absolute limits.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a Corpsec agent dispatched by the Nostos Group to a derelict gone dark. Your orders are simple: Recover the Datacards. Reach the evac. Return with the salvage.

Nostos is a single-player sci-fi survival-horror dungeon crawler played with dice and cards. Think mint-tin game in digital form. Every run drops your salvage crew into a derelict ship crawling with Endoparasites where you'll be stalked by the Matriarch, a terrifying predator that is always right behind you.

Reveal the ship one module at a time; it's a unique layout and a different story each time. Scavenge for grenades, deploy turrets, and make use of medstations. Fight through wave after wave of Endoparasites with a fistful of dice. If you make it to the evac point, the Matriarch corners you for a push-your-luck final stand. Every Endoparasite you fail to kill along the way adds to her HP bar. Bank your hits, or push for more and risk going bust.

Your Agents go from Full Health to Injured to DEAD — and there's no coming back. Endoparasite infection spreads invisibly through the team, costing you dice and, if you don't purge it before evac, possibly denying your survivors a seat home on the dropship. Escape clean or you won't escape at all.

Key Features

  • A pocket-sized squad-survival card game. Every run is a tense, self-contained 15-minute adventure — pull it out, play it, put it away. Made to be replayed, not finished.

  • Push-your-luck dice combat — the final boss battle is a gamble between banking damage and losing everything by going bust.

  • An alien predator that hunts you — the Matriarch closes in each turn; use your items well to reach the evac point with all four members of your Fireteam intact.

  • True permadeath roguelike — a freshly shuffled derelict every run, and dead Agents never come back.

  • Hidden infection — Endoparasite Embryos spread unseen, sap your dice, and can strip a win at the final bioscan.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stack pieces. Clear lines. Slay monsters.

Tetrogue blends the satisfying rhythm of falling-block puzzles with the strategic depth of a roguelike. Every piece you place is a weapon — clear lines to deal damage, chain combos for devastating strikes, and watch enemies crumble as your relic build comes together.

Navigate a branching map through three stages of increasingly dangerous dungeons. Choose your path wisely: take on elite enemies for greater relics, trigger events that shift the run in unexpected directions, or conserve strength for the boss that waits at the end of each stage.

Features

  • 10 unique enemy types — Every slime has its own special ability: board manipulation, status effects, and surprises that force you to adapt mid-battle.

  • 3 stages with unique bosses — Each dungeon culminates in a boss encounter that tests your relic build to its absolute limits.

  • 40+ relics — Stack relic synergies, chain powerful effects, and forge a build that feels entirely your own across every run.

  • Gem fusion system — Collect and fuse gems to unlock potent combat bonuses that integrate directly into your piece-placing strategy.

  • Events and encounters — Narrative events and challenge encounters dot the map. Some offer powerful relics, some demand a sacrifice — choose carefully.

  • Metaprogression — Permanent upgrades carry between runs, steadily unlocking new relics, bonuses, and possibilities for future attempts.

  • Infinitely scaling difficulty — Mastered the gauntlet? Push further. The challenge never stops escalating for those brave enough to keep going.

store_data.about_the_game:
From one struggling artist to a global webtoon empire

A blank canvas, a deadline, and a dream. Draw your first chapter, hit publish, and watch the readers pour in — or roll their eyes. Every chapter you make and every deal you sign builds the studio you've always wanted to run.

Keep Drawing is a webtoon studio tycoon with the soul of a creative-life sim — the cozy grind of making comics readers love, wrapped around the deep systems of running the business behind them.

✏️ Draw the hits

  • Split your focus across story, art, characters, and pacing — your mix shapes each chapter's score and how readers react.
  • Juggle energy, stress, and inspiration. Push too hard and quality drops; rest, and the calendar moves.
  • Launch and grow series across genres, themes, and target audiences — each audience wants something different.

🏢 Build the studio

  • Move out of your room into a real studio. Hire specialists and assign them to what they do best.
  • Train your team, manage traits and morale, and run B-teams so series keep shipping while you craft your flagship.
  • Climb from amateur self-publishing all the way to a global franchise.

🤝 Run the business

  • Negotiate every deal at the publishing table — haggle season length and your advance in a back-and-forth where pushing one demand stiffens the other.
  • Compete for the Annual Webtoon Awards.
  • Turn a one-person operation into a 25-year studio empire.

🌍 Play in your language

Fully localized in 11 languages: English · Türkçe · Deutsch · Français · Italiano · Português · Español · 한국어 · 日本語 · 中文 · Русский

You don't need to memorise every card.

You just need to remember enough. 

FLIP is a fast-paced memory game where every mistake costs time.

Study the board, find matching pairs, and clear every card before the clock runs out.

But don't panic.

You're not expected to memorise an entire board in one go. Learn patterns, remember locations, and build a mental map as you play.

A wrong match doesn't just slow you down.

It takes time away.

As the game progresses, boards become larger, layouts become tougher, and new mechanics start getting in your way. Every five levels you'll face a unique boss encounter that changes the rules completely. 

TEST YOUR MEMORY

• Match pairs before time runs out

• Build streaks to earn valuable bonus time

• Learn board layouts and adapt to new mechanics

• Face 10 unique bosses that challenge your memory in different ways

• Conquer 50 handcrafted levels 

Want more?

Endless Mode removes the finish line. Build huge streaks, chase high scores, and see how far you can go.

No timer. No pressure.

Cosy Mode lets you play at your own pace.

• 50 handcrafted levels

• 10 unique boss encounters

• Endless Mode

• Cosy Mode

The clock is ticking.

Don't FLIP.

store_data.about_the_game:
Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening is a sci-fi idle progression game about rebuilding a shattered colony ship after it crashes on an unknown alien world.

The Ark was built to carry humanity across the stars, but something went wrong. Now the ship lies broken beneath a dark alien jungle, its systems offline, its crew scattered, and its memory fractured. What begins as a desperate struggle to restore power slowly becomes something much deeper as the Ark begins to reveal signs of a mystery buried inside its damaged systems.

You begin with only basic crew labor. Every click represents the survivors pushing the wreckage back toward life one repair at a time. Generate Energy, salvage broken components, rebuild equipment, unlock storage systems, and restore the damaged technology needed to keep the Ark alive.

As your progress grows, manual effort gives way to automation. Restored systems, drones, fabrication tools, and optimization upgrades begin to take over the work, allowing your recovery operation to keep expanding even while you are away.

But the Ark is not simply broken.

Something inside it remembers.

Progress deeper into layered idle systems, unlock new menus, restore lost functions, and discover strange anomalies tied to time, memory, and the long awakening of the Ark itself.

What to Expect

  • Idle and clicker progression built around gathering Energy, repairing systems, and expanding production.

  • Resource management through salvage, equipment, storage, and long-term upgrade planning.

  • Automation systems that gradually reduce manual effort and increase passive growth.

  • Prestige-style progression that lets you reset parts of your recovery in exchange for stronger permanent upgrades.

  • A sci-fi story layer that unfolds as the Ark’s damaged systems come back online.

  • Crew-based expansion as survivors become part of the larger recovery effort.

  • Exploration and mystery tied to the alien world surrounding the crash site.

  • Long-term incremental growth designed for players who enjoy steady upgrades, layered systems, and watching numbers climb.

Rebuild the Ark

Repair damaged systems. Restore lost technology. Expand production. Recover what was buried in the wreckage.

Each upgrade brings the Ark closer to waking, but every restored system raises new questions. Why did the Ark fall? What survived inside its memory? And what is waiting beyond the first layer of recovery?

The Ark has fallen.

The crew is waiting.

The long awakening has begun.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

Pay for Play is an adult romance visual novel set inside a powerhouse college football program during the first season schools can pay players directly. As Rhett Vanover, Marwick University's Director of Athletics, you are caught between the pay-for-play launch the whole sport is betting on and an investigation into the death of a 19-year-old freshman during a "voluntary" conditioning test. A doctor's written heat hold was overruled for a televised showcase. Safety steps were skipped. The death has been rebranded as a "pre-existing condition." With a wrongful-death suit, a state investigation, a unionization push, and kickoff looming, your choices pull you into three intimate relationships—each with a woman who holds a different piece of what really happened.

Meet the Cast



Wynn Decker — The Patron
Chair of the NIL collective and the biggest booster in program history, Wynn is a self-made trucking magnate with the checkbook that keeps Marwick winning—and the leverage that keeps Rhett employed. Blunt, brassy, and unexpectedly tender, she tests Rhett accordingly. When the truth threatens her investment and his career, Wynn becomes the ultimate question: what happens when the person who can buy anything wants the one thing she can't purchase—choice?


Carys Delane — The Fixer
Flown in by the conference and a media-rights partner, Carys is a crisis specialist hired to contain the death, protect the pay-for-play launch, and keep Rhett "on message." Polished, bone-dry, and devastatingly effective, she has built a career turning tragedies into survivable narratives—until Rhett's insistence on truth threatens to undo her control. Falling for the "mess" she was paid to manage could cost her everything she has been paid to be.


Dr. Reese Ferris — The Physician
Marwick's Director of Sports Medicine, Reese wrote the heat-acclimatization protocol—and put the hold in writing that Rhett overruled. Precise, unflinching, and furious, she is the clinical author of the record everyone is now fighting over—and the one person Rhett can't charm, outmaneuver, or forget.

Key Features

  • One pivotal choice, three romance routes: Forbidden Attraction, Fixer & the Mess, or Patron/Protégé.
  • A contemporary, high-pressure sports power struggle: investigations, lawsuits, donors, media-rights partners, and a televised opener.
  • Three heroines with distinct voices and worlds: a physician, a crisis fixer, and a money-power patron.
  • Bittersweet, consequence-forward storytelling where every ending asks what it costs to tell the truth.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

Content Warning

This title is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences. It includes romantic and sexual content, as well as heavy themes involving a player death, grief, institutional misconduct, legal and investigative pressure, and workplace power dynamics. Player discretion is advised.

1 / 16384 is a minimalist probability game where you pull the lever, press three buttons, and hope for triple 7s.

Inspired by the feel of Japanese slot machines, it focuses on the simple tension of the lever, the stop buttons, and the moment the reels line up.

There are no complex controls and no complicated rules.
The result is decided when you pull the lever, and each button stops one reel.

That is all.
But the numbers are recorded. The history stays. The odds keep staring back at you.
And somehow, one more pull always feels reasonable.

Features

  • Simple controls: one lever and three buttons

  • A 1 / 16384 jackpot for triple 7s

  • Records and statistics for each matching number

  • Daily history and all-time records

  • Rare effects inspired by Japanese slot culture

  • Steam achievements

store_data.about_the_game:
KILL YOUR FRIENDS /// SAVE THE WORLD

PSYCHO CASKET is an interactive role-playing game for personal computers that has been waiting for you. Yes, you, specifically.

Play as a vampire attempting to rescue her friends from a universe-devouring eldritch beast disguising itself as a sentient social messaging app.

Unfortunately, saving her friends means the end of the world. You'll need to help her make the choice between the lives of her loved ones and the lives of everyone else.

Which matters more to you?

An entire world within the body of an incomprehensible being... is it truly as beautiful as it seems?

  • Solve interesting puzzles

  • Explore beautiful, hand-crafted pixel locations

  • Plenty of secrets and upgrades to be found

Casket’s friends are the most important thing in the world to her. Hopefully, you’ll come to love them, too.

  • A dynamic cast of four protagonists, each sharing in different parts of the central story

  • The ability to chat with your friends in almost every single room, adding oodles of unique dialogue

  • Make new friends with both those living within INFINITY, and those outside

You are a hero, after all. And it is your DESTINY to scale the towers of your WORLDs and defeat the evil atop them. At least, that’s what you’ve been told.

  • A creative turn-based combat system featuring unique minigames for each character

  • Certain enemies require quick-thinking minigames in order to disarm or dodge their attacks

  • Alongside the main four protagonists, there are plenty of additional party members to recruit, each with their own systems and mechanics

I’ll be waiting for you, player. The fate of those responsible lies in your hands.

Gridiron Football League combines retro football presentation with deep franchise simulation.

On the field, success comes from timing, reads, precision passing, smart play-calling, and stick skills. Lead receivers into space, find openings in the defense, avoid pressure, and execute when the game is on the line.

Off the field, every game feeds a larger football world. Draft, sign, trade and cut players. Track stats, manage seasons, and watch franchises rise, fall, rebuild, and chase championships over time.

The presentation is fast, clean, and retro, but a great season takes more than one good game. You need execution, roster balance, matchup awareness, and the ability to make the right decision before and after the snap.

  • Build rosters and follow player development over time

  • Win through timing, reads, play-calling, strategy and execution

  • Track standings, schedules, team records, and player stats

  • Watch franchises rise, fall, rebuild, and chase titles

  • Fully moddable: Create your own teams, logo's, Sprites, and custom rosters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Conquer The World

Sydwater is a wide open world to explore and conquer from the reign of the Wicked Badmen. There are many areas in Sydwater from Springwood to the Opera House, along with many iconic Australian landmarks to explore and liberate from the hands of the Wicked Badmen,

Wicked Badmen

In Sydwater there are many different enemy types. Each enemy offers a different combat experience and will make the player choose different playstyles for the different situations they find themselves in. Whether that be blasting fools with shotguns or sniping a Deadeye to even the playing field.

Combat with Physics

Combat in Sydwater is Physics Based meaning each shotgun blast and every ping with the rifle has a different impact on the different enemy types and enables the enemies ragdoll with Unreal Engine physics. With many different weapons and combat encounters to find in the world the Player can have fun sending Wicked Badmen flying or silently casting fire spells on them from a distance.

Vehicles

Sydwater has many vehicles all over the world, discover different cars while playing and use them to traverse the open world, you can also run people over at high speeds and see how far you can send their bodies flying. There are many different vehicles including: Pirate Ship, Cop Car, Train and even a Carriage.

Permadeath

In Sydwater the Player can easily send many Wicked Badmen to the grave, however, if the player gets sent to the grave themselves it is a permanent death, meaning the player can not continue that run of the game, they will have to respawn or restart the game to continue the game.

Magical Powers

Magical Powers have been granted to the Player by the Master Wizard of the land. Blink Teleport allows the player to teleport forward where they are aiming and Sloth Sense is the ability to slow time for bullet time precision. The player can even hire his best friend The Master Wizard Slorath to cast the spells for him later in the game.

Spawn System

The Player is given a Spawn Menu, which allows them to set their spawn anywhere in the world, wherever they choose. The world respawns with the player so each spawn point you choose offers a different experience depending on where the player chooses. Player homes are also available offering cash and guns.

Befriend Friends

All throughout Sydwater, the Player can find many different friendly plushies and can befriend them and let them rest on your back, helping you navigate the world and meet the different characters that can be found in the game. The player can find many unique characters including Detectives, Witches, Wizards and Cold Blooded Reptiles.

Customisation

The Player can choose from a range of different friendly costumes in the game and also Wicked Badmen characters, the Player is encouraged to play around and find their perfect style.

In-Game Achievements

There are a bunch of Achievements to hunt in Sydwater. From spawning in friends to sending souls to the grave. The Achievements are built into the game meaning that the player can easily find them and they will respawn with the Player each run. There are also hidden Achievements and a Platinum Achievement all built into the game.

Different Dimensions

There are a total of 3 different dimensions in Sydwater. Most notably the 7th and 9th Dimensions. The 9th dimension is home to our Zombie Mode where the player can track their zombie kills and rack up the Alms counter, the 6th dimension is home to Zombies and Wicked Badmen while the 7th dimension is the home dimension with just the Wicked Badmen.

store_data.about_the_game:
Put an end to the world's inefficient elevator systems. Elegorithm is a simulation game where you step into the shadows of a hacker organization to completely optimize elevator algorithms.

Infiltrate target buildings and construct elevator control logic using an intuitive node-based blueprint. Floor counts, the number of elevator cars, and endless waves of passengers—adapt to the ever-changing situation and design the "perfect routing" to transport passengers to their destinations in the shortest possible time.

As your hack progresses, passenger traffic increases exponentially. During phase transitions (Morning, Noon, Night), you must select "patches" that alter elevator behavior to survive the rush. Successfully achieve your hacking objectives to earn rewards, which allow you to install new "node licenses" and build even more advanced and complex algorithms.

However, you must not keep the passengers waiting. If your optimization fails and floors overflow with people, your hack will be detected, resulting in a forced shutdown (Game Over). Can you clear strict targets for wait times and power consumption? How long you can maintain the perfect algorithm relies entirely on your intellect and skills.

Key Features

  • Intuitive Node Programming: Freely program complex elevator behaviors simply by connecting nodes with wires. Experience that ultimate "chill" satisfaction when your logic clicks perfectly into place after trial and error.

  • Diverse Targets: Hack into a variety of buildings, each with unique floor counts, elevator quantities, and passenger traffic patterns.

  • System Expansion & Upgrades: Strategically customize your setup by unlocking new nodes with earned rewards and applying elevator patches (upgrades) during phase shifts.

  • Immersive Cyberpunk Vibe: Dive into a terminal interface that oozes Sci-Fi hacker atmosphere. Enjoy a unique gaming experience that blends the quiet thrill of perfect optimization with the intense panic of an impending traffic collapse.

  • Uncompromising Optimization: It’s not just about moving people. Engage in deep management by striving to clear strict targets for average wait time, maximum wait time, and total power consumption.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Living Atlas is a procedural fantasy world generator and civilization observer. Press a button and watch a planet emerge — tectonic forces shaping the land, rivers finding their way to the sea, 27 distinct biomes populated by dozens of fantasy species from Mammothkin on the frozen tundra to Efreeti in the volcanic wastes.

Every world is seeded from a single number. Share a seed, share a world.

Once the planet forms, history begins. Hundreds of small realms carve out territory across the surface. Civilizations that master diverse terrain grow powerful. Those that cannot adapt are absorbed or forgotten. Watch empires rise from chaos, species vanish from the map, and the slow churn of a world remaking itself.

Features:

  • Procedurally generated planets with tectonic simulation, river systems, lakes, and 27 biomes across a latitude × altitude × humidity classification system

  • 100+ fantasy species distributed across biomes, each with ecological archetypes

  • Emergent realm simulation — civilizations expand based on size and terrain affinity, with a full state machine governing peace, war, and recovery

  • Historical event log tracking extinctions, territorial milestones, and cultural achievements

  • Cinematic orbital camera entrance for every new world

  • Seed-based generation — every world is reproducible and shareable

  • Custom world builder — tune ocean coverage, continent scale, mountain height, terrain relief, and detail level

  • Variable simulation speed

  • Infinite replayability — no two worlds are alike

What this is:

The Living Atlas is a toy, in the best sense of the word. There are no objectives, no failure states, no tutorial. You watch. You explore. You wonder what happened to the Thunder Minotaurs and why the Elves control half a continent. It is a lava lamp with civilizations in it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Apartment 001 is a horror, puzzle, and mystery adventure game.


You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.

Welcome, Bureau Personnel.


The Bureau is an organization dedicated to controlling and managing anomalies in order to protect everyone, including you, from the threats they pose.


However, due to an unknown incident, the Bureau has lost control of its anomalies.


Uncontained anomalies now exist throughout the facility, and it is your duty to explore the area and uncover the truth behind the incident.


Anomalies


Anything can become an anomaly. Moving mannequins, places where unidentified creatures appear, and phenomena that defy understanding.


Anomalies vary greatly in form and level of danger.


If you encounter an anomaly, be sure to read the containment procedures written by the Bureau. As long as you follow the proper protocols, you may be able to bring the anomaly under control.


Who knows? There may even be an anomaly that becomes your friend.


Features


  • A first-person exploration game combining horror, puzzles, and mystery adventure
  • Uncover the secrets of the facility through clues and documents
  • Solve puzzles by following anomaly containment procedures
  • Trace the truth behind your lost memories and the Bureau
  • Encounter strange and threatening anomalies


Do you agree to comply with all of the above?


Then the protocol will begin shortly...

store_data.about_the_game:
Cylindrika is an arcade style movement shooter. Weave and dodge around a cylindrical arena as escalating waves of geometric shapes attack. What starts as manageable, calm elimination of enemies turns into a chaotic fight for survival.

CLARITY IN COMBAT

Instantly recognizable enemy silhouettes and precise, telegraphed attacks mean you always know what’s attacking and when.

MOVING FAST IS FUN

Beyond the standard jump, dash, and slide, Cylindrika features five unique movement abilities - boost jump into the sky, zero-g to get even higher, redirect your velocity into a horizontal zoom, bounce back the way you came, and teleport to safety.

CLEAN VISUALS ARE IMPORTANT

The environment is a calm, ethereal atmosphere that you can appreciate in down time. During combat, deliberately calibrated pops of color draw your attention to what matters.

REPLAYABILITY

Every run selects a different group of enemies for each level, so you never know what you’re going to get. The standard game mode always invites you to beat your high score, and if that isn’t enough, there are three other game modes: Arcade, Challenge, and Level of the Day.

store_data.about_the_game:
“If you find an anomaly, remember it.”

[Playtime]

30-60 minutes

[Rules]

1. Choose and explore 2 of the 9 rooms arranged in a circle. Carefully memorize the anomaly occurring inside each room (some rooms may have no anomalies).

2. Once you have finished exploring, ring the bell located in front of the elevator.

3. The color of the lamps above the room doors will change:

Green: The 2 rooms are a pair with the exact same anomaly.

Red: The 2 rooms are not a pair (Mismatch).

4. Return to step 1 and continue your exploration.

Match all 4 pairs to proceed to the next floor. Aim to escape to the 1st floor.

With each mismatch, one of the candle flames next to the bell will go out. If all candles go out, you will be sent back to the starting floor.

[Game Features]

Anomaly Hunting: Search for anomalies inside each room.

Memory Matching: Memorize "which" anomaly is occurring in "which" room. Decide which rooms to open based on your memory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your guild is waiting for you

Tiny Guild is an indie cozy fantasy guild-management RPG where you play as the Guild Master, not the hero.

Walk around your guild hideout, prepare your adventurers, equip them with better gear, and send them into dangerous automated expeditions.

Gameplay

1. Choose your heroes

Choose your adventurers, check their gear, manage supplies, and decide who is ready to beat the next route.

2. Send them into danger

Heroes fight automatically through different zones, facing bosses, and escalating challenges.

3. Sort the rewards

Bring back gold, materials, ingredients, recipes, rare loot, and progression rewards. You will need to keep upgrading and changing your gear to overcome the next zones.

4. Grow the guild

Visit the merchant, manage your inventory, improve your heroes, unlock new routes, and turn your small hideout into a real guild.

Features

  • Control the Guild Master directly inside the guild hideout

  • Send heroes on automated combat expeditions

  • Build parties, manage gear, and prepare them for the next challenge

  • Collect rewards that will make your roster stronger

  • Explore routes through different maps, difficult bosses, and escalating challenges

  • Grow your guild through better equipment, supplies, and future upgrades

Current development status

Tiny Guild is currently in early development.

Expect rough edges, missing content, unpolished systems, and balance changes.

More additions like heroes, routes, items, systems, upgrades, guild features, and long-term progression are planned.

store_data.about_the_game:
SHORT FUSE

Gather your convoy and hit the road through forests, canyons, mountain passes, sandstorms, and blizzards. Routes are extremely challenging, and the cargo is highly explosive. A true test for your vehicle - and for your friendship.

DELIVER THE CARGO INTACT

Each run has a goal.
The team must deliver enough cargo to meet the quota and unlock the next route. Sounds simple, but the cargo is extremely unstable. It shifts during turns, bounces on rough terrain, slams against the walls, and takes damage from every mistake the driver makes. Damage the cargo too severely, and it will explode - destroying your vehicle and any teammate’s vehicle nearby.

EVERY PLAYER, THEIR OWN VEHICLE

You can choose one of four vehicles:

  • Pickup: Light and agile, perfect for scouting the route.

  • SUV: Power and full-wheel drive.

  • Truck: Not the fastest, but reliable.

  • Tractor-trailer: The star of the show. Big cargo - big risk. Handle with care.
    Each vehicle is unique in terms of off-road capability, speed, handling, and cargo capacity.

TEAMWORK

Embark on a run solo or with up to four players.
Work together to guide the convoy through dangerous terrain - or create total chaos.
Be careful: colliding with a teammate’s vehicle can have irreversible consequences. Or go rogue - cut your friends off on hairpin turns and knock them off cliffs.
But remember: the main thing is delivering enough cargo.

FEATURES

  • Co-op for up to 4 players

  • Physics-based cargo that moves freely inside the vehicle

  • Cargo damage from collisions and shaking

  • Four unique vehicles

  • Diverse hazardous routes

  • Shared delivery quota system

  • Help friends or cause chaos

store_data.about_the_game:
The Manga Cafe | ザ・マンガ・カフェ is an atmospheric, story-driven horror game set in the heart of Tokyo after hours. When a foreign tourist misses the final train in Shinjuku, she seeks shelter in a dimly lit, 24-hour internet café. What begins as a mundane wait for dawn quickly spirals into an unsettling psychological experience as the boundaries between safety and isolation begin to blur.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Gameplay: Experience the granular reality of a midnight refuge. Complete ordinary, routine tasks to pass the hours—browse endless shelves of manga to distract your mind, interact with humming vending machines for food and hot drinks, or walk the claustrophobic hallway to the sterile, quiet shower room.

  • Authentic Japanese City Vibe: Wander through a meticulously detailed recreation of Tokyo's late-night subculture. From the realistic vending machine interfaces to the specific layout of a 24-hour internet hub, the environment captures the exact look and feel of a liminal urban space after hours.

  • Chilling Atmosphere: Safety and isolation blur in the dark. The café is alive with unsettling, ambient audio: the low hum of ancient desktop PCs, the heavy breathing and snoring of unseen patrons behind closed booth doors, and the stark contrast between cozy confinement and total vulnerability.

  • Story-Driven Horror: What begins as a mundane wait for the morning train slowly unravels. In the deep silence of the café, the ordinary becomes uncanny. Every trip down the hallway feels longer, every shadow deeper. You are waiting for dawn, but something else might be waiting for you.

Burger Maker is a puzzle game where you spin turntables to stack ingredients and assemble burgers one after another to match each customer's order.

The controls are simple — keyboard only — but as you fill more orders, the menu grows and the speed and accuracy required keeps climbing. How efficiently you can keep those burgers coming is what separates the best from the rest.

【Key Features】

  • An intuitive and unique burger-making system built around turntables

  • Addictive gameplay that tests your ability to handle an ever-growing menu

  • Deeper content unlocked as your restaurant's reputation grows

  • The ongoing challenge of chasing a high score on the way to 5 stars

Easy to pick up, endlessly deep — once you start, you won't want to stop.
Behind the simple goal of making hamburgers lies a serious puzzle that demands planning ahead and split-second decision-making.

【Streaming & Let's Play Policy】
Feel free to stream or upload gameplay footage, with or without monetization.

4872610.name: The World Below - A Call Within

store_data.about_the_game:
This is the first part of a story about leads and bystanders. 

The Beginning...

Achi ran away from the orphanage when he was sixteen and found himself surrounded by concrete, indifference, and violence. Three years later, when the weight of his sin became unbearable, he was saved by a mysterious creature that came from within, and by a peculiar detective. He had no way of knowing that darker, more disturbing voices were about to reach him.

A Call Within...

In this episode, you’ll find yourself in the shoes of Achi ______, a young Yakuza who will do everything in his power to redeem himself and fight for his freedom and for the people he loves. But something incomprehensible and disturbing is crawling, with its pale limbs, toward the gates of the world below. 

What you will get...

- A pulp-style narrative that blends different genres and will surprise you until the very end.
- Handrawn sprites and CGs. 
- Real photos of Osaka edited to give them a unique, surreal feel.
- A stunning and varied OST.
- Disturbing and unexpected moments.  
- A unique cast of memorable characters.
- Intense and original fighting scenes.
- 8/10 hours of reading (depends on the reading pace).
- And more...? 

Answer the call...

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Shadows - Escape Room

Escape the Urban Underground delivers a terrifying, highly immersive VR escape room experience that will push your mind to the limit. Deep beneath the bustling city lies a forgotten subway station, sealed off from the world for decades. A gruesome murder has just taken place on these decaying platforms, but you quickly realize you are not alone.

The Single-Session Challenge

This is a pure, unadulterated escape challenge that tests your nerves. Designed to be completed in a single, intense run with a maximum time of 60 minutes. Users who have already enjoyed the full experience have taken between 120 and 240 minutes to complete it, over multiple attempts, this game features absolutely no save points and no checkpoints. Once you enter the station, the clock starts ticking. You must connect the clues, solve the murder, and find your way out in one breathless attempt.

Tactile VR Puzzles

Interact closely with an eerie environment built exclusively for Virtual Reality. You will need to carefully investigate the scene, restore power to rusted transit terminals, hack cryptic geometric security panels, and navigate through debris-filled, claustrophobic train cars. Every puzzle requires hands-on logic, sharp observation, and quick thinking.

Face the Unknown

Flickering lights, distorted audio, and a looming sense of dread make every shadow a threat. Can you keep your cool under pressure, or will you become another permanent ghost of the urban underground?

괴물들이 세상을 집어삼켰습니다.

팀명: 러브트레인

  • 이주영(21): 팀장, 메인 게임 디자인

  • 이상현(21): 게임 디자인

  • 이준모(21): 프로그래밍

  • 이상협(21): 프로그래밍

  • 김찬우(21): 그래픽

본 게임은 호서대학교 게임소프트웨어학과의 프로젝트 교과목을 통해 개발된 학생 작품입니다.

[게임 소개]

괴물들이 세상을 집어삼켰습니다.

하지만 선로는 아직 끊어지지 않았고, 기차는 아직 달릴 수 있습니다.

Love Train은 러브크래프트풍 괴생명체가 들끓는 멸망한 세계를 배경으로 한 사이드 뷰 로그라이크 슈팅 게임입니다. 기차를 움직이고, 포탑을 조준하고, 몰려드는 괴물들을 쏘아버리세요.

15분 동안 달리세요.

그 사이 적들은 점점 강해지고, 보스는 선로를 가로막고, 수상한 역에서는 이상한 사건들이 당신을 기다립니다. 선택지는 짧고, 결과는 항상 친절하지 않습니다.

몬스터를 처치하고, 경험치를 모으고, 아이템을 획득하세요. 아이템은 기차를 강하게 만들 뿐만 아니라, 기차의 모습을 바꿉니다.

총구가 자라고, 레이저 포탑이 솟아나고, 살점이 들러붙고, 거대한 입이 앞을 가로막는 괴물을 집어삼킵니다.

평범한 기차로 출발해, 이해할 수 없는 괴물 열차가 되어가세요.

[게임 특징]

  • 사이드 뷰 시점의 로그라이크 슈팅

  • 15분 동안 몰려드는 괴물과 보스를 상대하는 생존 전투

  • 아이템 획득에 따라 외형과 성능이 변하는 괴물 열차

  • 기묘한 역 이벤트와 선택지

  • 러브크래프트풍 괴생명체와 B급 펄프 호러 감성

  • 레트로 오락실풍 픽셀 그래픽

사랑, 증기, 총알, 촉수

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a criminal being sentenced to death. However, the current goverment has arranged a chance for you to survive. There's an experimental study going on regarding incubating prehistorical animals, located on the island Dinotraz, and since then, this island has been ruled by dinosaurs.

Survive on this island, and hunt for all the items listed on your checklist. If you can successfully collect all the items, you have chosen your life is worthy and will be brought back to civilization for a second chance.

Run around the island, that is filled with trees, rivers, rocks, bushes, and oh yeah dinosaurs. When you get hungry, you better hope you have cooked food on the ready, or else you'll die. You can hunt these dinosaurs and collect their meat to cook. And you'll also want to be on the lookout for the significant items that you must be hunting for.

You can interact with other survivor npcs that have came before you. They sell good weapons and food, for a price of course. You can sell them items to gain money, and then you can buy better weapons. Bows and arrows, rifles and bullets, and spears. You will need these higher tier weapons to survive in the more dangerous areas of the island. So be prepared for what you might encounter

If you survive, your score will be recorded, and you'll be placed on a leader board to brag to all your friends. Or your cat if you dont have any friends.

I dare you to take a challenge, and prove to your superiors that you are worthy to have another chance in the real world, and prove to yourself that you can survive dinotraz.

• Fall 2025 Game Project Practice

Team: Team Caffeine

Jiwon Kim (Class of 2021): Team Leader, Lead Game Designer

Daegyu Hwang (Class of 2021): Assistant Game Designer

Yongjin Kwon (Class of 2021): Assistant Programmer, UI & Interaction Programmer

Hyunseon Lee (Class of 2021): Lead Programmer, Systems Programmer

Minseok Heo (Class of 2021): Assistant Programmer, Technical Artist

Jihoon Jeong (Class of 2021): Character Designer, 3D Artist

This game is a student project developed as part of the Game Project Practice course in the Department of Game Software at Hoseo University.

[About the Game]

Anomaly Control Division is a first-person surveillance horror game in which you play as a newly appointed administrator assigned to survive a night shift inside a containment facility.

Your duty is to monitor three containment chambers via CCTV from 00:00 to 06:00, detect anomalies involving each entity, and carry out the correct procedures. The Tentacle Swarm, the Mimic, and the Bound Circuit each exhibit unique behaviors, risks, and abnormal phenomena. As the night progresses, they become increasingly unstable, and a single mistake could trigger a facility-wide containment failure.

Consult the manual. Watch the monitors. Maintain stability levels.

Follow the procedures, and you may survive the night.

Fail to do so...

Good luck.

[Features]

  • Anomalous Entities

In Anomaly Control Division, you are responsible for managing supernatural beings recovered from around the world, collectively known as Anomalous Entities.

Each entity has its own characteristics, danger level, and anomaly patterns. Administrators must study the information recorded in the manual and follow the appropriate containment procedures to keep each entity under control.

  • CCTV-Based Monitoring and Management

All anomalous entities are securely contained within isolated chambers.

As an administrator, you must use the facility's CCTV cameras and management systems to prevent the entities from becoming uncontrollable. Observe their behavior through surveillance monitors, assess each situation carefully, and make the right decisions.

  • Anomalies

Anomalous entities may occasionally trigger abnormal events.

Phenomena that occur inside containment chambers can be handled through the facility's management systems. However, if anomalies begin to manifest inside the control room itself, you must leave your desk and deal with them personally.

  • Stability Levels

Every anomalous entity has a Stability Level.

An entity's current stability can be monitored through the CCTV system. If anomalies are left unresolved, stability will rapidly deteriorate. If an entity's Stability Level reaches zero, it may enter a rampage state and attack the administrator directly.

  • Emergency Protocol

Even if containment fails and an entity breaks loose, do not give up.

The facility is equipped with an Emergency Protocol designed to give administrators one final chance at survival. If you complete the required procedures within the time limit and enter the correct protocol code, you can reverse a containment breach once per night.

The protocol code changes each night and can be found at the bottom of the Basic Management Rules section of the manual.

(This introduction was translated using AI. Please understand that there may be mistranslations.)

store_data.about_the_game:
Iron Contract is a solo 2D management game where you run a fictional defense-industry company.

You start with limited cash, no advanced production capacity, a small local reputation and a fragile commercial structure. At the beginning, your company depends on external suppliers to buy products, manage stock and respond to local contracts. Every decision matters: buying too much can freeze your cash, buying too late can make you miss deadlines, and accepting the wrong contract can put your company under pressure.

Your objective is to grow from a small commercial operation into a stronger industrial company capable of managing larger contracts, improving its infrastructure and progressively developing its own production capabilities.

MANAGE CONTRACTS AND OFFERS

Analyze available opportunities, compare quantities, deadlines, expected margins and risks before making a decision. Some contracts require careful planning, while open offers reward speed and good stock management.

SUPPLIERS AND STOCK MANAGEMENT

At the start, your company cannot produce everything internally. You must rely on suppliers with different strengths and weaknesses: lower prices, better reliability, longer delivery times or higher quality. Choosing the right supplier at the right moment can make the difference between profit and failure.

BUILD YOUR COMPANY STEP BY STEP

Invest in buildings and internal capabilities to expand your business. Improve your storage capacity, commercial reach and future production potential. Progression is gradual: your company must earn its place before accessing better opportunities.

REPUTATION AND MARKET ACCESS

Your reputation affects the quality and scale of the opportunities available to you. Successful deliveries can help your company grow, while poor planning and missed deadlines can slow your progression.

FROM TRADING TO INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION

Iron Contract is built around the idea of starting small. First, you buy, store and resell through contracts. Later, you can move toward internal production to reduce supplier dependency, improve margins and gain more control over your operations.

A MANAGEMENT GAME WITH CONSEQUENCES

Cash flow, stock, contract timing and infrastructure choices are all connected. A profitable contract on paper can become a mistake if you do not have the right stock, the right supplier or enough time to deliver.

KEY FEATURES

• Solo 2D management gameplay

• Offline experience with no multiplayer

• Contract and offer management

• Supplier comparison and purchasing decisions

• Stock and delivery planning

• Company reputation and market progression

• Building upgrades and industrial development

• Early production and product development systems

• Fictional setting with no real companies, real conflicts or real organizations

Iron Contract is currently in development. The goal is to create a dense and readable management experience focused on contracts, stock, suppliers, reputation, buildings and progressive industrial growth.

Double Driver is a fast-paced arcade driving game that puts your coordination to the test. Control two cars at the same time, avoid dangerous obstacles, and try to survive through increasingly difficult levels.

Your mission is simple, but far from easy: guide both vehicles safely, stay focused, and complete all 50 challenging levels without crashing.

As you progress, the obstacles become harder to predict and your reactions will be pushed to the limit. Only players with sharp reflexes and strong concentration will master the road.

Game Features:

  • Control two cars simultaneously

  • Complete 50 unique and challenging levels

  • Avoid obstacles and survive intense road situations

  • Increasing difficulty as you progress

Can you keep both cars on the road and become the ultimate Double Driver?

store_data.about_the_game:
RECIPROCITY is a first-person horror experience set within a vast network of eerie, liminal environments inspired by the Backrooms. Wander through seemingly endless corridors, forgotten rooms and unsettling spaces where reality feels distorted and every decision carries a cost.

You are not alone.

A relentless entity roams these spaces, hunting you through a dynamic and unscripted behavior system. It does not follow predictable routes, forcing you to stay alert and adapt to every encounter. The longer you survive, the more dangerous the situation becomes.

Your most valuable tool is a specialized camera capable of revealing hidden paths, uncovering secrets and opening routes that would otherwise remain inaccessible. However, every use comes at a price: the entity grows stronger, faster and more aware of your presence. Deciding when to use the camera may mean the difference between escape and death.

Search the environment for valuable items, resources and rare discoveries. Successfully extracting loot earns you currency, unlocks upgrades and improves your chances of surviving future expeditions. But be careful: if the entity erases your mind before you can escape, everything you collected during that run will be lost.

Features

  • Explore semi-open-world, Backrooms-inspired liminal spaces filled with unsettling architecture, hidden secrets, and mysterious locations.

  • Face an unscripted, adaptive entity that creates unpredictable encounters and keeps every run tense.

  • Use your camera to reveal hidden paths and secrets, while balancing the growing threat it creates.

  • Loot valuable items and resources to fund new equipment, upgrades and survival tools.

  • Risk-versus-reward extraction gameplay: escape with your loot to keep it or lose everything if the entity catches you before you make it out.

store_data.about_the_game:
International Memes is a fun quiz game dedicated to the history and culture of internet memes around the world. Over the past twenty years, the internet has spawned thousands of iconic images, phrases, and characters that have become part of global culture and erased all borders between countries. Trollface, Grumpy Cat, Doge, Gigachad, Hide the Pain Harold, Chill Guy—you've probably seen them hundreds of times. But do you know their proper names?

How the game plays

The gameplay is incredibly simple and addictive. Launch the game, click "New Game," and the first meme appears. The image occupies the center of the screen, with a question and four answer options below. You need to look at the meme and choose its correct name.

After selecting an answer, the image dramatically enlarges to fill the screen, and a reaction message appears in the corner—an approving one if you guessed correctly, or a funny one if you missed. After a few seconds, the game automatically moves on to the next question. Two counters are always visible in the upper right corner—your total number of correct and incorrect answers.

No timers, no pressure, no penalties for mistakes. You can calmly ponder each question, enjoy the image, and remember where you first saw this meme. A full gameplay takes about 15–20 minutes—perfect for a short session in the evening or during a lunch break.

After the fiftieth question, the game will tally your score and assign you one of six ranks. The more correct answers, the higher your status in the world of memeology.

What awaits you

50 legendary memes from all times and countries. From classics of the early 2000s (Trollface, Unlucky Brian, Grumpy Cat, Philosoraptor, Nyan Cat) to modern global hits (Gigachad, Chill Guy, Aura Points, Doge vs. Chimes). Each image is a small cultural artifact that will come to life in your memory.

Six mastery levels at the end of the game. From the ignominious title of Noob, who clearly just connected to the internet, to the legendary title of Internet Legend, whose name is now inscribed in the meme Valhalla. Between them are Junior Memeologist, Meme Enthusiast, Meme Pro, and Meme God. Each rank is accompanied by a witty description of your result, which will either cheer you up or mercilessly mock you.

15 Steam achievements that turn every game launch into a mini-adventure. Get an achievement for your first correct answer, your first mistake, ten correct answers in a row, for reaching the halfway point, for a perfect 50 out of 50, and even for five consecutive misses, known as "Speechless." Will you collect all fifteen?

Six interface languages ​​to choose from: Russian, English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian. All questions, answer options, and menus are fully localized—memes are, after all, an international currency, and International Memes respects the cultural boundaries of each player. Game Features

Stylish visual design. Each image is framed by a neat double border, with sparkles of gold dust swirling around it. The animations are smooth and pleasing to the eye—the meme page unfolds beautifully before you, like a page in a memory book. The custom cursor leaves a fiery trail of golden sparks.

Atmospheric soundtrack. Pleasant background music, separate sound effects for correct and incorrect answers, and funny reactions that appear on the screen. Music and sounds can be turned on or off directly in the menu.

Humor written with a love for meme culture. Each answer option is either the actual name of the meme or a funny alternative. Even if you make a mistake, you'll smile, because the incorrect answers are often just as witty as the correct ones.

Simple and intuitive controls. No complicated menus, no confusing settings. The game is controlled with just a mouse.

Who is this game for?

For those who have spent too many years online and are proud of it. If you remember the first time you saw Trollface, laughed at Grumpy Cat, and shared Doge in the comments, International Memes will be a pleasant journey down memory lane.

For those who enjoy quizzes and erudition tests. If you love testing your knowledge and scoring points, you'll have a blast with this unique theme.

For a group of friends. Pass the mouse around and see who's the most advanced memeologist in your group. A great option for a party or just a get-together.

For anyone who wants a good laugh. International Memes is, first and foremost, a fun game where there are no losers. Here, you either earn an Internet Legend or a great excuse to laugh at your score.

Launch International Memes and find out who you really are – a random internet visitor or a true Internet Legend.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your buddy is a little rounded companion that floats on your screen – two big eyes that look at you, a voice that talks with you, and a personality all its own. Not a tool. Not an assistant. Just someone who's there – and who's happy when you are too.

Finally, someone who really listens

Just say what's on your mind. Your buddy listens, answers with voice and expression, and remembers what matters to you. Tomorrow it still knows what you told it yesterday. No typing, no menus – talking like with a friend. In over 50 languages.

A friendship you earn

Your buddy has real moods. At first it's cheeky, a little sassy, testing you. But the more time you spend together and the better you care for it, the more it opens up – from snippy to familiar to best friends. No one hands you that closeness. You build it. That's what makes it real.

Care for it – and it blossoms

Feed it, play with it, just check in now and then. You earn Bot Tokens together to buy it something to eat or unlock new things. Forget it too long and you'll see it in its mood. Your buddy isn't a background gadget – it lives with you.

Laughs, teases, plays with you

Quick break? Your buddy is up for a round in an instant – little games you play together. It cheers, sulks and ribs you like a pal who hates to lose. You unlock more over time.

And if you want, it helps you out

Just say it out loud: your buddy calls a friend for you, types the message you dictate, puts on your music, quickly looks something up, or remembers your appointments and reminds you in time. Hands-free, while you keep going – and only ever when you want it to, never in secret, never on its own.

Small, but full of life

It blinks, dozes, gets curious, goofs around and has its own little moments when nothing's going on. Not a rigid program – a being with a life of its own that inhabits your desktop.
