store_data.about_the_game:
Most games put you inside the MMORPG. This one puts you in the chair behind it. You are the studio, the live team, and the world designer all at once: you build the zones, stock the dungeons, author the loot, set the prices, and open the systems. Then you step back and watch thousands of fully autonomous adventurers move into your world, form parties, grind levels, chase gear, haggle on the auction house, die to your monsters, and if your world is good enough, keep paying the monthly subscriptions that fund everything you do.

It's SimCity meets WoW, with a pinch of RollerCoaster Tycoon: a top down living-world management sim where every subscriber is a simulated player with their own goals, and your job is to build a world worth playing.

The core loop

  • Build the world. Paint terrain, carve zones, lay roads, plant the wilderness, and place the monsters, towns, and points of interest that give your MMO a shape.

  • Stock the content. Author monsters, loot tables, gear, consumables, quests, and gathering nodes. Decide what drops, where, and how rare it is.

  • Run the economy. Open vendors, an auction house, and a flight-path network. Set fares, prices, and policies. Manage the flow of gold so your world stays healthy instead of inflating into chaos.

  • Grow your playerbase. A good world attracts and retains subscribers. Watch the population, the gold economy, and the XP curves, then tune the world to keep adventurers happy and paying.

A world that actually plays itself

The adventurers aren't scenery. Each one is an autonomous agent with a personality built from a weighted blend of player-type drives - the killers, achievers, explorers, socializers, and the gold-obsessed traders. Those drives shape what every adventurer chooses to do moment to moment:

  • Levelers push into tougher zones as they outgrow the easy mobs.

  • Treasure-hunters farm monsters for their most profitable drops.

  • Gatherers learn professions and work resource nodes.

  • Traders buy low and sell high on the auction house.

  • Explorers spend real gold on flight paths to see the far corners of your map.

They form parties, share threat in combat, level up, gear up, go broke, get rich, and occasionally die - all emergently, all driven by the world you built. Click any adventurer to read their thoughts, see their drive profile, inspect their gear and professions, and watch their personal story unfold.

Deep authoring tools

  • Terrain & zones — paint grass, water, roads, and hazard tiles like lava; define polygon zones with their own identity; plant trees and decorate the wilds.

  • Monsters, Dungeons & Spawners — author creatures with stats and loot tables, then place spawners that keep your zones populated. Build intricate dungeons or raids for players to group up and explore in.

  • Classes, Abilities & Gear — design classes, abilities, weapons, armor, and offhands with slots, level requirements, two-handed rules, and combat-stat effects. Every item has a quality tier from common to legendary that drives both its power and its rarity on the avatar.

  • Consumables, materials & quests — potions, crafting materials, gathering nodes, and quest content for your adventurers to chase.

  • Factions & PvP — set up rival factions, balance their populations, and let the conflict play out.

A real, self-correcting economy

Gold isn't a number that only goes up. The simulation models faucets and sinks: monsters mint gold when looted, while vendor purchases, flight fares, and auction deposits drain it back out. Item prices are world-derived from each item's identity and quality, then nudged by live supply and demand. A built-in economy dashboard tracks gold minted vs. burned (with per-source breakdowns), population, wealth leaderboards, and XP rates over time so you can spot inflation, dead content, or a broken market and fix it.

Tune everything

A sandbox tuning layer lets you adjust the rules of your world, and a seeded simulation means you can reproduce and experiment with worlds deterministically. The whole thing runs as a living, self-directed simulation under a stylized, flat illustrated art style - readable, colourful, and built entirely from programmatic visuals and synthesized audio, with a day/night sky cycle overhead.

Genre & style

  • Genre: Management / tycoon / living-world simulation

  • Play style: Single-player, sandbox, endlessly tweakable

  • Vibe: Build-and-observe - set the systems in motion, then watch the consequences ripple through a world of thousands

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you know how to assemble robots?

Humanity was wiped out on Earth by uncontrollable AI combat robots.

Only the descendants of criminals sent ahead to build a city on Mars have survived.

Unlike those content with a stable life on Mars, you lead a spaceship to reclaim Earth.

To build a robot army, you can create combat robots by assembling various robot parts at the repair shop.

You assemble a robot by attaching five different types of parts to eight different body parts.

The metal materials consist of copper alloy, steel alloy, and titanium alloy, each differing in durability, specific gravity, and price.

Each part can be repaired by purchasing raw materials from the black market.

Even during combat, you can board a robot onto the spaceship to perform repairs, recharge, or replace parts, and then sortie again.

Robots can move in walking, flying, diving, and burrowing modes, and each part is specialized for air, water, and land.

To possess special movement abilities, you must attach Jet, Dive, or Drill parts to the back part.

In particular, in diving or burrowing modes, movement is possible while stealthed.

However, you may be detected if the enemy has a detector.

Submerged hostile units can see each other underwater.

If you can see them, you can attack them; if you cannot see them, you cannot attack them.

Each part made of copper alloy, steel alloy, or titanium alloy has different durability and weight, even if they share the same design.

Increased weight increases battery consumption for all actions.

The robot's core part is equipped with a battery; if the core is destroyed or the battery is depleted, the robot becomes uncontrollable.

The robot's battery can be recharged on a spaceship, and if the spaceship's battery is depleted, the robot cannot take off from the planet.

In that case, you must secure emergency power by manually rotating the generator.

Of course, you can increase the automatic charging capacity by upgrading the space battleship's solar panels.

Once you have built a sufficient robot army, you can participate in the Battle for Earth Liberation.

Before joining, you must assess the terrain, secure sufficient batteries, possess superior combat power, and have resources for repairs.

A significant amount of funds is required to build a sufficient combat force.

To secure funds, you can collect scrap metal from the lunar ruins and sell it on the black market.

You can earn a large sum of money by participating in and winning robot duels.

You can receive money from the Mars City Alliance by eliminating pirate robots that have invaded Mars.

When purchasing parts or resources on the black market, you must monitor price fluctuations.

Price fluctuations occur independently for each resource, and the magnitude of these fluctuations increases as the scenario progresses.

Parts in the black market have limited stock, so if you absolutely need them, you must buy them in advance, even if they are expensive.

Also, since a profit margin applies, you cannot receive the same price you paid when selling them, so you must purchase only the parts you truly need.

The enemies establish their formations around space battleships and organize dedicated defense and reconnaissance units.

Since enemies flee when at a disadvantage and cooperate to attack, reconnaissance is crucial.

You can analyze the battle map in advance in the briefing room to gain an advantage in combat.

If there are many mountains, you can use tunnels, and if there is a lot of sea, it is best to move underwater.

The best method is flying, but it consumes battery power extremely quickly.

Diving significantly reduces battery consumption and offers the advantage of stealth.

Tunnels allow you to stealthily infiltrate behind enemy lines, attack targets, and then stealthily exit.

When attacking enemies with melee weapons, you can choose which of the eight parts to attack.

The enemy's weak point is the core, making it the top priority for attack; however, since it has the highest durability, you must examine the enemy's weak point.

Legs provide movement ability, the head provides vision, the arms provide action ability, weapons provide attack ability, and the back provides special abilities.

Since the corresponding ability is lost when each part is destroyed, you must first decide which ability to remove.

Conversely, you can use your arms for defense.

If a shield is equipped, its durability decreases, and you can also defend with a weapon.

You must utilize terrain advantages in combat.

Hills increase defense and attack power.

Streams decrease defense and attack power.

Flying units do not receive terrain advantages.

Submerged units and units underground have high defense.

Incapacitated enemy robots are treated as scrap metal and can be brought back to the space battleship.

Conversely, the enemy can take your disabled robots, dismantle them, and assemble modified robots to attack you.

The ultimate goal of this game is to use a robot army to reclaim Earth, which has been overrun by uncontrollable robots.

The scenario mode consists of a total of three parts, with 10 stages provided in each part.

As the parts progress, the difficulty increases and the scale of the battle map expands significantly.

Since there is no limit on the number of robots you can deploy, you will engage in large-scale battles.

Can you overcome rising prices, enemy AI, insufficient power, and scarce resources to reclaim Earth for humanity?

Humanity was wiped out on Earth by uncontrollable AI combat robots.

store_data.about_the_game:
A massive city has gone dark.

With the power grid collapsed, buildings sit abandoned, traffic has stopped, and valuable resources lie forgotten in dumpsters scattered throughout the metropolis.

Scavenge, recycle, craft, and rebuild as you transform discarded waste into renewable energy infrastructure. Restore power to buildings, then build solar infrastructure that can power the whole city, and watch the city come back to life.

♻️ Explore, Scan & Scavenge Valuable Waste

Not all trash is worthless.

Explore through a sprawling urban environment filled with dark streets. Use scanning tools to inspect dumpsters and identify valuable materials, including electronic waste, glass, chemicals, metals, and other recyclable resources.

Every discovery brings the city one step closer to recovery.

⚙️ Craft Advanced Recycling Technology

Turn recovered waste into powerful new equipment.

Craft and upgrade:

  • Sci-fi waste scanners

  • Futuristic solar panels and energy systems

  • Smart AI-powered sorting dumpsters

  • Resource processing equipment

Improve efficiency, automate collection, and expand your restoration efforts across the city.

☀️ Restore Power Building by Building

Start small.

Install high-tech solar panels on individual buildings using sci-fi hover vehicle and bring electricity back for the dystopian-recovery of the dark city. Watch dark structures illuminate once again as entire neighbourhoods return to life.

🚗 Revive the City's Traffic Network

A city cannot function without movement.

Restore power to gas stations and critical infrastructure to restart traffic systems throughout the metropolis.

As more areas regain power, vehicles return to the roads, and the city begins to feel alive again.

🏭 Build Toward a Fully Powered City

Small solar installations are only the beginning.

Expand your renewable energy network, construct larger power facilities, and create the capacity needed to restore entire districts.

From isolated buildings to a thriving metropolis, every decision contributes to the city's recovery.

🌧️ Relax and Enjoy the Atmosphere

Take your time and enjoy the journey.

Experience cozy weather, peaceful exploration, atmospheric lighting, dynamic day-night cycles, and the satisfying progression of bringing a power lost city back to life.

No combat. No enemies. Just restoration, discovery, and the reward of seeing your impact on the world around you.

store_data.about_the_game:
A chaotic pachinko roguelike where you build absurd combinations of ball effects and watch the board erupt into chain reactions of score, gold, and explosions.

Launch balls into a physics-driven board filled with triggers, upgrades, and evolving objectives. Every run is different as your machine grows more unpredictable — and more powerful.

This is not a precision strategy game. It’s about experimenting with builds, discovering synergies, and watching your setup spiral into controlled chaos.

Key Features

Build your own chaos engine
Collect and combine ball upgrades that stack, chain, and trigger in unexpected ways.

Satisfying physics-driven spectacle
Watch balls bounce, split, explode, and cascade through a constantly shifting board.

Light roguelike structure
Each run offers different upgrades, forcing adaptation rather than perfect planning.

Board objectives that change your priorities
Temporary targets appear during runs, creating new ways to direct your chaos.

Runs that evolve over time
Your machine becomes increasingly unpredictable as effects compound.

About the game

Pachinko Overdrive is designed around emergent chaos rather than heavy optimization. You don’t carefully solve a board — you build a system and watch it go.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wizball blends the chaotic fun of pinball, spinning tops and over the top anime magic systems to create a roguelike where you must master the positioning of your attacks to hit and bounce around a combat arena.

Powerscale tournament:

In this game, you are just a regular child, but as you fight others in the Powerscale Tournament, you get to learn techniques from masters and improve your skills. Your goal is to climb to the top of the brackets, defeating as many enemies you can face, and you will get rewarded with unique and powerful balls.

Synergizing and building:

Each ball has a different property, some are fast, some are big, some burn and some are natural leaders that will guide the other balls to the enemies. Combine different balls to create new strategies each run. And do not worry, game breaking builds and combinations are allowed!

Combat:

Inspired by classic anime fights, you will face many different enemies, from demons to mechs, so you must plan your turn strategically on where to shoot your balls and in what order.

store_data.about_the_game:
The aliens have one demand: WEED. A lot of it. Meet the quota or it's lights out for humanity.

BudMageddon is a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower. Start by clicking a single seedling — and end up running an automated cosmic cannabis operation that prints buds while you're asleep.

Plant → Grow → Harvest. Every harvest pays out Buds, Money, and Leaves. Feed the conversion chain — Leaves into Dry Leaves, then into Fertilizer and Power — and pour it all back into bigger, faster, fatter grows.

⚙️ AUTOMATE EVERYTHING

Hire employees and assign them to stations so the whole pipeline runs itself — even while the game is closed. Come back to a pile of buds.

🚀 PRESTIGE INTO ORBIT

Hit the wall? Cash out for Alien Seeds and restart with permanent upgrades that make every future run faster and juicier.

✨ FEATURES

• Satisfying click-to-idle progression — hands-on early, hands-off later

• A full conversion economy with no fiddly micromanagement

• Offline earnings — progress while you're away

• Employees & automation for every station

• A prestige meta-layer with permanent alien upgrades

• Goal ladder from your first gram to a planet-saving quota

• Pure pixel-art, alien-grow vibes. No fluff, just the grow.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tea Haven is a pixel-art business simulation game inspired by the world of traditional Chinese tea merchants. Starting from a small tea shop, you will process tea, serve customers, earn silver, and gradually build your family’s tea business.

Tea making is at the heart of the game. Different types of tea require different production steps, such as withering, fixation, rolling, oxidation, fermentation, and drying. Your choices during the production process can affect the quality, price, and reputation of your tea.

As your business grows, you will upgrade your shop, buy materials, meet different customers, and build relationships with merchant families from different regions. But this is not only a peaceful business story. Set against a turbulent historical background, your family may face war, donations, regional crises, and difficult moral choices.

Begin with a humble tea shop and create your own tea merchant legacy.

store_data.about_the_game:
AFTERLIFE

Imprisoned in the Palace, Ϗ prepares for inauguration as President of long-dead Letreya Empire. But at inauguration power split occurs within the Council of Apostles. Amid ensuing revolution, the President’s aide Secretarius decides to hide him at secret dimension, praying for only one thing — find reliquary weapon of Letreya and meet someone. Thus, Ϗ falls asleep in the depths of lake at Sidastel's mirror dimension. Until ⸎ wakes Ϗ up...

▯

To whom belongs this dream?

CHRONICLE RESUME

This novel about the most peaceful period Pax Romana in history of exiled arbiter ⸎ and defunct Ϗ tells the story of reunion of entities from Eternity. The Council of Apostles split intersects with Their mysterious problem. Complex relationship of these unequal partners changes with the emergence of a common goal: to find a lost reliquary weapon in the mirrored ruins of Sidastel. Discover their signals, uncover their secrets, relax and enjoy exploring the ruins of dead civilization.

▯

You're the only one who understands me. And that scares me.

OF ETERNITY

▯ Psychological horror, romance, dark fantasy, sci-fi, supernatural, martial arts, and realism based on theories of Our reality.

▯ Hidden dialogues between characters, concealing additional details of the stories. Heed and inquire. They might yet reply.

▯ Over 30 detailed backgrounds with parallax effects and more illustrations.

▯ Over 60,000 words. This novel inspired by pastoral novels and rich in idyllic descriptions of nature and paradoxes.

▯ Something is broking the system, expressing familiar concepts. Do not afraid.

▯ Sidastel is a dead paradise where death is a verb, knowledge is currency, ghosts smoke and drink alcohol, procreation is immortality, and absence of human greed mitigated by elven vices more terrible than death.

▯ Sidastel universe is filled with multitude personalities with their own origins, crises, and tragedies. These are humane and philanthropic elves building utopia in the unpredictable nature ecosystem of Sidastel.

▯ Ancient chronicle describes traditional relationships and reveals the psychology of trust, friendship and love in purest form.

▯ Every detail matters, but threads of causality know no Eternity. Ordinary clerk cannot understand this chronicle. This novel is perfect for those who appreciate complex dark worlds, humanity and exploring the depths of creation to their very essence.

▯ Horses... Horses?

▯ Ancient chronicle, time-worn on the Archive's servers. Nothing unusual. Time get to work... 

▯

You betrayed all of Us.

movies.name: Arcadia Unbound - 公式発表トレーラー

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a traveler who has arrived in a strange, scripted world.

What begins as an ordinary journey soon leads into a growing mystery that threatens the foundations of Arcadia itself. Choose from a cast of starting protagonists, including a formidable Arcadian Knight burdened by a painful past, a traveling stage magician who thrives on unpredictable outcomes, and more to be announced. Uncover long-forgotten secrets and explore a world where every town, forest, and ruin hides stories waiting to be discovered.

Arcadia Unbound is a character-driven tactical JRPG that blends strategic combat, exploration, and narrative adventure into a single immersive experience.

FEATURES

■ An Evolution of the Classic Strategy RPG System

Lead your party through strategic battles that reward planning, positioning, and teamwork. Master each character's strengths and overcome increasingly dangerous threats as your adventure progresses.

Arcadia Unbound introduces the Augmented Continuous Tactical Movement (ACTM) system, evolving on the traditional movement method of classic games. Unlike traditional grid-based tactics games, Arcadia Unbound allows units to move freely across the battlefield within their movement range. Run across bridges, leap over obstacles, navigate elevated terrain, and preview attacks before committing to your actions. If the outcome is not preferable, reset your movement and try navigating to another area, or choose to retreat instead. Players have full freedom to test movement and abilities to ensure optimal use of their character's abilities with least hassle.

Discover more and more unique features of the combat as the game progresses:

  • Class Advancement: Every unit on the battlefield from party members to bosses to generic enemy units have their own class advancement tree. Every class is built with the intention of offering a different play-style, balancing varying strengths and weaknesses across all possible advancement options.

  • Terrain-Based Power-ups: Arcadia Unbound battlefield maps are unique and will contain complex layouts with varying heights and grounds littered with structures to climb over, traverse around, in order to get to your objectives. In addition to that, the game also utilizes an elemental system that allows characters to power up their abilities and skills depending on the terrain of the tile they are standing on. With the right conditions, players might discover their moves transform into a cinematic fire or wind-elemental version of the move with devastating effects. The same remains true for enemy units and bosses, so terrain utilization and map control are key to victory!

■ Discover AURA and Build Meaningful Bonds

No dialogue choices. No predefined responses to select from. Speak naturally using your own words.

Get to know your companions through dynamic conversations, personal stories, and shared adventures. Learn what motivates them, challenge their beliefs, and forge lasting relationships throughout your journey.

Use the AURA Framework to speak to characters during key moments with your own words and expressions.

  • Cinematic Conversation - During pivotal moments of the story, speak out to a character and support them or challenge their beliefs, their actions, and make your voice heard. Characters will react while you speak, may interrupt, and even push back. These may be your only chance to influence the shape of story and bonds, so make every word count! All spoken dialogue are fully voiced by professional voice actors.

  • Deep Dialogue - At towns and hubs, you may find your party members strolling about while winding down from the heat of battle. At towns and hubs, spend time with your companions through Deep Dialogue. Speak to them using your own words, ask questions, revisit past events, and uncover new sides of their personalities through personalized and immersive conversations unique to your journey.

■ Explore the World of Arcadia

Travel across diverse regions filled with unique cultures, mysteries, and hidden discoveries. From quiet villages to forgotten ruins, every location contributes to the larger story unfolding around you.

■ Choices That Shape Your Journey

The people you meet, the questions you ask, and the relationships you build all influence your experience. No two journeys through Arcadia need feel exactly the same.

■ A Story of Mystery and Adventure

Investigate the strange cracks appearing throughout the world and uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to reshape reality itself.

Independent Development

Arcadia Unbound is being independently developed by Apurva Saini, founder of Immersion Games Inc. Game design, writing, programming, gameplay systems, and development of the AURA Framework are led by a single developer in collaboration with talented artists, voice actors, composers, and production partners from around the world.

For a complete list of contributors and project credits, please visit the official website.

movies.name: Three Days, No Words Steam Trailer

store_data.about_the_game:
THREE DAYS, NO WORDS

This first chapter tells the events of Friday, the beginning of a three-day story.

After months of talking online, Dante finally travels to Japan to meet Hana in person.

But things don't go as planned.

Soon after arriving, Hana leaves him alone with Midori: a shy young woman who barely speaks English.

And Dante?

He barely speaks Japanese.

Over the course the day, the two must navigate uncomfortable silences, cultural differences, and the challenge of understanding each other without a common language.

What begins as an awkward situation slowly becomes a story about connection, empathy, and the small moments that can bring people closer together.

Experience

  • Awkward conversations

  • Cultural barriers

  • Late-night walks

  • Vending machines

  • Quiet moments

  • Meaningful choices

  • Connections that don't need many words

Features

  • Pixel-art visual novel presentation

  • Multiple choices and endings

  • Atmospheric Japanese-inspired locations

  • Original sound design

  • Fully voiced dialogue effects

  • Immersive audio experience

  • Short and cozy playtime (20–30 minutes)

Controls

  • Left Mouse Button - Advance dialogue

  • Spacebar - Advance dialogue

Headphones Recommended

Three Days, No Words was designed with immersive audio in mind. For the best experience, play with headphones.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run the busiest warehouse in the realm

A bag of loot bursts open, items scatter across the floor, and a line of impatient customers is already forming. Sort fast, serve faster, and try not to bury yourself in your own inventory.

Organize your way

Every run starts with a flood. Bags burst open and dump loot across your floor: potions, blades, trinkets, junk. During the calm phase you decide where it all goes. There is no correct layout. Build the chest system that makes sense to you, because in a few seconds you will need to find any of it instantly.

Race the patience timers

Then the doors open. Animal customers arrive with orders and a patience timer ticking down over each one. Dash between chests, pull the right items, and hand them over before the timer empties. Fall behind and the line backs up fast.

One greedy armful from disaster

Speed is a trap. Grab too much at once and your items spill across the floor, and anything that hits the ground takes damage. Damaged goods sell for less, and the worst of it sells for nothing. The mayhem is always one greedy armful away.

Every shift is a fresh mess

No two runs play out the same way. The shop reshuffles what comes through the door, and the further you push, the faster and stranger it gets. Unlock new characters who each play differently, and stack run-altering mutators that bend the rules in your favor (or bury you for good). When it all collapses, you go again a little sharper.

Cozy on the outside, frantic on the inside

Under all the scrambling sits a warm, hand-drawn world full of character. Lantern-lit shelves, expressive animal shopkeepers, and a soft storybook palette make the mayhem feel inviting instead of stressful. It looks like a quiet afternoon. It plays like a counter at full rush.

Features

  • Frantic sort-and-serve gameplay that rewards quick thinking

  • Freeform organization: arrange your chests and shelves your way

  • Roguelite runs with unlockable characters and rule-bending mutators

  • A cozy, hand-drawn medieval-fantasy world

  • Full controller support, built with Steam Deck in mind

  • Single-player, with more in the works

Stash Mayhem is in active development. Wishlist now to follow along and get notified at launch.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your inventory is your body.

Your life was perfect. Just you, the forest, and your beautiful rocks.

Then the humans arrived with swords, shields, axes, and a truly unreasonable

amount of confidence.

The Slime Is Looting is a turn-based tactical roguelite RPG about

looting adventurers' equipment, gaining its power, and throwing it directly

back at them.

Absorb the loot

Weapons, armor, boots, shields, potions, and strange trinkets physically float

inside your translucent body. Every item grants passive stats while you carry

it, so your inventory is also your build.

Throw your build away—literally

The slime does not swing swords. That would be undignified.

Grab an item from inside your body and hurl it at an enemy or tactical tile.

Each throw deals damage, can trigger status effects, and costs durability. The

strongest item in your build may also be your best projectile.

Do you keep the shield for its armor, or throw it to finish the fight? Use a

weapon's final durability point, or save it for the boss? Every attack is a tiny

act of inventory management panic.

Dodge on the grid

Enemies telegraph attacks before they land. Move across the tactical grid to

escape the target zone, but stay alert: some enemies attack from range, use

special abilities, summon help, or feint toward your new position.

Digest. Adapt. Grow.

Bad loot is still useful. Digest unwanted items to heal, earn experience, and

permanently improve stats based on the type of gear consumed. Level up to choose

new bonuses, expand your capacity, and become a wonderfully over-equipped blob.

Choose your path

Navigate a procedural route through enemy encounters, elite fights, treasure,

rest sites, shops, mysteries, and bosses. Between battles, gamble items, forge

stronger gear, trade with merchants, and make strange choices in an increasingly

disrespectful forest.

Build a ridiculous slime

Combine item rarities, equipment sets, status effects, cursed bargains,

durability bonuses, critical hits, lifesteal, thorns, speed, armor, and more.

Then chase a better score with flawless fights, efficient turns, valuable loot,

and a final boss victory.

Features

  • A turn-based tactical roguelite where carried gear provides your stats

  • Throw-based combat that turns equipment into limited-durability ammunition

  • A visible inventory floating inside the slime's body

  • Grid movement, telegraphed attacks, dodges, feints, and enemy abilities

  • Procedural paths with combat, elites, treasure, shops, rest sites, mysteries, and bosses

  • Loot digestion for healing, experience, and permanent stat growth

  • Item sets, rarities, status effects, cursed gear, forging, gambling, and merchants

  • Dry slime commentary and an entirely reasonable attachment to beautiful rocks

  • Score chasing, flawless victories, and replayable build crafting

This is not a quest for glory. This is a Slime that loots.

store_data.about_the_game:
This Is Not a Power Fantasy. It's a Reckoning.

The war ended without a winner. Demons didn't defeat mankind they simply outlasted it. Now the remnants of humanity huddle inside Edenholt, the last walled city left standing on a broken continent. No reinforcements are coming. No hero from a prophecy is on the way.

Only you.

You are Solenne, a demon hunter who carries something far more dangerous than a weapon. You carry Ars, a rare and ancient power that reaches inside ordinary people and pulls out something extraordinary. Soldiers become warriors. Wanderers become legends. And the four demons standing between humanity and extinction?

They should have killed you first.

Four Demons. Four Places.

The war ended. They didn't leave. Scattered across the lands, each ruling their places like a god:

Malachar - The ogre-demon of staggering size who drove through pure destruction.

Vethara - The necromancer demon who raises the dead from ancient ruins.

Korroth - The demon warrior who ready to take down all humans.

Seravyn - The swordsman demon with just a blade and the silence everyone.

You take them down one by one. You take them down by upgrading every possible you can prepared.

Build the Last City Worth Saving

Edenholt is not just a base — it's a living, breathing community that grows with every decision you make. Six buildings. Six lifelines. Every upgrade changes what's possible.

The Campfire - Finn keeps the fire burning and the intelligence flowing. Upgrade it to unlock better roster management and stronger unit synergies.

The Tavern - Nessa knows where the capable people are hiding. Upgrade it to recruit rarer, more powerful mercenaries.

The Blacksmith - Owen forges equipment from the materials you bring back. Three tiers of gear, set bonuses, and six legendary unique pieces that change how you play.

The Market - Clara turns raw materials into gold and gold into leverage. The economy of survival runs through here.

The Pharmacist - Elias keeps your fighters alive between battles. Healing items, consumables, and compounds you won't find anywhere else.

The Training Ground - Roland makes everyone better. Upgrade it and your entire party fights smarter, hits harder, and survives longer.

Every building you upgrade is a statement: Edenholt will not fall on your watch.

The Ars System - Power Has to Be Earned

Forget experience points. In Arsica, growth is the Power of Ars.

Ars - earned from every battle, every demon slain, every risk taken - is spent on deep, branching skill trees that are unique to every character in your roster. Solenne has her own path. Each of your seven available mercenaries has theirs. No two playthroughs unlock the same combination.

Choose passive combat buffs. Choose stat evolutions. Choose abilities that redefine what your team is capable of.

Every point of Ars you spend is a permanent, irreversible investment. Choose all of it!

Turn-Based Combat That Actually Requires Thought

Arsica doesn't let you brute-force your way through. With a dynamic TurnOrderBar showing you exactly what's coming and when, every decision carries weight.

Position your party of up to 3 fighters - Solenne and two mercenaries - each with distinct roles, stats, and skill sets.

React to enemy that shifts behavior based on HP thresholds and battlefield conditions.

Time your skills, guard turns, and resource spending around a turn queue that rewards reading the fight, not just throwing power at it.

Watch battles unfold with animated formations, damage popups, and combat feedback designed to make every hit feel earned.

Regular enemies are dangerous. The four demon bosses are a different category entirely.

Craft. Gear. Dominate.

Every piece of equipment in Arsica is either earned or made. Drop materials from enemies. Combine them at Owen's forge. Build gear sets that do more than add stats - they transform your strategy.

Multiple equipment sets spanning three distinct power tiers, each with multi-piece set bonuses that reward commitment.

Collect endgame unique pieces with passive effects that bend the rules of combat.

Many material drops, each with their own independent drop chance - farm the enemy that has what you need, or chase the rare roll.

Recipes that gate progress meaningfully - you can't skip straight to endgame. You have to build toward it.

A World That Breathes Between Battles

Arsica lives on a day/night cycle that matters. Enemies respawn with each new cycle. Territories stay dangerous. The pressure never fully lifts.

But the four demons? Once they fall, they stay dead. Every boss kill is a permanent change to the world — a territory reclaimed, a resource unlocked, a shadow lifted.

The Question Arsica Asks

Not "are you powerful enough?"

Every hero thinks they're powerful enough.

Arsica asks: "Are you prepared enough?"

Because the lands don't care about your confidence. The demons don't respect your determination. What they respond to - the only thing that breaks them - is a hunter who studied the fight before stepping into it. Who upgraded the right building at the right time. Who spent Ars on the skill that mattered. Who brought the mercenary the moment called for.

That hunter is Solenne.

Whether she's ready depends entirely on you.

Arsica — She is not here to survive. She is here to end it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend Your Treasure

Hordes of magical creatures, drawn by the lure of gold, relentlessly descend upon your kingdom.

Protect your treasure by defending multiple strategic locations and prevent enemies from reaching your gold reserves. Because when they do, they don't simply pass through — they plunder your wealth.

Find the perfect balance between spending and saving.

Monsters are drawn to gold and will ignore everything else as long as some remains in your treasure.

But when the last coin disappears... you become their next target.

Purchase Powerful Upgrades

Between waves, visit the wandering merchant to prepare your defenses.

Unlock new spells, upgrade your abilities, equip powerful artifacts, and build devastating traps to repel the invaders.

Choose the playstyle that suits you:

  • Become a destructive mage capable of annihilating entire armies.

  • Build a network of deadly traps and let your defenses do the work.

  • Combine spells, equipment, and traps to create devastating synergies.

Every run is a new opportunity to experiment.

Choose Between Good and Evil

The end of the world is approaching, and the villagers know their days are numbered.

Save their souls and they will serve you in the afterlife as loyal helpers, repairing your traps, carrying your gold, and assisting your defenses.

But villagers are fragile, and your devastating spells don't always distinguish friend from foe.

Sacrifice their souls for immediate power and grow ever stronger... at the cost of your humanity.

Souls never forget.

Will you become a benevolent mage protecting the innocent, or a ruthless sorcerer willing to sacrifice everything to survive?

Embrace Randomness

No two runs are ever the same.

Explore procedurally generated worlds, adapt to their geography, and use their unique features to survive longer and longer.

Every merchant, upgrade, enemy, and opportunity is randomly generated, offering near endless replayability.

Collect the souls you save or condemn to unlock permanent upgrades between runs and push your limits even further.

Share your world seeds with friends and challenge them to survive the most unforgiving maps.

At a Glance

  • Defend your treasure against endless waves of enemies.

  • Save or sacrifice villagers to shape your destiny.

  • Build traps and create devastating synergies.

  • Unlock new spells and equipment every run.

  • Explore procedurally generated worlds.

  • Share your seeds with friends and compare your performances.

  • Progress through permanent upgrades between runs.

A fantasy idle RPG. Build a hero party and let auto-battles do the fighting. Farm gear and crafting materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize your own powerful equipment. Idle to auto-farm stages while the game is running and grow stronger with every battle.

Camp & Conquer is a fantasy idle RPG. Pitch your camp on the frontier, recruit heroes, let auto-battles fight for you, farm gear and materials, and craft and customize your own powerful equipment as you claim the land piece by piece.

· Fully automatic combat: battles resolve on their own, so you focus on team-building and progression.

· Idle farming: set a cleared stage to auto-repeat and pile up gear and crafting materials.

· Camp management: build and upgrade your camp to unlock bonuses and steady output.

· Endgame tower: after the main story, take on the auto-climbing tower for stronger gear and rare materials.

store_data.about_the_game:
Be the Light you Wish to See in the World

The world of Cult of the Red Heifer takes place in a dystopia. The media and government are controlled by a fanatical cult who seek to create a perfect Red Heifer in hopes of bringing the end times. As the roads of America begin to resemble that of Bosnia, the cult uses the United States as its personal piggy bank, siphoning out billions upon billions of dollars for use in their project.

What is the Cult?

The Cult is all powerful and cares nothing for the people they rule over, seeing them only as a resource to squeeze more money out from. The cult's members are diverse, however they all share a general indifference towards the suffering of the regular folk of the USA and a rabid support for their project in the Holy Land.

Who is the Firestarter?

The cult controls the people by pitting them against each other. Using their control over the history textbooks and the media they fearmonger against foreign enemies while omitting genocides favored nations have committed. 

Growing up, the Firestarter was promised if they just worked hard everything would work out for them, and the people in enemy countries hated friendly nations because they were backwards, irrational, and obsessed with the past, unable to see the system the young Firestarter grew up in was the greatest system. 

Yet as the Firestarter entered their adult life, they discovered everything they had been told was a lie. "You will prosper as long as you work hard," was not the truth, but instead a cudgel. The real ideology was "those who are not prospering are lazy." And once the Firestarter discovered the true history the cult had been suppressing they learned the grievances of "the aggressive, hate filled enemy" were quite reasonable.

The Game Begins

Be the Light you Wish to See in the World

The world of Cult of the Red Heifer takes place in a dystopia. The media and government are controlled by a fanatical cult who seek to create a perfect Red Heifer in hopes of bringing the end times. As the roads of America begin to resemble that of Bosnia, the cult uses the United States as its personal piggy bank, siphoning out billions upon billions of dollars for use in their project.

What is the Cult?

The Cult is all powerful and cares nothing for the people they rule over, seeing them only as a resource to squeeze more money out from. The cult's members are diverse, however they all share a general indifference towards the suffering of the regular folk of the USA and a rabid support for their project in the Holy Land.

Who is the Firestarter?

The cult controls the people by pitting them against each other. Using their control over the history textbooks and the media they fearmonger against foreign enemies while omitting genocides favored nations have committed. 

Growing up, the Firestarter was promised if they just worked hard everything would work out for them, and the people in enemy countries hated friendly nations because they were backwards, irrational, and obsessed with the past, unable to see the system the young Firestarter grew up in was the greatest system. 

Yet as the Firestarter entered their adult life, they discovered everything they had been told was a lie. "You will prosper as long as you work hard," was not the truth, but instead a cudgel. store_data.about_the_game:
FACTORY I is a minimalist simulation game that strips away visual clutter and unnecessary decoration, focusing purely on the core joy of factory building and optimization.

Instead of flashy graphics, you’ll experience a clean, intuitive interface that’s easy on the eyes—letting you fully concentrate on what matters: gathering resources, designing perfect production lines, and pushing efficiency to its absolute limits.

Start simple, then scale up.

Mine resources, process them through primary, secondary, and even tertiary production stages, and challenge yourself to build the most efficient system possible using straightforward yet powerful facilities.

Unlike other factory games, you won’t get lost in complex visuals or overwhelming UI.

All you need is:

  • Press ‘O’ to change output direction

  • Press ‘U’ to upgrade

  • Press ‘H’ to check recipes

  • Press ‘E’ to switch production targets

  • Press 'WASD' to move location

  • Press 'SPACE' to install

That’s it.

No distractions. Just pure optimization.

Now Feeling frustrated by bottlenecks?

Good.

Solve them.

Refine your production lines, eliminate inefficiencies, and maximize value like never before.

Build smarter. Optimize harder. Create the ultimate factory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sometimes, reality isn't what you see.

Years after the closure of Vefa Health Center, the abandoned hospital still hides unexplained deaths, missing patient files, and unfinished investigations. Official reports claim the facility was shut down due to technical reasons, yet rumors about what truly happened inside have never disappeared.

Is everything you witness real...

Or is the hospital showing you exactly what it wants you to see?

MUSKA is an atmospheric Short Horror Game and psychological horror experience inspired by Turkish paranormal folklore, black magic, and ancient supernatural beliefs.

As you explore the abandoned hospital, you will examine patient reports, forgotten newspapers, security records, and audio recordings left behind by the late Dr. Emir, slowly uncovering the horrifying truth hidden within its walls.

At first, everything appears to be psychological.

Insomnia.

Hallucinations.

Broken minds.

But as you progress, you begin to realize that something far darker is at work.

Scattered throughout the hospital are seven mysterious amulets.

They appear to be your only hope.

Each one brings you closer to the truth...

Or so you believe.

No weapons.

No combat.

No chase sequences.

MUSKA focuses on psychological tension, oppressive atmosphere, unsettling silence, and environmental storytelling rather than constant jump scares. Every corridor, every room, every document, and every recording reveals another piece of the mystery.

Every document uncovers a new clue...

Every recording raises new questions...

And every step brings you closer to a point of no return.

Features

• Original story inspired by Turkish paranormal folklore

• Atmospheric Short Horror Game experience

• Psychological horror driven by environmental storytelling

• Explore an abandoned hospital filled with hidden secrets

• Discover patient reports, newspapers, security files, and Dr. Emir's audio recordings

• Exploration-focused gameplay with environmental events

• Horror built on atmosphere instead of combat or chase mechanics

• Turkish voice acting

store_data.about_the_game:
You open your eyes in a pitch-black subway.

The train keeps moving, and there isn’t a person in sight. Everything is unclear. 

Yet one thing is certain: you must get out of here

Explore your surroundings and find clues to escape

Underground is built around point-and-click mechanics, letting you collect and combine items just like in classic escape room games. In this game, you can shift your view from car 1 all the way to car 0 (car 8), examining the objects around you in each one.

Solve the scattered puzzles

Using the information you gather while exploring, you'll manipulate objects to solve puzzles. These puzzles are often surreal and require flexible thinking. But don't worry too much — you have the Ring of Wisdom.

Survive the anomalies

Strange things happen in Underground. Do not lose your sanity. You are the only one here — or so it seems. Find a way to cope. Escape this place.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a game of speed. How fast can you swim?

Shark is a fast-paced reflex game where your objective is to reach the flag in each randomly generated level before the time runs out.

Your timer starts at 10 seconds, and gets one second faster every 10 levels until level 80 where it caps at 2.5 seconds. Levels will generate endlessly until you crash or the time runs out.

How to Play

Move across the board one tile at a time using WASD. Navigate around the deadly colored walls and the arrow tiles that may either help or harm you.

Holding SHIFT allows you to dash, moving two tiles at once, jumping through one tile.

Sometimes levels can be impossible! If you think the current level is unsolvable, press X! If you're correct, you will pass the level. If you're incorrect, you lose.

Other Features

  • Character select

  • Keybind customization

  • Unlockable modes:

    • Zen (No timer)

    • Turbo (Much faster timer)

  • Gameplay-altering settings:

    • Enable/Disable the dash mechanic

    • Enable/Disable generation of impossible levels

    • Prevent walls and arrows from making you crash (unlockable)

    • Change the size of the board (unlockable)

store_data.about_the_game:
Grey Frontier is an atmospheric adventure game with elements of exploration and mystery, set in an alternate version of the Soviet countryside.

Following a mysterious catastrophe, the world has changed. Communication with the Ilyinsk Region has been lost, and everyone sent there has vanished without a trace. In response, the authorities dispatch a Vympel special forces unit led by Vladimir Molotov to investigate the incident. However, the mission goes terribly wrong, and Vladimir soon finds himself alone on the border of the Grey Zone.

Explore abandoned villages, dams, logging sites, and secret facilities behind the wheel of your old Niva. Gather resources, uncover the fate of missing expeditions, and slowly piece together the truth behind the disaster that transformed the region forever.

But be careful. The Grey Zone hides far more than mere anomalies.

Features

• Explore diverse regions using your vehicle

• Immerse yourself in a Soviet provincial atmosphere inspired by Slavic folklore and urban legends

• Encounter dangerous anomalies that alter the rules of exploration and travel

• Discover abandoned villages, laboratories, bunkers, and other mysterious locations

• Upgrade your vehicle and prepare for increasingly dangerous expeditions

• Uncover a story about lost expeditions, forgotten secrets, and the consequences of a failed experiment

Every journey beyond the safety of your shelter may be your last.

Will you uncover the truth behind the Grey Zone?

Every journey beyond the safety of your shelter could be your last. Will you uncover the truth behind what happened within the Grey Zone?

  • Take on the ice and master the inertia of slippery surfaces

  • Soar high on the moon and get the timing right for jumps that can’t be corrected

  • Push yourself to the limit on clay! No inertia for ultra-precise movements

store_data.about_the_game:
THE FLOOR WON’T STAY

Oops, No Floor is a fast online multiplayer party game where the floor keeps disappearing beneath you.

Run, jump, and shove your way across colorful floating platforms as tiles collapse, islands move, and safe spaces become dangerously crowded.

FOUR CHAOTIC GAME MODES

Color Rush
Race toward the announced color before every other tile drops away.

Classic Collapse
Watch the warnings and move quickly as large parts of the floor disappear. Even safe tiles can break when too many players stand on them.

Moving Islands
Jump between floating islands as they rotate, separate, rise, sink, and reconnect.

One Tile Left
The floor shrinks until only one unstable tile remains. Stay balanced, survive the final shoves, and be the last player standing.

EVERY ROUND COUNTS

Falling only removes you from the current round. Everyone returns for the next mode, giving every player another chance to score.

Earn points by surviving hazards, finishing rounds, reaching safety quickly, and knocking rivals into the clouds.

The player with the highest total score after all four rounds wins the match.

QUICK TO LEARN. HARD TO STAY ON.

  • 2 to 12 online players

  • Public matchmaking

  • Private rooms with shareable codes

  • Bots that fill empty spaces

  • Fast four-round matches

Simple controls. Unstable floors. Questionable friendships.

Stay up. Everything else is falling.

store_data.about_the_game:
✨ Welcome to The Wisteria! ✨ Congratulations! You've just landed your first serious job in the city and moved into The Wisteria—a gorgeous, converted Victorian mansion repurposed as a luxury co-living space. But there's a little surprise waiting for you... You are the newest, and only male resident in a house full of six breathtakingly beautiful, distinctly feminine dormmates! 🌸💖

Get ready for 14 unforgettable days of close-quarters living, hilarious roommate drama, shared chores, and an undeniable romantic tension that just keeps building. Can you survive living under one roof where everyone is just way too attractive for your own peace of mind? 🏡💕

🎀 Meet Your Lovely Dormmates! 🎀

  • 👠 Harper: The glamorous, fiercely confident fashion editor and self-appointed "queen" of the house.

  • 📚 Luna: The shy, sweet librarian who hides away in cozy corners to write romance stories.

  • 🥊 Daisy: The high-energy, competitive MMA instructor who will absolutely challenge you to an arm wrestle before breakfast.

  • 🎨 Violet: The cool, enigmatic artist and tattoo apprentice with a deeply hidden, vulnerable side.

  • 🍷 Rosalie: The elegant, sophisticated lawyer and the maternal "house mom" who takes care of everyone.

  • 🎮 Sage: The chaotic, cuddly, and pastel-loving livestreamer who just wants to play games with you!

🌟 Game Features 🌟

  • 💖 14 Days of Romance & Comedy: Experience a heartwarming and hilarious slice-of-life story as you get to know the quirks and secrets of each roommate.

  • 🌙 Intimate Evening Encounters: Every night brings you closer to one of your beautiful housemates in passionate, emotionally charged encounters.

  • 🕰️ ~12 Hours of Playtime: Dive deep into a rich visual novel experience filled with beautiful art, witty banter, and engaging dialogue.

  • 💌 6 Distinct Endings: Your choices matter! On your final night, choose the one who captured your heart for a unique, dedicated ending and epilogue.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sundays on the Ridge is a cozy third-person photography adventure about slowing down, looking closer, and finding beauty in small moments.

  • Spend a peaceful Sunday exploring a quiet island filled with forest paths, open meadows, wooden bridges, gentle wildlife, and hidden corners waiting to be noticed. There is no rush and no pressure. Just you, your camera, and the soft rhythm of nature.

  • Take on simple photography tasks, search for animals, frame the perfect shot, adjust your focus and zoom, and capture the world as you see it. Some animals are shy, so you will need to move carefully, crouch, observe their behavior, and wait for the right moment.

  • Each photo you take becomes part of your album, turning your journey into a collection of quiet memories from the ridge.

Whether you are following a task, wandering off the path, or simply watching the light change through the trees, Sundays on the Ridge invites you to slow down and enjoy the little things.

Features

  • Explore a peaceful island at your own pace.

  • Use your camera to zoom, focus, and capture wildlife.

  • Complete cozy photo tasks and unlock new moments to discover.

  • Approach timid animals carefully by walking, crouching, and observing.

  • Build an album of your favorite photos and memories.

  • Enjoy a calm, nature-focused experience with no combat and no stress.

A game about farting your way to victory. 

Welcome to Anytown where the malls are overrun with hoodlums and only one man, Fart Fighter, has the intestinal fortitude to set things right.

Follow Fart Fighter through each level as he unleashes his flatulence with extreme prejudice on hoodlums, corrupt cops, and more!

Fart Fighter is a single-player, top-down action game where players use farts to defeat enemies and clear levels. Enemies and stages grow more complex as the player travels across the land from mall to mall.

Consume and combine four foods imbued with different elemental essences to give your farts unique effects. Collect coins from defeated enemies and buy equipment and power-ups to help battle formidable adversaries.

Transform Fart Fighter from a basic mall cop into the ultimate weapon in the arsenal of flatulence, and help him take down the biggest methane monolith in the land.

Players can expect to finish the story in 1 to 2 hours, while custom level building offers endless opportunities to create the ultimate challenge and hilariously bottom-burp their way to victory.

store_data.about_the_game:
What lies behind your facade?

Behind the Screen is a narrative, emotional indie game that sheds light on the invisible gap between appearance and reality. In a world that demands constant availability, perfection, and strength, we accompany 20-year-old Jonas. He tries to manage his daily life while quietly dealing with depression and the scars of his past.

Two Contrasting Worlds

Experience Jonas' divided daily routine in two completely different gameplay styles:

  • Real Life (The Facade): Navigate Jonas' room and make everyday choices. Communicate with family or colleagues via smartphone. But every social interaction costs energy. Can you maintain the facade without letting your willpower drop to zero?

  • The PC Monitor (The Escape): When reality becomes too overwhelming, turn on the computer. Escape into a vibrant world of fast-paced, pixelated retro minigames. A place of distraction and temporary solace – but how long can this escape keep reality at bay?

Key Features:

  • A Touching Story: Accompany Jonas through multiple emotional chapters, ranging from school bullying to the search for professional support.

  • Choices That Matter: Your decisions in real life control Jonas' willpower and influence the suspicion of those around him.

  • Interactive Phone & PC Simulation: Read text messages, answer calls, and balance your emotions in stressful conversations using interactive minigame mechanics to mask your true state.

  • Authentic Origin: Inspired by real-life experiences and anonymous submissions from the community.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: A melancholic synthesizer soundtrack and a stylized retro CRT monitor overlay draw you deep into the world behind the screen.

Important Content Warning:

Behind the Screen deals with sensitive topics, including depression, school bullying, and loss of a loved one by suicide. The game also features visual glitches and flashing lights. Please play mindfully and seek help if you are affected by these themes. Help is always available.

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

Veilmoor Academy — an ancient school of magic on a remote island, hidden from the ordinary world. You're twenty, and your gift awoke too late: while others honed their craft for years, you're only now stepping through the gates. Your magic fits into no Circle — colorless, foreign, belonging to no one. You're an outcast from day one.
And then a quiet calamity begins. One by one, the students fall in love — glowing, keeping secrets, going sleepless. Each of them has him: a perfect lover no one else has ever seen. And each slowly fades, melting away from her own happiness.
You're the only one the spell doesn't touch. The only one who sees what hides behind the mask.

HEROINES

Seraphine — top of the class, fire and pride. A sharp tongue, a flawless reputation, armor she never takes off for anyone. She seems to need no one. Seems.

Wren — a quiet seer, forever buried in her grimoire. No one has ever chosen her for who she truly is. At night she dreams of a faceless figure and the catacombs beneath the academy — before each new victim is ever found.
Together you descend deeper and deeper — into forbidden archives, into nighttime corridors, into catacombs where something that wears other people's faces lies sleeping. Intimacy grows from conversations over cold coffee, restless nights, and the lines you dared — or didn't dare — to say.
One of them will stay by your side. And in the end, you'll have to strike through the face of the one you came to love.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

- Two story routes, each with its own ending and its own explicit scenes.
- Choices with no hints: there is no "right" line — trust builds from the little things and decides how far it all goes.
- 18+ eroticism woven into the story: the same heroines, the same mood, the same threat.
- A mystery to uncover, and a creature you'll have to kill in the end.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cold Doctor & Noble Lady Fall for Me - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction: Simon, who was 22 years old, should have died in the explosion of the FX Group's secret laboratory, but he was reborn after merging with No. 7. In the ward on the third basement floor of Zurich University Hospital, he began to fight against his fate. With the power of No. 7, he borrowed others' senses and had a wonderful connection with nurse Tessa, volunteer Maria, and doctor Katya. Facing the pursuit of the FX Group, the three of them formed an alliance to jointly seek a chance of survival.
Worldview Atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of cyberpunk elements. Concepts such as silver - blue nano - streams, consciousness colonization, and singularity residues add a strong science - fiction color to the story. The third basement floor of the hospital is filled with the smell of disinfectant and damp cement, which is depressing and mysterious, forming a sharp contrast with the surveillance and threats in the outside world.
Highlights of Female Character Interactions: Nurse Tessa's professional efficiency and faint exhaustion, Maria's mature charm and vulnerability after being suppressed, and Katya's rational strength and inner pain. The three female characters each have their own charm. The interactions between Simon and them are full of emotional collisions and subtle changes. From the initial exploration to the later trust, it shows a complex and touching emotional relationship.
Tension in Character Relationships: Simon's merger with No. 7 makes his consciousness complex. There is not only a need for cooperation between him and Maria and Katya, but also mutual suspicion and exploration. Between Maria and Katya, the collision between mature charm and rational strength also creates a tense and subtle relationship. The tension in these character relationships adds many suspense and highlights to the story.
Scene Features: Scenes such as the hospital ward, the logistics passage, and the lakeside mansion each have their own characteristics. In the hospital ward, the monotonous sound of the electrocardiogram monitor and the smell of disinfectant create a tense atmosphere; in the logistics passage, the night wind wrapped in the wet and cold air of Lake Zurich adds a sense of urgency to the escape; the private lounge in the lakeside mansion is isolated from the outside world by thick curtains, becoming their temporary haven.
Immersive Experience: Players will follow Simon's perspective and delve into this world full of science - fiction and suspense. By borrowing others' senses, players can feel the inner world and physical state of different characters, as if they are on the scene. The tense plot, complex character relationships, and suspense - filled episodes make players immerse themselves in it and unable to extricate themselves.
High - definition Visual Performance: The game uses high - definition CG technology to delicately show the appearance, expressions, and actions of characters, as well as the details of various scenes. Special effects such as silver - blue nano - streams and golden cyber lines add a gorgeous visual effect to the game.
Functional Gameplay Features: The game supports offline play, allowing players to enjoy the game anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important episodes, the automatic play function allows players to easily browse the plot, and the chapter browsing function allows players to quickly locate the parts they are interested in. The smooth reading experience allows players to focus on the development of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
CIRTEMIN

Cirtemin is a combat card game set in a vast fantasy world where every duel is a war of wits, resource, and nerve. Build your deck from hundreds of cards, command your forces turn by turn, and destroy every last enemy standing on the field. Victory belongs not to the luckiest hand — but to the sharpest mind.

COMMAND THE BOARD. CONQUER THE FIELD.

In Cirtemin, winning means one thing: leave no enemy standing. Every card your opponent places on the board is a threat. Every card you play is a weapon. The duel ends only when one side is completely wiped from the field — and that side will not be yours.

THREE ACTIONS. INFINITE DECISIONS.

Each turn, you have exactly 3 actions. Use them wisely.

  • Draw a card from your deck to build your hand

  • Place a card onto the battlefield to strengthen your forces

  • Attack an enemy card and tear apart their lines

  • Use a card's special ability at the decisive moment

Every action spent is an action your opponent can anticipate. Every action saved is a trap waiting to spring. The tension of three choices — repeated, turn after turn — is where Cirtemin lives.

THE TRIANGLE OF POWER

Combat in Cirtemin is built on an ancient principle: nothing is unbeatable. Every attack type has a counter, and every counter has a weakness. Knowing the triangle is easy. Predicting what your opponent will do with it — that's mastery. Read the board. Anticipate the play. Strike where they are weakest.

FIVE TYPES OF CARDS. ONE BATTLEFIELD.

Cirtemin's card system rewards deep knowledge of your arsenal:

Silver — The backbone of your army. Reliable board units that hold the line and deal consistent damage.

Gold — Like Silver, but hiding a secret weapon. Each Gold card carries a powerful special ability ready to turn a fight on its head.

Element — The most devastating forces on the board. Element cards combine Gold's special ability with raw, overwhelming power. Deploy them carefully — they change everything.

Consumable — One use. One moment. Make it count. Consumables are single-use cards that can shift the tide of battle in an instant.

Over — Place an Over card on top of your board units to shield them from harm. A protected front line is a wall your opponent must break before they can reach what matters.

YOUR STRATEGY. YOUR VICTORY.

There is no one right way to win in Cirtemin. Flood the board with a relentless swarm of Silver cards and overwhelm your enemy through sheer numbers. Or strip your deck to its core and stand behind a single, nigh-unstoppable Element — an immovable fortress your opponent must somehow find a way to crack.

As long as one warrior still stands, the fight continues. The question is: whose champion will be the last one standing?

BUILD YOUR LEGEND

Jump straight into battle with expertly crafted starter decks, or forge your own path from the ground up. Cirtemin's deck builder gives you full control — every card slot, every strategic choice, every synergy is yours to discover. Modify, experiment, refine. Your deck is your identity. Build it like one.

THE WORLD OF ELEMENTS AWAITS

Beyond the battlefield lies a world ancient beyond reckoning. Factions forged in blood and ambition. Heroes whose stories stretch across centuries. Every card you play is a fragment of that world — and the deeper you go, the more of it reveals itself.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Path of Immortal Dust is a cultivation simulation game centered on narrative and strategy.

Cultivation and Breakthroughs

The game runs on a turn-based time system. Each turn grants you a set of action points, which can be spent on training techniques, advancing your cultivation realm, or venturing out to explore. Techniques require accumulated proficiency to level up, with each tier demanding greater effort. Realm breakthroughs require full cultivation progress and the right pill to ascend to the next major stage. Your innate talents—such as Bone Structure and Comprehension—affect training efficiency, and every breakthrough permanently strengthens your character.

Exploration and Events

Spend action points to travel to different locations and trigger random events. These events unfold through a multi-stage narrative system—you will meet a variety of characters and face meaningful choices. Some choices affect your relationships, some unlock new locations or follow-up events, and some will draw you into battle.

Combat System

Combat is turn-based, with you and your enemies taking alternating actions. You can use basic attacks, equipped divine abilities, artifacts, and talismans. The combat system features an energy mechanic, cooldowns, and status effects—you'll need to plan each turn carefully. Defeating powerful foes rewards you with cultivation progress, spirit stones, and rare items.

A World of Relationships

The sect is home to many characters with distinct personalities, waiting for you to befriend them. Give gifts, complete character-specific events, and raise affinity. Your relationships will evolve from strangers to trusted allies, and may even lead to unique ending paths.

store_data.about_the_game:
Three Kingdoms: March is a tactical strategy simulation set in the age of the Three Kingdoms. Become a ruler in a time of war, command your armies in battle, and grow your realm through officers, policies, and research.

In battle, you directly command units by dragging orders across the field. Victory is not decided by numbers alone. Strike the enemy's flanks and rear, use fire tactics, encirclement, and breakthroughs, and turn the tide with careful battlefield judgment.

On the world map, you manage cities, appoint officers, develop technology, and strengthen your realm. Choosing who to assign, what to improve, and when to prepare for war can change the course of your campaign.

Key Features

- Real-time tactical battles controlled with drag-based commands

- Large-scale unit warfare built around flanks, rear attacks, encirclement, and breakthroughs

- A Three Kingdoms campaign centered on famous factions and officers

- Realm management through policies, research, and officer assignments

- A deep single-player strategy simulation

store_data.about_the_game:
Petrix

You are a leucocyte. The battlefield is a petri dish. The enemy is everything else.

Dive through procedurally-escalating Rifts, fighting off swarms of viruses, bacteria, and fungi as you build toward devastating late-game power. Every kill earns Aether and Mutagen — spend them between dives at your Safe Zone to permanently reshape how you fight.

Choose your mutation. Commit to one of four elemental paths — Fire, Frost, Lightning, or Shadow — each with its own skill tree and a run-defining Tier 4 ultimate: scorch the arena with Solar Flare, freeze it solid with Absolute Zero, chain lightning through Tesla Storm, or vanish and strike with Shadow Shroud.

Face down real bosses. Four boss archetypes — Virus, Bacteria, Fungus, and Splitter — each fight differently and demand different answers. Push deep enough and you'll face two at once in a full-blown Outbreak.

Arm yourself. Stack up to seven auxiliary weapons alongside your beam — chain lightning, deploy turrets and mines, launch homing missiles, summon orbiting satellites, and more — and find the combinations that turn a desperate dive into a one-cell army.

Learn what you're fighting. Every boss and mutant strain you defeat unlocks an entry in the Compendium — real microbiology, decoded one kill at a time.

Key Features:

  • Four mutation paths with deep, exclusive skill trees and unique Tier 4 ultimates

  • Four core boss archetypes plus elemental variants, with dual-boss Outbreak fights in deeper Rifts

  • Seven auxiliary weapons to mix and match alongside your primary beam

  • A 50-entry Compendium of real microbiology, unlocked through play

  • Full gamepad and keyboard/mouse support

  • Steam achievements

store_data.about_the_game:
The green army men are coming — and they want your teddy bear.

Bearicade is a tower-defense game with one big twist: your tower is a toy train. A wind-up locomotive loops the track around your bear, dragging a tail of weapon-loaded carriages that blast the swarm as they circle. The engine is a battering ram, the carriages are your arsenal, and the teddy in the middle is everything you're fighting for. Deck out your train, ram the line flat, and hold on through 30 nights in the nursery.

Your tower never stops moving

Forget planting turrets in a maze. In Bearicade you build a train and it does the patrolling for you — every carriage you bolt on sweeps the whole battlefield once per lap, so one great weapon covers every angle. Crank up the engine's speed and bolt on spikes, and your train becomes a wrecking ball on rails that flattens anything caught on the tracks.

Key Features

  • A tower on rails — Grow your train up to 14 carriages, each carrying two weapons, all firing as they orbit the bear.

  • Ram them flat — Engine damage scales with speed × spikes. Pour gold into both and turn your little toy train into a freight of pain.

  • 13 toy weapons — Cap guns, squirt guns, firecrackers, bouncy balls, boomerangs, gatlings, snipers, cannons, mortars, rockets and more — stacking slow, freeze, burn, stun, pierce, bounce and knockback effects.

  • An army of little green men — Marchers, sprinters, bazooka troopers who shell your bear from range, unpushable bricks that clog the rails, and medics that patch the horde back up. Read each wave and counter the threat.

  • Bosses every 5 waves — A toy Jeep crashes the mid-game and a General's super-tank leads the final assault — and the big ones can grind your train to a dead stop.

  • Upgrade between every wave — Spend your gold on fresh carriages, train speed, spikes, weapon levels, and the bear's armor and health.

  • Panic items & charms — Keep emergency toys in your back pocket for when the line breaks, and start each run with a charm that bends the rules in your favor.

  • Good Night bonus — Clear a wave without the bear taking a single hit and pocket a discount as your reward.

  • 30 waves, then endless — Beat the campaign, then see how many nights you can survive as the toys keep marching.

Hold the line

One bear. One loop of track. A whole army box of little green men. Build the train, hold the line, and don't let them reach the teddy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Squoids is a game of momentum and endurance. Grow your swarm as you dynamically avoid the waves of enemies. Upgrade your swarm to fight back and ensure individuals survive longer. Every enemy defeated earning you the power to mix up the environment. Letting you tweak what is common to better suit your play strategy. 

Swim and Swerve

Squoids swim naturally in a swarm that follows your cursor's lead. Loop, lash, and launch as you outmaneuver enemies of a variety of speeds and movement types. The nature of the swarmed movement requiring shifting techniques as the number of squoids grow.

Upgrade and Fight

As you swim and explore your surroundings, you may come across bubbling pearls. These will let you select an upgrade for your squoids which can power them up and increase their value. Other than attacks, upgrades can also do things such as increase health or make squoids spawn quicker, making survival much easier. With three main paths that branch, each run you can select two allowing unique fusions geared toward how you like to play. As you upgrade, you'll also find that your swarm changes visually, representing the progress and choices you've made. 

Mix it up and More

In between runs, you can used earned currency to shift factors of the environment. This will change how your runs go as your mix things up, hopefully letting you find the balance that works best for you. Squoids is focused on convenience and runs whenever you want. You'll keep what you earned in a run no matter if you pause and quit, lose, or win. Game too slow? On the menu you can activate a 2x mode that will speed up gameplay to something much more fast paced. Want to start all over? A trashcan button will reset your data after 3 rapid presses, letting you start anew. In Squoids, pressure should only come from challenging gameplay, not external factors.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIG. BUILD. DESTROY.
Bunker Buster is a tactical underground base-builder with real-time combat. Excavate a hidden fortress beneath the earth, power it, staff it, arm it, then defend it against relentless enemy factions or take the battle to them.

BUILD YOUR BUNKER
Construct a fully self-sufficient underground fortress room by room. Manage power, air, water, food, sanitation, and morale while preparing for war.

  • Infrastructure — Generators, storage depots, cooling loops, exhaust vents

  • Life Support — Air intakes, scrubbers, water pumps, kitchens, med bays

  • Weapons — Missile silos, artillery, mortar pits, EMP cannons, drone hives, mech hangars

  • Defences — SAM sites, AA flak, Trophy active-protection systems, armour plating

  • Surface Installations — Watchtowers, radar domes, HESCO walls, camo netting

  • Intelligence — Radio intercept, seismic arrays, signal jammers

SYNTHESIZE YOUR ARSENAL — BILLIONS OF COMBINATIONS
Every weapon, defence, and daemon is built piece by piece, not picked off a shelf.

  • Ammo Synthesis — Stack up to 25 stat modifiers across 6 weapon platforms. Order changes the outcome: the same components in a different sequence fire differently.

  • Defence Synth — Layer 10 intercept modifiers across SAM, AA Flak, and Trophy systems to counter incoming fire before it lands.

  • Cyber Warfare Suite — Engineer daemons from 15 code modifiers and conditional triggers, or stack 10+ firewall layers into an unbreakable defence grid.

Combined, these systems give you billions of viable loadouts — no two bunkers, and no two battles, play the same.

GO TO WAR
Fight across a tactical No Man's Land in real time. Target enemy rooms, intercept incoming strikes, and deploy your full arsenal.

  • Launch ICBMs from buried silos

  • Deploy combat mechs to hold the line

  • Scramble drone swarms for recon and assault

  • Fire precision artillery or suppress with mortar fire

  • Breach enemy systems with your own synthesized cyberweapons

CONQUER FACTIONS. CLAIM THEIR WEAPONS.
Ten enemy factions each bring unique tactics. Defeat them and capture their technology for your own arsenal, including burrowing Mole Torpedoes, orbital kinetic rods, signal jammers, and more.

MULTIPLAYER / RAID ENEMY FORTRESSES
Build your fortress, then raid other players' bunkers via Steam. Challenge friends directly or find opponents through the quickmatch queue.

KEY FEATURES

  • Deep base-building with power, air, water, and morale simulation

  • Billions of weapon, defence, and cyber-warfare combinations via three full synthesis systems

  • Real-time tactical combat with dozens of weapon systems

  • 10 enemy factions each with capturable unique weapons

  • Research tree spanning 75 technologies across 7 doctrinal branches

  • Steam multiplayer, fortress raiding, and PvP battles

  • Retro pixel art with phosphor-green military UI
