store_data.about_the_game:
You have died. Now you sit behind the desk.

In AFTERCLERK you are a clerk in the bureaucracy of the afterlife — a weigher of souls. One by one, the dead are brought before your scale. You read their ledger of deeds, weigh their sins against their virtues, hear their final words, and render the only verdict that remains: Heaven, or Hell.

⚖ Weigh the Dead

Every soul carries a ledger. Some deeds are plain; others are ambiguous, and how you choose to read them decides everything. Tilt the scale, press your seal — but judgment is never as simple as the book pretends.

🕯 Every Verdict Is a Memory

As the shifts pass, the souls grow familiar — a blanket child, a caretaker, a mother. Each judgment stirs a memory, and a buried story surfaces: who you were, how you died, and the name you lost. The dead you weigh are closer to you than you know.

👁 The Doctrine Tightens

The Director watches every verdict. His doctrine hardens with each act — mercy grows costly, deviation breeds suspicion. Follow the book, or trust your conscience and risk everything. Your record remembers.

Features

  • A hand-crafted narrative across 18 shifts and 90+ souls

  • Choices that matter — your verdicts shape four distinct endings

  • A living record that quietly tracks your mercy, severity, and doubt

  • Atmospheric art — hand-painted scenes and pixel-crafted souls

  • An original, melancholic music-box score

  • Fully localized in 14 languages

The scale is yours. The dead are waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
They're coming for you. Are you ready?

The world has fallen. Hordes of monsters rage in its ruins, their waves only growing more violent. You are the last line of defense. Take matters into your own hands and prove that humanity will not go down without a fight.

Your fortress is your life. Build fortifications to slow down the creatures and deploy turrets to turn them into mincemeat. Your arsenal has everything you need to survive: from a reliable pistol and a powerful grenade launcher to a bloody axe and deadly knives.

Level up using coins dropped by defeated enemies. With each new wave, you will become stronger, faster, and more deadly. But don't forget to keep an eye on your health—one mistake can cost you everything.

The main goal is to survive. And for those looking for a real challenge, we've prepared 10 hardcore achievements. Can you unlock them all and prove you're a true monster hunter?

This game is for you if you:

  • Value tactics and strategy: you enjoy not just shooting, but thinking through your defenses, building fortifications, and placing turrets in the most vulnerable spots.

  • You love loot and progression: you enjoy collecting resources, farming coins, and upgrading your arsenal and skills after each wave.

  • You're looking for a challenge: 10 hardcore achievements aren't just checkmarks on your profile, but a true test of your nerves and reflexes.

  • You prefer dynamic gameplay: switching from a pistol to a grenade launcher to survive in a crowd of enemies is your style.

This game isn't for you if you're looking for a leisurely walking simulator or a story-driven adventure. Here, the main goal is survival, and that requires complete concentration.
store_data.detailed_description:
They're coming for you. Are you ready?

The world has fallen. Hordes of monsters rage in its ruins, their waves only growing more violent. You are the last line of defense. Take matters into your own hands and prove that humanity will not go down without a fight.

Your fortress is your life. Build fortifications to slow down the creatures and deploy turrets to turn them into mincemeat. Your arsenal has everything you need to survive: from a reliable pistol and a powerful grenade launcher to a bloody axe and deadly knives.

Level up using coins dropped by defeated enemies. With each new wave, you will become stronger, faster, and more deadly. But don't forget to keep an eye on your health—one mistake can cost you everything.

The main goal is to survive. And for those looking for a real challenge, we've prepared 10 hardcore achievements. Can you unlock them all and prove you're a true monster hunter?

This game is for you if you:

  • Value tactics and strategy: you enjoy not just shooting, but thinking through your defenses, building fortifications, and placing turrets in the most vulnerable spots.

  • You love loot and progression: you enjoy collecting resources, farming coins, and upgrading your arsenal and skills after each wave.

  • You're looking for a challenge: 10 hardcore achievements aren't just checkmarks on your profile, but a true test of your nerves and reflexes.

  • You prefer dynamic gameplay: switching from a pistol to a grenade launcher to survive in a crowd of enemies is your style.

This game isn't for you if you're looking for a leisurely walking simulator or a story-driven adventure. Here, the main goal is survival, and that requires complete concentration.
store_data.short_description: Survive in a bloody hell! Build fortifications, deploy turrets, and fend off waves of zombies. Upgrade with coins, use weapons from a pistol to an axe, and unlock 10 hardcore achievements.

store_data.about_the_game:
Card Flipper is an idle casino grinder built around one irresistible loop: flip a card, get paid, flip faster. Stack the cash, cash out, and turn a single table into a runaway money machine.

FLIP, FRENZY & FORTUNE

Flip cards across the felt and cash rains in. Pour it back into more cards and faster hands until the whole table is flipping itself. Land a golden card and a Frenzy erupts, multiplying every payout while the table glows gold. Bank chips into the skill tree, fill the jackpot meter, and watch your cash-per-second climb from a trickle to a flood.

FEATURES

  • Every flip pays. Flip for cash and chips, then reinvest to flip harder.

  • Golden cards. Drop fat cash or kick off a screen-glowing Frenzy.

  • Jackpot events. Spin the reels and click to claim the payout.

  • A deep skill tree. Unlock automation like Auto-Flipper and Wide Hands so the table runs itself while you are away.


VICES

Light up, drink up, snack up. Mature buffs that push your numbers higher, each with its own risk and payoff. Hold a cigarette for a bigger drag, press your luck at the bar before you get wasted, snack for timed boosts. The bad habits pay, if you can handle them.

store_data.about_the_game:
Curlith is a tactical curling game that combines uniquely tuned physics-based stone behavior with simple card effects. Use stones with special effects, read the changing ice condition, and aim for the perfect shot!

The game includes two modes: Single Play and Local Match.

Single Play

Single Play is a challenge mode where you aim to complete objectives on randomly generated board positions.

You can use three types of cards: Normal Stone, Lane Shift Stone, and Double Curl Stone. You can choose from three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard. The higher the difficulty, the more likely you are to face dense board positions.

Local Match

In Local Match, two players split into the red team and the yellow team and compete against each other. In each round, both teams throw 6 stones each, for a total of 12 shots. Damage is then calculated based on the positions of the stones in the house. The more stones you leave closer to the tee than your opponent, the more damage you deal.

Before the match, you choose 3 cards from 8 types of stone cards to create your Starting Deck. The first half of each round is a board-building phase where both players throw Stone Pillars, which become fixed in place where they stop. From the 7th total shot, the match enters the Free Card Phase, where you can use your selected cards. After the 7th total shot ends, all Stone Pillars return to Normal Stones at once.

Between rounds, there is a card swap. From two candidates chosen from cards that are not in your hand, you can select one card and swap it with a card in your hand. Victory depends not only on shot accuracy, but also on card selection and how you build the board.

*This game mode requires two controllers.

Stone and Ice Behavior

A stone’s speed loss and curl amount change depending on its speed, spin, and the ice condition. A stone with high linear speed tends to lose less speed, and a stone with high spin also tends to slide farther. Stones curl in the direction of their spin, and when they pass over areas where the ice condition differs, they may curl more strongly. If the spin speed is close to 0, the curl becomes less stable and the stone follows a knuckle-like path.

The ice condition is not fixed. Areas where stones have passed or where sweeping has been used gradually become more slippery. Slippery areas are shown in blue, and the effect accumulates over time. However, once the ice condition progresses beyond a certain point, a reversal phenomenon occurs, causing behavior that differs from normal.

Sweeping is the action of polishing the ice to help the stone slide more easily. Full Sweep has little effect on curl and mainly helps reduce speed loss. Sweeping on the side opposite the spin direction makes the curl stronger, while sweeping on the spin direction side makes it easier to reduce the curl. By choosing where to sweep, you can adjust how far the stone travels and how it curls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aster League 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG.

Taking place 20 years after BallisticNG, Aster has developed its anti-gravity bike league into a major sporting event that sits alongside the AGL. Experimenting with afterburner technology, Aster has carved it's own segment of AG racing where boost is king and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

Skill based boost mechanics

Trigger mini boosts with good timing while drifting to increase your top speed and maintain reserves. Hop into big jumps and perform barrel roll stunts to further increase your speed and reserves.

Stay consistent to work your way up to 200% top speed!

Speeds for everybody

The 5 speed classes from BallisticNG make a return. From painfully slow to blisteringly fast, Aster League accommodates everybody.

Speed classes will be optional and not required for progression.

Vehicles and pilots

Aster League will feature an assortment of anti-gravity karts and bikes, with additional vehicle types such as a forklift!

Every team in BallisticNG is competing in the league and will have a playable pilot.

Decoupled stats

Instead of your vehicle and character selections determining your stats, they'll be visual only and you'll be able to select from a tailored set of playstyles. Look and play however you want!

Modding

Aster League is built for modding.

Custom tracks, vehicles, pilots, playstyles, and more! The same development kit being used to make the game's official content will be available for modders to utilize.

store_data.about_the_game:
Play as a squad of time-traveling soldiers sent back to stop an orc invasion before it can change history forever. Fight through waves of enemies, collect resources, unlock new soldier classes, and build an increasingly powerful army. Take direct control of the action or let your troops fight automatically.

You can jump into the action yourself or let your soldiers fight automatically while you focus on upgrades and squad management. Between battles you'll spend resources on new units, stronger weapons, and permanent improvements that help push deeper into later waves.

Each soldier class brings something different to the battlefield. Some specialize in raw damage, shield penetration, electric arc, crowd control, or homing missiles etc. Building an effective squad is just as important as upgrading it.

The game starts simple, but the number of enemies, upgrades, and possible squad combinations quickly grows as you progress. Every wave introduces tougher enemies, new challenges, and a boss standing between you and the next stage.

Features

  • Isometric shooter combat with active and idle playstyles

  • Directly control your squad or let them fight automatically

  • Recruit and upgrade multiple soldier classes

  • Earn resources and invest them into permanent progression

  • Battle through waves of enemies and challenging bosses

  • Grow from a handful of soldiers into a force capable of wiping out entire armies

store_data.about_the_game:
You just dived into the Halflight, a place with no way back.

Walk in blind, or read the doors.

The house only goes one way. It rolls out before you and unmakes itself behind. Every door you enter is a decision that cannot be undone.

Five symbols mark each door, spelling the way. Your notebook has all the paths you need to move along and backtrack.

Don't make a sound. Don't look away. Don't stop.

The entities that live in the Halflight cannot be fought. There are no weapons; no second chances.

Some of them like to watch you. Others like to be seen. Some never stop moving. And some are already in the room with you, waiting for you to notice.

While you're here, all you can do is hide, run, and maybe pray.

Piece together the path out.

Each key to the elevator leading out of this place lies behind a puzzle buried within the shifting maze. Trace them, solve them, get the key, backtrack, and most importantly: don't get caught.

They want you to die here.

Every run is different.

Every dive into the Halflight finds you face to face with different entities, in rooms you've never walked in, with a different road back each time. Death is permanent. Learn what killed you, then step back in.

store_data.about_the_game:
Remilia's cake has vanished from a locked room in the Scarlet Devil Mansion!

Welcome to a late-night tea party hosted by head maid Sakuya. On the table sit tea, cake, and — a single shotgun.

How to Play

A single shotgun is loaded with a random mix of blanks and live rounds. At the start of each round the NUMBER of shells is revealed, but their ORDER stays hidden. You'll have to rely on luck, memory, and reading your opponent to pull the trigger.

  • Shoot your opponent — a live round deals damage; a blank passes the turn.
  • Shoot yourself — a blank keeps your turn for another action! But if it's live…
  • Remembering which shells have fired and calculating the remaining odds is the key to victory.

Items Handed Out Each Round

Of course, items are there to help you — handed out at random each round. Sakuya lifts the silver cloche to reveal them, and carries out every effect herself, with the utmost elegance.

  • 🍭 Lollipop — Restore 1 HP
  • 🫖 Teapot — Eject the currently chambered shell
  • 🗡️ Dagger — Skip the opponent's next turn
  • 🔍 Magic Monocle — Reveal whether the current shell is live or blank
  • 📛 Curse Seal — +1 damage on the next live round

Punish the Suspects

Koakuma → Hong Meiling → Patchouli → and the boss, Flandre. Face the residents of the Scarlet Devil Mansion one by one in a tournament, and survive to the end to find the cake thief.

Features

  • A 3D turn-based roulette built on a live-vs-blank battle of wits
  • Get hit and you take stars and >< instead of blood — cute, comedic SD characters
  • A third-person view that shows the reactions of all three characters — player, opponent, and host
  • The gothic tea-room atmosphere and sound of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
  • A variety of challenges to unlock (achievements)

store_data.about_the_game:
Humans fled to Solace seeking refuge from the eternal Celestial War. The name was a promise which was never kept. The war followed, and what they brought with them consumed everything. What remains is broken land, corrupted biomes, and desperate powers that call themselves salvation.

You fight through what remains. Combat runs automatically. And when you die, that is not the end. That is the door.

A Dark Fantasy RPG That Runs Itself

Tormented Souls Idle is a dark fantasy idle RPG with a deep story, lore, and worldbuilding, all presented with rich pixel art. This is not a spreadsheet simulator idle game. Every combat encounter resolves without input, with optional active play layers. Your hero levels, gears, and fights while you plan, build, and choose. The decisions are real, the builds are deep, and the prestige loops compound across hundreds of hours.

Real Decisions

In Tormented Souls Idle, your decisions matter. You can't take every skill, and you can't take every bonus. There are no respecs, and there is no undo button. You live with the consequences of your decisions and must forge your own path.

One-time purchase. No microtransactions. No ads. No timers. No paywalls.

Five Classes. Each class fights differently:

Warrior: Rage builds from hits taken and detonates on demand. The front line that hits back harder the longer it absorbs punishment.

Mage: Spell Charges gate every cast. Invest in the Foresight branch for bonus crit against Burning and Chilled targets. A glass cannon with ramping damage.

Rogue: Shadow Steps stack on evasion procs and explode on Shadowstrike. Fast, fragile, and devastating when the build clicks.

Paladin: The tank whose defense becomes offense. Retribution reflects armour as damage on every enemy hit. Radiance converts self-healing into Holy strikes. Build the sustain and the damage comes with it.

Hunter: Fights alongside a beast companion. The companion is a full second NPC with its own skills and abilities, and truly becomes your only partner in this world.

Gold is shared across all five. Grinding one class funds upgrades for every other.

The Campfire Grows

Discover and rescue friendly NPCs in the world to recruit back to your campfire, extending your roster and repertoire. To name a few:

The Blacksmith for permanent per-class stat upgrades.

The Cartographer for route selection before each run.

The Merchant and Fence for gear.

The Ritualist for run modifiers.

Four Prestige Layers

Each operates independently. Each changes what is possible on the next cycle. There's always something to grind, there's always another challenge, and always a way to overcome it. Exploration and discovery is a core pillar, and you never know where you might find power waiting to be taken.

Choose Your Patron

Align with the Angel (Holy power, celestial armour, divine retribution) or the Demon (Infernal power, soul corruption, chaotic destruction). The choice is permanent for this class and run. Your hero's appearance evolves across four stages as you invest Prestige Points: a faint aura becomes a full transformation. You'll need your patron's help for what lies ahead.

Build Depth

Each class has a full skill tree of over 130 nodes, mixing passive stat nodes, scaling nodes, conversion nodes, and active skills. A hundred points cannot fill the tree. Branches compete. Every build is a tradeoff, and bad builds are possible, which is what makes a good build matter. This is no "illusion of choice" game.

Gear drops in four rarities up to Legendary. Artifacts introduce mechanics that fundamentally alter how a class scales: convert all damage to Shadow, turn your Life Regen into a weapon, store soul shards toward a catastrophic strike.

Feature List

  • Five playable classes

  • Fully automatic combat with deliberate pacing

  • Optional active play layers with scaling

  • Angel and Demon alignment trees with visual transformation

  • Four independent prestige systems

  • Many campfire services found in dungeons

  • Skill trees of 130 nodes per class with real tradeoffs

  • Gear across four rarities with 50-plus affixes

  • Artifacts that reshape class scaling

  • Procedural dungeon generation across five biomes

  • Hand-crafted pixel art

  • Dark, sombre Diablo-inspired instrumental score

  • One-time purchase. No microtransactions. No ads. No timers. No paywalls.

About This Build

Tormented Souls Idle is a solo-developed game built for players who want the depth of a dark-fantasy RPG without demanding constant attention. The world of Solace fights on whether you are watching or not.

Come back stronger.

Welcome to the ultimate haunted playground, where the creatures of the night are hunting for something far wetter than blood. Lose yourself in a world of gothic castles, moonlit graveyard trysts, and encounters with wicked witches, dripping slime babes, and seductive succubi. Driven by a modern, high-energy spooky groove that will get your pulse pounding, these supernatural beauties are ready to show you how they hump in the night. Step into the dark, you won't want to escape. 🎃🦇🖤

🧩 Six Spellbinding Puzzle Modes

Unravel the mysteries of these seductive creatures across six intoxicating puzzle modes—Swapping, Rotating, Swapping & Rotating combo, Sliding, Mirror, and Shifting. Randomize the puzzle styles to keep the magical tension high and the gameplay unpredictable. Every piece you lock into place strips away another layer of the paranormal, exposing dripping wet slits, heavy chest-heaving action, and wicked supernatural ecstasy. 🔮🎯

📸 Gallery, Favorites System & Character Profiles

Amass an exquisite collection of your most explicit paranormal encounters. From a wild witch ride in the woods to taking a dripping slime girl from behind in her glowing cave, every puzzle victory unlocks high-quality, hardcore reward scenes. Mark your absolute favorite monster girls with our heart system to keep them ready for quick access. Want to know what really pleases the undead? Read through incredibly detailed character profiles that reveal their hyper-specific kinks, sexual styles, and what makes them scream. Best of all, the entire gallery is optimized for comfortable, one-handed browsing. 🎥📝💕

🎶 Spooky-Sexy Modern Grooves

Surrender to the rhythm of the night with a soundtrack that hits hard and haunts deep. Pulsing basslines and eerie, playful melodies set the perfect atmosphere for solving puzzles and getting hard. Use the fully draggable music player to customize your sessions — bumping your favorite beats or skipping tracks on the fly as you watch these monster girls slide down onto massive shafts. 🎧✨

🕹️ Monsters Love Company: Multiplayer & Co-op

Why investigate the paranormal alone when you can invite the whole coven? Gather your friends for a wild puzzle-solving session! The game fully supports 4 Player Local and Online Co-op via Steam Remote Play, allowing you and up to three partners to open up these thirsty ghouls together. Play with gamepads, mouse, or mix-and-match setups. It also runs flawlessly on Phone, Tablet, and TV via Steam Link, so you can enjoy the monstrous climax wherever you are. 🎮👥
⚠️ Local co-op requires a gamepad per player.⚠️

♿ Spooky-Safe Accessibility Features

Tailor your ghostly encounter with a suite of options designed to let you play exactly how you want. Adjust background animations, resize the text, and set custom colors for titles and text. Specialized fonts optimized for dyslexia, ADHD, and clean readability so nothing distracts you from the pure, unadulterated action. The game is fully playable using mouse-only or ambidextrous one-handed controls for keyboard, controller, or Steam Deck ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°), leaving your other hand free for... hands-on research. Quick Quit/Minimize options and customizable window titles keep your monster-hunting strictly confidential. 🕶️🔐

💻 Beastly Technical Features

Feast your eyes on every drop of slime, every arching bat wing, and every gushing creampie in gorgeous clarity with full Ultrawide and Super Ultrawide support. Native gamepad support ensures smooth, zero-config play right out of the box. Fully optimized for the Steam Deck, you can make use of native touchscreen gameplay to make your supernatural encounters highly interactive. Includes Steam Input, Steam Cloud saves, and a chest full of Steam Achievements to unlock. The interface is translated into all 103 Steam-supported languages because the primal urge to hump in the night is globally shared. 🎬🖥️🌍
⚠️ Character profiles, lore, and custom fonts are English only⚠️

About This Game

Alice & Aidy: The Big Adventure is a warm and gentle interactive story with a touch of fairy-tale science fiction.

The story begins with Alice, a young girl who is trying to write an essay about “a day in the future.” Just when she feels stuck, she meets Aidy, an old companion robot who has somehow arrived from the future.

Aidy carries a secret from a world where people have gradually become used to letting systems choose answers, plan routes, and decide their lives for them. Together, Alice and Aidy set out on a curious adventure through a future changed by algorithms, searching for the lost “sparks of the future.”

This is not a story against AI.

It is a story about asking questions, making choices, taking responsibility, and learning to become yourself.

AI can help us, but it cannot become us.

Features

  • A warm children’s sci-fi adventure story

  • Interactive narrative gameplay suitable for families

  • Simple visual novel / AVG-style experience

  • Make choices and follow the story forward

  • Explore a future world together with Alice and Aidy

  • A gentle story about creativity, courage, responsibility, and self-discovery

Who Is This Game For?

This game is for players who enjoy fairy tales, light science fiction, interactive stories, and warm narrative experiences. It is also suitable for parents and children to read, discuss, and experience together.

There are no complex controls or heavy failure penalties. Just follow the story, make your choices, and accompany Alice and Aidy on their big adventure about the future and the self.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Tower of Seven is a board-game-inspired tower-climbing game built around cards, dice, and lightweight deckbuilding.

On each floor, choose three build cards from a five-card hand. Use the first die, second die, and final die to trigger upright or reversed card effects, and make your final score exceed the demon score.

Demon cards constantly rewrite the rules. Every card choice, die roll, reward replacement, and card order decision can change the fate of the run.

The goal of each floor is simple:

make your final score higher than the demon score. But there is no single way to do it. You may rely on high-value bursts, or create an advantage through card order, affinity, rerolls, swaps, copies, and weakening demon dice. A good build is not just about choosing strong cards. It is about understanding the relationship between the current dice, demon rules, and your three selected cards.

Every card has both an upright and a reversed effect.

Low values usually trigger upright effects, high values usually trigger reversed effects, and neutral results may offer additional choices. Dice are not just random numbers. They determine card faces, direction, timing, and risk. You must decide: which card should receive this die? Where should this card be placed? Should you play safely, or gamble for a higher ceiling?

Demon cards create new restrictions on every floor.

They may strengthen demon dice, change trigger directions, force the final die to be revealed early, or shut down familiar routes. Players must find openings within changing rules instead of repeating the same strategy every time.

Features

Lightweight deckbuilding: Choose three cards from a five-card hand each floor. Card order directly affects resolution.

Upright and reversed effects: The same card can offer different strategic value depending on the triggering die.

Dice-driven decisions: The first die, second die, and final die affect both values and available routes.

Rule-changing demons: Demon cards reshape each floor, forcing you to reassess your hand and risk.

Evolving tower runs: Replace cards after victories and reshape your build as the climb continues.

Traceable resolution logs: Every score change, reroll, swap, and failure reason is clearly shown.

Expandable card-effect system: Future updates will focus on new cards, new demons, and new build paths.

store_data.about_the_game:
Refund is a single-player grid puzzle game. You move through a little shop where stepping on goods means buying them: coins are paid, and a receipt lands in your pocket. The real rules live in the refunds — every refund rewrites your position, your resources, or the map itself.

The core mechanic: refunds

Every receipt remembers the step you took when you bought it.

Refund: part of the cost comes back, and you step backwards, against the recorded direction. This step ignores physics — it can carry you straight into a wall. Punching through walls is the heart of the game.

Refund only: the coins come back, you stay put.

When to buy, when to refund, and in which order — that is the whole solution space of every level.

Level titles

Every level title is hand-written by the author: hints, rambling, dinner plans, and some genuine scams. And one useless but delightful rule — the title of level N is exactly N words long (N characters in Chinese and Japanese). It holds in all 15 languages, except level 50, which is simply a thank-you.

The systems

  • Fans blow you across the board in a straight line — the only safe way over the void. Fans take refunds too: the same gust, blown backwards.

  • Pins become record points when stepped on; refund one and you teleport straight back to it, from anywhere on the map.

  • Clocks are savepoints for YOU: a refund rewinds your position, coins and receipts to the moment you wound the clock. The map stays as it is.

  • Cameras are savepoints for the MAP: a refund rewinds the board to the snapshot, while you stay where you are. Combine both and the two timelines stay strictly independent.

  • Plus multiplier tiles, toll tiles, loose coins and the lethal void — 50 levels introduce new pieces chapter by chapter, then keep recombining the old ones.

The budget is the puzzle

Clearing a level takes exactly one thing: reach every ★.

The real constraint is money. On almost every level the starting coins sit right at the optimal solution — one purchase too many, and the last star quietly drifts out of reach. Solving a level means reworking your buy-and-refund order until the books balance.

Quality of life:

  • Unlimited undo, redo and restart — experimenting is free;

  • Every level ships with a verified official solution, replayable once you clear it;

  • Stuck on a level for 20 minutes? A portal opens in the corner and lets you skip it.

Features

  • 50 handcrafted single-player puzzle levels

  • Wall-piercing refunds, pin teleports, clock/camera dual savepoints, fan rides

  • A verified official solution for every level

  • Unlimited undo / redo

  • Full controller support, with hints that switch between keyboard and gamepad automatically

  • Interface and all level titles localized into 15 languages

  • 11 Steam achievements + Steam Cloud saves

If you like puzzle games with few rules and deep combinations, welcome to Refund.

store_data.about_the_game:
One life. Month by month. No do-overs.

Net Worthless is a turn-based strategy game — except you're not building an empire, just running one thoroughly average life. One turn — one month.

🎭 Choose your path

It all starts with picking a character, and it's not just a skin. Each archetype is its own game,

with its own starting conditions, goal, and deadline.

One wants to make a first fortune; another, to buy out the company that laid him off;

a third, to become a world-famous actress. Different starts, different ceilings, different paths.

🗓️ Plan ahead

You don't control your character in real time. You plan how the next 30 days play out:

hours of sleep, hours at the desk job, hours at the gym, hours studying, hours doomscrolling.

But Lady Luck, as we all know, has her own plans for your plans.

📊 This is an economic simulator

You'll have to deal with all the joys of adult life:

  • Inflation that eats your nest egg faster than you can refill it.

  • Loans, payday loans, and debt collectors who have your number on speed dial.

  • A market that never stops storming.

  • The choice: take a side gig and burn out completely, or save your sanity and skip lunch.

🧭 The game sets the rules, you choose the path

The game hands you systems and rules, but it won't tell you what's right.

Spoiler: there's no single right way. Slog away at three jobs, play the market, or just coast.

Every action is a trade: you swap time for money, money for health, health for sanity. Nothing grows for free.

Nobody holds your hand or flags the best move.

💀 Iron Will mode

For anyone who doesn't like save-scumming. The game saves once, at the end of the month, after every event has resolved. One slot, no backups.

Reloading won't undo a bad deal or a sudden illness. You live with what you chose.

This isn't difficulty for its own sake. It's honesty.

🔒 The game belongs to you

  • Fully offline. No launchers, no server tethers, no "always online."

  • Zero telemetry. The game collects nothing about you and sends nothing anywhere. Want to share your story? Leave a review or make a video, we're all for it. But it's your call.

  • Tiny footprint, runs on minimal specs. It'll even run on a potato.

Satire aimed at crypto bros, info-grifters, hustle culture, and the impossibility

of buying a home in the 2020s, wrapped around a merciless economy.

Get rich. Or at least don't die tryin'.

The game includes:
Mature/satirical themes — burnout, depression, money troubles, debt-collector harassment, and the death of your character from old age or poor health. These are conveyed through text and abstract stats, not graphic imagery.
Depictions of alcohol use — such as social drinking.
Mild language — occasional crude or strong language.
Non-graphic depictions of violence — for example, intimidation by a debt collector, shown through text without blood, gore, or graphic detail.
Speculative financial mechanics — investing in stocks, crypto, and businesses with random gains and losses. These are economic systems, not gambling, and involve no real money.
The game contains no sexual content or nudity, no graphic violence, and no microtransactions, ads, online play, or chat. It is fully offline.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gentle Doctor's Exclusive Shelter - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction
Ethan Gray's daughter was used as an experimental subject by the FX Group. When he delved into the project emails, he was shot by Teeraphat Saran. On the verge of death, he was taken over by a consciousness insect and got a new life. Then he went to a private clinic and had a tense interaction with Doctor Kyung-eun Choi. At this time, his ex-wife sent a distress message. Although he knew it was a trap, he was going to turn it into new rules.
Worldview Atmosphere
The story is shrouded in the thick fog of San Francisco. The Golden Gate Bridge is swallowed by the fog, and the ceiling lights in the underground parking lot are like ghosts in the fog. Cyberpunk elements are intertwined with transhumanism. Technological settings such as mysterious consciousness insects, gene sequence modifiers, and dimensional spiritual gate leaps create a future world full of unknowns and dangers.
Highlights of Female Character Interaction
Doctor Kyung-eun Choi has her blond hair coiled up and is wearing a white doctor's robe. She is not only professional and calm but also shows sexiness and shyness in her interaction with Ethan. The interaction between her and Ethan in the consulting room is full of a hormonal atmosphere. From the initial professional examination to the gradual warming of emotions later, it makes people feel a different kind of charm.
Tension in Character Relationships
Ethan and Teeraphat Saran are in a hostile relationship. Teeraphat is bent on killing Ethan. The relationship between Ethan and Kyung-eun Choi is a complex doctor-patient relationship. There is both medical instruction and obedience, as well as emotional attraction and entanglement. In addition, there are also varying degrees of conflicts of interest and emotional collisions between Ethan and his ex-wives Isabella and Laras Hermawan.
Scene Features
The story scenes are rich and diverse, ranging from the underground parking lot in the San Francisco Bay Area to the consulting room of the private clinic and then to the gallery in Manhattan. Each scene has its unique atmosphere. The gloom of the underground parking lot, the ambiguity of the consulting room, and the luxury of the gallery all add different colors to the story.
Immersive Experience
Players will follow Ethan's perspective and delve into this world full of science fiction and mystery. In the interaction with the characters, they can feel their emotional changes and experience exciting plots, as if they were a part of the story.
High-definition Visual Performance
The game uses high-definition graphics to delicately show the appearance, expressions of the characters and the details of the scenes. Whether it is Doctor Kyung-eun Choi's delicate makeup or the cool effects of cyber technology, it can bring visual enjoyment to players.
Functional Gameplay Features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one-key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The automatic play function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly locate the part they want to read, and the high-definition CG adds more visual impact to the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
XENOMIRE is a 2D top-down sci-fi horror extraction shooter set on Vespera, a lost colony planet consumed by alien contamination.

As a government operative, you descend from the safety of an orbital station into hostile zones such as abandoned facilities, alien ruins filled with mutated lifeforms. Complete contracts, recover valuable resources, upgrade your gear, and extract before sleeping horrors wake up.

Every expedition is a high-risk decision. The longer you stay, the more aggressive the alien presence becomes. What begins as a quiet mission through dark corridors can spiral into a desperate fight for survival against monster swarms, ruthless mercenaries, and unstoppable horrors.

DESCEND, LOOT, EXTRACT

Choose a contract, prepare your loadout, and land on Vespera. Search the zone for supplies, complete objectives, and decide when to leave. Death means losing valuable resources, so every item, weapon, and upgrade matters.

SURVIVE AN ALIEN ECOSYSTEM

Vespera reacts to your presence. Time spent on the planet increase alien aggression, making each mission more dangerous the longer it continues. Don't overstay your welcome.

BUILD YOUR OPERATIVE

Collect dozens of weapons, customize them with powerful modules, and combine different armor sets with their own upgrades to create a build that fits your playstyle. Become a fast scout, a heavily armed gunner, a resilient scavenger, an aggressive exterminator, or anyone you desire. 

EXPLORE A DARK SCI-FI WORLD

Uncover what happened to the first colony, investigate alien ruins, and work with uneasy factions aboard the orbital station, each trying to exploit Vespera in their own way. Inspired by the oppressive tension of classic sci-fi horror, XENOMIRE blends extraction gameplay with atmosphere, mystery, and constant pressure.

FEATURES

  • 2D top-down PvE extraction shooter gameplay

  • Expeditions to a hostile alien planet

  • Loot, resources, gear upgrades, and build variety

  • Escalating alien aggression during each mission

  • Dark sci-fi horror atmosphere

  • Abandoned facilities, alien ruins, swarms, and powerful monstrosities

  • Orbital station hub with factions, preparation, and progression

store_data.about_the_game:
Critical Ward is a frantic arcade survival game set in a hospital on the brink of collapse.

Treating patients sounds simple... until hundreds of them flood the hospital, angry relatives begin sabotaging medical equipment, contagious patients appear, and critical system failures strike.

Keep hospital occupancy under control, build massive combos, deploy automated medical equipment, and make split-second decisions as the chaos spirals out of control.

Every character offers a completely different way to play, from specialists capable of clearing entire wards to powerful healing machines that can become a threat when something goes wrong. But only those who truly master the hospital will unlock the mysterious Biker, a character who completely reinvents the way the game is played.

Features

  • Fast-paced arcade action inspired by the great survival shooters.

  • Unlock characters with completely unique abilities and playstyles.

  • Combo system that boosts both healing power and experience gained.

  • Deploy automated medical equipment to expand your coverage.

  • Use special items to survive desperate situations.

  • Contagious patients, troublesome relatives, and unpredictable events.

  • Arcade Mode and Wave Mode.

  • Character progression and achievement system.

  • Fast, intense and highly replayable runs.

The hospital never stops

Every discharged patient grants experience and resources, but every second brings new arrivals.

Will you try to stay in control... or wait until the last possible moment to unleash your Last Resort?

store_data.about_the_game:
OBJECTIVE
You are trapped in a house populated by hostile entities. The objective is absolute: search the environment, locate the hidden exit key, and unlock the room door to escape.

ADAPTIVE AI BEHAVIOR
The threat level scales as you progress. Advanced stages introduce smarter, highly sensitive entities with expanded patrol logic and sharper environmental awareness.

DECEPTION & EXPERIMENTATION
Survival requires navigating hazards and utilizing designated hiding spots. You can actively trick or distract threats to clear a path. However, entities learn from your behavior. If an enemy discovers they have been misled, they investigate that distraction point and adapt, rendering the same tactic useless a second time.

DYNAMIC SOUND TRIGGERS
Sound is the primary tracking mechanism. Generating noise alerts nearby threats instantly. Passive entities populate the house to sound alarms and broadcast your position if encountered, adding unpredictable layers to your escape route.

Hide

Don't Let Them Follow You

Don't Make Sound

store_data.about_the_game:
Party Executable is a narrative adventure game, discover lost secrets and interact with peculiar characters to learn more about the prison that is Fauxidy Manor.

Features

  • Interactive Dialogue! Interact with the many characters the Manor has to offer! Make dialogue choices to complement them, insult them, gather more information, give characters certain items, and many more possibilities!

  • Collect Stuff! Fauxidy Manor has many free things to steal collect for yourself, you just need to find them! Collect pinatas, crystals, spiders, and more! Each item has unique description which you can find in your codex. Some key items are also very useful in accessing certain parts of the Manor, or perhaps as a gift to certain entities!

  • Buy Stuff! Unfortunately there are things which are not free. They are held in a shop and you will need to collect tokens in order to purchase them. You can find tokens scattered in unusual places or perhaps as rewards for doing certain activities!

  • Read Classified Documents! Along with normal items and tokens, there are also documents which can be picked up and read! They are saved into your Codex so you can read them at any time! The contents can be anything from incidents, to love letters, to number combinations, or even about ████████████!

  • Explore the Manor! There are many places to reach in Fauxidy Manor, and multiple ways to reach them! Take your time and let the atmosphere of the funny oppressive Manor wash over you! Be careful however...

  • Survive. The Manor is rife with threats which threaten to end your life. You can run, you can hide, but combat is never an option. The horrors each have their own reasons for hunting you down, but that will not stop you from reaching your goal and escaping. Also be wise about the choices you make, as certain choices will make Fauxidy Manor more hostile towards you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set your bearing. Adjust for wind. Hope your aim is better than theirs.

M.A.D. - Mutually Assured Destruction is a modern 3D reimagining of the turn-based artillery duels you grew up with, rebuilt for up to 8 players across 4 teams, with a Cold War-era arsenal and beyond, ten tiers of AI, a full campaign, and online crossplay across VR and flatscreen, plus local hotseat.

Plant your base. Read the wind. Lob a tactical missile, a cluster bomb, or a nuke across the map and watch the whole table fire at once. Last base standing wins.

Play in VR or on a standard monitor — no headset required. Full crossplay between both.

KEY FEATURES

  • Up to 8 players, 4 teams - Host or join online games with friends, gather a crowd on one PC in pass-and-play hotseat, or mix both. Free-for-all or team up for the multiplayer mayhem this genre was made for.

  • Play it your way - Fire simultaneously for chaotic all-at-once barrages, or go sequential and classic turn-based for the methodical duel. The match plays how you want it to.

  • A real arsenal - Eleven distinct weapons drawn from Cold War-era ordnance and beyond: tactical missiles, bunker busters, bouncing bombs, cluster munitions, EMPs, mortars, cannons, the never-fires-the-same-way Crazy Ivan, and of course, nukes... and one that hits harder still. Fire single shots or unleash cinematic salvos that fill the sky with rocket trails.

  • Offense beyond the warhead - Pop chaff over an enemy to scramble their defenses while your real barrage closes in, or send in orbiting drones to strafe with guns and missiles.

  • Buy your defenses - It's not all offense. Invest in CIWS, point defense, flak to swat down drones, and permanent bunkers. Intercept incoming fire before it lands.

  • Play together, any setup - Everyone jumps in from their own PC over Steam, in VR or on a monitor, and any flatscreen player can pass the controller to friends on the couch beside them. Up to 8 players, mixed however you like - headsets, monitors, and hotseat all in one match.

  • 8 distinct battlefields - Rolling grasslands, rocky foothills, alpine knife-edge mountains, wind-blown dunes, a tropical island, low-ceilinged caverns that cap your firing arc, a lava-bleeding volcano, and fortress pillars floating above an endless cloud sea where you can't see where your misses land. Each one rewrites the fight.

  • A battlefield that remembers - Shots leave craters across the terrain - track your fire, read the aftermath. The battlefield wears your war as it goes.

  • Read the battlefield - Open maps give clean line-of-sight; mountains and caverns force you to master arc and power. Dial in map size, wind strength, and wind behavior (steady, breezy, or chaotic) to set your challenge.

  • Day / Night / NVG - Fight under a blazing sun, a starlit sky, or through the green wash of night vision.

  • Campaign mode - Climb from boot camp to five-star Battlefield Commander, learning every tool in the arsenal and earning medals along the way.

  • Ten tiers of AI - From clueless recruit to terrifyingly precise, with AI that scales aim, weapon IQ, and tactics. Train up, then test yourself.

  • Deep stats - Service records, war-room analytics, performance trends, per-weapon breakdowns, win streaks, and net war-chest profit. Track every shot.

A NOTE ON CROSSPLAY SETUPS

Each VR player needs their own PC - a headset can't also run a separate flatscreen seat at the same time. A single flatscreen PC, on the other hand, can host any number of pass-and-play hotseat players, up to the 8-player match cap. Check the System Requirements before you plan game night.

store_data.about_the_game:
Starglyphs is a puzzle game about tracing glyphs among the stars.

Each glyph you complete reveals a nebula in one of dozens of color palettes, with shooting stars crossing the sky.

Every constellation comes with a glyph guide. Connect the stars to match it, drawing each path only once.

The final connection transforms the constellation into a nebula, painted from one of dozens of color palettes. No two finished skies look quite the same.

All of your solved constellations are saved to your Atlas automatically. You can revisit the skies you've charted and name them, and Photo Mode lets you adjust and export your favorites.

Every glyph is procedurally generated and always solvable. Take on simpler constellations or denser, more intricate ones. Try a fifteen-star glyph for the ultimate challenge.

Every player receives the same Daily Glyph each day, at a random difficulty. See if you can finish it before your friends do.

Features

  • Constellation puzzles built around reading glyphs and connecting stars

  • A shifting night sky that blooms into a nebula when a glyph is complete

  • Procedurally generated glyphs, from simple patterns to fifteen-star challenges

  • An Atlas for naming, collecting, and revisiting completed constellations

  • A shared Daily Glyph

  • Photo Mode for saving your favorite skies

store_data.about_the_game:
Paint animals and blend in! Animal Chameleon is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game

Hide And Seek Action 

Paint your animal and hide from the seekers, paint you body to blend to the world and hide from the seekers attempting to find you.

Hide Together

Play With Friends Or Play Public Lobbies The choice is yours. This game will put your artistic skills to the test so grab your brushes and paint yourself in plain sight 

Hunt Animals

At the start of each round a Seeker will be randomly selected and has the task of finding all of the animals hiding, once you find an animal they also become a seeker and help you on your quest to win the round. 

Success isn't about running the fastest, it's about blending in the best. Study your surroundings, choose your colours carefully, and outsmart your opponents with clever disguises. Whether you're hiding as the last remaining animal or leading the hunt as a Seeker, every match is packed with meccha suspense, strategy, and hilarious moments.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wildborn Football Cup is a cinematic card-and-dice football strategy game where every attack becomes a tactical sequence.

Shape moves from the player cards you are dealt, push through midfield, break the defensive line, and finish the chance before momentum turns against you. When the match reaches its most dramatic moments, a penalty duel or a captain decision can turn the game in an instant.

Captains are the stars of the tournament. Each one brings unique instincts, signature tactics, and a personal reason to chase the trophy. Use them at the right moment, and a captain’s power can shift the outcome of an entire match.

Build the Attack

Each attacking phase is built from the player cards in your hand. Choose who carries the move, who supports it, and when to commit your strongest options.

A good sequence can break through the midfield, open the defense, and create a chance on goal. A poor one can stall, waste momentum, or leave you exposed when the opponent strikes back.

A strong attack feels like football: players moving together, space opening, and one decisive moment before the defense closes.

Penalties Are a Battle of Nerves

When a match reaches the penalty phase, the card battle gives way to a dice-driven duel between attacker and goalkeeper.

Choose your risk, read the pressure, and let the dice decide the final touch: a clean strike, a desperate save, or the moment that keeps your team alive.

Three Ways to Play

Campaign Mode
Lead Dominique Roar, captain of France, through a cinematic story campaign. Compete for the ultimate victory while uncovering the hidden truth behind the mysterious powers of the Cup.

Tournament Mode
Choose your country and chase football glory through a full tournament. Win matches, collect captain cards, and build your path toward the greatest honor in Wildborn football.

Deck League Mode
Play standalone matches of increasing difficulty using your own deck of players. Each opponent asks you to solve a tougher football puzzle: stronger pressure, fewer safe choices, and less room for wasted attacks.

A Tournament With Its Own Soul

Sixteen Wildborn nations enter the Cup, each shaped by its captain, its instincts, and its football identity. Between story moments, tactical swings, team anthems, and sudden dice drama, every match has its own personality.

This is football reimagined as a card-and-dice battle of nerve, momentum, and instinct.

store_data.about_the_game:
VOIDREND

The Void is rising. Plant your feet, pick your weapon, and turn an endless tide of the dead into a fountain of XP. Voidrend is a fast, stylish 3D arena survivor-like — play solo or drop into 1–4 player co-op and become an unstoppable build.

⚔️ Reap the Swarm

Your attacks fire automatically — your job is positioning, timing, and building a monster. Cleave 360° with the Sword, snipe through ranks with the Staff, backstab and vanish with the Daggers, or harvest souls in a wide arc with the Scythe. Chain kills into streaks that multiply your XP and damage, and watch the screen fill with hundreds of enemies.

🧬 Evolve a Game-Breaker

Every level-up offers a choice. Stack 5-rank stat upgrades, unlock weapon abilities, and combine them into one of 14 evolutions — call down chain lightning as Thunder God, tear open a gravity singularity as Black Hole, or fortify into an unkillable Iron Fortress. Reroll, banish, and bank your upgrades to chase the exact build you want. No two runs play the same.

🗺️ Five Biomes. Five Bosses. One Void.

Fight from the lush Meadow into the Crypt, the hellish Abyss, the Frozen Wastes, and the screaming Void — each with its own look, lighting, hazards, and enemy roster. Every stage ends with a towering, multi-phase boss in a bespoke arena: the Slime King, Skeleton Lord, Demon Lord, Frost Titan, and the Void Walker. Stagger them, exhaust them, and bring them down — then keep going into endless mode.

🕳️ The Rift Tide — the floor is the boss

A creeping field of corruption rises with the horde and recedes when you fight at its edge. Stand in the Void and it eats your health; reclaim the ground and the swarm thins. In the final boss phase the Void anchors itself and you fight the boss and the floor at once. It's a survivor-like signature you won't find anywhere else.

🤝 Better Together

Host or join a game with a simple 4-letter room code. Up to 4 players share pickups, revive each other, ping threats, and combine builds to melt bosses. Authoritative netcode with client-side prediction keeps it crisp.

🔁 Built to Replay

  • 4 weapons, each with a distinct identity and signature mechanic

  • 14 evolutions + auto-activating resonance pair-bonuses

  • 12 enemy types — summoners, chargers, frost-casters, healers, and more — plus elites and affixes

  • Meta-progression you carry between runs

  • Daily challenges with a fixed seed and a global leaderboard

  • Fully procedural audio — adaptive music that reacts to streaks, danger, and bosses

🎮 Play Your Way

Full keyboard & mouse and gamepad support, remappable controls, colorblind modes, and accessibility options. Solo runs play fully offline — bring friends when you want the chaos.

Sharpen your blade. The Void is patient, but it is not kind.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everything hinges on the fold

Paper Flags is a two-player strategy game on a 9×9 board. Every pieces starts folded: moving one square diagonally forward, contained and deliberate. Unfold it, and it becomes a flag: sliding any number of squares along a rank or file, like a rook with somewhere to be.

That change—one piece, one action, no movement—is enough to end a game.

Three Actions | Constant Pressure

On your turn, you choose exactly one: move a piece, fold a flag down, or unfold a piece into a flag. The board is never still.

Victory comes one of three ways. Territory, Domination, and Overrun. To Dominate your opponent, reduce them to three pieces or fewer. To Territorially Overpower them, plant three flags on your opponent's back row.

If your opponent is one legal action from winning, you are Under Threat and your next move must break it. If you can't, you are Overrun.

For chess players and strategy fans

The structure is recognizable: two players, perfect information, no luck. The driving goals of territory and elimination are familiar. But the fold mechanic shifts the calculus in ways that take more than a couple of games to really feel. Pieces don't just threaten where they stand, they far more often threaten what they might become.

A piece sitting quietly on the fourth rank is a flag waiting to seize control.

Features

  • Player vs Computer: Four AI difficulties, from approachable to punishing

  • Player vs Player: Local hot-seat on the same screen

  • Play Online: Invite a friend for a remote match

  • Computer vs Computer: Watch the AI battle itself

  • Controller Support

  • Multi-platform play

About

Paper Flags is developed by Stephen Merriam at Winterlude Interactive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise a tankard. Raise a warhammer. Same hand if you're feeling brave.

Hammered Heroes is a roguelite about recruiting a rowdy band of fantasy heroes and sending them brawling down a dungeon that runs deeper than anyone sober should attempt. You don't pilot a single hero — you command the whole drunken expedition. Pick who joins, what they specialize in, where you descend, and how you spend every coin. Then the band fights it out in real time while you read the battlefield and make the calls that keep them standing.

Every run starts with one free founding hero and a fistful of gold. Every run ends differently.

Command the band, don't babysit it
Your heroes hold the line, pick their targets, and swing on their own. Your job is the part that actually wins runs: building a party whose damage types cover the road ahead, choosing the right boon after every floor, training skill points into the build you're chasing, and knowing when to spend gold on a fresh recruit instead of a heal. Get the composition right and your band steamrolls. Get greedy and the whole expedition wipes in the dark.

A roster where no two parties are alike
Start with a free founding hero and earn the rest by playing — slay enough goblins to recruit the Wizard, clear graveyards for the Death Knight, raze monster dens for the Demolitionist. Glass-cannon Sorcerers that start frail and end devastating. Holy Templars that scourge the undead. Beastmasters, Pyromancers, Gladiators, Assassins — each with its own stats, damage type, and a kit of signature abilities.

Biomes that fight back
Descend through stone halls, frozen wastes, haunted graveyards, trap-laced mines, sunken marshes, and burning underworlds. Each biome has a signature monster that dictates how you should fight there — frost to chill the swarms, holy to put down the undead, fire to melt the frost-numb, arcane to shatter the armored. Bring the wrong party and the dungeon teaches you why.

A descent with teeth
Bosses guard the deep floors. Chromatic dragons stand as the run's great walls, each tougher than anything before it. Reach the bottom and a final tyrant waits — fell it to win, or press on into Endless and see how deep your band can really go.

Die smarter, not just again
When the band falls, you keep what matters. Fallen wanderers leave Echoes behind — spend them on permanent upgrades that make every future expedition tougher. Every class grows stronger the more you play it, carried across all runs forever. Each wipe sends you back to the tavern a little stronger, a little wiser, and ready to go again.

The dungeon's deep, the ale's flowing, and somebody has to clear it. Might as well be hammered.

store_data.about_the_game:
Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.

The town of Black Hollow has fallen to the Hollow Plague, a strange sickness that twists its victims into violent, rabid, demon-like creatures. As the last plague doctor still searching for a cure, you have retreated to an abandoned farmstead to continue your research. Each night, the infected come through the fields. Each corpse leaves behind plague ichor, organs, and corrupted materials that may bring you closer to understanding the sickness.

Survive the Night

Defend your farmstead from waves of infected peasants, rabid villagers, bloated plague victims, corrupted healers, armored guards, and stronger boss-like threats. Every night becomes more dangerous as the plague sends more of Black Hollow’s dead toward your refuge.

Fight Like a Plague Doctor

Use a crooked staff, alchemical lantern, thrown potions, plague vials, and experimental remedies to survive. Your weapons are not heroic tools of war. They are medical instruments, failed cures, and dangerous plague research turned against the infected.

Harvest Plague Ichor

Enemies drop plague ichor, a glowing green-black residue left behind by the infected. Collect it during combat and use it as the main resource for research, upgrades, and new abilities.

Attune Your Research at the Runestone

Outside the farmstead stands an ancient runestone carved with glowing plague runes. By offering plague ichor and infected materials, you can unlock new staff attacks, improve your lantern, strengthen your potions, and turn forbidden research into weapons.

A Dark Low-Fantasy World

Black Hollow is not a world of grand magic and shining heroes. It is a grim medieval plague setting filled with fog, rot, failed medicine, corrupted villagers, and desperate survival. The plague behaves like a disease, but something older and stranger moves beneath it.

Key Features

First-person plague doctor combat

Wave-based survival at a remote farmstead

Roguelite upgrades and progression

Plague ichor resource collection

Ancient runestone upgrade system

Staff attacks, ranged plague shots, and thrown potions

Low-fantasy medieval horror atmosphere

Multiple infected enemy types

Dark alchemical abilities and plague-based weapons

A grim story about survival, research, and the search for a cure

Black Hollow is about surviving one more night, gathering one more sample, and pushing one step closer to the truth behind the plague.

store_data.about_the_game:
Strap into a sleek shuttle, drop through a planet's atmosphere, and walk its surface. Then lift off, break orbit, and aim for a new pinprick of light on the far side of the system. In Holospace there are no loading screens between worlds — just one continuous voxel universe that runs as far as you're virtually willing to fly.

One seamless journey, surface to space

Pilot your ship from the ground, up through the atmosphere, into open space, and on to the next planet — all in real time, no cuts. Land anywhere, park on the pad, and explore on foot: run, sprint, jump, and jetpack across voxel terrain beneath a living sky of day/night cycles and rolling weather.

An endless procedural universe

Every planet is rolled from its own seed — palette, gravity, terrain, biomes, oceans, and the creatures that roam it, all generated coherently from scratch. No two worlds are exactly the same. Your home world is always waiting; everything beyond is yours to chart.

Mine, craft, and build

Carve into the world with a plasma cutter, gather materials tier by tier, and craft at deployable stations on a shaped recipe grid. Place blocks, raise structures, and leave your mark — your edits to a world persist.

Gear up

Wield a deep arsenal — plasma rifles, SMGs, revolvers, snipers, scatter guns, and glowing plasma blades — and customize your exosuit from a range of craftable styles and upgrades. Summon a glowing Echo orb to light the dark and help you traverse the unknown.

Survive the firefights

Worlds erupt into Surges: dropships descend and waves of creatures and armed voiders, the corrupted in the universe. Close in with rushers, ranged units, and heavies that take cover and flank. Hold your ground, or run for your ship.

Beware the dark

Deep space hides wandering black holes. Real-time gravitational lensing bends the starfield around a glowing accretion disk, and their gravity wells reach far. Stray too close and the pull turns inescapable — spiral in and get stretched into a fine cosmic noodle, or get hurled clear across the galaxy through a wormhole.

Fly together

Host or join over LAN and explore the universe with friends.

Make it your own

Keep multiple save "universes," each with its own seed and its own worlds to discover.

Disclaimer

store_data.about_the_game:
The Crystal Atelier is a cozy crafting RPG about turning rough materials into treasured masterworks.

Begin with a humble gem workshop and build your name one careful step at a time. Mine rough stones, chisel away the excess, wash away the grit, mend cracks, infuse elemental essence, and polish each gem into something worthy of a patron's request. As your atelier grows, new paths open through alchemy, smithing, and higher guild recognition.

What begins as a small artisan shop grows into a long-form journey of craft, discovery, and refinement.

Key Features

Restore gems by hand

Take rough finds through a tactile process of chiseling, washing, mending, infusing, polishing, and finishing each piece for sale or commission work.

Run your own atelier

Fulfill guild requests, earn gold, invest in workshop upgrades, and shape the rhythm of a growing artisan business.

Expand into alchemy and smithing

Unlock new ways to turn gathered materials into potions, forged goods, and advanced commissions that deepen the same core craft loop.

Grow from small workshop to master atelier

Progress through better tools, richer materials, tougher requests, and higher guild recognition as your craft reaches new heights.

Manage a satisfying web of materials and decisions

Balance gems, dust, essence, reagents, orders, and upgrades while deciding what to restore, refine, sell, or save for later.

Follow a full single-player artisan journey

Build your atelier from its earliest days to a masterwork legacy through steady progression, discovery, and increasingly prestigious work.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Collection of games that try not to reach far.

This is a collection of 12 retro games I made in PICO-8. These games range from a wide variety of genres, so you're bound to find something you like!

These games come from a variety of genres, and theres something for everyone.

You'll find city building games, score based arcade games, platformers, 

When you boot up the game, after the title screen, you'll be met with a screen outlining every game available to play, pick one that you'd like, boot it up, and play!

This collection includes:

  • Trash Attack - Score-based arcade game about collecting trash falling from the sky!

  • Metropolis - City builder game about managing a city and keeping your residents happy

  • Ghostlies Adventures - Platformer game about a ghost trying to find its own grave.

  • Hopeless Romantic - Adventure game about saving valentines day

  • Spike Factory Trouble! - Score-based arcade game about dodging spikes on the road!

  • Spike Factory Trouble! (classic, using the older designs)

  • Cow Ball: Rolling Through The Seasons - Puzzle game about rolling along a farm through the seasons of the year.

  • Gambling Square Root (G8)* - Blackjack, but with twists to the rules!

  • Robo-Dungeon - A roguelike where robots rule the world!

  • Not Another Flappy Clone! - Flappy Bird, but with a twist.

  • Rebuilder - Incremental about rebuilding the game itself.

  • Cat Game - Incremental about cats!

*G8 may not be appropriate for all ages, as it contains simulated gambling

store_data.about_the_game:
MISTWOODS

Something woke beneath the Ancient Ruins. The forest has been answering ever since.

Mistwoods is a dark fantasy narrative RPG set in Brackenford — a trade village on the edge of a corrupted forest that has started sending things back that should have stayed dead. You are not a chosen one. You are the sort of person a desperate village prays for when the sensible options are already gone.

Build your character. Choose your origin — mercenary, hunter, refugee, pilgrim, or caravan survivor — then your path, and the strange fate mark the road left on you. Every choice shapes your stats, your gold, and the way the world reads you.

Lead three companions. Ura is a dwarven warrior who solves arguments with an axe and privately notices everything. Gilleth is a rogue building a philosophy out of near-misses and one regrettable wedding. Anaise is an archer and healer carrying faith through the evidence against it. They will argue, confide in you around a campfire, and go somewhere unreasonable for each other — if you give them reason to.

Navigate a corrupted world. From Brackenford's last-chance tavern to the Mistwood's branching paths, through the sealed Ashcroft Crypt and the Ancient Ruins, all the way to Groveheart Sanctuary and the heart of the corruption: every area offers meaningful choices, hidden events, and consequences that travel with you.

Fight or negotiate. A turn-based combat system rewards preparation, companion bonds, and knowing when to run. Enemies can flee, surrender, or be reached through mercy. The way you fight shapes which ending finds you.

Watch the corruption grow. A rising corruption bar tracks the cost of every wrong decision, every brutal choice, and every door left open. Let it fill — and the forest stops waiting.

Seven endings. Verdant Dawn or The Corrupted Crown. The Last Mercy or Ash and Roots. And one ending that only appears if you know where to look. The choices that determine which one you reach are spread across the entire journey — not saved for the final room.

Choices tracked. Consequences kept. Fog not guaranteed to lift.

The game begins in 1488. Victory is achieved when either 100 years have passed or all territories have been conquered.

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn a corner of your desktop into a tiny, living world.

Grow adorable creatures, care for them on a customizable floating island, and let them quietly accompany you while you study, work, or relax. Your companions live alongside your daily routine, occasionally asking for attention through short interactions while spending the rest of their time exploring, sleeping, and hanging out together.

Grow Your Collection

Plant seeds and nurture them until they mature into unique Wooberts. Every seed grows into a specific species, while personality traits make each one feel different.

Build Their Little Home

Customize your floating island by placing farm plots and decorations to create the perfect habitat. Watch your creatures naturally wander the island, rest in their favorite spots, and interact with the environment.

Relaxing Wooberts Interactions

Your Wooberts will occasionally ask to spend time with you through bite-sized minigames and activities. Complete these interactions to strengthen your bond, level up your companions, and unlock new memories.

Discover Every Creature

Unlock new seeds as you progress, collect a growing roster of Wooberts, and fill your journal with detailed entries. Learn about each Woobert's personality, discover hidden memories, and slowly uncover fragments of a forgotten world.

Designed to Stay With You

This is a game made to be played alongside your day. Whether you're studying, working, drawing, or simply browsing the web, your little island continues to feel alive without demanding your constant attention.

Features

  • Grow and collect adorable Wooberts with unique personalities.

  • Customize a cozy floating island with decorations.

  • Play relaxing interaction minigames with your companions.

  • Discover unlockable creature memories and journal entries.

  • Level up Wooberts and unlock new seeds to expand your collection.

  • A cozy desktop companion designed to accompany your daily routine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to "CUMANIOK" — a unique 3D open-world village life and business simulator, packed with local humor and the heartwarming atmosphere of traditional countryside!

You start your journey with a simple, overgrown plot of land, but you have an ambitious goal — to become the most respected "Gospodar" (Master Householder) in the village. In this game, you don't just click buttons; you freely control your character, drive cars, explore the village, and build your estate from scratch.

KEY FEATURES:

Iconic Rural Car Fleet: Forget about expensive supercars! Get behind the wheel of an old-school classic, a legendary and spacious diesel station wagon, or drive to the local village club in a flashy vintage sedan. Start your engine and drive through dirt roads to the local store to buy construction materials!

Idle Village Business: Build greenhouses for juicy tomatoes, set up beehives, manage a chicken coop, and plant vineyards. Set up a market bench by your gates to sell fresh homemade goods to passing tourists and earn steady passive income.

Yard Customization & "Casa Mare":Turn your yard into a masterpiece. Build a traditional sweep well, a cozy wooden gazebo for family gatherings, and construct a beautiful house with a mandatory "Casa Mare" (the grand traditional guest room).

Cozy Village Vacation Vibe: Enjoy relaxing gameplay filled with funny cultural references, authentic traditions, soul-stirring music, and the cozy feeling of spending summer at grandma's house.

Grab your hoe, fuel up your wagon, and show everyone who the real Master of the village is!

store_data.about_the_game:
Pay off your debts, empty the vaults, and just relax.

Debtbound is an incremental (idle/clicker) game designed for active play without any of the headache. No three-hour tutorials, no useless dialogue: you launch the game, you get it instantly, and you start progressing.

With its clean visuals and ultra-chill soundtrack, it’s the perfect game to unwind after a long day while enjoying the sheer thrill of watching numbers explode.

Debtbound features:

  • Active & rewarding gameplay: While you will unlock automation over time, your presence and quick reflexes make all the difference when it comes to maximizing your earnings.

  • Zero fluff, 100% fun: Immediate gameplay, short sessions, and intuitive controls that feel completely natural.

  • A massive skill tree: Upgrade your abilities run after run to hoard mountains of cash faster and faster.

3 game modes to switch things up (and more!)

Each mode offers a unique way to handle your cash:

  • Classic Mode (The Debt): Accumulate cash in quick sessions to pay back what you owe. Each run lets you unlock permanent upgrades in a giant skill tree, until you reach that pure state of satisfaction where the money just flows.

  • Survival Mode (The 50 Days): A slightly longer, more strategic experience. Survive for 50 days against increasingly heavy daily bills. Collect cash to level up, choose the right upgrade cards, and manage random events (both good and bad) that spice up your days.

  • Heist Mode (The Sprint): The clock is ticking! You have just a few minutes to blast through increasingly lucrative rooms and open as many vaults as possible to grab all the cash you can before time runs out. Choose temporary boosts after each room to help you along. But stay on your guard: opening vaults can trigger positive or negative cards that will drastically ease or complicate your progress through the next rooms!

Do you have what it takes to break the cycle of debt and strike it rich? Get comfortable, launch a run, and start raking it in!

A quiet, unattended laundromat.
Washing machines spinning.
A row of dryers.
Stacked laundry baskets.

store_data.about_the_game:
No Reserve


When the lots turn rotten and the clocks start counting down, your only honest bid is your own heart.

In the chandeliered saleroom of Calthorpe's—an old London auction house quietly fighting for its life—star auctioneer Julian Ashby is preparing the season-defining event: The Aslanov Collection. Three weeks before the hammer falls, the pillars of his sale begin to collapse at once: the "rediscovered" Old Master that made his name shows signs of forgery, a temple deity's immaculate provenance hides wartime looting, and the consignor's fortune is a sanctioned machine disguised as elegance.

As pressure mounts from the boardroom, the press, and the calendar itself, Julian is pulled into three incompatible romances—each with a woman who holds a different truth he can't un-know—and forced to decide what he's willing to withdraw… and what he'll risk offering with no reserve.

Meet the Cast




Lara Aslanova — The Wife
Lara is the sanctioned magnate's glittering young wife—and, on paper, the "clean" owner of a fortune desperate to reach the market. She offers Julian an arrangement: staged closeness as cover, the sale as her exit, and the collection as leverage—because leaving her marriage any other way could be fatal. To Julian, Lara is performance honed into survival… and the dangerous possibility that something real is hiding under it.



Sophea Lim — The Barrister
A formidable British-Cambodian cultural-restitution barrister, Sophea is suing to pull a looted Koh Ker deity from Julian's sale and send it home. She is also Julian's estranged wife, separated for nearly a year with an unsigned divorce still haunting both their desks. To Julian, Sophea is both opposing counsel and unfinished history: brilliant, combative, and the one person whose judgment cuts past every charm he's ever used.



Isobel Carr — The Conservator
Calthorpe's head of scientific research, Isobel is Julian's quiet counterweight: where he sees, she proves. Her evidence threatens to expose the career-making Judith as a forgery, detonating the season—and the long, unspoken intimacy of nine years at the same easel. To Julian, she is truth in human form: precise, unbribable, and terrifyingly close.

Key Features


  • A high-stakes, contemporary romance VN set inside London's elite art market, where beauty, power, and paperwork can make anything look "clean."
  • Three distinct romance routes with a single pivotal choice, each built around a different dynamic: Slow-Burn Coworkers, Fake Relationship / Marriage of Convenience, and Estranged-but-Stuck.
  • A morally charged central mystery: forgery, cultural repatriation, and sanctions-era money laundering collide in one compromised season.
  • Time pressure and escalating "season clocks"—an impending evening sale, an injunction hearing, an attribution bombshell, and looming compliance deadlines keep tension tight.
  • A thematic core about authenticity—by or after, real or performed—asking whether love can survive when everything else has a price tag.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

Content Warning


No Reserve is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences. It contains explicit sexual content in adult scenes, strong romantic themes, and mature subject matter including infidelity/estrangement, coercive power dynamics, cultural heritage theft and repatriation disputes, fraud/forgery, and sanctions-era financial misconduct. Player discretion is advised.
