store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a fantasy world, use magic and mythical creatures to explore, manage crops, and build community with non-human neighbours.

The environment drastically shifts at nightfall, revealing hidden fantastical creatures, nocturnal magical crops, and spells needed to nurture your farm in ways traditional tools cannot.

Set in a vibrant, undiscovered fantasy world teeming with dormant wonders, mystical biomes, and secrets waiting to be explored by a human from another world.

Whisked away to a magical realm, you must restore an abandoned enchanted farm to its former glory. By mastering the rhythm of the sun and the moon, you will uncover the secrets of the realm and find your true home.

A unique crop system where magic-infused farming replaces mundane chores, focusing on high-value night crops and artisan automation.

Reintroduce the art of traditional agriculture to a wild land. Spend your days tending to nostalgic crops and raising familiar livestock, establishing a stable foundation for the civilization you are rebuilding under the warm sun.

As dusk falls, the night reveals the true nature of this world, offering exotic plants that can only survive in the glow of the moon and elemental beasts that challenge you to adapt to a different rhythm.

Capture and tame elemental creatures to assist in resource gathering, farm management, and exploring new environmental biomes.

Tame elemental spirits to automate your crops with magic, and raise sturdy beasts to aid your exploration. Discover unique synergies between creatures to create a thriving, magical ecosystem on your land.

Wield the forgotten human power to commune with nature. Bond with ethereal elemental spirits and majestic beasts alike.

Become a bridge between worlds by building meaningful relationships with non-human neighbors and helping them revitalize their society.

Curious about your mythical neighbors? Bridge the gap between species by uncovering their unique stories, tastes, and traditions.

Build profound friendships or pursue romance across racial lines to prove that connection knows no boundaries.

Explore vast, otherworldly biomes to find rare species and master the art of breeding to unlock specialized traits and superior elemental skills & materials.

  • Farm

    A secluded valley where ancient, overgrown gears peek through fertile soil.

  • Capital

    A grand, decaying capital built atop massive, medieval human ruins.

  • Forest

    The forest floor slopes down into white-sand shores where the tides wash up old-world debris.

    A dense woodland where massive, ancient trees entwine with crumbling houses.

  • Volcano

    A treacherous landscape of blackened stone and rivers of molten lava. Hidden within the heat are ancient geothermal conduits that once powered a global empire.

  • Dessert

    A vast expanse of golden dunes hiding solar-powered arrays and wind-worn pylons of the old world. Only the hardiest mythical creatures can survive the scorching sun and sandstorms.

  • Winter

    A frozen wasteland where skeletal remains of creatures are preserved. The silence of the blizzard is broken only by the cry of frost-adapted creatures.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Collapsed World

People have abandoned the cities and towns, leaving only the infected behind in once-familiar places. Abandoned roads, forests, and ruined locations still bear the traces of what happened after the fall. Left alone, you must face the clues that remain and the dangers that stand in your way.

Choices for Survival

The infected are a constant threat to your survival. Sometimes you will need to pass by quietly, and sometimes you will have to use a weapon to escape danger. Safe paths are few. With limited resources and unforgiving environments, every decision can affect your chances of survival.

Traces Left Behind

Abandoned places still hold the traces of those who left. As you move through cities, towns, forests, and dangerous locations, you will search for your next destination. Exploration is not just about moving forward — it is a journey to find the hope that still remains.

Checkate is a roguelike deckbuilder where checkers goes completely off the rails. Break the rules, build absurd combos, wreck bosses.

Item Shop

Spend your hard-earned money on items, pieces, and booster packs. Every purchase pushes your run further, so choose what fits your strategy and build toward combos the board never saw coming.

Booster Packs

Crack open booster packs to score new pieces and items, then weave them into your run for combos the board was never built to handle.

Items

Items work quietly in the background. Once you own one, its buff stays active for the rest of your run, no setup, no activation, just a steady edge that stacks with everything else you build.

Pieces

Pieces are yours to place on the board. Deploy them where they'll do the most damage, chain them into your captures, and turn a tight position into a board-clearing combo.

Break the rules. Build the chaos. Become unstoppable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn Mahjong into a scoring engine that grows stronger with every move.

Mahjong Rush is an ink-wash style mahjong roguelike deckbuilding game.
No four-player battles. No discards, calls, or dealing into someone else’s hand.
Your goal is simple: sit down at one table after another and use Chows, Pongs, Kongs, Discards, Talismans, and Plays to push your score past the target line.

Start with an ordinary hand. Build it, shape it, and turn it into your own scoring engine.

🀄 Chips × Multiplier — One Explosive Payoff

Every Play is scored independently:

Chips × Multiplier

  • Chows, Pongs, and Kongs stay on the table, continuously providing Chips and Multiplier.

  • Honor tiles, sequences, triplets, formations… every part of your hand can become a new source of power.

  • Once your Multiplier is high enough, a single winning hand can send your score sky-high.

Build, charge, cash out — that is what it means to WIN WIN WIN.

🗺️ Route Map — Every Step Is a Choice

Each run unfolds across a roguelike route map.
At every branch, you choose one node and leave the other behind:

  • Normal Tables — steady and reliable.

  • High-Score Tables — risky, but rich with rewards.

  • Shops — buy Flower Cards, Talismans, and Relics.

  • Yokai Bosses — tough battles with punishing special rules.

Gold and your build carry forward throughout the run.
Every choice pushes your game in a different direction.

🎴 Flower Cards, Talismans, and Relics — Build Your Own Playstyle

  • 100+ Flower Cards — in-run passives that reshape scoring, Multiplier, Chows, Pongs, Kongs, and economy.

  • 10+ Talismans — one-use active items that can turn the tide at critical moments.

  • 30+ Relics — long-term passive upgrades that form the core of your snowballing engine.

Buy, sell, refresh the shop, or spin the wheel of fate for new card pools.
No two runs play out the same.

🔥 Advanced Winning Hands — Let the Numbers Spiral Higher

As the game progresses, unlock more advanced winning hands:

Big Three Dragons, All Green, Four Kongs, Thirteen Orphans, and more.

The rarer the hand, the more outrageous the Multiplier.

Combine Flower Cards, Relics, Talismans, and the perfect timing for your winning hand, and watch the score climb higher and higher.

A brush of ink.
A perfect table.

This round, let’s see if you can truly — Mahjong Rush！

store_data.about_the_game:
A precision platformer built around one rule: you leave echoes of yourself behind.

Place an echo mid-jump — it becomes solid. A platform. A shield. A bridge. You carry three at a time. Every placement is a decision; every deletion, a second chance.

One mechanic. Infinite depth. 

How it works

Your echoes aren't decorations — they're tools. Ride them, jump off them, block lasers with them, bridge a gap and delete it behind you as you fall. The same three echoes that feel simple in level one will demand everything from you by level twenty-five.

No shortcuts. No hand-holding. Just the mechanic, and you.

Die. Learn. Own it.

Instant respawn. No checkpoints to soften the blow, no filler to pad the time.

Hazards compound as you progress — spikes, sweeping lasers, patrolling enemies, turrets, vanishing floors, moving platforms. Each one teaches you something. Each death is data.

You'll fail a run that felt impossible, then clear it on muscle memory alone. That's ECHO.

Controls

Move — WASD / Arrows / Left Stick

Jump — Space / W / A / A

Dash — Shift / B

Place Echo — C / X

Delete Echo — E / Y

Full controller support — including on-screen button prompts for Xbox controllers.

Designed for fans of Celeste, N++, and Super Meat Boy.

ECHO began as a solo project. After extensive playtesting and iteration, it's heading to a full Steam release.

Credits

Game Development & Level Design — Ionașcu Andrei
Music & SFX — Ionașcu Cristian
Cover Art — Ionașcu Andrei

Dash. Echo. Repeat.

I SHALL NAME THE DEAD

At a cemetery amidst the Metropolis, the bones of the dead pile up. Robbed of their identities, they remain in limbo, no grave, no dignity.

 

From the entrails of the Metropolis crawls Imaculada.

Cursed with the Worm gnawing at her insides, she makes her way to the Necropolis.

 

There, she’ll speak to the dead and uncover their forgotten names.

 

She shall name the dead.

 

MEMORIALS

●      A new atmospheric horror experience from Tiago Rech, writer of TELEFORUM, I DID NOT BUY THIS TICKET and DROWNED LAKE.

●      Hand-drawn art by Lirio Ninotchka, art director of I DID NOT BUY THIS TICKET.

●      Explore the cemetery, the City Within the City: interact with its denizens and unique sepulchral art.

●      The Worm overtakes your words: burn matches to purify dialogue choices, or allow him to get ever closer.

●      Investigate the clues by the dead, uncover their names, and name them so they can finally be cremated.

●      A surreal, magical-realism horror narrative with no jumpscares.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rogue's Flush is a single-player poker roguelike deckbuilder about turning a standard 52-card deck into a criminally elegant score engine.

Every Mark gives you limited Plays, Sleights, and Redraws. Pick up to five cards, build real poker hands, and beat the target before the table catches up. Each score is easy to read and hard to master: Stake x Odds = Take.

Build the Crew

Start each run with a Crew card, then recruit from the Backroom Shop after every cleared Mark. The live roster includes 70 Crew across Common, Uncommon, and Rare tiers, each pushing different poker lines, risk profiles, and economy plans.

Stack duplicate Crew for diminishing returns, chase hand specialists, suit engines, rank payoffs, end-of-mark bonuses, or run-scaling masterminds. Your crew is your build.

Cheat with style

Use Sleights to burn selected cards. Redraw the whole hand when the deal goes cold. Buy one-use Tricks that bend the table: forge Golden cards, swap suits, copy key cards, restore resources, destroy dead weight, or push immediate Take.

The shop also offers Rackets: run upgrades that add Plays, Redraws, Sleights, score bonuses, Trick slots, richer draws, lower targets, and more.

Cards carry heat

Fresh decks can roll special card statuses and editions: Golden, Silver, Bronze, Frozen, Hunted, Poisoned, Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome. Some add Stake. Some bend Odds. Some pay cash. Some punish sloppy hands. Premium cards can turn one clean Pair into a run-saving payday.

Climb the casino ladder

Take on Tourist, High Roller, and Pit Boss Marks with rising targets and shifting pressure. Pit Bosses can hide cards face down, tax suits, cut your Redraws, or reward a perfect opening shot before turning cruel.

Beat a Pit Boss and the Long Con opens: claim a reward now, or carry a Score Case to a later boss for bigger permanent run power. Lose before it opens and the case is gone.

Return to the Safehouse

Clearing Pit Bosses earns Notoriety, unlocks Safehouse Edges, and lets you prep future jobs with contacts, bankroll perks, tactical advantages, and gear. Save favorite loadouts, chase better Top Takes, and come back sharper every run.

Built for feel

Rogue's Flush pairs crisp pixel cards, animated casino-felt backgrounds, punchy chip-and-card audio, fanned hands, readable tooltips, autosaves, and full keyboard or mouse play. It has casino style, but no real-money gambling or microtransactions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Football Boardroom is a football club management sim where you sit in the director’s chair, not on the touchline.

You hire the manager. You set the budget. You negotiate the sponsors, expand the stadium, and decide whether to push for promotion or steady the ship. Matchday plays out live, but your job is influence, not formations. Text the manager. Demand a sub. Tell them to push forward or sit deep. Two interventions per match. Use them wisely.

Every week, the club needs a decision. Every season, the league table tells the story.

YOUR ORIGIN. YOUR CLUB.

Start with a director backstory, ex-player investor, city financier, lifelong fan with a windfall, or media operator. Your choices shape starting cash, club reputation, fan loyalty, and how the press sees you.

Pick a league pyramid and starting division, from the County League at the bottom to the Apex League at the top. Take over a pre-made club with history and character, or build your own; name, colours, badge, motto, the lot.

RUN THE CLUB

This is chairman football, not spreadsheet football, but the spreadsheets still bite.

  • Squad & transfers — buy, sell, and loan through summer and winter windows. Watch release clauses, wage bills, and squad morale.

  • Manager — hire tacticians with distinct styles, formations, and man-management skills. Keep them happy, or pay the severance.

  • Academy — invest in youth intake, develop prospects, and promote the next generation.

  • Stadium & commercial — expand capacity, upgrade facilities, set ticket prices, and land shirt and naming-rights deals.

  • Identity — kit design, merch, branding, and the kind of club fans actually want to follow.

Promotion spots are scarce. Relegation is real. The pyramid has four tiers and twenty-plus clubs per division. Climb it, or fall.

MATCHDAY FROM THE BOARDROOM

When your team kicks off, follow the action in a live match dock, commentary, moments, momentum shifts. You don’t pick the lineup. You don’t drag players around a tactics board. You watch, react, and intervene like a director who actually owns the place.

BEYOND THE CLUB

Your personal fortune and the club treasury are separate problems. Invest personal cash when the club is skint. Withdraw dividends when times are good. Use the bank. Manage the mogul life.

Expand into side businesses, at portfolio level, set each venture to grow, steady, or harvest. They won’t demand your full attention, but they will fund your ambitions… or drain them.

WEEKLY TURNS. LONG GAME.

Football Boardroom runs in weekly turns, one decision layer at a time, always moving forward. Difficulty scales starting resources. Easy gives you breathing room. Hard makes every transfer feel like a gamble.

No game studio. No hardware R&D. No distractions. Just football, finance, and the long climb from lower-league obscurity to top-flight pressure.

Build the club.

Back the manager.

Survive the board.

Win the argument in the stands.

(Game Language is only German at the Moment)

My City is a game where you can do whatever you want. You start without an apartment, without money, and with only a tent and your dog. Can you manage to rent an apartment? Will you be able to find or buy food?

In My City, you can: find items, craft items, complete jobs, buy lottery tickets, gamble, bet on sports (live), create music MIDI files, decorate your apartment however you like, trade at the flea market, dress up your avatar, and much more.

My City is a one-man project in a 2D comic style and is still in the development phase. The game is free to play.

Please keep in mind:

- The game is currently in the development phase! (It is still far from finished.)

- The game may/will therefore contain bugs.

- The game is already on Steam so that the game client and server can be completed.

- --> Therefore, feedback regarding bugs, performance, and suggestions for future ideas is very welcome.

- The game is updated every 1-21 days to remove bugs, optimize server performance, and introduce new features.

store_data.about_the_game:
WARNING :

IT IS RECOMMENDED DOWLOADING AND PLAYING THE FIRST CHAPTER Of VOLTUS' NEON NIGHTMARE BEFORE PLAYING THIS GAME !

If you're into both liminal space and mascot horror games, this is the perfect game for you.

In this 2nd chapter of the Voltus' Neon Nightmare franchise, you'll have to continue making your way to the Core, in this endless mall that became a liminal nightmare to live in.

Use your elemental laser gun to guide you through the doors and the dark, as you try to escape while getting the Core in your hands.

Find some friends to help you, and getting your way into this world will be easier than you expect, because your enemies could be everywhere, hunting you down to make sure you don't even approach the Center.

After the events of the first chapter, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it. You'll have to find a way to escape from your cage, and with the help you'll find on your way to the Core itself, you'll have to cure Voltus from his madness, so there will no longer be any obstacle between you and the Core.

The Core is an unlimited source of energy, so powerful that it could either save or destroy the entire planet. Finding the Core is essential to the world's future, as we need a new source of energy for humanity, to keep our world safe from any danger.

Explore liminal spaces, meet new friends and enemies, find the Core, and escape this endless world of chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cozy sci-fi tidy-up game. Gather the books scattered across your ship and sort each one into its rightful place. Play in calm normal gravity or start on Zero-G mode, where the books float in mid-air. No timers, no pressure.

What You Do

Your job is simple: tidy the ship. Search the room for scattered books, carry them back to the shelves, and sort them into the correct sections. Some books belong together, some shelves reject your logic, and sometimes the fastest solution is a very confident throw across the room.

Main Features

- First-person book sorting and shelf organization

- Carry, stack, place, drop, and throw books

- Shelf indicator that help you sort books correctly.  

- New rooms unlock as you clean

- Sci-fi spaceship setting with a cozy cleanup mood

- Zero-G mode for a more chaotic run

- Powerups like bigger carry stacks, longer reach, and guided throws

Modes 

you have 2 modes one normal mode and one zerog mode where tidying becomes a lot less sensible. Books float, throws matter more, and powerups help you survive the mess.

Fight through escalating waves of hostile robots, collect upgrades, stack weapon synergies, and survive as long as you can while the arena becomes more chaotic with every minute.

Each run pushes you into faster decisions: which upgrades to take, which enemies to prioritize, when to hold your ground, and when to move before the swarm closes in.

- Fast first-person arena combat

- Run-based roguelike progression

- Upgrade cards that change how your weapon behaves

- Robot enemies with increasing pressure over time

- Elemental effects such as lightning, explosions, and shatter bursts

- Score-chasing survival runs built for replayability

- A planned overheat system that rewards risk and aggressive play

The demo will focus on the core combat loop: shooting, upgrading, surviving, and pushing the arena as far as possible.

One home planet. 2,160 turns. Six galaxies of rivals.

Infinite Conflict is a free, tick-based grand strategy game built on a single ruthless premise: the clock never stops. Every hour the universe advances one turn - refineries cycle, fleets jump, treaties decay, and your decisions compound. Set your orders, walk away, and return to galaxies that have moved without you.

Mine, build, research, scout, raid. Forge alliances or burn alone. Win, lose, or land somewhere in the middle - when the round ends, the slate wipes clean and everyone starts equal.

Build your empire

Every planet is a factory, a fortress, and a target. Begin with a single protected home world, then expand into the safer outer rims for steady yields - or push for the rich, contested galactic cores where the real wars are fought.

  • Four economies - balance Metal, Mineral, Food, and Energy across your worlds.

  • 33 building types - from humble resource Mines to high tech Jump Gates.

  • Every world is unique - scout planetary Abundance before you commit a colony.

  • Conquer up to ~100 worlds - at full empire your dashboard becomes a constellation of small worlds to orchestrate.

Command your fleets

Compose mega-fleets for overwhelming force, or surgical task forces tuned to crack a single target. Every move is a turn, and every turn is a commitment.

  • Nine ship classes - Fighters, Bombers, Frigates, Destroyers, Cruisers, Battleships and more, built to counter, screen, and deliver capital strikes.

  • Jump Gates & Hyperspace beacons - speed up travel times and intercept your enemies.

  • invasions, and pre-drops - every doctrine is on the table.

Climb the tech tree

Train scientists, bank research points, and climb a deep, branching tech tree - from Core Metal Mines all the way to Super Capital Ship doctrine. Specialise early or sprawl wide; every commander's tree tells a different story.

  • Expansion tiers unlock longer queues and higher planet limits.

  • Incremental unlocks keep economy, fleet, and infrastructure advancing in lockstep.

  • End-game unlocks - battleships, jump gates, strip mines and beyond.

No empire holds alone

Play solo and watch your empire bloom in the silence between turns — or band together with up to 30 commanders and move as one across six galaxies and nine thousand worlds. The Discord is your war room.

  • Coordinated strikes - move together and drop thousands of soldiers on a single enemy world at the exact same tick.

  • Shared intel - pool scans, stake claims, and divide the spoils.

  • Operation planning - get everything planned before committing.

  • Veteran mentors - experienced pilots teach new recruits the ropes.

A strategy that breathes

Infinite Conflict isn't a twitchy real-time game - it's long-form strategy with a casual cadence. One turn every hour, around the clock. Play from your phone on the bus, your laptop at lunch, or your desktop at midnight. From only 20 minutes a day, fight at your peak hours, and walk away clean.

A full round runs 2,160 turns - about three months - before the universe resets and a fresh war begins.

Every battle has receipts

Combat is deterministic and totally legible. When the dust settles you get a forensic, ship-by-ship ledger reconciling owned, allied, and hostile forces in a single readout. Read it, learn from it, and build the fleet comp that wins next time.

Enlist now

Free to play. New round after every reset. Pick a name, pick a planet, and write your own destiny.

  • Solo or alliance play across six persistent galaxies.

  • New commanders and wiped-out veterans always start on equal footing.

  • Jump straight in - the clock is already running.

Note: Infinite Conflict is an online-only game and requires a constant internet connection to play.

You have become trapped in a hospital of unknown origin.

Carefully observe your surroundings and reach the exit on Floor 8.

Do not miss a single anomaly.

If you discover an anomaly, report it immediately.

Find a specific number of anomalies and escape through the exit on Floor 8.

Floor404 is a first-person psychological horror game focused on detecting anomalies, reporting them, and escaping.

Inspired by The Exit 8, liminal spaces, and the Backrooms, it was created around the concept of exploring a space where the boundary between reality and unreality has collapsed.

Will you be able to find every anomaly and escape safely?

store_data.about_the_game:
ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator:: STAB SEASON

Friendship ends where the draft begins. You think fantasy football is about touchdowns? Cute. It's about betrayal. It's about looking your buddy dead in the eye, smiling, and then trading him a kicker with a torn hamstring. Welcome to the only fantasy manager that hands you a knife on draft night and dares you to use it.

DRAFT LIKE A SHARK

Snake draft, 15 rounds, zero mercy. Build a roster of real-positioned monsters — QBs who can actually run, RBs who break tackles, defenses that eat quarterbacks for breakfast. Every pick you steal is a pick someone else cries about. Auto-draft exists for cowards.

STAB CARDS

This is where the gloves come off. Action cards built for one purpose: ruining someone's week. Many ways to twist the knife:

Backstab — yank a player straight off a rival's roster. Borrachera — your enemy shows up to game day blackout drunk. Good luck with that lineup. Contagioso — spread the flu and bench their best man. Cagalera — gift someone a -10 point catastrophe. Insider, Bloqueo Parental, Día de Playa... and more dirty tricks where those came from.

Dead last in the standings? Good. The loser gets extra cards. Nothing more dangerous than a desperate man with a fistful of knives.

RUN THE LEAGUE, RULE THE LEAGUE

14-week regular season — byes, matchups and all. Free agency & trades — wheel, deal, and stab in the back. Brutal injuries — from a bruise to a season-ending Achilles. Pray it's not your stud. Channel-based matchups — air vs. ground, your offense against their defense. Scout it or get scouted. Playoffs — 6 teams, 3 weeks, one champion. The rest go home and think about what they did.

PLAYER EDITOR

A comprehensive editor that lets you customize every player in the game to your liking: edit their names and stats to play on your own terms, with no limits. Save and load your modifications in-game and enjoy the fantasy exactly how you want.

NO EXCUSES

Up to 16 managers. Pick PPR, Half-PPR or Standard. Custom team names, custom avatars, custom grudges. It runs offline, it runs solo, it runs on whatever potato you've got.

Draft your team. Sabotage your friends. Lift the trophy. Somebody has to finish last. Make sure it isn't you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Last Hope: Zombie Autobattler blends bullet-hell action with the laid-back vibe of an idle game. It’s a chill, progression-focused defense experience. There are no health bars or game over screens here!

Build your automated setup, place your units, and sit back. Melt through zombie hordes in a hail of bullets before they ever reach your impenetrable shield. The faster you wipe them out before they hit the barrier, the more loot you secure for your lab. Your only goal: optimize your kill zone and build a well-oiled, autonomous system.

 The World Fell, But We Are Safe

When the apocalypse hit, our scientists managed to boot up an impenetrable Prototype Shield. Now, our mission is to build a massive automated defense network behind it, lure in zombie bosses, and harvest their genetic data to complete the research that will save humanity.

 Build & Optimize

This isn't a stressful survival game; it's all about tactical engineering and efficiency:

  • Buildings & Units: Set up your frontline, upgrade your core structures, and maximize your DPS. Kill faster, loot faster.

  • Mutation Control: Want to progress faster? Take a risk! Let the zombies mutate and grow stronger in exchange for much rarer materials and better loot.

    Reactor System

    Forge entirely new, devastating weapons by combining different towers in the Reactor. There are exactly 56 different tower variants waiting to be discovered, letting you unleash your ultimate strategy against the horde!

    Contracts & The Big Hunt

    Once your setup is lethal enough, sign Contracts to summon regional Zombie Bosses directly to your shield. Watch your automated defenses shred them to pieces, then harvest their rare DNA. Complete your research tree, unlock new tech, and bring an end to the apocalypse.

store_data.about_the_game:
A journey through broken histories, tender memories, and the weight of identity.

Walk through lived-in homes and explore everyday spaces across different eras as you uncover the quiet impact of displacement and fading traditions across generations.

Through exploration, light puzzles, environmental storytelling, and gentle interactions, you piece together how traditions fade, how identity endures, and how remembering reveals a world shaped by stories far larger than one family.

Move through everyday spaces across different eras, examining objects, following subtle cues, and connecting fragments scattered through time. Exploration drives the experience, gradually revealing a wider world shaped by shifting traditions, migration, and the stories that surround the Cantor family.

One of the game’s core mechanics lets you assemble handcrafted objects through clear, interactive steps while watching the artisan’s work unfold. This is just one way you’ll engage with traditional crafts, each mechanic revealing a different facet of the world and the people who keep these practices alive.

Integrated into the flow of each scene, light puzzles provide short interactive beats that balance the pacing of the story. Each one unlocks narrative progression or details that link characters, eras, and traditions, reinforcing the game’s progression and its interconnected world.

Made without AI and built by a fully human team, Los Olvidados is an ongoing commitment to handcrafted storytelling. Every asset, narrative thread, and design choice reflects the care, culture, and emotional truth of the people behind it — and it will continue to be developed that way.

Follow our development journey. We’ll soon be unveiling our Discord community, our Kickstarter campaign, and new gameplay footage, trailers, and updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nanoquarium is a real aquarium that lives on your desktop. Pop the tank out and the fish drift across your screen, swimming over your open windows while your clicks pass straight through to your work, or keep it tucked in a cosy corner, always on top. All the fun of a fish tank, none of the water changes.

Built by someone who bred tropical fish for years, so every fish looks, behaves and breeds like the real animal, not a reskin.

A tank that's always alive


It pootles along beside your work whether you're watching or not, so feed it between emails and come back to fry you never saw coming. Tetras shoal, bettas blow bubble nests, corydoras dash up to gulp air, plecos graze the driftwood, shrimp climb the plants. And there's no way to lose: stocking goes by bioload, not fussy fish-count caps, coins tick along while you're away, and nothing ever dies of neglect. Cosy, never punishing.

Collect 200+ real fish




Every fish is based on a real one, with the right shape, size and personality, across three little worlds: a warm tropical community, a cool coldwater tank, and a saltwater reef where coral grows in and clownfish nest in an anemone. 207 species in all, as males and females, long-fin and high-fin strains, pale albinos and inky melanistics, over 500 looks in total, and every fish then gets its own unique markings, so no two are ever quite the same.

Breed your own rare ones


Pair two up, watch them court, and raise the next generation, and every kind does it its own way: scattering eggs through the plants, tucking them in a cave, blowing a bubble raft, or carrying the babies in its mouth. Colours pass down to the fry and drift a little each time (RGB colour-blend genetics), so a line slowly becomes your own. Chase a rare fin shape or a colour nobody else has, and one special fish can be worth a small fortune.

Make it your own


Plant it, scape it and light it however you like: driftwood and stone, lush carpets, a whole shelf of backgrounds, the water tinted and rippling just so. Save your favourite layouts and switch between them, then grow into a whole fishroom of up to ten tanks, each with its own look. Just want to play and decorate? Creative mode hands you everything, unlocked.

How the desktop overlay works


Run the tank any way you like: a frameless window that stays on top in a corner, free-resized to any size, fullscreen, or a click-through overlay where the fish swim over your apps while your clicks pass straight to your work. Tune exactly what shows, from the whole furnished tank down to just the fish on the bare desktop, or anywhere in between. It's so light and quiet you'll forget it's running, so leave it on all day.

Made by an actual fish breeder

Nanoquarium is built by one person who bred tropical fish for years, so the shapes, the sizes, and the way every species behaves and breeds are all drawn from the real thing, not made up. I don't keep tanks any more, and this is the one I get to keep now: all the joy of the hobby with none of the water changes.

At a glance
  • Up to 10 tanks + a Creative sandbox (all unlocked)
  • Window, fullscreen, a tiny corner, or a click-through desktop overlay · system-tray icon
  • Day/night & weather, a travelling fish trader, powerheads & bubble gear, a soft generative soundtrack
  • Photo + one-click GIF capture · full species bestiary · 59 Steam achievements · Cloud saves
  • Idle economy: Coins (offline, capped) plus Breeder Points from breeding milestones
  • Light enough to run on a potato · barely sips power, no graphics card needed

Lucian opens his eyes in an unfamiliar place, trapped and with no memory of how he got there. The only way to escape is by reconstructing the events of the previous night. But what if the truth is more terrifying than you imagine?

Interact with enigmatic characters. Solve unique puzzles and brain-teasing riddles. Immerse yourself in memories filled with dark secrets

A point-and-click mystery game that will test your wits

The plot will draw you in with its suspenseful atmosphere, unexpected twists, and enigmatic characters that add new layers of mystery to the enigmatic town of Hidden Town.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bad Signal

A social-deduction platformer for 4 to 8 players. Steer one shared robot to the exit. Trust no one.

A single robot has to reach the exit door of a 2D grid level, but nobody drives it directly. Each round, every player secretly submits one move, and the moves play out in a random order on the shared screen. One or two players are secretly hackers, steering the run into pits, spikes, and projectiles to drain the round budget before the team reaches the door.

The PC shows the world. Players join in seconds from their phones by scanning a QR code, with nothing to install.

How it plays

  • Everyone moves, no one is in control. You each pick a single move per round and only see your own turn order. The robot's path is the sum of choices nobody fully owns.

  • Read the run, not the labels. Evidence is behavior. A mistimed jump into a spike could be a mistake, or it could be sabotage.

  • Beat the clock. Every level has a fixed round budget. Wasted moves and avoidable deaths burn it down, and if it hits zero before the door, the hackers win.

Roles

  • Hackers sabotage from the shadows, with cooldown abilities to override a player's move, jam a reveal, or plant false evidence.

  • Tracers can privately inspect one player's submitted move each round to gather proof.

  • Operators keep the run on track and hold a one-time tamper-proof move to defend against the hackers.

Accuse, vote, and gamble

Between rounds the table debates who keeps steering the robot into danger. Vote to disable a suspect for a round, or call a final accusation that wins or loses the game on the spot.

Features

  • 4 to 8 players, no extra controllers required

  • Instant phone join by QR code, nothing to install

  • Hand-crafted levels with pits, spikes, and timed projectiles

  • A built-in level editor for making and sharing your own stages

As part of an up-and-coming outfit of mercenaries, break your way into a shady underworld ruled by mega-corporations. Make yourself known through contracts from corporations, criminal organizations, and anyone else who's willing to pay.

Dynamic Missions

While completing procedurally generated contract missions, you'll encounter a variety of enemies such as organized gangs, corporate strike teams, and foreign PMCs. Each mission has a variety of loot which can be sold or stored for later use, however if you die, you'll lose it as well as the gear you brought in.

Contacts

Contacts are your main lifeline in this world. They're your shops and fixers. They've also got their own problems. You can help them with those problems. In return, they'll help you source more contracts and help you gain reputation in their region, among other rewards.

As you climb in the underworld, you'll grow stronger with your own unique build with an assortment of stats and associated skill trees. Install various cyberware that enhance your capabilities further, including additional HUD elements. Utilize a variety of weapons and attachments, as well as alternate types of ammo.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trenchcoat Adventurer Vol 1 : Gone Rogue

Topp, Meedul, and Bawtom have crawled out of retirement and are back on the hunt for loot and shinies. Their latest adventure is an unforgiving roguelike permadeath turn-based dungeon crawler that takes the classic blobber formula and flips it on its head.

Built on the same engine as A Kobold Story: Trenchcoat Adventurer, you control three kobolds literally stacked into one single trenchcoated adventurer. This is grid-based, turn-based combat across 30 hand-crafted floors, each with multiple variants for virtually endless unique runs.

Key Features

  • Deadly Progression — The deeper you descend, the stronger and smarter the enemies become thanks to improved AI. Every floor feels noticeably more dangerous.

  • Hazardous Floor Tiles — Slippery ice sends your stack sliding out of position. Burning fire tiles punish you every single turn. Positioning matters.

  • Chaos Altars — High-risk reforging stations where you can gamble an item into something far more powerful… or curse it into oblivion. Pure roguelike tension.

  • Legendary Kobold Stomachs — Brutal inventory management with almost no bag space. Eating anything (food, potions, junk, or equipment) is your main way to heal, remove bad status effects, gain powerful buffs, or even revive the entire stack when knocked out. Resource starvation is real — every bite counts.

  • Deep Item System — Rich loot featuring pre/suffix enchantments across multiple rarity tiers. Hunt for powerful synergies and build-defining gear.

  • Wizzo’s Bank — The human wizard Wizzo now runs a bank. Store valuable items between runs and build your power across attempts.

  • Campfire Saves — Modern quality-of-life saves that let you stop mid-run when real life calls. Each campfire can only be used once per descent to prevent save-scumming.

Single Difficulty — There is only one difficulty. The game is balanced to be hard.Master your limited resources and descend as far as your skill allows. Every run is different. Every mistake is permanent.

Can you survive the depths?

store_data.about_the_game:
Some gifts are meant to be buried.

Arlo Part I: The Past, is a first-person supernatural psychological horror game that plunges you into one terrifying night inside the mind and home of Arlo — a young woman with a gift she never asked for.

The Story

Arlo has spent years running from her ability to communicate with the dead. But when the supernatural begins bleeding into her waking life — dreams, shadows, voices — she can no longer ignore what she left behind. The past has come knocking.

Gameplay

No hand-holding — objectives are never displayed. A detective mindset is required.

Proximity-based interactions — everything in Arlo's world must be discovered up close. Walk up, press E, and uncover the truth.

Environmental storytelling — interact with photographs, objects, and characters scattered throughout to piece together Arlo's hidden past.

Two handcrafted puzzles — one to ease you in, and one to test you.

Drive through the street — explore beyond the walls of Arlo's home.

Earn your way — unlock special interactions by completing unique challenges hidden within the world.

Best experienced with a headset.

The Threat

Bifrons. A fallen angel turned demon. Ancient. Patient. Collecting souls — including someone Arlo loves. To save her grandmother from eternal torment, Arlo must confront the darkness she buried long ago.

This is only the beginning.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend your king, build your deck, use your cards on this deck building tower defense!

In Seize Siege, where only one can rule it all, seize the crown! Become the King of Kings! Rival kings will send units to halt your march of progress. Defend yourself with your king's unique cards. Place your towers and survive as long as you can.

Build your deck:

  • Deck: With over 30 different cards, build your deck as the waves go by. Use gold earned throughout the rounds to buy new cards and create your own unique deck. Plan every step; as the endgame approaches, your build will be tested to the limit

  • Towers: Use your cards to summon powerful towers, each with unique interactions. Use magic cards to make them stronger or help clear the waves.

  • Upgrades: By using Tower Cards of the same type or archetype, you can level up your towers during the waves, changing their appearance and increasing their stats and utility.

  • Kings: Select one of 3+ kings, each bringing their own unique cardset. Create your own strategy with each king to become the King of Kings.

Waves:

  • Waves: Enemies will try to steal your crown every round. Defeat them using your towers and magic cards! As the waves progress, new foes will join their ranks in pursuit of your title. Old foes will also grow stronger; every enemy has a chance to spawn as a more powerful variant that will put your defenses to the test.

  • Final Wave: On the last wave (depending on the difficulty), a rival king will challenge you with their hero. Defeat them to win the run and become the King of Kings!

FEATURES:

  • 30+ Cards

  • 3+ Maps

  • 3+ Kings

  • Difficulty Selection: Changes enemy stats and upgrade rates.

  • More to come....

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your very own tabletop roleplaying club. Stock the shelves, welcome the players, and run unforgettable game nights - all from behind the counter of the cozy lair you build from the ground up. Whether your players quest through fantasy realms, far-future galaxies, or creeping cosmic horror, every session begins at your club.

Stock & Sell

Build your inventory around what collectors crave most - detailed miniatures, both pre-painted and unpainted. Add dice sets, rulebooks, and more as your club grows. Order stock, price it smart, and keep the bestsellers front and center.

Run the Counter

Serve customers yourself - scan items, take payments, and keep the line moving. Every sale grows your club.

Rent Out Tables

Groups come to play. Set table rental fees, keep the space clean, and turn your floor into a buzzing hall of adventurers.

Step Behind the Screen

Become the game master and run living roleplaying sessions. Guide your players through branching stories where every choice matters - roll the dice, react to your group, and shape an adventure that's different every time. Fantasy, sci-fi, cosmic horror - the world is yours to run.

Hire & Grow

Bring on staff to stock, clean, and cover the register. Expand your space, upgrade your club, and build the ultimate destination for roleplayers.

Build the Atmosphere

Lighting, posters, painted minis on display, clean tables - every detail shapes your club's appeal. Create the welcoming, nerd-culture haven players keep coming back to.

Project Eel is a first-person horror game set inside a vast underground research facility where something has gone terribly wrong.

Deep below the surface, strange experiments, abandoned sectors, and endless tiled corridors hide a terrifying secret. As a newly assigned technician, your job is simple: travel between sectors, complete critical maintenance tasks, analyze the facility's condition, and locate the cure hidden somewhere within the complex.

Each sector presents unique challenges. Regulate temperatures, inspect water systems, navigate claustrophobic ventilation networks, and survive increasingly dangerous environments as the facility continues to deteriorate.

But you are not alone.

Something massive moves through the darkness.

Explore liminal environments inspired by poolrooms, industrial laboratories, and forgotten research facilities. Carefully monitor sector conditions, discover safe routes, and uncover the truth behind the experiments before it is too late.

• Atmospheric first-person horror
• Large interconnected facility to explore
• Multiple task-based gameplay systems
• Dynamic safe and unsafe sectors
• Liminal poolroom-inspired environments
• Unique giant creature encounters
• Immersive sound design and environmental storytelling

REALITY SHIFTS WHEN UNOBSERVED

In this first-person puzzle game, the world only obeys the laws of physics while you are watching. Look away, and objects change places. To navigate the facility, you must master the art of observation.

MANIPULATE THE QUANTUM STATE

Bend reality to your will using the simulation's tools:

  • Darkness: Objects move freely in the dark. Use switches and flashlights to change environment lighting.

  • Quantum Boxes: Open a box to let it shift when unobserved, or close it to prevent its movement.

  • Cameras & Mirrors: Ensure objects stay in place even when your back is turned.

PLEASE, DO NOT OVERPERFORM

You are monitored by a Ministry supervisor who communicates with you constantly and hates their job.

A word of advice: do not be too good at this. Exceptional performance means your supervisor has to write a 500-page report, which they really do not want to do. Your success might just make them unhappy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Horror in everyday life always begins in the most ordinary way.

A late-night subway station. A movie theater with only a single audience member. A mountain road swallowed by dense fog. A bedroom where you lie alone after work. Even the bathroom of an ordinary apartment.

Every story begins in places that feel familiar. Then, without warning, something inexplicable slips into the ordinary.

Scary Stories: Grotesque is a collection of short horror visual novels inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends.

Some stories begin with something someone else once experienced. Others begin with a single careless mistake. And in most cases, the protagonist never truly discovers what they encountered.

New ghost stories will continue to be added through future updates. More horrors are waiting to invade your everyday life.

Have you ever...

  • Fallen asleep on the subway and missed your stop?

  • Watched a movie alone in an empty theater?

  • Walked home alone late at night?

  • Fumbled for a power outlet in a dark room?

  • Truly hated someone?

  • Driven down a deserted road in the middle of the night?

Scary Stories: Grotesque gathers the unsettling tales that may have been hiding between those ordinary moments.

Face every kind of horror you can imagine.

From slow-building psychological dread, to nerve-racking jump scares, to the overwhelming despair of cosmic horror.

Experience every boundary of fear, all in one place.

Key Features

  • Horror That Feels Real - The scariest thing isn't ghosts—it's the feeling that it could really happen. Experience a creeping sense of dread that slowly tightens its grip within familiar places.

  • Anthology Format - A collection of short, intense ghost stories. Enjoy each story at your own pace, anytime and anywhere, with every tale delivering a different flavor of horror.

  • Paranormal Photo-Inspired Visuals - Aged film photography, heavy noise, and low-light cinematography. Designed to recreate the disturbing realism of browsing paranormal photo archives and ghost story forums late at night.

  • Immersive Sound Design - Every breath, every creak, every distant sound is crafted to keep you on edge. Atmospheric music and unsettling sound effects bring each story vividly to life.

  • Things Left Unexplained - Not every mystery is solved when the story ends. What did you really see? What was actually there? The answer is yours alone.

store_data.about_the_game:
A world that lives without you

  • Civilizations emerge on their own — villagers found settlements, take up professions (farmer, lumberjack, miner, hunter, builder, warrior), and grow through race-themed housing from a single hut to castles, elf palaces, orc fortresses, and dwarf keeps.

  • Kingdoms wage real wars: armies muster, march across the map, lay siege, raze enemy towns, and sue for treaties and tribute while you watch from above.

  • Auto-discovered trade routes thread the world together, with merchants ping-ponging goods between distant villages.

  • Religions are founded, vassal bonds and pacts are sworn, and rebellions boil up from the unhappy — no two worlds politick the same way.

  • Settlers board colony ships and cross the ocean to found daughter colonies on distant shores.

Watch them climb through eight ages

  • Every village advances through eight full tech ages — Stone, Bronze, Iron, Medieval, Industrial, Modern, Digital, and Future — each unlocked by real progress: build a Smelter to reach the Iron Age, a Forge for Medieval, a Town Hall for Industrial, a Factory, a Power Plant, a Tech Campus.

  • 120+ building types appear era by era: farms mechanize and go vertical, markets grow into supermarkets and malls, dirt paths become paved roads and highways, torches become streetlamps, and huts end up as apartment blocks and skyscrapers.

  • Advanced kingdoms field real hardware — tanks roll out of army bases, jets scream off airport runways, cars fill the streets.

  • Each age has a Wonder of the World: one kingdom per world can raise it and stake its claim on history.

Dynasties, blood, and succession

  • Inspect any creature to read its name, personality traits, profession, equipment, and full family tree.

  • Kings sire bloodlines; thrones pass down; a botched succession can crack a kingdom open into civil war.

  • Legendary figures rise on their own — heroes and tyrants whose deeds are sung in a spotlight beacon and written into legend.

  • Heraldry and kingdom identity give each rising power its own colors and character, and villages throw festivals with fireworks when their towns hit milestones.

  • Read it all back in a living Chronicle — a world-history log of births, betrayals, battles, and collapses — plus a politics screen and population graphs.

Sculpt the stage

  • Raise and lower land, pour water, lava, and ice, and paint biomes — forest, jungle, savanna, desert, swamp, tundra.

  • A live procedural terrain shader paints it all; rivers carve their own paths through hydraulic erosion, and fire spreads tile to tile through anything that will burn.

  • Seasons turn, weather rolls in, lightning cracks, blizzards and droughts bite, and a day/night cycle sweeps across the map — with auroras dancing over the night sky.

  • World Eras bias the whole simulation into chapters — an Age of Sun drought, an Age of Tears deluge, a creeping Dark Age — so history itself has moods.

  • Five world sizes and five terrain templates, from a tight island to a huge continent.

Seed the life

  • 30+ creatures: humans, elves, orcs, dwarves, bandits; cows, sheep, chickens, deer, horses; wolves and bears; sharks, dolphins, fish, and sea serpents; boar, fox, rabbit, giant spider, troll; and mythics and undead — dragon, kraken, hero, zombie, necromancer.

  • Creatures carry personality traits — tough, glutton, lazy, fireproof, even cannibal — that genuinely change how they live, fight, and die, and parents pass them down to their children.

  • Animals spawn and roam wild on their own; civilization and the undead are yours to place.

Play god — wrath and mercy both

  • Rain down catastrophe: bombs, nukes, meteors, the Tsar Bomba, earthquakes, tornadoes that carve the ground under their funnels, volcanoes, floods, blizzards, black holes, plague, acid rain.

  • Or be merciful: raise mountains, part the sea, summon rain, smite the wicked, bless a bloodline, possess a single creature and walk in its shoes, polymorph a mob into livestock, clone, teleport, or just gild something with a golden touch.

Bake your own rules

  • World Laws let you set what kind of god a world even has — toggle disasters, wildlife, aging, war, rebellions, vegetation, and reproduction on or off before you generate. A peaceful botanical sanctuary, or a deathless gladiatorial pit? Each ruleset is baked into its world, so every save is its own experiment.

  • Six scenarios layer curated starts and goals on the sandbox when you want a challenge: Unite the Continent, Reach the Future, Survive the Apocalypse, hold a Dynasty, outlast the Age of Monsters — or ignore them all and free-play.

Mod it with a text editor

  • Real mod support, no scripting required: drop a folder of plain INI files and PNGs into mods/ and the game picks it up at startup.

  • Add or override buildings and god powers, retune any creature's stats, reskin any sprite in the game, and tweak simulation tunables — malformed files are skipped safely, never a crash.

Pull up a chair

There are no goals, no timers, no fail screen. Pick a creature and follow it for an afternoon. Watch a dynasty you've grown fond of get swallowed by the kingdom next door. Snap it all with the built-in screenshot tool and browse your gallery in-game. Light and dark UI, 145 achievements to chase if you want them, 11 languages, original soundtrack and living ambient audio, and so light it runs on pure C and SDL2. A digital ant farm with ten thousand years of drama inside — you just poke at it.

Key Features

  • Genuinely emergent history — villages, kingdoms, wars, trade, and collapse all run themselves; the story is discovered, never scripted.

  • Eight tech ages — Stone to Future, unlocked by real gate buildings, with 120+ era-specific buildings, upgrade ladders, tanks, jets, and one Wonder of the World per age.

  • Deep civilization sim — professions, tiered cities, religions, vassals, pacts, rebellions, overseas colonies, and trade routes.

  • Dynasties & politics — kings, bloodlines, succession crises, civil wars, heraldry, legendary figures, and a living world Chronicle.

  • Per-world World Laws + six scenarios — toggle disasters, aging, war, wildlife, vegetation, and reproduction to bake your own ruleset, or chase a curated goal.

  • A living landscape — procedural terrain shader, self-carving rivers, spreading fire, seasons, weather, day/night, auroras, and mood-setting world Eras.

  • 30+ creatures with inherited traits — civilizations, wildlife, sea life, wild beasts, mythics, and the undead.

  • Dozens of god powers — wrath and mercy both, from the Tsar Bomba and black holes to part-the-sea, possession, and blessings.

  • Mod-friendly by design — add buildings, powers, sprites, and creature tweaks with plain INI + PNG files; no code needed.

  • Cozy and light — pixel-art charm, light and dark UI, in-game screenshot gallery, 145 achievements, 11 languages, pure C and SDL2.

store_data.about_the_game:
You owe everything. You own nothing. Time to hustle.

DEBTMASTER is a roguelite strategy game about clawing your way out of debt by any means necessary. Interest compounds daily. You juggle side hustles, stack upgrades, and make impossible choices about where your next dollar goes -- rent a better bot server, or repair your delivery car before it dies?

HUSTLE EVERYTHING Play Spades with recruitable AI partners who each have their own playstyle. Count cards in Blackjack. Grind Video Poker and Slots. Flip items for profit. Mine crypto on rigs you build and overclock. Deliver gigs in a car that's falling apart. Farm viral content by studying what NPCs post on social media. Arm wrestle for quick cash. And more. Every hustle has its own upgrades, progression, and strategy.

1,000+ EDGES. DEALT AT RANDOM. Each run deals you a random hand of "edges" -- powerful upgrades pulled from a massive pool. Boost payout multipliers, slash repair costs, rig card odds, unlock new hustle strategies, or stack combos the game never intended. You won't see the same build twice.





BOTS DO THE WORK Unlock The Black Book and deploy bots to grind hustles while you're away. Pick a server tier -- cheap ones crash, premium ones print money. Assign strategies per game. Balance bot earnings against server rent and downtime risk. Passive income or passive disaster.

EVERY DOLLAR COUNTS Random life events drain your wallet when you least expect it. Compound interest never sleeps. One bad decision can bury you. One broken combo can save you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run the room. Deal every hand.

SimPoker is a cozy-but-deep poker-room management sim. You start with an empty floor and grow it into a buzzing card room: poker tables, dealers, a cash cage, restrooms, a food stand, a bar with waitstaff, and security to keep it all running.

Build your floor. Place entrances, poker tables, and amenities tile by tile. Capacity, mood, and flow all respond to your layout. A cramped room with no restrooms or food drains guests fast, while a well-run floor keeps the rail full and the chips moving.

Hire and manage staff. Dealers, cage cashiers, bartenders, waitstaff, and security all draw wages. Pay raises keep morale up and understaffing creates real bottlenecks. Balance payroll against the rake your tables generate.

Real poker under the hood. Hands are genuinely dealt and evaluated, with cash games and nightly multi-table tournaments. Pull up the full visual hand-history review on any hand, sit down at your own table to play, or spectate the floor and watch the economy work.

Grow a real card-room economy. Members, waitlists, table stakes, capped rake, tournament series, upkeep, and reputation all interlock. Read the demand, open the right tables at the right stakes, and turn a sleepy room into the busiest game in town.

SimPoker is in active development. This is an early look, and your feedback directly shapes the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Uncover the mystery of the Noiret family of dollmakers as you explore their abandoned estate.

For years, the story of the Noiret family has been surrounded by rumors and legends. The official version claims that the entire family was murdered by business rivals. Others believe financial troubles and the collapse of their company led to their downfall. Some whisper about darker, supernatural forces at work.

Iris Hale, a young journalist determined to write the article that will make her career, travels to the Noiret Mansion in search of the truth.

What begins as a simple investigation quickly turns into a dangerous nightmare. The mansion proves far more hostile than expected, and the deeper Iris ventures into its halls, the more she becomes entangled in the secrets of the Noiret family. To uncover the truth, she must survive deadly trials, confront living dolls, and face horrors hidden for decades.

The mansion is not what it seems, and some secrets were never meant to be uncovered.

GAME FEATURES

Explore the abandoned Noiret Mansion and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls.

  • Investigate the tragic fate of Noiret family of dollmakers.

  • Encounter living dolls and other horrors lurking throughout the mansion.

  • Search for clues, keys, and important items to progress through the mansion.

  • Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries connected to the family's dark past.

  • Experience a retro-inspired PSX horror aesthetic with atmospheric visuals and sound design.

[From the Developer]

Hello! My name is Rosemary, and I am the solo developer behind Rosenshine Games.

VESSELS: Noiret Mansion is currently in development. If the project interests you, feel free to follow the studio's social media pages, where I regularly share development updates, behind-the-scenes content, and progress on the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook is a cozy desktop game of quiet discovery and collection, designed to keep you company in a corner of your screen while you work. TEKUTEKU, a curious little traveler, was born one night from a doodle touched by moonlight. While you work or study, it wanders Yanesen — a Tokyo neighborhood known as “Cat Town” — noticing little things and writing each discovery down in its notebook.


Wander and discover
TEKUTEKU takes its time among the alleys, signboards, cats, and tiny shrines. In a neighborhood that looks ordinary at first glance, something quietly sparkles — click it to tuck it into the notebook. These are things you only notice when you slow down and look closely; some reveal themselves only in the glow of sunset.

Record and slowly collect
Each discovery settles into a square of TEKUTEKU’s notebook. As the light shifts through the day, the same alley shows a different face — and the more you come to know the neighborhood, the more the notebook fills with your own Yanesen.

Right there beside you
TEKUTEKU keeps you company without getting in the way, quietly going about its own little day. When you type, it scribbles along beside you — and on days you spend a little longer together, it might leave you a small letter. Use what you’ve found to decorate TEKUTEKU’s spot, or dress up your notebook with bands, charms, and more.

A neighborhood that’s really there
The Yanesen that TEKUTEKU walks is a real neighborhood in Tokyo. Meet the Yanaka Ginza shopping street, the narrow winding Hebi-michi, and the worn back lanes in the game — then, one day, retrace TEKUTEKU’s steps yourself. More neighborhoods are slowly on the way.

Drawn and made by hand
TEKUTEKU grew up through illustration and comics. The same illustrator behind TEKUTEKU drew this whole neighborhood too — every alley and signboard, one at a time — and carried that world into a game. Hand-drawn art, warm as paper, adds a small comfort to your day from the corner of your screen.


[Key Features]

  • Hand-drawn art, made one drawing at a time by the illustrator behind TEKUTEKU

  • Observe → Discover → Record → Collect → Decorate

  • TEKUTEKU’s discovery notebook — your own little field guide

  • A small companion beside your work — reacts as you type and may leave letters when you spend a little longer together

  • Based on the real Yanesen in Tokyo — places you can actually visit and walk through

  • No generative AI content

  • English · Korean · Japanese · Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)

  • Free demo · new neighborhoods coming after launch

store_data.about_the_game:
Sky Scramble is the local multiplayer dogfighting brawler your living room deserves, and your friendships don't.

Inspired by the timeless chaos of Biplane Duel and Squadron Scramble, Sky Scramble throws up to 4 players into a free-for-all across three eras of glorious aviation history - strap in, take off, and immediately shoot your best mate out of the sky.

THREE ERAS. ONE VENDETTA.

  • Classic — Flimsy biplanes, weak engines, but the purest duelling - don't stall!

  • WW2 — Spitfires, dogfights, and a level of pettiness the history books left out

  • Jet Age — Go fast & loud

EJECTOR SEATS Think you won? Think again. Your freshly-exploded opponent just bailed out, parachuted to the ground, and is now sprinting across the tarmac with a pistol. You'd better finish the job before they get back to their hangar.

FEATURES

  • Up to 4 players, one screen

  • Three eras of air combat, each with distinct planes and feel

  • Ejector seats: because one death isn't embarrassing enough

  • 5 hand-crafted levels from England to Japan

  • Bots to practice against

  • Full controller & Steam Deck support

  • Remote Play Together: Can't get together - no problem, Steam has you covered

  • 18 Achievements to unlock

  • Possibly a hidden level, who knows

You ruled the Stormy Island once. The Enemy holds it now, and its people have been turned against you. You have come back to take it all back.

Match tiles to gather resources, then spend them to raise your defense. Every match pulls wood, stone, steel and more from the board, and you turn it into units and towers placed along the road that leads to your king. Wave after wave of the corrupted marches down that road, and the only thing standing between them and your king is what you've managed to build.

The catch is time. The enemy comes every few moves, so each match is a choice: chase the resource you need right now, or save your moves and gamble on getting it before they arrive. There's always one more thing you want to place, and never quite enough to do it all.

Between battles, you build your deck from a growing roster of units, trying combinations and finding the mix that suits the road ahead. A level that broke you yesterday gives way once you bring the right hand to it. And the further you march toward the Tower of the Lore Smiths, the harder it gets to tell whether you're freeing this island or simply taking it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Anubis is an isometric action-RPG in the spirit of Diablo, but set in the ancient Egyptian afterlife. Instead of playing as a survivor, you play as Anubis himself, a soul guide who faces the imbalance of the Duat and the rise of forgotten gods.

The game focuses on close combat, dodging, and clever abilities rather than inventory management. Instead of hundreds of items, you find and upgrade relics that drastically change your playstyle and skill progression.

Key Features

- Combat Anubis

Control the god of the dead himself: quick strikes, dashes, finishing moves, and the ability to hold your ground against crowds of enemies.

- Hybrid Combat System

Combine basic strikes, Dash, area of effect, and Anubis's special abilities

- Relics of the Afterlife

Find artifacts from temples and tombs - relics that enhance abilities, add effects and allow you to collect your build for the style of the game.

- Enemies of Duat

Fight with the revived mummies, clay golems, zoms

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the most unrealistic surgery simulator where everyone can instantly become a terrible doctor.

You will have to solve hilarious surgical procedures ranging from CPR to brain transplant or even removing alien eggs from a poor patient using a robotic arm! You always thought you had that surgeon in you?

SCALPEL PLEASE!

Choose among a wide variety of tools and utensils to perform your art... and dig into your patient!
Scalpels, knives, syringes, drills, saws, lasers, rubber ducks and much more!

HE IS FLATLINING!

Keep an eye on that ECG and defib the hell out of that chest if needed! Don't forget to pump some air in those lungs when the patient is unconscious. Pump it!

BUTCHER OR SURGEON? 

Some procedures will require precision, some others will require raw power to get there! You will be the judge!

LET'S GET SERIOUS

Cut out that skin, break open that chest, and precisely move away those organs in the way to proceed to a very dangerous heart transplant. Precisely remove that scalp, open that skull like a fresh egg and take out that brain to replace it with a cybernetic one! Because why not?

RESPECT AS YOUR Nº 1 PRIORITY

Be mindful, be respectful and be very careful with your patient's integrity. Your mission is to guarantee a precise and painless procedure and outstanding result for your patient.

Because if you don't, you better have a bulletproof malpractice insurance before putting those hands in there!

store_data.about_the_game:
ExSpelled is a multiplayer social-deduction game about wizards brewing powerful spells. Dark Wizards have infiltrated the Wizard Council. Your only chance is to work together, brew spells, collect clues and fight the darkness. But who can you trust?

Brewing Spells

Find elemental ingredients to brew a number of spells. Just throw anything you find in a cauldron and see what you get or keep looking to find that one spell.

Wizards and Dark Wizards

Everyone is either a Wizard or a Dark Wizard. Dark Wizards can recognize each other and infiltrate the Wizards together. They can also brew evil spells from the souls of the Wizards like invisibility, traps and more.

Flee from the Evil

Chests are scattered around the castle, but each player only has the key to their own. Open them to find pieces of a special recipe to brew artifacts. These artifacts can deactivate the containment spell cast by the Dark Wizards, allowing everyone to escape. But be careful: Dark Wizards can also find out how to create a Hell Portal this way! When they activate it, the Wizards need to close it in time or face certain doom.

Spells

Each spell has its' own uses: cast a fireball to burn your enemies or block the way with an earth wall. Staying away and spying on everyone by sending a bird after them can also work to find the dark wizards.

Features

  • Play with 3-15 friends

  • Use proximity chat to communicate

  • Map variations depending on number of players

  • 15 unique spells

store_data.about_the_game:
Read the clues, deduce every hex, and clear the board one step at a time. Hexzen is a hexagonal logic puzzle you play under a slow, living sky, with a peaceful soundtrack. The thinking is sharp. The place you do it in is calm.

Read the board

Every hex hides behind a clue, and every clue tells you something true about the cells around it. Count them, line them up, mark what you know. One careful read after another, the whole board opens up. It takes a minute to learn and a long time to wear out.

A sky that never repeats

You solve under living skies: an aurora breathing over the board, mist rolling off a dawn coast, snow coming down slow enough to watch. No two sessions sound or look the same. Turn the whole scene up when you want a show, or down to near silence when you just want to think. Most logic puzzles are cold and white. Hexzen is dark and warm.

Every board has a way in

Before a puzzle ever reaches you, a solver works it end to end using deduction alone. So you can trust what you're looking at: there is one solution, and a chain of pure logic that reaches it. When you're stuck, the answer is already on the board. You just haven't found it yet. When you need it, you can let the game guide you with a hint.

The Cartographer

A peaceful campaign across multiple worlds. It opens on sunlit coasts and works its way out into stranger water: mirrored boards, loops that have to close, shapes that have to fit. Each world hands you one new way to read the grid, then asks you to use it. These are hand-built levels, where the logic gets odd and specific.

Puzzles without end

The generator never runs dry. It builds an unlimited run of puzzles from counting, lines, even-and-odd parity, and a runic cipher you decode as you go, and it checks every one solvable before you see it.

  • Infinite mode: set it to Easy or Hard and keep going as long as you like.

  • Daily puzzle: one board the whole world shares, new every day.

  • Shareable seeds: the same seed always builds the same board, so you can hand one to a friend.

Make your own

Build single levels or whole campaigns in the editors, then pass them around.

Built for everyone

Accessibility is part of the game, not bolted on afterward.

  • 15 languages

  • Four color-blind palettes and a dyslexia-friendly font

  • High-contrast and high-legibility display modes

  • Full mouse, keyboard, and controller play

  • Screen-reader support, with the board read aloud

  • A relaxed mode for solving with zero pressure

Features

  • Hexagonal logic puzzles, every board verified solvable by a built-in solver

  • Endless procedural generation with shareable seeds

  • A daily puzzle shared by every player

  • A fully-featured campaign

  • Level and campaign editors

  • A lively atmosphere with soothing skies and sounds

  • 15 languages and deep accessibility

  • Full controller support

Wishlist Hexzen

Add Hexzen to your wishlist! We'll tell you the day it's out.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rookspell merges the tactical depth of chess with the chaotic energy of a card game roguelike. You play on a real chess board, commanding pieces that move exactly as you'd expect - but then your hand of spell cards changes everything. Freeze a bishop mid-advance, summon a pawn army, or teleport your queen across the board in a single turn. No two runs play the same way.

Each run starts with a standard chess setup and a starting deck. As you win matches, you draft new cards from a rotating pool, building synergies between your pieces and your spells. Lose a piece, and you might lose it for the rest of the run - so every exchange matters. Survive long enough and you'll face increasingly dangerous opponents with their own powerful decks.

Victory comes from threading the needle between chess fundamentals and card-fuelled chaos. You can outplay your opponent on the board, overwhelm them with a powerful combo, or assemble a deck so broken it bends the rules of chess entirely.

Key features:

  • Draft and deckbuild - construct your spell deck run-by-run from cards with unique board effects

  • Real chess movement - every piece moves according to standard rules until your cards say otherwise

  • Roguelike progression - piece loss, escalating opponents, and randomised card pools keep every run fresh

  • Multiple play modes - solo PvE runs, or online PvP via Steam

  • Steam Workshop support - create and share custom cards, rulesets, and board variants

  • Full controller support - plays great on couch with Xbox or PlayStation controllers, including Remote Play Together

Chess knowledge is helpful but not required. If you can move a knight, you can play Rookspell. We also have a tutorial to help teach you along the way

store_data.about_the_game:
It's 2076. After the collapse, humanity rebuilt itself into a single city — Nova Europa — and at its heart raised The Spire: a two-kilometer-tall monument owned by Soteria Global, the corporation that helped bring the world back from the edge. Inside, everything is calm, ordered, taken care of. It should reassure you. It doesn't.

Reality in The Spire isn't fixed. Shift between two versions of the same world — the smooth surface everyone is meant to see, and the dithered layer beneath it. Passages, paths, and secrets solid in one are gone in the other. Learning when and how to shift is the key to moving through The Spire — and to seeing what it doesn't want you to.

A 2D metroidvania in hand-crafted pixel art where combat is just one element of the world, not its axis. You venture into the sealed sectors of The Spire and places no one is allowed to enter, gather information, solve puzzles, and run your own investigation. Every lead brings you closer to who you are — and to the truth this place hides from everyone.

You woke with a hole where your identity used to be — not your skills, but who you were. Your past is somewhere in The Spire, broken into fragments, buried in a vast noise of data. Question the people who live here, read the traces, and assemble the truth from pieces others wouldn't even notice. The Spire took your identity. The Spire is also where you'll get it back.

Your character grows across the whole game — you earn modules gradually, so you never have everything at once. They fit into a limited slot grid, and because you have more modules than slots, you choose your loadout to fit the moment: Zeus weapon modes, a shield, higher-tier modules. This isn't a roguelike — you lose nothing, you just decide what to bring.

The more you uncover, the more closely The Spire watches you — and the tighter it closes in. The corridors you knew stop being safe. Combat isn't a reward, it's a price: you reach for a weapon because you're left no other choice.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Story

A secluded inn deep in the mountains. A letter left behind. A destiny long sealed away.

You come following your grandmother's final wish, expecting nothing more than to see the place she tended all her life.

A gentle and thoughtful keeper. A jovial, spirited girl. A short-tempered, enigmatic woman with fiery red hair.

Warm meals, idle chatter, and the gentle rhythm of ordinary days. Life settles around you like a quiet dream.

Until one midnight passes — and you realize: this inn doesn't only take in travelers.

About the Opening

An immersive prologue that begins on a mountain trail. Make your way along a winding, untended path toward the inn your grandmother left behind. Slow your pace. Feel the gravel shift beneath your feet, catch your breath in the thin forest air, listen to the wind and the insects as you find your bearings. Shake the dust from your clothes. Take a sip of water. Let the stillness of the wild dissolve the clamor of the world you left behind.

There's no need to hurry. Beyond the ridge, the lights of the inn are already lit.

Features

Slow-Burn Narrative: A story that unfolds gently, peeling back the warmth of everyday life to reveal the deeper truths buried within the inn.

Light Interactive Elements: Simple, intuitive quick-time actions woven seamlessly into the narrative, keeping you engaged without pulling you out of the story.

A Living Ensemble: A cast of distinct, deeply human characters — each with their own secrets and regrets — who will accompany you through this strange mountain journey.

Chinese Folk Fantasy Reimagined: Blending the quiet eeriness of traditional Chinese tales with genuine human warmth. Unsettling yet never cold.

store_data.about_the_game:
From street corner to criminal empire

You start with nothing but lint in your pockets and a talent for taking what isn't yours. Mobsteria: Rise is a cozy-but-ruthless idle game about clawing your way up the underworld - from petty pickpocket to untouchable Don.

Every racket you run earns cash even while you're away. Reinvest it. Sharpen your skills. Grow your reputation until the whole city knows your name.

Run the rackets

  • Climb a ladder of criminal jobs, each unlocking the next rung of the empire.

  • Bank passive income that keeps flowing while the app is closed.

  • Delegate rackets to your crew and let the money roll in hands-free.

Mind the heat

  • Every score you pull raises your Heat - push too hard and the law comes knocking.

  • Balance greed against caution. The biggest earners burn the hottest.

Build, then burn it down

Train skills, buy upgrades, and earn the Respect that multiplies everything you do.

When you've gone as far as one life allows, Pass the Torch - prestige to start over with permanent advantages.

Or Burn It All for a deeper reset and a legacy that outlives you.

Made to idle or take full control

Simple pixel art and an atmospheric noir vibe.

Designed to be checked in on, not ground out - progress respects your time.

Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud sync across your machines.
