store_data.about_the_game:
Dimensional Breach is a co-op survival-horror game made to be played with friends.

Reality has torn, and a whole host of dimensions has spilled out behind it. These dimensions are unstable; if they aren't contained and sealed, they'll swallow your world. But closing them won't be easy.

Every dimension means a different threat. And the dimension is aware of you — and hostile. It knows you don't belong to that world, and it'll do everything it can to wipe you out. Choose your team wisely, because their decisions will affect your life. Or test your luck alone and face the cruelty of the dimensions by yourself.

Your mission: enter the dimension, gather intel and samples, then return to your own world. With what you've collected, you build your dimension bomb — and step back into a dimension that now knows you're coming, to seal it for good.

Good luck!

🤝 Co-op for up to 4 players

🔊 In-game voice chat — takes the experience to the next level

store_data.about_the_game:
A group of renowned adventurers set sail in search of answers to a growing corruption spreading across a remote chain of islands.

They never returned.

Now, a new band of heroes must follow in their footsteps. Journey across diverse islands, rescue the missing adventurers, uncover what happened to them, and piece together the trail leading to a powerful force responsible for twisting the creatures and landscapes of the world.

Whether playing alone or with friends, every rescued adventurer reveals new clues, hidden knowledge, and fragments of a larger mystery. The closer you get to the truth, the more dangerous the journey becomes.

Combine Elemental Magic

Harness powerful elemental forces and experiment with unique spell combinations. Create new magical effects, overcome environmental obstacles, solve puzzles, and adapt your abilities to different enemies and situations.

Customize

Find, collect and buy clothing from your favorite vendors, so that you can fight in fashion.

Explore Mysterious Islands

Venture through handcrafted islands filled with secrets, hidden paths, ancient ruins, and unique environmental challenges. Every island offers new discoveries and brings you one step closer to finding the missing adventurers.

Rescue Lost Adventurers

Track down explorers who disappeared during their expeditions. Each rescue expands the story, reveals valuable information, and helps uncover the identity of the force spreading corruption throughout the islands.

Battle Corrupted Creatures

Fight creatures transformed by a mysterious blight. Learn their weaknesses, master your elemental abilities, and overcome powerful guardians protecting the darkest secrets of the islands.

Discover Ancient Relics

Collect relics scattered throughout the world to strengthen your abilities, unlock new opportunities for exploration, and customize your playstyle.

Uncover the Truth

Follow the trail left behind by the missing adventurers and confront the source of the corruption before the islands are consumed completely.

Sporebound is a cooperative action-adventure that combines exploration, platforming, puzzle-solving, and elemental magic in a world filled with mystery, danger, and discovery.

store_data.about_the_game:
In This Little World, you work to rebuild Great Britain, following a devastating cataclysm. To reveal the mystery of what happened, you must collect tools and resources to regenerate the rivers, fields, forests, roads, and towns across the land, in a 1:1 recreation of the entire country, exquisitely recreated from real-world data, down to the individual buildings and trees. Beginning on foot, you'll unlock bicycles, cars, trucks, trains, boats, and aircraft to explore more than 200,000km² of England, Wales and Scotland, discovering the history, geography, and culture of the island.

 

Designed as a casual world (re)building game, underpinned by ecological themes and dark humour, This Little World features multiple game modes suiting explorers, builders, and detectives, using stunning ray-traced graphics, genuine British weather, and an entirely procedural soundtrack that provides an immersive and expansive experience of Britain's green-and-pleasant land - requiring you to use both your eyes and ears to solve the challenges before you.

 

Developed using the Unreal Engine 5 game engine, Manhattan procedural music editor (available on Steam), and Klang audio programming language, the game is designed as a platform users, artists, and developers can customise by adding their own music and sound effects, bringing rich, dynamic, interactive sound to every corner of Albion.

FEATURES

  • An epic story that blends discovery, mystery, philosophy, ecology, and a British sense of humour™ (largely sarcasm), dynamically interwoven with history, landmarks, and regional culture. Choose where you start and gradually regrow and rebuild the country - town by town, county by county - with a dynamic campaign and mission system drawing on local knowledge of the land.

  • Over 200,000km² of England, Wales, and Scotland, recreated in 1:1 ray-traced graphics from real-world data, including every hill, valley, village, town, building, road, path, river, lake, and even tree - generated in pure 3D using open data; no satellite or photogrammetry.

  • Dynamic day/night cycle, seasons, and British Weather system (not just rain), including simulated water cycle, where the player must regenerate rivers and lakes to bring life back to the once green-and-pleasant land, before the towns and cities can thrive.

  • Multiple game modes, including both open exploration, mini-games, and an immersive single-player campaign based on world-building and discovery, in which you must restore the land and infrastructure while unravelling the mystery of what befell the once Great land.

  • A range of quintessentially British vehicles*, including bicycles, motorbikes, cars, trains, planes, helicopters, balloons, boats, and ships, gradually unlocked as the story (and land) develops.

  • An entirely procedural soundtrack, showcasing innovative interactive audio technologies, where:

    • Music (powered by Manhattan) is driven by the game world, reflecting the state of the land, foreshadowing events, and providing clues to finding resources or solving objectives - dynamically changing as you move between areas, gaining harmony as the land does - with inspiration from artists ranging from Massive Attack to Vaughan Williams.

    • Sounds (powered by Klang) are dynamically synthesised, rather than pre-recorded; procedurally modelling everything from engines to ambient sounds like birds and weather that react authentically to how they behave in the changing world - enabling a richer, adaptive sonic performance.

    • New music and sounds can be developed by players, artists, and developers using Manhattan or Klang, placed in the game world and shared with others, creating an interactive tapestry of interactive music and sonic art that evolves over time, and an open resource for other game makers.


* Defined as vehicles that leak oil.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a wizard.

Unfortunately, gravity is broken and nobody knows why. Pick a

direction to fall in, hurl spells at your friends, and try not to hit yourself

with a ricochet bolt you launched at your own face. This is Axis Flip.

Every time you respawn, you choose which direction gravity pulls you - up, down,

left, or right. Use this to reach powerups, ambush enemies from unexpected angles,

or simply fall in a new and exciting direction. All directions are equally valid.

All directions are equally fatal.

Combat is entirely spell-based. Ricochet bolts bounce off every wall - including

back at you. Ice spray coats the ground in slippery patches. Grapple hooks let

you swing into enemies at full speed. Tethers can be anchored across the arena

for truly deranged swing angles. Master the trajectory. Own the arena. Apologize

to your teammates later.

The Arcane Council promised this "wouldn't be a problem." That was before Akimbo

cast an anti-gravity rune too fast. Now everyone's just falling sideways.

store_data.about_the_game:
A nightmare fueled by fear.

THROB is a first-person psychological horror platformer set inside a colossal brutalist structure pulsing like a living heart.

Trapped within a nightmare shaped by her own hemophobia, a young woman must climb toward an unknown exit before panic consumes her completely.

As your heartbeat accelerates, the structure reacts. Platforms shift, hazards activate, and blood begins to rise through the building itself. The higher you climb, the more unstable the nightmare becomes.

Every obstacle follows the beat. Survival depends on observing patterns, timing movement, and adapting to an ever-increasing tempo.

The world is almost entirely monochrome. Red is reserved for what matters: danger, blood, rhythm, and the manifestations of fear itself.

  • First-person rhythm-based platforming

  • Platforms and hazards synchronized to the beat

  • Brutalist monochrome environments with red as the only dominant color

  • A pressure-based climb focused on timing, readability, and survival

  • Stylized horror atmosphere with high-contrast visuals

  • Minimal UI and strong visual language: red means danger

Screenshots and trailer footage are taken from an early vertical slice of THROB. The game is still in active development, so visuals, level design, and gameplay elements will evolve over time.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The world is dead.

After a global climate catastrophe, Earth has been plunged into an endless winter. Cities lie abandoned, resources are running out, and the last survivors of humanity are desperately searching for shelter.

You are the Coordinator of Convoy 07, a train carrying one of the last remaining human communities. Your mission is simple: keep moving.

Manage the convoy's resources, organize your survivors, send expeditions into abandoned locations, and make decisions that will shape the future of your community.

Every choice matters. Accepting new survivors may help preserve your humanity, but it will also put additional strain on your supplies. Refusing to help others may secure the convoy's survival... at the cost of your conscience.

Manage Your Convoy

  • Monitor food, water, electricity, medicine, and materials.

  • Assign survivors to different train cars.

  • Expand and maintain your convoy's critical systems.

Explore a Frozen World

  • Send expeditions to abandoned cities, train stations, tunnels, and forgotten facilities.

  • Recover valuable resources.

  • Discover new survivors.

  • Face unexpected events.

Repair the Radio

A damaged long-range radio remains aboard the train.

Finding the parts needed to restore it will be one of your first priorities.

Once repaired, it may reveal what remains of the world beyond the rails.

Write Your Own Story

Every playthrough tells a different story.

The survivors you rescue, the decisions you make, and the sacrifices you accept will shape the fate of Convoy 07.

store_data.about_the_game:
WORLD'S GONE MAD.

An anarchic zone, inhabited by antisocial killers, disturbed perverts, mutated half-humans, egomaniacal dictators, and some nice people sprinkled in here and there. 

Swap out and perfect all your body parts and organs. Collect the most powerful loadout of guns, knives and swords. Learn martial skills and neuro-manic psychomanipulation. Choose whose will to enforce and whose cause to help, and lay waste to those who stand in your way... assuming they don't put up a bigger fight than you.

Your body is yours to customize, optimize, and strengthen. Arms, legs, vitals, guts - swap it all out! Make the most of androgen, xenogen and synthetic implants to turn yourself into an athletic monster, an unstoppable tank, an unholy sharpshooter, or anything in between.

Choose from a plethora of melee weapons and firearms to forge your ideal playstyle. Slow and methodical hitmen, lightning-fast swordsmen, sledgehammer juggernauts, machine gun powerhouses, and whoever else you can think of - Waderverse has them all.

What else is in store?

Currently, there is only a demo available on Steam, in which you slash, shoot and run through a small course full of training dummies and try to beat your best time. The game itself - a 2D open-world RPG - will take years to fully create. There are many gameplay systems and mechanics missing from the demo - Mania and active and passive abilities, for example - which will be added in a second demo when enemy AI is finished. If you are interested in the game's development, my socials are listed on this page.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chasing the Truth, Caught in a Nightmare Until Done tells the chilling story of Beyza, a female journalist who travels to the isolated Silver Lake Farm to investigate the mysterious disappearance of three children.

Hoping to find answers in this desolate land, Beyza discovers mysterious notes belonging to the missing children and their families. While the authors of the notes are clearly known by the names on them, who placed them there and for what purpose remains a complete enigma. As she tries to piece together the clues, she discovers with horror that she has become the target of a demonic entity relentlessly hunting her from the pitch-black darkness.

Are you ready to experience this nightmare through Beyza's eyes, trying to survive in a tense night atmosphere and along the dark, eerie paths of the forest?

Key Features:

  • Your Light is Your Only Shield: You cannot completely destroy the entity pursuing you, but you are not defenseless. By using your flashlight's powerful mode at the right moments, you can temporarily blind and slow down the demon, gaining crucial seconds to lose your trail.

  • Uncover Dark Secrets: Carefully search for the notes scattered around Silver Lake Farm. Reading every single page without missing a clue will bring you closer step by step to the horrific truth of what happened to the children.

  • Suffocating and Eerie Atmosphere: From a first-person (FPS) perspective, the tension never drops as you navigate the forest paths relying solely on the beam of your flashlight. Every shadow and every sound could spell your end.

  • Do You Have the Courage to Learn the Truth?: Beyza's journalistic curiosity dragged her into this hell. Will you be able to survive long enough to bring the truth to light?

store_data.about_the_game:
RESTRICTED SIGNAL DETECTED: PROJECTING INTO SECTOR 7

STATUS BRIEFING (LP-MAN-1993-S7):

On January 12, 1993, the carrier-wave quantum reactor inside Sector 7 went critical. The physical facility, its steel superstructures, and the onsite staff didn't explode—they experienced a spatial phase-shift, melting down and compressing into a monospaced digital grid. The steel, concrete, and the very air itself now exist only as ASCII coordinates.

The criticality ruptured the dimensional boundary, opening a direct corridor to the Backrooms—a liminal, endless labyrinth existing behind the fabric of consensus reality. Anomalies are bleeding through these tears, migrating directly into our monospace coordinate grid.

Project your consciousness via the T-Link Neural Bridge from a cryogenic isolation tank into this glitched, collapsing spatial lattice. Calibrate the terminals, lock onto carrier frequencies, and escape before your synaptic link collapses.

OPERATIONAL PROTOCOLS (GAME MODES)

Solo Protocol (Single-Player Hacking & Survival)

Deploy on sequential runs into the grid to salvage logs and acquire persistent upgrades.

  • The Decryption Loop: The Escape Bulkhead Hatch is locked by an alphabetical passcode. Locate Clue Terminals and hack the consoles (or use Bypass Keys) to reveal the password letters. Enter the password at the hatch to escape.

  • Persistent Upgrades: Spend XP between runs to upgrade your digitized containment suit across 8 categories, including battery capacity, sanity dampening, movement speed, decryption hacking speed, and cognitive shield capacity.

  • Emergency Credit Shop: Collect Data Cores and logs for credits, then spend them at Wall CRT Terminals for emergency consumables: battery refills, sanity pills, decoys, bypass keys, and shield boosters.

Infinitum Protocol (Endless Compression)

Survive in a recursively generated, endless layout under active structural decay.

  • Core Quota: Collect the required amount of Data Cores on each floor to unlock the escape hatch.

  • Cascade Failure: Floor stability decays continuously (0.3% * floor per second). At 0% stability, a cascade failure triggers: anomalies accelerate to high speed and sanity drains continuously.

  • Environmental Hazards: Navigate Pitch Black Zones (no radar scans, 2.5x sanity decay) and Radar Jamming Fields (blocks the HUD schematic map).

Multiplayer Sync Protocol (Steam P2P Co-op)

  • Matchmaking: Host private lobbies or join public matches using SteamWorks P2P matchmaking.

  • Cooperate to Survive: Team up with up to 4 players. Coordinate calibrations—one player can gaze-lock entities while others secure the nodes.

  • Leaderboards: Upload survival times and endless mode scores directly to Steam.

T-LINK CONTAINMENT SUIT BIOMETRICS

  • Flashlight Power: Toggle your flashlight (F) to see, but keep in mind it drains battery and hostiles can track the light beam footprint.

  • Psychic Aegis: A cognitive shield absorbs 90% of incoming sanity damage. It regenerates up to 50% near safe light sources (beacons, tube lights). If depleted to 0%, you take full sanity damage.

  • Sub-Space Decoys: Deploy decoys (Q) to distract nearby anomalies within a 12-cell radius.

  • Synaptic Collapse: Proximity to anomalies and total darkness drains sanity. If sanity hits 0%, the link snaps, resulting in immediate brain death.

THE ANOMALIES

  • Anomaly-01: The Seeker (Red Static Waveform): Freezes in place when looked at directly. Turn your back or look away, and it closes the distance at hyper-speed. Back away slowly while keeping eye contact.

  • Stalker Drone (S-DRN): Corrupted security sentinels immune to gaze. They patrol corridors with radar sweeps. If spotted, toggle your flashlight off to lower your footprint, break line-of-sight, and run.

  • Entity-03: SCP-096 ("The Shy Guy"): Humanoid anomaly that wanders slowly. Looking at its face triggers a 3.5-second scream (causing screen distortion), followed by a 15-second rage where it chases you at high speed.

CUSTOM RETRO TECH

  • Custom WebGL ASCII Raycaster: Renders the entire game world as a real-time grid of monospaced ASCII characters. Lighting, shadows, and depth shading are calculated on the GPU for high performance and authentic CRT style.

EARLY ACCESS ROADMAP

Future updates will include:

  • Deep-Grid Sectors: New maps representing the digitized remnants of the reactor core.

  • More Anomalies: Additional entities escaping from the Backrooms with unique AI behaviors.

  • Breach Modifiers: Unstable reality settings that alter physics, visibility, and entity speed.

  • Steam Achievements: Unlockable achievements for progression milestones and co-op extraction.

SOUL MIXER is an arcade-style rhythm action game set in a dark comedy world,
featuring satisfying key sounds for every note, designed for everyone to enjoy!

Rock out with a unique 9-button layout (Arcade Controller / Keyboard strongly recommended)!
※Gamepads (standard controllers) are not recommended.

■ STORY: Become a Live Sound Engineer at a Demonic Sweatshop!

Under the command of the vampire producer CIGINT, you become a PA (Audio Assistant) in the underworld. Your mission? Use the mysterious "Soul Mixer" to pull off successful live shows and rack up cash! Use your hard-earned money to pay off the company's massive debt, or freely purchase helpful items, enhancement parts, skins, and new tracks. store_data.about_the_game:
It's a football-manager career — but for airlines. In Airline Legacy you don't just own a carrier, you're hired to run one. Take the CEO chair at a struggling airline, answer to a demanding board, hit their targets, and claw your way from a no-name regional outfit to the most powerful executive in the industry. Miss your numbers and you're fired — and a rival CEO takes your seat.

Live the Career

  • Sign contracts with airlines of every culture — budget, premium, or cutthroat — each with its own board, salary, and mandate.

  • Answer to the board: hit their objectives to win renewals and promotions, or burn through their patience and get sacked.

  • Compete in a league of rival CEOs — your career is measured against theirs, and they're gunning for your job.

  • Get poached, promoted, or fired, then work the job market for your next seat. Your reputation follows you everywhere.

Run Every Side of the Business

  • Fly the world — open routes to 1,000+ cities across every country on Earth.

  • Build your fleet — buy or lease beloved classic and modern airliners, brand-new or pre-owned.

  • Fight for slots — negotiate scarce takeoff and landing rights at the world's busiest airports.

  • Plant your hubs — establish bases to anchor and expand your network.

  • Build your team — hire and fire specialist agents to broker slot deals, hub bids, and campaigns.

  • Own the terminal — open lounges, hotels, and passenger businesses for fresh revenue streams.

  • Fill the seats — launch advertising and PR campaigns to drive demand and grow your brand.

Master the Bottom Line

Fuel, wages, maintenance, airport fees, aircraft age, load factors, reputation — every call lands on the monthly P&L. Survive the lean months and stay solvent: three straight months in the red and the board pulls the plug.

Prefer the Classics? Play Historical Mode

Rather own your airline outright? Historical Mode is a love letter to the classic airline sims. Pick your decade — 1980, 1995, or 2010 — and build a global empire from scratch as the aircraft, economies, and world map evolve around you. No board, no contracts. Just you, the map, and decades to dominate the skies.

Take the Chair

The boardroom is waiting. Can you become the world's number-one airline CEO?

store_data.about_the_game:
THE CITY HAS FALLEN. YOU'RE WHAT'S LEFT


Civilization collapsed and the streets belong to them now. Zombie City Together is a first-person zombie shooter set in a post-apocalyptic city, playable by 1 to 4 players online. Stand shoulder to shoulder with friends against the incoming horde — or turn on each other in a brutal free-for-all where everyone fends for themselves. The choice is yours.

THE DEAD DON'T JUST SHAMBLE

These aren't your average zombies. Fled to a rooftop? They'll leap after you — and the entire nearby pack jumps at once. The ones at range rain acid-like spit and stones down on you, so there's no such thing as a safe spot. Every zombie has its own speed, its own staggering gait, its own face: with 50+ unique city-zombie looks, no two fights ever feel the same.

TEAR THEM APART

An advanced dismemberment system means every hit leaves a mark. Head, arm, leg — whatever you shoot gets blown off and flung by physics, complete with bloody stumps and bursting particles. Blow off a zombie's leg and it won't die; it starts crawling toward you.

FIGHT BY DAY, HUNT BY NIGHT

Pick the atmosphere before the match begins. Day: the threat is visible — hold your ground and mow the wave down. Night: deep darkness, narrowed vision, nothing safe beyond the beam of your flashlight. Same map, two completely different feelings — one is relief, the other is pure dread.

WEAPONS

Assault rifle, shotgun, flamethrower and rocket launcher... and the fists that kick in when everything's empty. The rocket travels with real projectile physics, synced for everyone in the match. Swap weapons on the fly, with polished recoil, a dynamic crosshair and punchy hit feedback on every shot.

THREE MODES, ENDLESS CHAOS

  • Survival: Endless, ever-escalating waves. How long can you hold out?
  • PvP (Team): First to the kill limit wins. Zombies off, the only target is each other.
  • Survival + PvP: The most chaotic mode. Stay alive against the horde while fighting your rivals at the same time. You decide who to shoot — and who to forge a fragile alliance with.

EVERY KILL COUNTS

Every zombie you drop is XP. Level up and unlock new ways to make your survivor your own — hats, beards, hairstyles, full costumes and more. The more you kill, the more your character becomes truly yours.

WITH FRIENDS, AND FAIR

Invite friends over Steam and host your own lobby. A server-authoritative architecture with lag compensation keeps your headshots landing even at high ping. Prefer to play on your own? Single-player is fully supported.

FEATURES

  • 1 to 4 players online — co-op and PvP
  • 50+ unique zombie looks with physical dismemberment / gore
  • Smart zombie AI that leaps and attacks from range
  • Pick day or night atmosphere before each match
  • 4 weapons + melee
  • 3 game modes, 4 difficulty levels
  • Level-based cosmetic progression — hats, beards, hair, costumes for a long-term "one more run" loop

The city is waiting for your last stand. Survive together... or be the last one standing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Project Matter is a minimalist 2D text based factory design game.

Place an unlimited amount of free buildings, design a web of increasingly complex production chains, refine and recover numerous waste products into valuable resources, and research nearly 100 technologies all in your quest to acquire stable matter.

Progression is driven by Science Packs. Each Science Pack is a physical resource that must be manufactured, routed to labs, and consumed for research. New research unlocks new production recipes, material families, recovery loops, refining methods, and deeper factory problems.

Waste is not optional cleanup. Tailings, slag, acid waste, spent chemicals, and other byproducts become required parts of the production web. Early waste may be burned or ignored, but later tiers depend on recovering, enriching, purifying, and stabilizing those streams.

Discover and produce stable matter to access infinite and repeatable technology for never ending factory growth

~150 resources and byproducts from just 7 raw inputs.

6 Science Pack tiers driving a deep, cumulative research web of ~90 nodes.

~30 building types across processing, manufacturing, research, and waste recovery.

Clean, minimal text based 2D visuals on an infinite grid.

No player character, no belts, no combat, no inventory.

The web must grow.

Gear up, break in, grab the loot — then run for your life as the whole town panics and the police close in. Close to the Scene blends tense police chases with low-poly crime-sandbox chaos.

You've got one goal: pull off five jobs across the city before the clock runs out. Sounds simple. It isn't.

GEAR UP & BREAK IN
Three types of targets, each with its own pace — Houses (fast), Shops (medium), and Factories (slow, big payout). Collect the right tools, check your job list, hold E, and crack the place open. Every job empties your bag for the next one.

ESCAPE THE HEAT

store_data.about_the_game:
Some Games Are Built So You Can Never Walk Away


Loss Limit is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set inside a breakout sports-betting startup at the worst possible moment: three weeks after a VIP player—an ordinary husband and father—lost everything and took his own life. You play Knox Mercer, the quiet operator behind Vantage's "in-play" microbetting engine, personalization model, and VIP host program—systems designed to keep people tapping long after they should stop.

With an IPO, a marquee launch weekend, lawsuits, and a state investigation closing in, Knox is forced to choose what he'll protect: the machine he built, or the people it broke—while three dangerous relationships ignite around the same dead man's file.

Each route offers a different kind of romance under pressure: a hostile reunion with the regulator who can end his career, an intimate closeness with the ex-wife who needs the truth, and a forbidden affair with the partner who can bury him.

Meet the Cast




Nora Keane — The Ex-Wife
Nora is Danny Keane's ex-wife and the mother of his six-year-old daughter—an exhausted, fierce single mom who left Danny to save their child, then lost him anyway. She comes to Knox for answers no settlement can buy: what "limited" really meant, what the app did at two in the morning, and whether leaving pushed Danny over the edge. She should hate Knox—and she tries—but he's the only person who can tell her the full truth, and the only one who can share a grief that doesn't end at the courthouse door.



Helena Cross — The Regulator
Helena is senior enforcement counsel for the state gaming commission, leading the investigation that could pull Vantage's license and make Danny's death official on the record. She's also Knox's past: the woman he was with fifteen years ago, before the app and the money, who left when she saw what he was becoming. Sharp, principled, and dangerously funny when she's winning, Helena forces Knox to face not only what he built—but the version of himself she never stopped measuring him against.



Margot Renn — The Trader
Margot is Vantage's Head of Trading: the one who sets limits, sees patterns early, and understands exactly how the machine makes its money. She built the book alongside Knox from the beginning—and now her logs can prove who killed the safeguard that should've stopped Danny Keane. Flat, brilliant, and unbribable, she's the closest thing Knox has to an equal… and the most forbidden person he could reach for when the company starts rewriting the truth.

Key Features

  • Single-choice branching romance: Early on, choose whose door Knox walks through—then follow a complete, character-driven route shaped by that decision.
  • A modern noir corporate thriller backdrop: IPO roadshows, discovery deadlines, suitability investigations, and launch war-rooms—where every conversation has stakes and every document can ruin someone.
  • Three distinct romance dynamics: Hostile Reunion (adversarial chemistry + old history), Bereaved-Adjacent Confidant (shared grief + moral barrier), and Forbidden Attraction (work + witness risk).
  • A grounded, adult emotional tone: Guilt, complicity, grief, and desire collide—without easy absolution.
  • Themes with teeth: "Responsible gaming" as theater, "in-play" as addiction design, and the central question of whether anyone can ever truly cash out.
  • Adult content: Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

Content Warning

Loss Limit is intended for mature audiences (18+). It contains sexual content and explores heavy themes including gambling-related harm, grief after suicide, legal/corporate pressure, and emotionally intense relationships. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grombo Card Shop Idle is an idle management game about running a tiny trading card shop full of absurd hand-drawn creatures.

Buy stock, open packs, sell singles, complete your Grombodex, and watch weird little customers walk into your shop, browse products, buy whatever they can afford, or leave disappointed because they were looking for “that weird fried egg card”.

The game is designed to work both in fullscreen and as a small desktop window. You can leave your shop running in a corner while you do other things, check back from time to time, restock shelves, open a few packs, and see if that ridiculously rare Grombo finally shows up.

Run your card shop

Restock packs, boxes, accessories, and singles. Upgrade shelves, expand the showcase, unlock new features, and slowly turn your suspicious cardboard corner into something that almost looks like a real business.

Open packs of Grombos

Each set includes original, stupid, collectible creatures. Some are cute. Some look like mistakes. All of them have charm, even the ones that probably should not exist.

Open packs, discover new cards, chase special rarities, and decide what to do with your best pulls:

  • keep them;

  • place them in the showcase;

  • sell them as singles;

  • or turn repeated cards into bulk.

Sell singles and set prices

Valuable cards can be placed in the showcase. You decide whether to sell them quickly, price them fairly, or ask for a ridiculous amount and hope a customer makes a terrible financial decision.

A living shop in the background

Customers enter, browse, buy, complain, ask weird questions, and sometimes leave without spending anything. The activity log tells you what happened while you were not looking, because apparently the shop keeps existing without you.

Progress, events, and requests

Increase your shop prestige, unlock new rewards, complete daily customer requests, and take advantage of theme days where certain products or cards are worth more than usual.

It may not always be good business, but there will be Grombos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Become Untamed. Become a Beast.

In a city where swagger is currency, violence is language, and the weak are crushed first, you begin as a bottom-rank gang member in Posan City, only to be dragged deeper and deeper into a more dangerous world.

The rules of survival here are simple. Never show weakness. Overwhelm those weaker than you. When you stand before someone stronger, bow low and wait for your next chance.

Physics-Kinematic Combat

A punch does not come out with a single button press. You must lean your body, adjust your attack trajectory, and read your enemy’s timing. Every attack produces a completely different result depending on direction, charge, recovery, distance, and impact angle.

Experiment with different fighting stances and attacks, discover the optimal trajectory, and punish your enemies.

Swagger System

Money? It is meaningless. It gets paid upward and disappears. What truly matters in this world is swagger.

Defeat your enemies to gain swagger. Stake your swagger to pressure your opponent, or overpower them without even starting a fight.

Bring your enemies to their knees and become stronger. If you cannot, then at least pretend to be strong.

Intimidation and One-on-One Brawls

No matter who stands before you, do not flinch. Stare them down first. Some will hand over their money. Others will start a fight.

Judge your opponent by their clothes, build, posture, gaze, and reputation. Community posts, eyewitness accounts, and saved photos may contain vital clues that decide whether you live or die.

Read your enemies, and force those weaker than you into submission.

You may receive rewards you never expected.

Key Features

Physics-based one-on-one combat built around precise weaving and attack trajectory control.

Jabs, straights, hooks, uppercuts, charged attacks, near-misses, counters, hit stops, and execution follow-ups.

High-risk psychological confrontations where you stake your swagger to pressure your opponent.

Reactive AI that changes according to the situation and the player’s actions.

A noir story that casts a harsh light on both the floor and the ceiling, from cramped boarding rooms to luxury apartments.

Lives and endings that change according to your choices and decisions.

Brothers.. our final battle is coming. Get ready for it..

store_data.about_the_game:
Burn Tree Burn is a tactile incremental about one dangerous little pleasure: dragging a flame across a forest and watching it get away from you.

Your cursor radiates heat. At first nothing catches, and one warm tree just cools back down. But hold the flame over a dense grove and the heat starts to stack: one tree pops, then its neighbor, then the whole cluster, embers leaping the gaps you mistook for firebreaks. Every tree you burn leaves charcoal behind. Spend it on a hotter, hungrier fire.

Cross the tipping point

Every fire is chasing the same moment, the one where it stops needing you. Below the line you nurse small blazes along by hand, grove by grove. Cross it, and you light a single spark and step back while the firestorm does the rest.

Burn, bank, upgrade

Between sparks, spend the charcoal. Push the heat hotter so fire leaps gaps that used to kill it. Stretch the embers so a dying blaze hands off to the next grove. Seed the map with oil trees that go up white-hot, and powder kegs that detonate and throw fire across the breaks. Call down lightning, grow ironbark that pays out big, evolve the whole forest so it regrows richer every time you torch it. Then claim more territory, zoom out, and start over at a bigger scale.

Features

  • Fire that spreads: it fizzles in the gaps and roars through the clusters, finding its own way through the trees.

  • A flame on your cursor: drag it across the trees and the heat drags along, every tree glowing hotter the second you touch it.

  • Charcoal that never stops: it pops off every burning tree and streams into your counter, and the number keeps climbing.

  • Always one more upgrade: hotter flames, longer embers, powder kegs, lightning, tree evolution, prestige.

  • The payoff: one spark, and a whole forest goes up at once.

  • A forest that grows back: fresh and swaying between burns, then charred and smoking once the fire rolls through.

Burn it down. Bank the ash. Burn it down again, bigger.

store_data.about_the_game:
Restcue is a cinematic short-form psychological horror game.

You wake up on the living room sofa in complete silence. The front door is deadbolted, and the once-familiar space feels disturbingly wrong... As you explore every corner of the house, fragmented memories slowly surface, along with a heavy sense of guilt.

You thought you were just a victim trapped in this house. But as the truth gradually reveals itself, you’ll discover that everything is far darker than you imagined.

Core Features

  • Immersive environmental puzzles and real-time stealth

  • Multiple carefully crafted chase and escape sequences

  • Strong sense of oppression created through lighting and sound design

  • Extreme tension where one mistake can lead to death

  • A shocking final twist

The game only takes about 30 minutes, yet delivers an emotional rollercoaster from the ordinary to pure despair. Through masterful atmosphere and audio design in a confined space, Restcue immerses players in intense claustrophobia and psychological pressure.

If you love deep storytelling, subtle horror, and short experiences that linger long after you finish, Restcue will be an unforgettable journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
🎮 Digit Dash 3

Digit Dash 3 is a live party game streamed directly from a streamer's Twitch or Kick channel. Viewers play together in real time by typing simple commands in chat.

🌌 The Board

The game is played on a 13×13 grid of numbered cells. Each cell holds a random value between -12 and +12 at the start of every game. There is one shared game piece that all players take turns controlling — the piece starts in the centre of the board when the game begins.

👥 Players & Joining

- The host (streamer) connects their Twitch or Kick channel from the game's control panel and clicks Start Game once enough players have joined.

- Up to 7 players can join a single game.

- To join, viewers simply type !digit in the streamer's chat.

- Players are added on a first-come, first-served basis. Once the game starts or the lobby is full, no new players can join.

🎯 Taking Turns

Players take turns in order, one at a time. On your turn, you have 35 seconds to move the shared game piece to an adjacent cell — up, down, left, or right. You type your move in chat:

Command Direction W or WW Up S or SS Down A or AA Left D or DD Right

The double-letter variants ( WW , SS , etc.) exist to help avoid Twitch/Kick chat duplicate message filters — both do the same thing.

When a player moves onto a cell, they earn (or lose) the points shown on that cell. Positive numbers add to your score, negative numbers subtract from it.

💥 Cell Destruction — No Regeneration

Cells are permanently destroyed once the game piece passes through them. Both the cell the piece moves from and the cell it moves to are destroyed after every move. There is no regeneration — once a cell is gone, it's gone for the rest of the game. Destroyed cells appear as dark void craters on the board and cannot be moved to.

🌀 Teleportation

If the game piece becomes completely surrounded by destroyed cells with no valid move available, it automatically teleports to a random surviving cell anywhere on the board. The current player instantly claims and destroys that landing cell, earning or losing its points in the process.

🔀 Random Board Shuffle

At random intervals during the game ( between 100 and 200 seconds ), all surviving (non-destroyed) cells have their numbers re-randomised . This can dramatically change the value of cells you were planning to move to — keeping every player on their toes. A "Board Shuffled!" alert flashes on screen when this happens.

⏱️ Inactivity & Removal

If a player fails to make a move within their 35-second window, the game automatically makes a random move on their behalf and counts it as a missed turn . After 3 consecutive missed turns , that player is removed from the game entirely.

A 10-second audio warning plays to remind the current player their time is running out.

🏁 Game Over

The game ends when every cell on the board has been destroyed . The player with the highest score wins . Final scores are displayed on screen with the winner announced.

🤖 AFK / Auto-Run Mode

The host can enable AFK Mode — designed for streams where the host isn't actively present. In this mode:

- The game waits up to 2 minutes for at least 2 players to join, then starts automatically.

- After a game ends, a 30-second countdown begins and then a new game starts automatically.

- This keeps the game running on loop for the stream with no manual intervention needed.

🛠️ Host Controls

The streamer's host screen includes:

- Connect to Twitch or Kick chat

- Start / New Game buttons

- Music volume control

- Activate Cell Zoom — zooms into the game board centred on the current player's position, like a magnifying glass

- Remove individual players manually

- Windowed / Fullscreen toggle

About This Game

The Rich Die First is a multiplayer strategy card game about building wealth, managing resources, and outsmarting your opponents.

Starting with limited money and opportunities, players must invest wisely, play powerful cards, and react to unpredictable events in order to become the wealthiest player at the table. Every decision can change the balance of power, and a single mistake can turn a market leader into a bankrupt loser.

Build Your Fortune

Grow your wealth through investments, business opportunities, and strategic card play. Managing your resources efficiently is the key to long-term success.

Compete Against Other Players

Challenge friends in multiplayer matches where every player is fighting for financial dominance. Disrupt your opponents' plans, seize opportunities before they do, and stay one step ahead.

Play Solo Against AI

Prefer playing alone? Face AI-controlled opponents and experiment with different strategies before taking on human rivals.

Every Match Is Different

Random events, unique card combinations, and changing game situations create a different experience every time you play.

Features

• Multiplayer gameplay over local network and online connections

• Single-player mode with AI opponents

• Strategic card-based decision making

• Resource and wealth management mechanics

• Competitive player interaction and sabotage opportunities

• High replayability through randomized events and card combinations

• Easy to learn, difficult to master

Can you build an economic empire and become the last millionaire standing?

store_data.about_the_game:
This game requires a microphone to play.

You must stay silent in the morgue. Sound means death.

Welcome to *No Sound*. A voice-controlled psychological horror game where every sound you make could be your last.

You play as Shen Ting, a 21-year-old forensic intern, left alone in the morgue late at night to organize the body registration forms. The duty handbook says: "No sound is permitted after midnight." You hear knocking from inside the freezer. You decide to read the handbook first.

 The rules might be fake.

You see 4 rules, but some of them don't seem right. Blurred passages, altered wording—as if someone deliberately hid something. Which rules are real? Which were fabricated? You'll need to test them yourself.

 In the morgue, even your breath is your enemy.

Every movement, every hesitation could be detected by something. You'll find yourself holding your breath without realizing it—that's exactly what this game wants you to feel. Which sounds are safe and which will kill you? You'll have to find out.

 Find the truth, or be consumed by it.

The key is locked away. You're trapped. There are containers scattered around the room—maybe a clue lies inside one of them. Maybe somewhere else. Maybe you don't need a key at all.

You need to decide: which clues are real, and which are traps left behind on purpose? The rules in the handbook aren't necessarily reliable. When you discover the first rule is false—will you still trust the rest?

You can test, or you can stay silent. But every sound you make could bring you closer to the exit—or further away.

 A horror story you can experience firsthand.

*No Sound* is a new title set in the *Prison Chain* universe. If you enjoy solitary exploration, psychological terror, and narratives where nothing is what it seems—this game is for you.

Add to your Wishlist now and be among the first to uncover the truth.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mow It. Plow It. Tow It. Fly It.

Mow My World puts modular CCBOT robots to work across Earth, the Moon, and Mars. Take on service jobs, upgrade your fleet, build your own places, and switch into AirMode when the job calls for a view from above.

Mow, Plow & Tow

Cut lunar grass, clear snow on Mars, and haul cargo across Earth. Each job gives your robot a different purpose, from clean service routes to heavy-duty work across changing terrain.

Take Off With AirMode

When the ground is not enough, deploy AirMode. Lift off, scout the map, line up your next route, and capture cinematic shots of your robot at work from above.

Weather, Light & Off-World Atmosphere

Clear days, night work, snow, rain, lunar sunrise, and dusty Martian skies change the feeling of every job. Turn on your robot lights and keep working when the world gets dark.

Real Maps Become Playable

Enter a supported address and turn a real-world place into a playable work site. Mow lawns and save neighborhoods you want to revisit.

Visit Landmarks Across Worlds

Take your robot to hand-built landmark scenes across Earth, the Moon, and Mars. These scenic places are made for exploration, AirMode, and cinematic service jobs.

Practice Before The Job

Jump into practice areas to test modules, learn controls, try AirMode, and get comfortable before taking on real map jobs. The last but not the least, use blocks to build, test, and play your own creations.

store_data.about_the_game:
BE THE LAST CAT STANDING
Boompaw is a physics-driven party brawler with one simple goal: shove, smack, and blow every other cat off the arena before they do it to you. No health bars. No hand-holding. Just ragdoll cats, live bombs, and the edge of the platform.

SUMO, BUT CATS

Every cat is a wobbling ball of momentum. Build up a charge, slam into a rival, and watch them flail into the void. Read the shove, dodge the counter, and fight for center ring. The physics do the comedy — you just aim it.

BOMBS CHANGE EVERYTHING

Grab a bomb. Hold it too long and it's your problem. Lob it into a scrum and four cats go flying at once. Every match is a scramble of greed, timing, and "oh no" — the funniest wins are the ones nobody planned.

FIVE WAYS TO BRAWL

  • Survival — last cat on the arena takes the round.
  • Overthrow — hold the zone, defend the crown.
  • Bomb-Tag — pass the bomb or go boom. Hot potato with claws.
  • BoomBall — cat soccer: headbutt the ball into the goal.
  • Horde — go solo against endless waves of cats.

ARENAS THAT FIGHT BACK

Slip across a glacier, dodge cannon fire on a pirate galleon, dance over lava in the foundry, or get sugar-rushed on a giant cake. Every arena has its own hazards, edges, and ways to die hilariously.

EASY TO PICK UP, IMPOSSIBLE TO PUT DOWN

Pick your fighter from 20 cat colors, name it, and send it to war. Play solo against bots, or pile in with up to 8 for total party chaos. No tutorial nobody reads — just pure pick-up-and-play.

Wishlist now

Add Boompaw to your wishlist to get the launch-day boom.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

Robert wakes up to find himself trapped in a dream.

The only way to escape is to find the Red Door.

However, what awaits him beyond it is the past he has tried to forget.

To confront his past, Robert ventures deeper into the dream.

What lies beyond the Red Door? And what truth is hidden within Robert’s past?

Gameplay

The Door is a story-driven first-person horror adventure game.

Play as Robert and journey through the dream while reliving his memories.

Each area contains diaries written by various characters, as well as fragments of Robert’s memories.

By reading these diaries, you’ll uncover Robert’s past and learn what happened in each location.

Each area also features its own beautiful scenery and original music.

store_data.about_the_game:
A calm little aquarium that lives on your desktop


Reefling is a see-through fish tank that sits in the corner of your screen while you work or play. The fish swim around, the water glows, and your desktop shows right through the glass. Clicks pass straight through the tank too, so it stays out of your way.

Feed your fish and grow your collection

  • Click anywhere in the tank to drop food, and your fish will swim over to eat it.
  • You earn shells slowly while the tank is open, with a little bonus when you feed. It builds up on its own, so there's nothing to grind for.
  • Spend those shells in the Store and pick from over 150 pixel-art fish species.
  • New species show up the longer you play, so the collection fills out over weeks instead of one long sitting.

Make it your own

  • Decorate with seaweed, kelp, coral, sea fans, rocks and shiny shells.
  • Name and rename any fish you like.
  • A day/night cycle slowly shifts the water from bright noon light to deep blue night.
  • The tank gets livelier (and a bit bigger) as your little community grows.

Keep it relaxed

  • Your fish never starve. Leave it alone for hours or days and the tank is always fine.
  • The interface fades out when you go idle, with soft aquarium sounds in the background.
  • It stays on top when you want it around, and clicks pass through so it never blocks anything.

Reefling is my first game, made by one person. I wanted something calm to keep me company while I worked, without it ever getting in the way. That's the whole idea.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the near-future city of “New Uranos,” people’s lives are managed by the AI system EDEN. It calculates optimal choices, corrects deviations within the city, and guides everyone toward what the system considers the “most correct” future.

And you are the chosen “Memory Restorer.”

Through Helios’ restoration device, you can enter the past, investigate events deemed abnormal, and attempt to correct mistakes that should never have happened. Accidents, disappearances, altered records, and inexplicable memory deviations all point to the same question:

Can the past truly be restored?

Enter the Past and Correct What Went Wrong

This is a sci-fi mystery visual novel centered on time regression, memory restoration, AI governance, and multi-ending choices.

You will follow Eli through multiple restoration missions, investigate the truth behind each incident, read records, piece together clues, and make choices at critical moments. Every restoration affects reality. Every choice may create a new deviation in the worldline.

You may believe you are only correcting the past. But before long, you will discover that what has been rewritten may not be limited to events. People’s memories, and even the reality you believe in, may have already been altered.

Her, or the World?

Through repeated restorations, the protagonist gradually approaches the truth hidden by the system. And the girl who once shared an important promise with him returns to his fate once more.

If the optimal solution given by the system demands that you abandon her. If saving her means the world will deviate from its intended future.

Will you obey EDEN’s judgment, or rewrite the so-called optimal solution with your own hands?

Character Introduction

Protagonist: Ciel


A Memory Restorer at Helios.

To uncover the truth left behind by his missing father, he joins the Helios Restoration Division and begins to investigate the machine known as the “Restoration Device.”

Free-spirited and independent, he hates having his life decided for him.
And yet, time and again, he willingly steps into the past, even if it means being forgotten by the world.

Heroine: Lin


A mysterious girl who appears repeatedly in Ciel’s dreams.

She seems to know the truth behind the Restoration Device and keeps trying to stop Ciel from becoming a Restorer.

Her name cannot be found in any record.
But Ciel knows she is not an illusion.

Restoration Division Member: Vera


The head of the Helios Restoration Division.

Calm and elegant, she makes decisions with reason and always protects her team when it matters most.

She understands the rules of the Restoration Division better than anyone.
And she knows better than anyone what kind of cost lies hidden behind them.

Restoration Division Member: Hana


Helios Restoration Division’s intelligence and documentation specialist.

Cheerful and sharp-eyed, she can always find the details others overlook within cold, impersonal records.

She may seem lighthearted, always ready with a teasing remark, but she knows better than anyone that so-called “official records” are not always the truth.

Restoration Division Member: Kyle


A technical specialist in the Helios Restoration Division.

Precise and methodical, he believes in systems, and in the “optimal solutions” calculated by EDEN.

He is one of Ciel’s trusted teammates.
But when truth and order collide, he must decide which side he will stand on.

Game Features

· A sci-fi mystery visual novel set in a near-future AI-controlled city
· A time-regression story centered on “memory restoration”
· Investigate records, compare clues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath altered reality
· A main story woven from multiple characters and interconnected incidents
· Player choices influence the story and lead to different endings
· A story about free will, optimal solutions, memory, and promises

Recommended For Players Who Enjoy

· Visual novels, interactive fiction, and story-driven games
· Time regression, multiple endings, mystery, and detective-style narratives
· Near-future settings, AI governance, and dystopian worldbuilding
· Character relationships, emotional choices, and stories shaped by fate

The past will not reveal the truth on its own.

You must enter it yourself, and choose who will be left behind.

store_data.about_the_game:
Why can't Jim stay faithful?

He doesn't really know himself.

Maybe by stepping into his shoes, you'll finally uncover the answer.

Jim works at a boutique fashion company that designs and sells women's swimwear. It's an unusual workplace for a guy, but he fits in surprisingly well... except for one problem. His charismatic boss has never accepted the meaning of the word "no" and seems determined to keep him under her spell.

Meanwhile, Jim's girlfriend Laura remains blissfully unaware of the complicated web of relationships surrounding him. His demanding boss, his ex-girlfriend, the charming girl from the local sex shop, the seductive club dancer... all of them are part of a life Jim struggles to keep hidden.

Laura is smart, beautiful, and deeply committed to their relationship. She works at a pawn shop specializing in rare vintage music equipment and genuinely believes she and Jim are building a future together. They share affection, trust, passion, and dreams of something lasting.

At least, that's what it looks like on the surface.

But is their happiness real?

Features

  • A story-driven visual novel focused on relationships, temptation, and difficult choices

  • Explore a living city filled with unique locations and memorable characters

  • Sandbox-style gameplay that lets you decide where to go and how to spend your time

  • Multiple story paths and consequences shaped by your decisions

  • Romance, humor, drama, secrets, and betrayal

  • Numerous side stories and character interactions to discover

  • Adult themes and mature relationships

Will you fight to preserve Jim and Laura's relationship, or embrace the chaos of his double life?

The choice is yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

One tank. Two pilots. Zero hope.

Welcome to Tank Mates, where teamwork isn't optional—it's survival.

Control a single tank together as you battle through a brutal military obstacle course packed with deadly traps, impossible jumps, enemy tanks, and explosive surprises. Every movement, every jump, and every shot requires perfect coordination.

One mistake can send both of you flying.

One victory feels legendary.

Whether you're playing online, on the couch, or taking on the challenge alone, prepare for spectacular failures, clutch saves, and the kind of laughter that only comes from complete chaos.

One Tank. Shared Controls.

Forget everything you know about co-op games.

In Tank Mates, you don't each get your own vehicle.

You share one.

One player controls the left side. The other controls the right.

Want to move forward?

Push together.

Need to make a difficult jump?

Time it perfectly.

Trying to destroy an enemy tank?

Aim first. Panic later.

The controls are simple to learn—but mastering them is another story.

Every Obstacle Wants You To Fail.

The military obstacle course isn't here to help.

It's here to test your teamwork.

Fight your way through increasingly dangerous environments filled with:

  • Rivers of lava

  • Massive swinging hammers

  • Explosive minefields

  • Slippery oil-covered roads

  • Enemy tanks

  • Automated turrets

  • Precision platforming challenges

Every obstacle is designed to push your coordination, timing, and patience to the limit.

Every checkpoint feels earned.

Every failure is hilarious.

Play Your Way

Online Co-op

Team up with a friend from anywhere and conquer the chaos together.

Local Co-op

Share the same couch, the same tank... and probably the blame.

Singleplayer

Think you don't need a teammate?

Control both sides of the tank yourself and discover a whole new level of challenge.

Checkpoints (We're Not That Cruel)

Yes, you'll fail.

Probably a lot.

Fortunately, strategically placed checkpoints mean you're never too far from your next attempt.

Dust yourselves off.

Argue about whose fault it was.

Then try again.

Features

  • Unique shared two-player tank controls

  • Chaotic physics-based platforming

  • Online and local co-op

  • Full singleplayer support

  • Battle enemy tanks and automated turrets

  • Deadly military-themed obstacle courses

  • Precision platforming that rewards teamwork

  • Full controller support

  • Designed to challenge your coordination—and your friendship

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into 2006. Emily Parker died after a late-night gathering by the lake. The police ruled it an accident, the case was closed, and life in town moved on.

But someone who knew her best refuses to accept the official story. Desperate and stonewalled by a community that doesn’t want to talk, they quietly reach out to a private investigator - and you, their young trainee, are thrust into your first real case.

With no access to official records and few people willing to speak, your investigation unfolds in an unusual place: the brand-new, wild, and wonderfully messy early internet. This is the dawn of social profiles, personal photo albums, archived local news, and digital breadcrumbs scattered across the web.

High school was already complicated. When teenagers started archiving their lives online, they often revealed far more than they intended.

Piece together what really happened. Search for the right phrases. Examine photos for hidden details. Follow the tangled web of friendships, rivalries, secrets, and lies that a tight-knit town tried to leave behind. Gather information about the people involved, uncover their connections, and build a clearer picture of the events leading up to Emily’s death.

Key Features

  • Authentic 2000s-era digital investigation experience full of early-internet nostalgia

  • Search-driven gameplay: type specific phrases found in the world to unlock new leads, profiles, and evidence

  • Closely examine photos for hidden clues and connections

  • Build your own understanding of relationships, motives, and events using only public digital footprints

GALATRIA

Strap into the cockpit and take the fight across the stars. GALATRIA is a 3D arcade

shoot-'em-up that fuses the relentless wave assault of the best know 80's and 90's Games, the multi-directional mayhem and the fast, replayable package.

Features:

Scrolling 3D battlefields — pilot a fully 3D fighter over hand-crafted stages.

Island labyrinths — after every boss, a floating island maze drifts in from deep space. Thread the corridors at speed; the glowing walls mean instant death.

Dug-in gun emplacements — tanks, towers and spider-turrets track your every move and open fire; the tanks answer with homing rockets.

Boss battles — massive capital ships that don't just vanish when beaten: watch them break apart, burn and drift away.

Arcade feel, modern polish— tight controls, a driving original soundtrack, punchy explosions, and a shield to save you in a pinch.

Controls:

Arrow keys to fly, A to fire, S for your shield — fully rebindable.
Joysticks, Joypads, X-Box Controller

How far into the swarm can you get?

Extras:
- Coop Play together (2 Player Mode) 
- Coop Play against each other side by side in a Split Screen (party VS Mode) (only on 16:9 Resolutions)
- Full Arcade Cabinet Support: (Aspects 3:4 and 9:16)

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD, GROW STRONGER, SURVIVE

There is no truly safe place in the middle of a broken world. That’s why you must create your own. Use what you can find in abandoned structures, deep within the forest, and throughout the world around you to build a shelter that can keep you alive.

Start with a simple cabin and gradually turn it into a stronger, larger, and more livable base. Organize your shelter, craft the items you need, create a place to rest, and prepare for the dangers that come with the night.

But remember: this world does not belong to you. If you want to stay alive, hiding will not be enough. Every piece you collect, every fire you light, and every wall you build will determine your chances of survival.

FIGHT TOGETHER WHEN THE FOG ROLLS IN

Time passes, the weather changes, and every new day turns into a new struggle for survival. In a 24-hour day and night cycle, gather resources, reinforce your shelter, and prepare for the threats ahead.

The direction of the wind can change, rain can suddenly begin to fall, and dense fog can completely destroy your visibility. But the fog is not only a part of nature; it is also a warning sign of one of the greatest dangers. When visibility drops, zombies can become more aggressive and attack from within the darkness and fog.

Try to survive alone or fight against this dangerous world with up to 4-player co-op support. Explore together, defend together, build together, and fight to stay alive.

SURVIVE WITH WHAT YOU HUNT, GROW, AND FIND

Hunger is just as ruthless as the dangers waiting outside. To survive, you will need more than weapons and shelter; you will need food. Search abandoned places for supplies, make use of the resources nature provides, and find a way to feed yourself.

In the forest, you can hunt animals such as deer, process their meat, cook it over a fire, and eat it. But ready-to-eat food will not always be available. Work the soil, plant vegetables such as tomatoes, grow your crops, and use the ingredients you gather to prepare more nutritious meals.

From a simple bite to a warm bowl of soup, every meal you make will directly affect your struggle to survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Draw your path. Survive the dungeon.

Hexborne is a hex-grid dark fantasy roguelite RPG where you draw a single connected line to fight. Inspired by the 2010 mobile cult classic Dungeon Raid, it reimagines one-stroke combat as a modern roguelite.

■ DRAW TO SURVIVE — Core Combat

Connect the weapons, shields, and potions across the hex tiles in a single line.

- Connect SWORDS to attack your enemies

- Connect SHIELDS to raise a protective barrier

- Connect POTIONS to restore your health

Longer chains are more powerful—but they demand greater risk. The board reshapes every turn, and every choice becomes a tactical decision between life and death.

■ ROGUELITE DEPTH

This is no simple puzzle. It carries the depth of a true roguelite.

- Four chapters across a branching world map (events, shops, elite monsters, bosses)

- The Soul Forge: meta-progression that grows permanently between runs

- Classes, crafting, and enchantment systems for fresh strategies every run

■ A DARK FANTASY OF THE LOST

Born with a cursed gift, used as a weapon of war, and left with nothing—this is Kael, the Lost One.

From orcs to the undead, demons, and dragons. Cross the fallen kingdoms and face your fate with the only weapon left to you: a single line.

■ INSPIRED BY A CLASSIC, REBORN FOR TODAY

Dungeon Raid is one of the most beloved—yet forgotten—classics in mobile gaming history. Hexborne revives the feel of its one-stroke combat on a hex grid, adding the depth of a modern roguelite with branching campaigns and meta-progression.

■ DEMO COMING — October 2026

store_data.about_the_game:
Fellow adventurer, turn back while you can! For here begins the roguelike Iter Vehemens ad Necem, a Violent Road to Death. If you choose to travel along it, you will dive into countless exciting adventures to gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes. Unfortunately, along the way you will also often be dangerously injured, poisoned, catch numerous diseases, lose several limbs and transform into manifold different kinds of pitiful creatures in the darkest depths of hostile dungeons. And, at the end of the road, you are bound to perish in a most gruesome and painful way.

Don't say we didn't warn you.

IVAN History

The first alpha (0.301) was released in 2001 by Timo "holybanana" Kiviluoto,  Heikki "hexi" Sairanen, and Tuukka "Kahvi" Virtaperko. In 2006 the original developers moved on to other projects. This is a fan continuation of IVAN by members of the Cathedral of Attnam forum (since 2013). Join us on for news, updates, discussion of planned features, or anything else regarding the game. Also the IVAN3D mod by Zeno Rogue is added (which adds an option to view the world in first-person perspective, similar to classic dungeon crawlers).

IVAN can be classified as a "hacklike" -- a roguelike heavily borrowing from NetHack. Hacklikes extend Rogue's signature "time moves only when you move" exploration/combat style and procedurally generated maps with a high degree of simulationism: various effects can potentially equally affect the player character as well as other creatures, items, walls (and, in case of IVAN, even bodyparts). Hacklikes heavily influenced more modern simulationist masterpieces such as Dwarf Fortress, Spelunky, Minecraft, Noita, and Caves of Qud. As you might have already noticed, your road to death is quite violent. While most hacklikes have non-permadeath modes, the developers of IVAN swore to never discard permadeath (although, as in some other hacklikes, another character can later find the body, with all the loot the dead character still had; and technically the included "wizard mode" can be used to play with the simulation and explore the world without fear).

Note: the descriptions below were written in the early 2000s, when "roguelike" had a clear meaning (an RPG using Rogue's exploration/combat style) and it was indeed unusual for a roguelike to have this level of graphical detail.

Body part system

Remember Monty Python and the Holy Grail? All body parts in IVAN have separate armors and separate hit points. After you've found your first good weapons, you will be able to reduce some monsters to helpless torsos by mutilating them frivolously! The game rewards brutality by showing its results graphically. Brutality can also be applied to you, though, so it's best to have a remedy available in case of a lost limb.

Material and equipment system

Unlike any other roguelike, there is a certain definition in IVAN for, say, a longsword. However, the material of a longsword can be anything at all. If you have been lucky enough to get a scroll of change material, you will be able to turn your 'iron longsword' to a 'mithril longsword', but also to a 'bread longsword' if you, for some reason, wanted to eat a bread that is shaped like a longsword (I'm not saying it's a good idea, but it's not impossible). Another example: you might also want to turn your 'leather boots of strength +1' to much stronger 'phoenix feather boots of strength +1'. Besides allowing you to upgrade your equipment in a fresh way, the material system makes it possible for the game engine to easily generate lots of different objects in the dungeons for your use and amusement.

Graphic effects

IVAN has advanced graphics more than comparable to many modern roguelikes. "But graphics are useless in a roguelike!" you might exclaim. You would probably reconsider such an opinion when following a wounded and panicked monster according to its trail of blood. Each god has its own specialties and altars, and you will be able to affect your own alignment by the way you play. And on the top of all that, IVAN's storyline will keep you pumped with its unique events!

IVAN works pretty much in the same way as other roguelikes. The player controls a character, which moves and attacks from the direction keys. All other commands can be found by pressing '?' key in the game.

Fellow adventurer, turn back while you can! For here begins the roguelike Iter Vehemens ad Necem, a Violent Road to Death. If you choose to travel along it, you will dive into countless exciting adventures to gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes. Unfortunately, along the way you will also often be dangerously injured, poisoned, catch numerous diseases, lose several limbs and transform into manifold different kinds of pitiful creatures in the darkest depths of hostile dungeons. And, at the end of the road, you are bound to perish in a most gruesome and painful way.

Don't say we didn't warn you.

IVAN History

The first alpha (0.301) was released in 2001 by Timo "holybanana" Kiviluoto,  Heikki "hexi" Sairanen, and Tuukka "Kahvi" Virtaperko. In 2006 the original developers moved on to other projects. This is a fan continuation of IVAN by members of the Cathedral of Attnam forum (since 2013). Join us on for news, updates, discussion of planned features, or anything else regarding the game. Also the IVAN3D mod by Zeno Rogue is added (which adds an option to view the world in first-person perspective, similar to classic dungeon crawlers).

IVAN can be classified as a "hacklike" -- a roguelike heavily borrowing from NetHack. Hacklikes extend Rogue's signature "time moves only when you move" exploration/combat style and procedurally generated maps with a high degree of simulationism: various effects can potentially equally affect the player character as well as other creatures, items, walls (and, in case of IVAN, even bodyparts). Hacklikes heavily influenced more modern simulationist masterpieces such as Dwarf Fortress, Spelunky, Minecraft, Noita, and Caves of Qud. As you might have already noticed, your road to death is quite violent. While most hacklikes have non-permadeath modes, the developers of IVAN swore to never discard permadeath (although, as in some other hacklikes, another character can later find the body, with all the loot the dead character still had; and technically the included "wizard mode" can be used to play with the simulation and explore the world without fear).

Note: the descriptions below were written in the early 2000s, when "roguelike" had a clear meaning (an RPG using Rogue's exploration/combat style) and it was indeed unusual for a roguelike to have this level of graphical detail.

Body part system

Remember Monty Python and the Holy Grail? All body parts in IVAN have separate armors and separate hit points. After you've found your first good weapons, you will be able to reduce some monsters to helpless torsos by mutilating them frivolously! The game rewards brutality by showing its results graphically. Brutality can also be applied to you, though, so it's best to have a remedy available in case of a lost limb.

The year is 2247. Mars has fallen.

The Martian Liberation Council has seized control of the planet's Helio-X energy supplies — and without them, Earth faces collapse. You are the commanding general of the Earth Coalition Forces. Your mission: retake Mars.

Red Reconquest is a turn-based hex strategy game inspired by the classic Panzer General series. Fight across 8 scenarios from the initial landing in the Hellas Basin to the final assault on New Olympus — the fortified MLC capital built from Ossium, an indestructible Martian biological material.

FEATURES

  • 8 hand crafted scenarios across diverse Martian terrain

  • Combined arms warfare — tanks, infantry, artillery, air support, engineers and naval units

  • Persistent campaign — units gain experience and carry across scenarios

  • Voice acted briefings from General Obi, Commander Voss and Belt Council Chief Zara Vane

  • Engineer mechanics — demolish walls, breach gates, build bridges

  • Naval warfare — transport troops and engage shore batteries

  • Urban combat — fight through three distinct city districts in the finale

  • Prestige system — earn points to buy, repair and upgrade your forces

  • Four difficulty levels from Easy to Iron General

Mars is waiting, General. The fate of the solar system is in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
A turn-locked cyberpunk roguelike built around high-stakes, quick-time duels, deep build theorycrafting, and an infinite prestige loop.

Master the Rhythm of Death

Combat is turn-locked, but execution is real-time. Take your offense turn, weather the enemy’s assault, and defend. Every action is a precise quick-time event: a marker sweeps across a bar.

  • Hit the Success Zone: Your action connects.

  • Hit the PERFECT Band: You unlock the real power—massive damage crits, preserved streaks, and free turns.

There is no attack-speed stat to cheese and no throughput to optimize. Winning comes down to reading the timing better than the machine trying to kill you. Build up your class Ultimate to break the turn rhythm entirely, unleashing a reactive burst that rewards raw execution.

Choose Your Framework

Pick from a roster of distinct classes that fundamentally change how a run plays out:

  • The Glass Cannon: Trade half your health pool for a tripled attack.

  • The Masochist: Gain catastrophic power the more debuffs and drawbacks you stack.

  • The Juggernaut: Convert incoming kinetic damage directly into personal shielding.

Draft Your Cyberware

Between combat waves, draft lethal cyberware modules from a shifting deck. Build around what the QTE system rewards: wider success windows, tighter perfect bands, streak scaling, or raw sustain. Lower-rarity pieces hit well above their weight class—if you're willing to eat their nasty downsides.

The Radial Skill Tree

Earn Cores to fund a massive, radial skill tree that fans out from a central node. Small stat nodes sit close to the center, leading out to game-changing Notables, and paradigm-shifting Keystones at the absolute edges.

The catch? The tree is not permanent. It resets every reboot, allowing you to completely re-forge your build path on every single descent.

Sectors, Bosses, and Stolen Powers

Fight your way through brutal sectors, each driven by its own track of cold, heavy phonk. Every tier culminates in a boss with a signature mechanic designed to break you—freezing your reaction windows, flipping your inputs, or dragging you into a psychological tug-of-war. Kill the boss, steal its signature, and use it as your own.

Reboot. Adapt. Repeat.

Beating the game is just the baseline framework. Once you successfully conquer a full descent, you unlock the ability to Reboot. This ultimate prestige wipe clears your current cyberware and skill tree, plunging you into a significantly harsher version of the sectors with lethal, evolving enemy behaviors (regenerating shields, low-HP frenzies, and active healing).

In exchange for wiping your temporary progress, you permanently bank rewards to carry forward into the next, harder cycle:

  • The Tarot Deck: A pixel-art prestige card system layered over the endgame.

  • Permanent Buffs & Drawbacks: A custom portfolio re-selected each run.

  • Boss Signatures: Equipped directly into your build.

  • Mutually-Exclusive Identities: Meta-progression frameworks that reshape the core loop.

The climb is capped, so a deeper sector never outruns what you've banked. How many Reboots can your system handle?

Retro-Futuristic Violence

Run inside a simulated CRT terminal packed with heavy scanlines, chromatic aberration, violent screen-shake on crits, and explosive particle effects. Powered by a dark cyberpunk phonk soundtrack built on dry 808 cowbells, the music dynamically shifts to match the aggression of the zone.
