store_data.about_the_game:
Rust & Ruin is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a scrapyard arena. You'll draw, gamble, and spend your way through every fight, building a bot that can survive whatever's thrown at it.

Each battle, you'll draw 5 random cards from your bot's arsenal. Keep your hand and fight, or gamble your coins to redraw for better odds, just know the cost climbs with every redraw. Every card has its own power, cooldown, and exchange value, so deciding what to play and what to bench matters as much as the draw itself.

Win fights to earn money, then head to the chip store between rounds to upgrade your bot's parts and capabilities.

Every run plays out differently, shaped by the calls you make along the way.

KEY FEATURES

  • Draw your hand, take your chances :5 procedurally generated cards every round, no run plays the same twice

  • Redraw or commit: gamble your coins for better odds, but watch the cost climb each time

  • Manage cooldowns and value: every card has its own power, downtime, and payoff

  • Upgrade between fights: spend your winnings on chips to boost your bot

  • Fast, tactical robot battles: built for quick decisions and high stakes

  • Roguelike progression: every choice you make shapes your run

Build your deck. Upgrade your bot. Survive the arena.

🤖 Made for GameJam+ 🤖

store_data.about_the_game:
Gods Shall Tremble

Forge legends from blood, bone, and cold mathematics.

Gods Shall Tremble is a gladiator management sim and auto battler of absurd depth and mind bending amounts of customisation options. Master tactical combat and millions of customisations, build an unstoppable stable, and immortalize your champions... or watch them fall permanently in brutal PvP brackets.

About The Game

Tactical Combat with Real Depth

Gods Shall Tremble features a deeply tactical combat system driven by six core stats, five attack styles, five defensive maneuvers and personalised fight plans.. as well as an absurd amount of customisation with 67.5 million Behavioral Combinations, and 15 million unique equipable items.

  • Stamina is King: Fatigue actively scales your stats downward. Will you blow your energy on a reckless opening assault, or play the long game? Defensive strategies are genuinely viable because mindless aggression is swiftly punished.

  • Dynamic Battlefields: Arena effects like blinding dust storms, noxious fumes, and deafening roars trigger mid-combat, permanently altering stats.

  • Emergent Chaos: Watch your back. Wild beasts can randomly storm the arena mid-fight, turning a tense duel into an unpredictable, three-way struggle for survival.

  • Living Commentary: Dynamic move descriptions and your fighters abilities change based on your fighter's current energy. Even the world’s greatest champions throw sloppy strikes when they are gasping for air.

Micro-Manage Your Ludus

Every gladiator is a blank canvas waiting to be carved into a legend.

  • 7.5+ Trillion Name Combinations: Roman-style naming systems with dynamic nicknames ensure you will never see the same fighter twice. You could reroll names every second for 235,000 years and not see the same name twice.

  • Physique Matters: Height and weight alter performance. Heavy, towering fighters hit with devastating force but lack mobility, while short, light fighters excel at swift evasion.

  • Deep Training & Fight Plans: Individually train 16 distinct attributes across a 10-tier progression system. Configure your gladiator's AI with precise Fight Plans—adjusting their aggression, effort, and favored attack frequencies to counter your next opponent.

  • No Meta: Your training is capped so that you cannot simply max every stat, you can train up to 10,000 points of a possible 15,000 for your base stats, and 10,000 points out of 12,500 for each of the attack and defense moves, so every fighter will have to make sacrifices and have exploitable weaknesses. Agility is not the god stat, and the meta is simply the counter to the 10 people around you on the leaderboard.

Procedural Loot: 15 Million Items

Optimize your fighters with a massive, procedurally generated equipment system built from four distinct layers: Quality, Prefix, Material, and Item Type, with additional Set bonuses which can be run at full strength, or half strength for twice the possible combinations.

  • Explore 50 weapon types across 5 distinct categories (Spears, Katanas, Battleaxes, and more) and 50 unique armor types.

  • Discover gear forged from 20 different materials across 10 quality tiers ranging from Broken to Legendary—with high-tier loot actively boosting specific skill percentages.

  • Find 50 rare Sets that add behavioural perks to your fighters, that can be equipped at a full set for game changing bonuses, or 2 broken sets that add half strength bonuses for even more customisation combinations.

  • Manage your empire via a comprehensive Market and a robust Sell Tab featuring advanced filtering to quickly liquidate unwanted gear and give you the coin to buy gear in the global market. With 15 million items, the loot rains down, and a 'Sell All' button becomes a notable feature!

Build Your Unique Combat Identity: 67.5 Million Behavioral Combinations

Shape how your gladiators fight with 90 game-changing combat modifiers split across Common, Rare, and Legendary tiers, as well as 50 set bonuses for your items, which creates a staggering 67.5 Million behavioural combinations for your fighters.

No two fighters will ever be the same.

  • Perks and Sets add behavioral actions and status effects like bleed damage stacking, vampiric health steal, blinding status effects, just to name a few.

  • Defensive Trees: Specialize your defense with bonuses such as damage reflection, enhanced tanking capabilities and guaranteed counter-attacks.

  • Risk/Reward & Synergies: Combine high-stakes perks like Blood Gamble (HP drain for massive crits) with synergistic abilities like Opportunist to deal devastating bonus damage to debuffed targets.

Six Distinct Game Modes

Whether you prefer climbing the ranks against real players or tackling brutal endgame PvE content, there is always an arena waiting.

  • PvE game modes are not restricted in any way. Play how you want, when you want. You can fight the floor 10 Boss as your first fight in the Shattered Ascent if you choose, and farm any fight for loot with no limits at all.

  • Colosseum (PvP Ladder): Battle in a competitive ranked ladder that resets every two weeks. The #1 fighter in each tier is crowned champion and immortalized forever.

  • Tournaments: Every Colosseum season if capped off with huge tournaments crowning a champion, or you can enter 32-man single-elimination brackets with automatic matchmaking at any time. Or if you're looking for even higher stakes... Enter monthly Permadeath Tournaments for big account prizes... where if your fighter dies, they are gone forever.

  • Shattered Ascent: A brutal 100-floor PvE tower scaling through Mortal, Unnatural, and Immortal difficulties with huge prizes and more loot than you can count, resetting every week with more Player created Bosses to test your skills against.

  • Lair of Legends: Farm five weekly Godslayer-tier bosses to collect pieces of 50 unique Armor Sets, which grant massive combat bonuses that stack with your perks.

Death Is Not The End: The Legacy System

Your fighters will leave a permanent mark on the game world, alive or dead.

  • Retirement: Max out a Godslayer and retire them with honor. They will permanently become a boss in the Lair of Legends defending the Set items for other players on the server to hunt.

  • The Fallen: Fighters lost in permadeath tournaments don't just disappear, they resurrect as bosses defending the Shattered Ascent.

  • Account Prestige: Build your Ludus leaderboard ranking globally. Each retired Godslayer grants permanent account bonuses—giving you faster training speeds and better loot drops for your next generation of recruits.

Wishlist now.

No two fighters will ever be the same.

  • Perks and Sets add behavioral actions and status effects like bleed damage stacking, vampiric health steal, blinding status effects, just to name a few.

  • Defensive Trees: Specialize your defense with bonuses such as damage reflection, enhanced tanking capabilities and guaranteed counter-attacks.

  • Risk/Reward & Synergies: Combine high-stakes perks like Blood Gamble (HP drain for massive crits) with synergistic abilities like Opportunist to deal devastating bonus damage to debuffed targets.

Six Distinct Game Modes

Whether you prefer climbing the ranks against real players or tackling brutal endgame PvE content, there is always an arena waiting.

  • PvE game modes are not restricted in any way. Play how you want, when you want. You can fight the floor 10 Boss as your first fight in the Shattered Ascent if you choose, and farm any fight for loot with no limits at all.

  • Colosseum (PvP Ladder): Battle in a competitive ranked ladder that resets every two weeks. The #1 fighter in each tier is crowned champion and immortalized forever.

  • Tournaments: Every Colosseum season if capped off with huge tournaments crowning a champion, or you can enter 32-man single-elimination brackets with automatic matchmaking at any time. Or if you're looking for even higher stakes... Enter monthly Permadeath Tournaments for big account prizes... where if your fighter dies, they are gone forever.

  • Shattered Ascent: A brutal 100-floor PvE tower scaling through Mortal, Unnatural, and Immortal difficulties with huge prizes and more loot than you can count, resetting every week with more Player created Bosses to test your skills against.

  • Lair of Legends: Farm five weekly Godslayer-tier bosses to collect pieces of 50 unique Armor Sets, which grant massive combat bonuses that stack with your perks.

Death Is Not The End: The Legacy System

Your fighters will leave a permanent mark on the game world, alive or dead.

  • Retirement: Max out a Godslayer and retire them with honor. They will permanently become a boss in the Lair of Legends defending the Set items for other players on the server to hunt.

  • The Fallen: Fighters lost in permadeath tournaments don't just disappear, they resurrect as bosses defending the Shattered Ascent.

  • Account Prestige: Build your Ludus leaderboard ranking globally. Each retired Godslayer grants permanent account bonuses—giving you faster training speeds and better loot drops for your next generation of recruits.

Wishlist now.

致敬英雄坛说，重新设计了游戏内容。

这是一款复古像素武侠GMUD游戏，开放世界，自由探索。

按键操作

纯键盘操作，方向键↑↓←→控制人物移动或菜单选项，Enter键交互或确认，Esc键弹出菜单、关闭或取消，空格键轻功传送。

探索地图

探索地图上可以交互的人和物，获取信息，了解故事，获得隐藏物品。

加入门派

6个风格不同的门派：三清宫、万佛寺、天策府、文衡院、血煞门、凝霜剑派，每个门派有自己的武功体系、招式、绝招。

秘术

寻找不同的NPC学习秘术，提升属性或者解锁新功能。

异宝

获取不同作用的异宝，每一件都可以带来游戏体验的提升。

技艺

  • 烹饪：制作食物，非战斗时恢复

  • 炼药：制作药物，战斗时恢复

  • 炼丹：制作灵丹，提升人物四维属性

  • 钓鱼：钓鱼换钱，概率钓到宝箱

装备

  • 类型：武器、衣服、腰带、鞋子、戒指、项链、耳环

  • 属性：数值浮动，次级词条随机获得

  • 强化：最高强10，等级越高属性提升越多失败风险越大

战斗

回合制战斗，和NPC一决高下，获取NPC掉落的装备和物品。

更多游戏内容等你发现...

store_data.about_the_game:
Match. Chain. Conquer

Vexbound is a free tactical puzzle-battler RPG where a single slide can turn into a cascade of formations, walls, spells, and champion strikes.

Slide troops to line up matching units. Vertical formations charge attacks. Horizontal rows raise defensive walls. Trigger multiple formations at once, chain combos to refund actions, evolve your charges into bigger hits, and break the enemy hero before they break you.

A Puzzle Board With Real Tactics

Behind the simple rules is a deep tactics game about timing, pressure, defense, and explosive turns.

  • Line up troops to charge attacks and build walls.

  • Chain combos to turn one move into a cascade.

  • Summon elites and champions with unique abilities.

  • Cast hero spells to reshape the board and swing the duel.

  • Evolve formations to multiply damage and set up devastating strikes.

  • Read your rival, block their charges, and counter at the perfect moment.

Three Ways To Play

  • Campaign — Battle through a story-driven journey across the five Seals.

  • Quick Battle — Jump into a fast duel against the AI with your own army loadout.

  • Ranked Online — Challenge friends by room code or climb the global ELO leaderboard against players around the world.

Five Seals. Five Ways To Win.

Each faction is bound to an ancient Seal, with its own hero, troops, champions, spells, and battle plan.

  • The Crown — Radiant zealots with blazing attacks and holy walls.

  • The Veil — Mirror-born tricksters using curses, glass, and reflection.

  • The Gild — Gilded war-engines built around armor, siege, and relentless value.

  • The Hush — Drowsing wardens with slow, crushing, unstoppable weight.

  • The Maw — A bloodthirsty horde built for speed, fury, and all-out pressure.

Fair From The First Match

Every faction, hero, champion, spell, and relic is unlocked from the start. No pay-to-win shortcuts. No locked competitive toolkit. The same pieces are available to everyone — victory comes from strategy.

Built For Fans Of Tactical Puzzle Battles

If you love lining up units, setting traps, building defenses, and watching one clever move explode into a board-wide combo, Vexbound is made for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
SIGNAL//LOSS is a minimalist arcade survival game about keeping a collapsing signal alive.

Rotate the phase needle, tune drifting signal rings, and hold alignment long enough to sync the system before the signal tears itself apart. Each run starts readable, then escalates into faster rings, hostile glitches, screen noise, and split-second survival decisions.

Features:

  • Fast one-more-run arcade survival

  • Simple touch controls: steer the needle and hold the signal

  • Multiple unlockable difficulty modes, from DRIFT to TERMINAL COLLAPSE

  • Beneficial and hostile signal motes that change the run in real time

  • Archive entries that reveal the game’s signal anomalies as you encounter them

  • Best Sync tracking and mode-specific leaderboards

  • Clean neon pixel-art presentation built around rings, waves, and signal corruption

Tune the rings. Hold the signal. Delay the collapse.

store_data.about_the_game:
NEON SURGE is a fast, brutal, easy-to-pick-up single-player twin-stick arena shooter. You aim — your ship fires on its own. So it's all about movement: dash through bullets with brief i-frames, hold back ever-harder waves, and between them pick 1 of 3 roguelite upgrades. Every run becomes a different build.

Every pixel is drawn in code, with zero external assets — a clean, glowing vector-neon look with particles, screen shake, hit-stop and combo multipliers that make every hit feel good.

8 ships, 8 ways to play

From piercing cannons to ultra-high-fire-rate ghosts — each ship has its own stats, sound, ultimate and animated parts. Level them up and unlock PREMIUM ships through achievements.

10 worlds, 10 vibes

NEON, VAPORWAVE, THERMAL, retro CARTRIDGE, BLUEPRINT, GLITCH, BLACKOUT and more — every world re-skins the arena with its own visual identity.

7 game modes

  • ARCADE — endless waves + upgrades. The classic.

  • CRUNCH — 3 minutes. Score as high as you can.

  • SURVIVAL — nonstop swarm. Last as long as you can.

  • CHASE — the clock drains. Kill to keep living.

  • DAILY CHALLENGE — same seed for everyone that day. Daily leaderboard.

  • DEFENSE — protect the core. Satellites help you shoot.

  • BOSS RUSH — only bosses, one after another.

Take on the bosses

Encounters with cutscenes, phases, telegraphs and real weight behind every hit.

Highlights

  • A real roguelite: 1 of 3 each wave, synergies, drones and ascension Pacts

  • 360° aim and movement with auto-fire and an i-frame dash

  • Polished game feel: particles, screen shake, hit-stop, neon glow

  • Full Xbox controller support (auto-detect) + keyboard & mouse

  • 6 languages (PT, EN, FR, ES, DE, IT)

  • Achievements and a persistent per-mode high score

Made with Godot Engine 4.6.

About the Game

Take the helm as the owner of a pro baseball team. Sign players, develop them, build your roster, and lead your team to the title — all while working within a limited budget. A deep, authentic baseball management simulation.

Key Features

Run Your Franchise
Salaries, player signings, facility investments — winning takes smart money management.

Build Your Roster

  • Draft: Pick rookies each year and uncover future stars.

  • Free Agency: Sign stars from rival teams — or fight to keep your own from leaving.

  • Returning Stars: Bring back players coming home from overseas leagues.

  • Foreign Imports: Scout reinforcements from around the world.

Player Growth & Fate
Players develop with age, then gradually decline. Sudden breakouts where hidden potential erupts, season-changing injuries, star players departing for overseas leagues — every player has a story of their own.

Compete for the Pennant
Battle through a full 143-game season, claim the pennant, and rise all the way to the top.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the near future, the world is a dangerous and broken place. Robots have taken over most jobs, rapidly increasing human unemployment. The world's largest economies are falling apart, as the ultra rich hoard wealth and let the poor suffer. Worst of all, there is no universal basic income, the younger generation need to find a job to survive.

Story:

You play as a young job hunter invited to your first interview at Do No Harm, a mega-tech corporation. Everything is going well... that is, until you fail the interview and get stuck in a timeloop.

Key Features:

  • Role-playing in an immersive, first-person environment. The game includes action, choices and consequences, character dialogue and skill selection.

  • Hand-crafted locations, in a realistic office environment with many surprises and secret areas.

  • A game filled with people, some of whom are monsters. This creates empathy with the game characters and enhances the realism of the game world.

  • Multiple solutions to problems and character development choices ensure a varied game experience. Use your skills, wit, or violence to resolve quests with multiple endings.

  • Story-rich: a focused, detailed story based on robotics and advancements in technology. Find unusual and surprising plot twists.

store_data.about_the_game:
GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown is a Living World RPG where you travel through a living, ever-changing fantasy world.

Begin your journey as a lone traveler in a medieval high fantasy setting. Explore villages, forests, rivers, and ancient roads while encountering monsters, bandits, merchants, and adventurers throughout your adventure.

The people of this world are more than quest givers. NPCs have their own daily routines, occupations, goals, and relationships. Villagers work, merchants travel between towns, adventurers explore dangerous areas, and events gradually shape the world around you.

Combat takes place seamlessly on the field without loading into a separate battle screen. Explore, engage enemies, defeat them, and continue your journey without breaking immersion.

During the tutorial, you begin your adventure alongside a wolf companion. As development continues, additional companions, jobs, equipment, regions, quests, and gameplay systems will become available.

The demo allows players to experience the core gameplay of GEKOKUJO within the Northern Forest Region, including exploration, NPC interaction, seamless combat, quests, and save/load functionality.

The full release is planned to greatly expand the world with new regions, professions, companions, monsters, events, and ultimately a living world inhabited by more than 1,000 NPCs.

Key Features

• Living World RPG with an evolving fantasy world

• NPCs with daily lives, occupations, goals, and relationships

• Seamless real-time field combat

• Explore a medieval high fantasy world at your own pace

• Character progression through equipment, jobs, and companions

• A world that changes through events and rumors

• Demo featuring the Northern Forest Region

• Full version planned to feature a living world with over 1,000 NPCs

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to PlantUp – where cozy gardening meets organized chaos

In PlantUp, you grow plants, process your harvest into valuable products, and serve impatient customers before they run out of patience. What begins calmly with a few carrots quickly turns into a hectic workday full of routes, orders, machines, upgrades, and decisions under time pressure.

Your little plant shop grows day by day – and so does the chaos. Plant carrots, corn, tomatoes, fruit trees, and flowers, make popcorn, soups, smoothies, or flower bouquets, and find out how to make your workflow more and more efficient.

Two game modes, many challenges

Endless Mode

Take on an increasingly demanding workday and try to survive for as many days as possible. Customer requests become more complex, new products are introduced, and every mistake can cost you valuable lives. Plan ahead, optimize your routes, and use upgrades to withstand the growing pressure.

Campaign

Experience varied levels with different maps, exciting quests, and special challenges. Each task puts you in a new situation: sometimes every second counts, sometimes you need clever preparation, perfect production chains, or smart use of limited space.

Grow together with your shop

Earn gold, improve your production, unlock new machines, automate workflows, find helpful upgrade cards, and turn stress into control step by step. In PlantUp, it is not just about becoming faster – it is about planning smarter, reacting better, and mastering the chaos.

  • Grow plants, fruit trees, and flowers

  • Process your harvest into more valuable products such as popcorn, soups, smoothies, and flower bouquets

  • Serve customers under time pressure and earn more when you work efficiently

  • Play Endless Mode and try to last longer and longer

  • Experience a campaign with different levels, challenges, quests, and maps

  • Unlock upgrades and new mechanics that change the way you play

  • Optimize routes, production, and preparation to turn chaos into a working system

Cozy? Yes. Relaxing? You decide!

PlantUp combines the charm of a colorful plant shop with the pressure of a fast-paced management game. It is a game about growth, planning, and the art of staying calm at the right moment – even when the shop is sinking into complete chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Instruct a robot. Resolve hostage situations. No programming experience required!

Welcome to the unit, rookie.

Hostage crises plague the city, and you're assigned to combat them using a new tool: a programmable tactical robot.
Analyze each situation, create a plan, and execute it to save the hostages!

Choose your loadout

Equip your robot with the tools you want or need.
Guns, lasers, explosives, or maybe you will mostly use the environment. You decide!

Solve puzzles your way

There are no fixed solutions.
Every situation can be resolved in multiple ways using logic, creativity, or pure chaos.
Do you want to be quick and efficient, or do you prefer something a bit silly?

Optimize

Each situation has extra optional optimization challenges:

  • Fast solutions: well-liked by the hostages

  • Minimal instructions: great for code reviewers

  • Cheap resolutions: the budget department's favorite

A wide variety of puzzles

Solve over 40 unique hostage situations, and more than 20 harder variations for those who want a bigger challenge.

Instruct with ease

Use dropdowns to add instructions; no prior knowledge is required.

Prefer quick coding? Type your instructions to build solutions even faster.

We can't wait to see what solutions you'll create!
